title: World-Model-Grounded LLM Planning for AUV and ASV Navigation Near Offshore Wind Farms
relevance_to_user: 该论文将世界模型与LLM规划结合用于海洋机器人导航，其物理仿真和模型预测控制方法可迁移至生物力学仿真与植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, FEA-based biomechanics, or any medical device design context; it focuses on marine robot navigation.

summary_zh.motivation: 大语言模型缺乏物理感知，难以判断动作时长和碰撞风险。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理世界模型、梯度轨迹优化器和MPC闭环重规划器，结合LLM实现导航。
summary_zh.result: 在AUV和ASV上实现零碰撞，GazeboSim误差降低70-93%。
summary_zh.validation: 在GazeboSim仿真中验证，并对比无世界模型基线。

summary_en.motivation: Large language models lack physical intuition, making it difficult to determine action durations and avoid collisions in dynamic environments.
summary_en.method: A physics-grounded neural world model, a three-phase gradient-based trajectory optimizer, and an MPC-style closed-loop replanner with trust-region guard are integrated with an LLM planner.
summary_en.result: Both AUV and ASV achieve zero predicted collisions across five missions, with GazeboSim goal-distance error reduced by 70-82% (ASV) and ~93% (AUV) after residual fine-tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed in GazeboSim simulations with ocean currents, waves, and thruster dynamics, comparing against an ungrounded baseline.

visual.caption: Fig. 1 : Why an LLM planner needs a world model (ASV variant shown; the same contrast holds for the AUV, without the VLM stage). Without grounding (left), the LLM’s plan drifts into the turbine tower; with the world model (right), the same plan receives physically feasible step durations and reaches the goal collision-free. The ASV’s inputs additionally include a gridded map classified by a vision-language model and enriched with forecast wind/current/wave data (Section IV-F ); the AUV instead uses pre-dive obstacle boxes (Section III ), with no VLM stage.

summary_en.result: The review highlights the superior energy absorption of sheet-based TPMS and the stable deformation plateaus of functionally graded structures, while summarizing biomedical applications for stress shielding elimination.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is included; the findings are based on a critical review of existing literature.

summary_en.validation: The approach was validated on ten diverse tasks including synthetic functions and real-world chemical optimizations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高Péclet输运问题中边界层导致的代理模型精度不足。
summary_zh.method: 在DeepONet的trunk网络中结合Chebyshev多项式与AAA算法构造的有理字典。

summary_en.motivation: To improve surrogate model accuracy for singularly perturbed transport problems with thin boundary layers.
summary_en.method: A rationally enriched Chebyshev trunk for DeepONet, combining Chebyshev polynomials with rational functions from the AAA algorithm.
summary_en.result: The proposed trunk reduces profile errors by up to 60.2% compared to vanilla DeepONet and suppresses spurious oscillations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical benchmark problems with varying singular perturbation parameters.

title: LLMs as Acquisition Policies for Finite-Pool Materials Optimization: A Controlled Study
relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨将LLM作为主动学习中的采集策略，虽面向材料优化，但其方法可迁移至生物力学或植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on materials optimization with LLM-based acquisition policies.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低昂贵材料评估中的采样成本，探索LLM作为采集策略的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 在四个有限池材料优化任务中，对比五种LLM与GP方法及随机选择，并测试不同候选呈现策略。
summary_zh.result: LLM策略通常优于随机选择，但与GP相比性能混合，且对任务和呈现方式敏感。
summary_zh.validation: 基于四个回顾性材料优化基准任务进行数值对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the cost of evaluating materials candidates, this study explores whether open-weight LLMs can serve as standalone acquisition policies in active learning.
summary_en.method: Five LLMs were evaluated across four retrospective finite-pool materials optimization tasks under different candidate presentation strategies, and compared with random selection and Gaussian process baselines.
summary_en.result: LLM policies generally outperform random selection but show mixed performance relative to GP methods, with high sensitivity to task, model, initialization, and presentation.
summary_en.validation: The study uses retrospective numerical benchmarks on four materials optimization tasks, without experimental validation.

why_not_core: 该论文未涉及生物医学或植入物力学，也未进行有限元分析或接触力学建模，因此与FEA代理建模方向无直接关联。

summary_zh.motivation: 针对LNG储罐热分层和蒸发气预测中CFD计算昂贵、经验公式精度低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于300组实验数据，训练七种机器学习模型并集成随机森林、梯度提升和MLP，结合Bootstrap区间量化不确定性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost of CFD and the low accuracy of empirical correlations in predicting LNG tank thermal stratification and boil-off gas generation.
summary_en.method: An ensemble machine learning framework combining Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and Multi-Layer Perceptron was developed, trained on 300 experimental records, with bootstrap prediction intervals for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The ensemble model achieved superior predictive accuracy (R²=0.90, RMSE=0.11 kg/h) compared to empirical correlations and CFD-RANS, and time-series forecasting reached R²=0.968.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated against experimental data, with performance benchmarked against empirical correlations and CFD simulations, and agreement assessed via Bland-Altman analysis.

title: Complementary, Not Cumulative: Interaction Effects in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Navier-Stokes Vortex Shedding
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了PINN中不同训练技巧的组合效应，对构建高效的FEA代理模型具有方法学参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not consider constraints or multi-objective optimization relevant to the user's direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究PINN训练技巧的组合效应，而非单独验证。
summary_zh.method: 在DFG/Schafer-Turek圆柱绕流基准上系统测试多种技巧的组合。
summary_zh.result: 仅SIREN激活与因果加权组合有效，误差4.1%，更多技巧反而导致性能下降。
summary_zh.validation: 与OpenFOAM参考解对比，计算平均相对L2误差。

summary_en.motivation: The paper investigates whether commonly used PINN training techniques compose effectively, rather than being validated in isolation.
summary_en.method: A systematic ablation study is conducted on the DFG/Schafer-Turek unsteady cylinder wake benchmark, testing combinations of techniques including periodic activations and causal weighting.
summary_en.result: Only the combination of SIREN activations and causal weighting achieves accurate reconstruction (4.1% relative L2 error), while adding more techniques degrades performance.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated by comparing predicted velocity and pressure fields against an OpenFOAM reference solution on a standard benchmark.

title: Calibrated, robust, and physically consistent uncertainty quantification in deep-learning surface-wave shallow shear-velocity inversion
first_author_affiliation: Guangxi Vocational College of Safety Engineering

corresponding_authors.name: Yangkai Ou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering and Management, International College, Krirk University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的校准与鲁棒不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但应用领域为地球物理反演，与植入物设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization; it focuses on seismic inversion with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 确定性反演缺乏不确定性，现有概率方法校准不足。
summary_zh.method: 用混合密度网络预测速度分布，结合共形校准与增强鲁棒变体，并检查物理一致性。
summary_zh.result: 校准后覆盖率精确，区间宽度缩小，但严重分布偏移下仍有欠覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 基于公开基准数据集测试，评估覆盖率与物理一致性。

summary_en.motivation: Deterministic inversion provides only point estimates without uncertainty, and existing probabilistic approaches lack calibration and robustness.
summary_en.method: A mixture density network is trained to output depth-wise velocity distributions, enhanced with conformal calibration and an augmentation-based robust variant, and physical consistency is checked via forward modeling.
summary_en.result: Calibration improves coverage accuracy and narrows intervals, but severe distribution shifts still cause under-coverage.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a large-scale public benchmark, evaluating coverage, robustness to noise and geological shifts, and physical consistency.

title: An end-to-end differentiable transient vapor-compression framework for automated machine sizing and unified optimal control
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了可微物理仿真与最优控制的统一框架，其方法可迁移至基于有限元代理模型的植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, bone mechanics, or FEA-based surrogate modeling; it focuses on vapor-compression systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速热泵电气化，需要统一设备选型与动态控制。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于JAX的可微有限体积框架，共享物理内核实现选型与MPC。
summary_zh.result: 预测制冷能力MAPE为7.37%，控制误差在1.19%-1.62%内。
summary_zh.validation: 利用公开实验数据和硬件在环轨迹验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate heat pump electrification, a unified framework is needed to integrate equipment sizing and dynamic control.
summary_en.method: A differentiable finite-volume framework in JAX is proposed, sharing a compiled physics kernel for both simulation and MPC.
summary_en.result: The framework predicts cooling capacity with 7.37% MAPE and bounds control error within 1.19%-1.62%.
summary_en.validation: Validated against open experimental benchmarks and hardware-in-the-loop traces.

title: Adaptive replication strategies in trust-region-based Bayesian optimization of stochastic functions
first_author_affiliation: Université Côte d'Azur, Inria, CNRS, LJAD

corresponding_authors.name: Mickaël Binois
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Université Côte d'Azur, Inria, CNRS, LJAD

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在信任域框架下结合自适应复制的高斯过程优化方法，可迁移到生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks biomedical context, and does not include uncertainty quantification in the sense of predictive intervals for design outputs.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决随机仿真优化中目标函数方差大、评估成本高的问题。
summary_zh.method: 在信任域框架内结合高斯过程模型与自适应复制策略，改进采集函数和成本感知评估。
summary_zh.result: 自适应复制显著提升计算效率并保持解精度，尤其在评估成本高时。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验与基线方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to improve the efficiency of stochastic simulation optimization when the objective function has high variance and evaluations are costly.
summary_en.method: It integrates Gaussian process modeling within a trust-region framework and introduces adaptive replication mechanisms, including modified acquisition functions and cost-aware evaluation strategies.
summary_en.result: The proposed method, OGPIT, substantially improves computational efficiency while preserving solution accuracy compared to baselines, especially when evaluation costs are considered.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical experiments on benchmark problems, comparing against baseline optimization approaches.

title: ADAPT: Physics-Aware Diffusion-based World Models for Adaptive Predictive Transferable HVAC Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文将世界模型与物理感知正则化结合用于建筑暖通控制，其方法可迁移至基于物理的仿真代理建模，但与植入物力学或生物打印无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant mechanics, FEA-based design, or bioprinting; it focuses on HVAC control in buildings.

summary_zh.motivation: 建筑能耗高且室内热响应延迟，现有控制方法泛化性差。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理感知条件扩散世界模型，结合热平衡正则化与强化学习。
summary_zh.result: 在IID和OOD场景下分别降低能耗7.3%和不适30.2%，鲁棒性优于基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在SemibuildingSim和Sinergym模拟环境中验证。

summary_en.motivation: The paper addresses the challenge of HVAC control in buildings, where delayed thermal responses and partial observability hinder generalization to unseen environments.
summary_en.method: It introduces ADAPT, a physics-aware conditional diffusion world model that predicts thermal baselines and uses a learnable heat-balance regularizer to enforce thermodynamic consistency, integrated with reinforcement learning.
summary_en.result: ADAPT reduces energy consumption by 7.3% and occupant discomfort by 30.2% over state-of-the-art baselines in IID settings, and maintains robust performance under out-of-distribution scenarios.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through extensive experiments on the SemibuildingSim and Sinergym building simulators.

title: A model predictive control framework for assistive standing balance recovery in lower limb exoskeletons
first_author_affiliation: Systems Design Engineering, University of Waterloo, 200 University Ave W, Waterloo, N2L 3G1, Ontario, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Keaton A. Inkol
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Systems Design Engineering, University of Waterloo, 200 University Ave W, Waterloo, N2L 3G1, Ontario, Canada

relevance_to_user: 该论文将模型预测控制应用于下肢外骨骼的辅助站立平衡，其控制框架和仿真方法可迁移到生物力学仿真与植入物设计优化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve FEA-based implant mechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface modeling, and it lacks experimental validation on human subjects or physical exoskeleton hardware.

summary_zh.motivation: 为下肢外骨骼开发辅助站立平衡恢复的控制策略。
summary_zh.method: 采用模型预测控制框架，结合多体动力学模型进行平衡控制。
summary_zh.result: 仿真表明该控制方法能有效辅助站立平衡恢复。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多体动力学仿真案例验证控制效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a control strategy for lower limb exoskeletons to assist standing balance recovery.
summary_en.method: A model predictive control framework is formulated using a multibody dynamics model of the exoskeleton and human.
summary_en.result: Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller in restoring balance during standing.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through multibody dynamics simulation cases, without physical experiments.

title: A feature-dimension-adaptive physics-informed neural network for cross-operational state of health prediction of lithium-ion batteries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种特征维度自适应的物理信息神经网络，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但应用领域为电池健康预测，与植入物设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, finite element analysis, or any biomedical context; it focuses on battery state of health prediction, so the method is transferable but not directly applicable to the user's FEA surrogate direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升跨工况锂电池健康状态预测的准确性与泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出特征维度自适应的物理信息神经网络，动态调整输入特征维度以适配不同工况。
summary_zh.result: 在跨工况预测中取得了优于传统方法的精度与稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于公开电池数据集进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and generalization of lithium-ion battery state of health prediction across different operating conditions.
summary_en.method: A feature-dimension-adaptive physics-informed neural network is proposed, which dynamically adjusts the input feature dimension to adapt to varying operating conditions.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior accuracy and stability compared to conventional approaches in cross-operational prediction tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on public battery datasets.

title: Unified bending analysis of plates via a data-free physics-informed neural network
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, National University of Singapore, Singapore 117575, Singapore

corresponding_authors.name: Lin Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Engineering Mechanics, School of Civil Engineering, Shandong University, Jinan 250061, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无数据的物理信息神经网络方法用于板弯曲分析，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统板弯曲分析依赖数据或网格的问题，实现无数据求解。
summary_zh.method: 采用物理信息神经网络，将控制方程和边界条件作为损失函数，无需训练数据。
summary_zh.result: 在多种板弯曲案例中准确预测位移和应力，验证了方法的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准案例与解析解或有限元解对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable plate bending analysis without relying on labeled data or meshing, by embedding governing equations into a neural network.
summary_en.method: A data-free physics-informed neural network is constructed, where the loss function incorporates the governing PDEs and boundary conditions, and training is performed via automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately predicts displacement and stress fields for various plate bending scenarios, demonstrating its capability as a meshless solver.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted through numerical benchmark problems, comparing predictions with analytical or finite element solutions.

title: Uncertainty quantification in Bayesian full waveform inversion based on underdamped Langevin Markov Chain Monte Carlo
first_author_affiliation: 1Jilin University, College of Exploration Science and Technology, Changchun 130026, China
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于Langevin动力学的贝叶斯采样方法可迁移至有限元代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on geophysical full waveform inversion.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统全波形反演无法量化不确定性，MCMC收敛慢。
summary_zh.method: 采用欠阻尼Langevin动力学结合Strang和OBABO分裂格式高效采样后验分布。
summary_zh.result: 两种分裂格式均能有效探索高概率区域，Strang收敛更快且计算开销更低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个数值算例验证了方法的有效性和初始模型不敏感性。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional full waveform inversion lacks uncertainty quantification and MCMC methods are computationally prohibitive for high-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: The authors develop an underdamped Langevin dynamics framework with Strang and OBABO splitting schemes to efficiently sample the posterior distribution.
summary_en.result: Both splitting schemes effectively explore high-probability regions, with Strang showing slightly faster convergence and lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on two numerical examples, demonstrating robust posterior statistics and insensitivity to initial model choice.

title: Root-Inspired Bio-Interlocking Structure Design and Its Mechanism on Enhancing the Interfacial Bonding of NiTi/Ti6Al4V Fabricated by MM-LPBF

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Centre for Laser Extreme Manufacturing, Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology and Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Ningbo 315201, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多材料LPBF制备NiTi/Ti6Al4V界面的仿生互锁结构，虽未直接涉及应力遮挡或骨整合，但其界面强化机制和力学测试方法对生物医用植入物的多材料增材制造具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses on interfacial shear strength of dissimilar metal joints without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多材料LPBF制备NiTi/Ti6Al4V界面易开裂脱层的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出根状仿生三维互锁界面结构，改变分支角度和尺寸倍数，系统研究其对界面性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 60°-1.5结构使剪切强度提升至128.37 MPa，较45°-1.2组提高6倍以上，失效模式转为混合模式。
summary_zh.validation: 通过剪切测试、TEM和微观组织观察验证界面强化机制。

summary_en.motivation: To address the issue of brittle cracking and delamination at the interface of NiTi/Ti6Al4V dissimilar metals fabricated by multi-material laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: A root-inspired three-dimensional bio-interlocking interface structure was proposed, and the effects of branching angle and size multiplier on interfacial quality, microstructure, and mechanical properties were systematically investigated.
summary_en.result: The optimized 60°-1.5 structure increased the average shear strength to 128.37 MPa, more than six times that of the 45°-1.2 group, and changed the failure mode to a mixed mode involving crack deflection and plastic tearing.
summary_en.validation: The study employed shear testing, TEM analysis, and microstructural observation to validate the interfacial strengthening mechanism.

title: Progressive Experience Fusion for Multi-Task World Model Control in Endovascular Navigation
relevance_to_user: 该论文将世界模型与模型预测控制应用于血管介入导航，其方法可迁移至基于有限元仿真的植入物设计优化，但未涉及生物力学或结构仿真。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or structural simulation; it focuses on endovascular navigation in vascular anatomies.

summary_zh.motivation: 为偏远地区提供自动血栓切除导航，需应对多阶段血管路径。
summary_zh.method: 提出渐进经验融合训练多任务TD-MPC2控制器，并采用自适应规划时域启发式。
summary_zh.result: 在训练解剖结构上成功率74%，在未见血管上达90%，并成功迁移至体外患者血管。
summary_zh.validation: 在已知和未知血管模拟及体外荧光透视下验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable autonomous endovascular navigation for mechanical thrombectomy in underserved areas, controllers must handle long multi-stage paths across varied anatomies.
summary_en.method: The paper introduces Progressive Experience Fusion (PEF) to train a multi-task TD-MPC2 controller, combined with an adaptive Model Predictive Path Integral horizon heuristic and patient-specific fine-tuning.
summary_en.result: PEF achieved 74% mean success on training anatomies, 90% on held-out vasculatures, and improved path ratio from 63% to 80% in an in vitro patient-specific setting after fine-tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validation included simulations on known and held-out vascular anatomies and an in vitro fluoroscopy experiment with a patient-specific phantom.

title: Process Optimization Under Uncertainty for Improving the Bond Quality of Polymer Filaments in Fused Filament Fabrication
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化和高斯过程代理模型用于增材制造工艺优化，其方法可迁移至植入物有限元代理建模与稳健设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, bone-implant interface mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on polymer filament bond quality in FFF, not on FEA surrogate for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: FFF工艺中丝材间粘合质量受多种不确定性影响，需量化并优化。
summary_zh.method: 耦合瞬态热传导与烧结颈生长模型，结合Sobol灵敏度分析和GP代理模型，将不确定性和模型偏差纳入优化。
summary_zh.result: 所提不确定性优化框架显著提高FFF产品丝材间粘合质量。
summary_zh.validation: 通过物理实验校准和验证物理模型及最优解。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to optimize fused filament fabrication process parameters to maximize inter-filament bond quality while accounting for uncertainties in the predictive models.
summary_en.method: A transient heat transfer model coupled with a sintering neck growth model is used to estimate bond quality, and a Gaussian process surrogate is constructed to incorporate model discrepancy into a variance-based sensitivity analysis and subsequent optimization under uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The proposed optimization framework under uncertainty yields high bond quality between adjacent filaments, demonstrating the effectiveness of including uncertainty and model discrepancy in process parameter optimization.
summary_en.validation: Physical experiments were conducted to calibrate and validate the physics model and to confirm the optimal solution.

title: Physics-Unrolled Neural Operator for Wireless Field Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理展开神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但其应用领域为无线场建模，与植入物设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical context; it focuses on wireless field prediction with ray-tracing simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 无线场高保真模拟成本高，机器学习需高效预测。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理展开混合神经算子，三级级联逐步捕获反射、衍射和散射效应。
summary_zh.result: 在图像质量和无线部署指标上优于多种基线模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种室内平面图上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity wireless field simulation is computationally expensive, motivating machine learning surrogates that can predict radio maps efficiently.
summary_en.method: The paper introduces a physics-unrolled hybrid neural operator that cascades three stages to progressively model reflection, diffraction, and scattering effects from low-fidelity ray-tracing inputs.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms image-to-image baselines, wireless-specific models, and monolithic neural operators on both image quality and deployment metrics.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through numerical experiments on diverse indoor floorplans, comparing against multiple baseline models.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : PU-HNO predicts high-fidelity radio maps from low-fidelity inputs and intermediate-fidelity supervision.

title: Multi-stage neural operator learning with application for convolutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多阶段神经算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，以提高采样效率和精度。
why_not_core: 该论文仅针对卷积算子进行数值验证，未涉及生物医学有限元问题、植入物力学或不确定性量化。

summary_zh.motivation: 加速卷积积分计算，提高算子学习精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出DCNO和DGNO两种多阶段神经算子框架，逐步构建基算子。
summary_zh.result: 在卷积问题上精度接近机器精度，且多次查询效率高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证，并与传统求解器对比。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate convolution integral computations and improve the accuracy of operator learning.
summary_en.method: Two multi-stage neural operator frameworks, DCNO and DGNO, are proposed, which progressively construct basis operators via supervised residual learning or unsupervised weak-form PDE residual minimization.
summary_en.result: Both methods achieve near machine precision for convolution problems and provide substantial efficiency gains for multiple queries or parametric variations.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated through extensive numerical experiments on convolution problems, comparing accuracy and efficiency against traditional solvers.

title: Function-On-Function Regression Through Separable Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的可分离神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on function-on-function regression with oceanographic data.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统函数型回归多限于线性模型，需处理一般回归算子。
summary_zh.method: 提出可分离神经算子，用输入依赖系数和输出依赖基函数表示回归算子。
summary_zh.result: 在温和光滑条件下证明估计量一致性，并应用于BGC Argo数据。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理论证明和海洋数据案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To extend function-on-function regression beyond linear models by leveraging neural operators for general regression operators.
summary_en.method: Introduces a separable neural operator architecture that represents the regression operator via input-dependent coefficient functions and output-dependent basis functions.
summary_en.result: Establishes consistency of the estimator under mild smoothness and sampling conditions and demonstrates applicability on BGC Argo oceanographic data.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical consistency proofs and a numerical case study on real oceanographic data.

summary_zh.result: 实现约1.1e5倍加速，R²>0.94，并在30次高保真评估内找到非直观最优微结构。
summary_zh.validation: 与高保真数值求解器（如LBM）对比验证预测精度与加速比。

summary_en.motivation: The inverse design of stochastic heterogeneous materials is hindered by combinatorial complexity and high computational cost of multiphysics simulations.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a graph-based surrogate modeling framework that discretizes volumetric tomography into permutation-invariant graphs and employs specialized GNN architectures (Pore-GNN and Long-Short-Edge MeshGraphNets) combined with active learning for efficient design space exploration.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves approximately 1.1e5-fold end-to-end speedup in permeability prediction with R²>0.94, and identifies an optimal anisotropic microcapsule configuration within only 30 high-fidelity oracle evaluations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated by comparing predictions against high-fidelity numerical solvers (e.g., Lattice Boltzmann Method) across multiple random splits.

title: Adaptive surrogate modeling for high-dimensional spatio-temporal output
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，用于处理高维时空输出和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: 该论文未涉及植入物或生物力学背景，也未进行实验验证，仅以燃气轮机叶片热力分析为例。

summary_zh.motivation: 高维时空输出代理模型构建困难，需高效采样策略。
summary_zh.method: 先降维至低维潜空间，再构建代理模型，并采用探索与利用结合的自适应采样。
summary_zh.result: 在燃气轮机叶片热力分析中验证了方法有效性，以最少样本提升精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟案例验证，无实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: The construction of surrogate models for high-dimensional spatio-temporal outputs is challenging, necessitating efficient sampling strategies to minimize expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: The method first reduces the high-dimensional output to a low-dimensional latent space via dimension reduction, then builds a surrogate in that space, and employs an adaptive sampling strategy combining exploration and exploitation to select new training points.
summary_en.result: The proposed method was demonstrated on a thermo-mechanical analysis of a gas turbine engine blade, achieving improved surrogate accuracy with fewer expensive model runs.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through a numerical simulation case study, without experimental data.

summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmark problems without experimental data.

summary_en.method: The paper proposes a computationally efficient algorithm for structural uncertainty quantification that handles stochastic loading inputs.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves significant computational savings while maintaining accuracy in uncertainty estimates.

why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or surrogate modeling for expensive simulations; it focuses on dynamic system identification in control theory.

summary_zh.motivation: 为动态系统辨识提供兼具数据驱动灵活性与不确定性输出的方法。
summary_zh.method: 构建线性动态GP与静态GP互联的深度高斯过程模型。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to develop a system identification method for dynamical systems that combines the flexibility of data-driven neural network approaches with probabilistic output for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: It proposes a deep Gaussian process model constructed by interconnecting linear dynamic GPs and static GPs to capture both linear dynamics and static nonlinearities.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates effective system identification performance on both simulated and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using numerical benchmarks with simulated and real-world data.

summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元模拟案例验证预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: The motivation is to develop an efficient surrogate model for predicting excavation-induced longitudinal heave in existing shield tunnels, reducing reliance on expensive finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: The method employs a weak physics-informed neural network that integrates partial physical constraints with finite element simulation data to enhance prediction accuracy and generalization.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach achieves accurate predictions of longitudinal heave and demonstrates improved generalization over purely data-driven models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through finite element simulation cases, comparing the network's predictions against simulated results.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于变分约束的物理信息神经网络，可降低高阶自动微分和采样成本，对提高FEA代理模型的训练效率具有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not demonstrate transferability to FEA surrogate modeling for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN在高维问题中计算成本高、精度受限。
summary_zh.method: 提出FC-VPINN，将强形式PDE约束转化为变分约束，降低导数阶数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个多维PDE上误差降低约一个数量级，内存占用降至40%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维对流扩散、三维扩散和三维泊松方程数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PINNs suffer from high computational costs and limited accuracy in multidimensional problems due to high-order derivatives and sampling demands.
summary_en.method: The proposed FC-VPINN reformulates strong-form PDE constraints into variational constraints for self-adjoint operators, reducing the derivative order in the loss function.
summary_en.result: FC-VPINN achieves about one order of magnitude lower prediction errors and reduces memory usage to 40% of the baseline across several multidimensional PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks including 2D advection-diffusion, 3D diffusion, and 3D Poisson equations.

title: Variational Outlier-Robust Gaussian Process Regression with Generative Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的鲁棒高斯过程回归方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的异常数据处理，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or biomechanical design; it focuses on robust Gaussian process regression for general datasets.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高斯过程回归对异常值敏感的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出生成式GPR模型，结合变分广义期望最大化算法学习潜在变量和模型参数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上，预测精度优于或媲美现有鲁棒GPR方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上进行了数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the adverse effects of outliers on Gaussian process regression, which typically assumes Gaussian observation noise and thus becomes inaccurate in contaminated settings.
summary_en.method: A generative GPR model with observation-specific contamination is introduced, and a variational generalized expectation-maximization procedure is developed to infer latent variables and model parameters.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves competitive or superior prediction accuracy compared to robust GPR baselines across synthetic and real datasets under various contamination levels.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical experiments on synthetic and real datasets with different contamination settings.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索无需发泡剂直接打印多孔金属材料。

summary_en.motivation: To demonstrate the feasibility of fabricating stochastic porous intermetallic alloys via LPBF without foaming agents, overcoming limitations of conventional powder metallurgy.
summary_en.method: Fe-25Al-1.5Ta samples were fabricated by LPBF with varying scan speeds at elevated build-plate temperature, and their pore architecture, microstructure, and compressive behavior were characterized.

title: Physics-informed neural networks for modeling infiltration and solute transport in porous media

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on porous media flow and solute transport, lacking FEA validation for solid mechanics or biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效模拟多孔介质中水流和溶质运移，避免传统数值求解器的非线性收敛问题。
summary_zh.method: 开发半隐式混合有限元高保真求解器，并构建嵌入控制方程的PINN进行前向和逆向建模。
summary_zh.result: PINN与高保真有限元结果吻合，验证了其在耦合流动-输运建模中的潜力。
summary_zh.validation: 与解析解、已有数值代码和实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop efficient physics-constrained models for simulating water infiltration and solute transport in porous media, overcoming convergence issues of traditional nonlinear solvers.
summary_en.method: A semi-implicit mixed finite element solver is developed as a high-fidelity benchmark, and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained with embedded governing equations for forward and inverse modeling.
summary_en.result: The PINN predictions agree well with the finite element solver, demonstrating its potential for coupled flow-transport simulations.
summary_en.validation: The models are validated against analytical solutions, established numerical codes, and experimental datasets.

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINN formulations for inverse problems suffer from high sensitivity to initial guesses, leading to local convergence, which motivates a more robust training strategy.

summary_en.validation: The method is validated on one-dimensional porous medium equation problems using manufactured and analytical solutions, with comparisons to classical numerical methods.

summary_zh.method: 在LPBF制备的18Ni马氏体钢紧凑拉伸试样中嵌入狗骨形韧带，通过裂纹桥接降低应力强度因子。

summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳裂纹扩展实验验证，并分析裂纹闭合与桥接机制。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to develop a novel additive manufacturing-enabled strategy for enhancing fatigue life in monolithic metals through location-specific extrinsic toughening mechanisms.
summary_en.method: Compact tension specimens of 18Ni(300) maraging steel were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion with strategically placed unbonded dog-bone-shaped ligaments that engage as crack-bridging elements along the anticipated crack path.

summary_zh.method: 构建PINN代理模型，嵌入弹塑性本构与边界条件，直接预测位移场并导出应力应变，结合MSQP与SSSA计算安全系数。
summary_zh.result: 两个算例表明该方法预测应力应变与安全系数精度高，与商业软件一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个算例与商业软件结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional data-driven slope stability methods often ignore physical principles, so a physics-informed approach is needed to improve accuracy and interpretability.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) surrogate is developed by embedding elastoplastic constitutive equations and boundary conditions into the loss function, enabling direct prediction of displacement and stress-strain fields, which are then coupled with multi-initial point sequential quadratic programming and slip surface stress analysis to compute the factor of safety.
summary_en.result: The proposed PINN-based method accurately predicts stress-strain responses and factor of safety in two illustrative examples, matching commercial software results.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through two simulation cases comparing against commercial software outputs.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及热响应性生物墨水的合成与打印，但未集成AI，仅可作为生物打印材料背景参考。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not address autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发兼具热响应性和机械稳定性的生物墨水，以支持多种增材制造技术。
summary_zh.method: 合成含胺基的POEGMA二嵌段共聚物，结合热凝胶和光交联，实现可打印墨水。
summary_zh.result: 墨水具有剪切变稀和快速恢复特性，成功用于挤出打印和体积增材制造，并保持细胞活性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过流变学、打印实验和体外细胞培养验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop thermoresponsive bioinks that combine reversible thermal gelation with sufficient mechanical stability for advanced additive manufacturing techniques.
summary_en.method: Synthesized POEGMA-based diblock copolymers with pendant amine groups, enabling temperature-induced physical gelation and subsequent photo-induced chemical crosslinking.
summary_en.result: The inks exhibited shear-thinning behavior and rapid recovery, were successfully processed via extrusion and volumetric additive manufacturing, and supported fibroblast and keratinocyte viability.
summary_en.validation: Rheological characterization, printing tests, and in vitro cytocompatibility assays were performed.

title: Finding the Needle in a Haystack: Test-Time Analog Circuit Representation Adaptation for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的测试时表示自适应方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的贝叶斯优化，提升采样效率并处理约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA or biomechanics; it focuses on analog circuit topology search, lacking any biomedical or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 固定嵌入表示与优化目标不匹配，降低贝叶斯优化效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出TTARO，在线调整电路表示并联合学习高斯过程代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 相比固定嵌入和DKL，平均后悔AUC降低15.2%和20.7%。
summary_zh.validation: 在40种编码器/核/采集设置下进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Fixed circuit embeddings used in Bayesian optimization are misaligned with the optimization objective, reducing sample efficiency.
summary_en.method: TTARO adapts circuit representations online by jointly learning a nonlinear feature transformation and a Gaussian-process surrogate using labels from evaluated designs.
summary_en.result: TTARO reduces regret AUC by 15.2% on average over standard BO and 20.7% over DKL across 40 settings, with up to 46.7% reduction.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on analog circuit topology search, comparing against multiple baselines.

After TTARO, the FoM exhibits substantially stronger spatial organization, with high-performing candidates concentrated within a more coherent region. This objective-aligned geometry allows the Gaussian-process kernel to assign greater similarity to circuits with comparable performance, improving surrogate…

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过熵工程优化LPBF工艺，提高合金致密度和疲劳性能，对生物医用植入物的增材制造工艺优化具有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, and lacks any biological or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决激光增材制造金属构件中孔隙和缺陷导致疲劳性能下降的问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用CoCrNi与316L混合粉末，通过打印过程中熵的时序变化实现近无缺陷的致密化。
summary_zh.result: 获得相对密度>99.99%的合金，疲劳裂纹扩展抗力和腐蚀性能显著优于传统中/高熵合金。
summary_zh.validation: 结合宏观致密化分析、SEM/EBSD和TEM微观表征及疲劳测试。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome porosity and structural defects in laser-based additive manufacturing that degrade long-term mechanical properties such as fatigue and corrosion resistance.
summary_en.method: A single-step entropy engineering strategy integrating CoCrNi and 316L powders to modulate entropy evolution during printing, thereby optimizing melt pool spreading and microstructure.
summary_en.result: Achieved a near-void-free medium-entropy alloy with relative density exceeding 99.99%, exhibiting superior fatigue crack growth resistance and corrosion performance compared to conventional PBF-LB/Med alloys.
summary_en.validation: Validated through multi-scale characterization (SEM/EBSD/TEM) and mechanical testing including fatigue and corrosion assessments.

title: BTF-PINN: Enforcing Dirichlet Boundary Conditions Without Boundary Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需边界训练的PINN变体，可提高求解偏微分方程的精度和效率，对开发面向生物力学模拟的代理模型具有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not consider biomechanical constraints or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非插值方法求解Dirichlet边界问题的困难，避免边界训练开销。
summary_zh.method: 提出BTF-PINN，通过设计无边界损失函数将本质边界条件嵌入变分形式，并证明等价性与收敛性。
summary_zh.result: 在高维、不规则几何和各向异性椭圆方程上验证有效，边界迹精度优于标准边界惩罚PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试与标准PINN对比，展示边界精度提升。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the challenges of enforcing homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions in non-interpolatory methods without incurring boundary training costs.
summary_en.method: Proposes a boundary-training-free PINN that embeds essential boundary conditions into a novel boundary-free loss function, with theoretical equivalence and convergence guarantees.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior boundary trace accuracy and effectiveness on high-dimensional, irregular, and anisotropic elliptic problems compared to standard boundary-penalty PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on diverse elliptic PDEs, comparing against standard PINNs.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钛表面微纳层级结构对骨整合的影响，与AM生物医学材料方向相关，但未涉及增材制造或力学性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve additive manufacturing (LPBF), mechanical testing (fatigue or static), or stress shielding/stiffness matching; it focuses on surface topography and biological osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究微纳层级钛表面对骨整合的增强作用。
summary_zh.method: 通过热酸和碱处理制备三维纳米粗糙钛表面，表征理化性质并评估细胞行为。
summary_zh.result: 三维纳米表面促进成骨分化，显著提高大鼠种植体骨整合强度。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和动物体内植入实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether hierarchical micro/nano titanium surfaces enhance early osseointegration of dental implants.
summary_en.method: Three-dimensional nano-roughened titanium surfaces were fabricated via combined hot acid and alkaline treatments, and their physicochemical properties, protein adsorption, and osteoblastic responses were characterized.
summary_en.result: The hierarchical surfaces exhibited higher nanospike density and anisotropy, promoted osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in vitro, and significantly increased osseointegration strength in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro cell assays with mouse bone marrow stromal cells and in vivo implantation in rat maxillary molars.

title: Analysis of Error Propagation in Autoencoder-Based Reduced-Order Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究神经ODE降阶模型的误差传播分析，其方法可迁移至基于FEA的代理模型不确定性量化，但未涉及工程仿真或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not connect to engineering simulation (e.g., FEA/FEM data, design optimization) nor to biomedical implant/biomechanics contexts, focusing instead on abstract PDE systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经ODE降阶模型长期外推误差行为差异大，需分析误差传播机制。
summary_zh.method: 提出路径积分恒等式分离局部误差注入与放大，用多步Jacobian范数表征传输敏感性。
summary_zh.result: Burgers系统误差有界，Gray-Scott系统外推时误差显著放大。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers和Gray-Scott数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Neural ODE reduced-order models exhibit similar local accuracy but divergent long-horizon extrapolation, motivating a theoretical analysis of error propagation.
summary_en.method: A path-integral identity is developed to separate local discrepancy injection from amplification, with multi-step Jacobian norms quantifying transport sensitivity.
summary_en.result: Burgers systems show bounded errors dominated by local discrepancies, while Gray-Scott systems display pronounced amplification during extrapolation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Burgers and Gray-Scott benchmark systems validate the theoretical analysis.

title: A clinically translatable coating-free strategy for 3D-printed porous titanium implants: TiO2 nanotubes simultaneously prevent infection and promote bone integration
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔钛植入体的表面改性，与AM生物医学方向相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能匹配。
why_not_core: This paper does not report stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or mechanical characterization of the porous structure; it focuses solely on surface nanotube modification for antibacterial and osseointegration outcomes.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决3D打印钛植入体感染与骨整合不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 在多孔钛表面原位生长TiO2纳米管，实现无涂层抗菌与促成骨。
summary_zh.result: 纳米管表面显著抑制细菌并促进骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞与细菌实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the dual challenges of infection and insufficient osseointegration in 3D-printed porous titanium implants.
summary_en.method: In-situ growth of TiO2 nanotubes on the porous titanium surface to provide a coating-free antibacterial and osteogenic modification.
summary_en.result: The nanotube-modified surface effectively inhibited bacterial adhesion and enhanced osteogenic differentiation in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro assays with bacterial cultures and osteoblast-like cells were employed to evaluate antibacterial and osteogenic performance.

title: A Convergence‐Based Correction Framework for Finite Effects in Tensile Lattice Structures
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering Opole University of Technology  Opole Poland
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对拉伸晶格结构有限尺寸效应的收敛校正框架，其方法可迁移至增材制造多孔植入物的刚度匹配与应力屏蔽分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or implant-bone interface mechanics, nor does it include LPBF fabrication or fatigue testing; it focuses on numerical correction of effective modulus for lattice structures under tension.

summary_zh.motivation: 拉伸晶格结构的有效模量受单元数影响，缺乏代表性准则。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于收敛的数值框架，用指数模型描述模量收敛并建立校正因子图。
summary_zh.result: 校正后预测更接近实验，但仅适用于各向同性缩放域。
summary_zh.validation: 与实验拉伸测试对比验证校正效果。

summary_en.motivation: The effective Young's modulus of periodic lattice structures under tension depends on the number of unit cells, yet representativeness criteria are lacking.
summary_en.method: A convergence-based numerical framework is proposed, employing an exponential model to describe modulus convergence and generating correction factor maps for non-representative domains.
summary_en.result: Corrected predictions align better with experimental tensile data for most configurations, but the correction is limited to isotropically scaled domains.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated by comparing corrected predictions with experimental tensile tests on lattice specimens.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or bone mechanics, nor does it apply surrogate modeling to biomedical FEA; it focuses on automotive crash safety.

summary_zh.motivation: 碰撞测试中胸部变形预测需量化不确定性，以提高安全评估可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯神经网络基于正面碰撞试验数据构建预测模型，输出预测分布。
summary_zh.result: 模型能提供预测不确定性，提升对胸部变形预测的置信度。
summary_zh.validation: 基于正面碰撞试验数据验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the reliability of chest deflection predictions in frontal impact scenarios by quantifying predictive uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian neural network is trained on frontal impact test data to produce probabilistic predictions of chest deflection.
summary_en.result: The model yields uncertainty estimates that improve confidence in chest deflection predictions.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated using frontal impact test datasets.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将迭代反演与深度学习结合的方法，其梯度引导和结构增强策略可迁移至有限元代理模型的构建与优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on geophysical electromagnetic inversion.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电磁反演中初始模型依赖和正则化平滑问题，提高薄层和复杂结构分辨能力。
summary_zh.method: 将有限迭代高斯牛顿反演与轻量U-Net结合，通过数据失配自适应加权和动量平滑迭代更新模型。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据上多层结构误差降低49%，均方根误差降低28.6%，优于PINN和纯U-Net。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和美国Fox River野外数据上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of gradient-based inversion methods for time-domain airborne electromagnetic data, which suffer from initial model dependence and regularization-induced smoothing, especially for thin layers and complex resistivity structures.
summary_en.method: A gradient-guided iterative enhancement (GGIE) inversion is proposed, combining a limited-iteration Gauss-Newton inversion with a lightweight U-Net, where adaptive weighting and momentum smoothing balance data-driven structural enhancement with physics-based data consistency.
summary_en.result: On synthetic data, the method reduces mean relative error and RMSE by 49.0% and 28.6% for complex multilayer structures, and outperforms PINN and U-Net baselines in data misfit reduction.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic datasets and applied to field data from the Fox River area, Wisconsin, USA.

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了4D生物打印和牺牲性生物墨水制造无支架骨植入物的方法，虽未直接应用AI，但其可扩展生物制造流程对AI驱动的生物打印质量控制具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate any AI/ML methods into the bioprinting workflow, nor does it address autonomous decision-making or experimental validation of AI models.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决临界尺寸骨缺损治疗中组织工程植入物可扩展性不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用流变学适配的牺牲性海藻酸盐生物墨水进行高细胞密度3D生物打印，并通过EDTA溶解形成无支架植入物。
summary_zh.result: 植入物在体内经历软骨内骨化，形成皮质骨、小梁骨和骨髓腔，且通过生物反应器实现人尺寸概念验证。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外软骨-成骨分化表征和免疫缺陷小鼠体内植入验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of scalable fabrication methods for dense cellular constructs that can recapitulate native fracture healing for critical-size bone defects.
summary_en.method: A 4D biofabrication process combining 3D bioprinting with rheologically competent sacrificial alginate bioinks, followed by selective EDTA-mediated dissolution to yield scaffold-free implants.
summary_en.result: The implants underwent endochondral ossification in vivo, forming cortical and trabecular bone with marrow compartments, and scale-up to human-sized constructs was achieved via a suspension bioreactor.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro characterization of chondro-osteogenic markers and in vivo implantation in immunocompromised mice.

title: Real-Time Predictionof Hydrogen Explosions InvolvingFuel Cell Vehicles Using a Physics-Informed Transformer Model
first_author_affiliation: Ministry of Emergency Management , , ,
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了物理信息Transformer作为CFD替代模型的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA context; it focuses on hydrogen explosion CFD surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统数据驱动方法难以捕捉爆炸场时空演化，需高效实时预测。
summary_zh.method: 提出火焰正则化的物理信息Transformer，嵌入火焰传播与超压耦合关系。
summary_zh.result: 模型R²达0.94，推理仅需2.33秒，实现快速后果评估。
summary_zh.validation: 基于CFD生成的城市街区爆炸数据库进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional data-driven models struggle to capture spatial interactions and transient evolution in hydrogen explosions, necessitating an efficient real-time surrogate.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Transformer with a flame-informed regularization mechanism is developed to embed the coupling between flame propagation and overpressure evolution into the learning objective.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high prediction accuracy (R²≈0.94) and fast inference (2.33 s), enabling rapid consequence assessment for urban hydrogen safety.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against a high-fidelity CFD benchmark database of hydrogen explosions in representative urban blocks.

title: Process-fracture mapping of a DLP-printed photopolymer using Bayesian active learning and surrogate-based sensitivity analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了贝叶斯主动学习与高斯过程回归在稀疏实验数据下高效映射工艺-性能关系的方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型构建与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, nor does it involve implant mechanics, stress shielding, or biomechanical context; it focuses on experimental fracture testing of a photopolymer.

summary_zh.motivation: DLP打印件断裂性能受多工艺参数影响，实验表征成本高。
summary_zh.method: 用贝叶斯主动学习结合高斯过程回归，从少量实验数据构建工艺-断裂映射代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型预测准确，识别出UV曝光时间为关键参数，并量化了参数交互效应。
summary_zh.validation: 通过28组实验和留一交叉验证评估模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: The fracture performance of DLP-printed polymers depends on multiple interacting processing parameters, making exhaustive experimental characterization impractical.
summary_en.method: A data-efficient framework combining Bayesian active learning with Gaussian process regression was used to build a surrogate model mapping processing parameters to fracture resistance, with DIC-assisted experiments.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieved high training accuracy and identified UV exposure time as the dominant factor, with significant interaction effects revealed by Sobol analysis.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated using leave-one-out cross-validation on 28 experimental conditions, achieving R²=0.63 and Pearson r=0.81.

title: Neural network-based model predictive control for residential four-asset energy co-optimization with vehicle-to-home integration and carbon-aware dispatch

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Tamanghasset

relevance_to_user: 该论文将神经网络代理模型用于建筑能源系统控制，与生物医学FEA代理建模方向相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical or implant mechanics, lacks FEA validation, and focuses on building energy optimization rather than surrogate modeling for expensive simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统规则方法难以高效求解多资产住宅能源协同控制问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息神经网络模型预测控制框架，离线训练替代在线优化器。
summary_zh.result: 相比MILP，成本降低7.5%，碳排放降低26.3%，推理时间大幅缩短。
summary_zh.validation: 通过全年蒙特卡洛模拟（30次）与规则和MILP基准对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional rule-based approaches cannot efficiently solve the high-dimensional coupled control problem of residential multi-asset energy systems.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network-based model predictive control framework is proposed, where a feedforward network trained offline replaces the online optimizer in a receding-horizon loop.
summary_en.result: The NN-MPC achieves 7.5% lower electricity cost and 26.3% lower carbon emissions compared to MILP, while recovering 87% of the optimality gap at over 2,400 times lower computational cost.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated via a full-year Monte Carlo simulation (30 runs) with Algiers climate data, benchmarked against rule-based and MILP controllers.

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue behavior, or surface/osseointegration aspects relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究LPBF-TA15钛合金经不同退火工艺后的组织遗传与拉伸性能变化。
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF-TA15试样进行不同温度单步及两步退火，并进行室温及高温拉伸测试与微观组织表征。

summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸测试和EBSD等微观表征验证组织与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructural inheritance and resulting tensile properties of LPBF-fabricated TA15 titanium alloy under different sequential annealing schedules.
summary_en.method: LPBF-TA15 specimens were subjected to single-step and two-step annealing at various temperatures, followed by microstructural characterization and monotonic tensile testing at room and elevated temperatures.
summary_en.result: The two-step annealed condition A800-S550 exhibited the highest room-temperature strength (yield 1045 MPa, elongation 14.3%), while elevated temperatures reduced strength but increased ductility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile testing and microstructural analysis including EBSD.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of the Bundeswehr Munich, Institute of Engineering Mechanics and Structural Analysis, Werner-Heisenberg-Weg 39, 85577, Neubiberg, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的无锁死PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，提高细长结构（如植入体）的仿真效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在求解剪切刚性梁板问题时出现的横向剪切锁死和训练退化。
summary_zh.method: 采用能量基PINN，结合分层参数化、独立网络和长细比缩放因子，构造无锁死公式。
summary_zh.result: 实现了与长细比无关的快速收敛，梁和板问题均准确求解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题验证，对比标准参数化方法。

summary_en.motivation: This paper aims to mitigate transverse shear locking in PINNs for Timoshenko beams and Reissner-Mindlin plates, which causes severe training deterioration for slender structures.
summary_en.method: The authors propose locking-free energy-based PINNs using hierarchic parametrizations, separate networks per variable, and a slenderness-dependent scaling factor to balance energy terms.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves fast, slenderness-independent convergence for both beam and plate problems, outperforming standard PINN formulations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark problems for beams and plates, comparing against standard parametrizations.

title: Layer-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Condition Embedding for Electro-Thermal Coupled Temperature-Field Modeling of XLPE HVDC Cables

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经网络与条件嵌入方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical context, or any biomedical FEA surrogate application; it focuses on cable thermal modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 电缆导体温度无法直接测量，有限元仿真实时性差，需快速代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出层感知物理信息神经网络，嵌入热传导方程与焦耳热源，并采用条件嵌入输入电流和环境温度。
summary_zh.result: 在十五种工况下均方根误差0.0024K，残差较数据驱动网络降低28倍，外推性能提升。
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元参考解对比，并进行了网格细化研究，但无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: The need for real-time temperature prediction in XLPE HVDC cables, where direct measurement is infeasible and finite-element simulation is computationally prohibitive, motivates the development of a fast surrogate model.
summary_en.method: A layer-aware physics-informed neural network is developed that embeds the transient heat equation, temperature-dependent Joule heating, and boundary conditions into the loss, with condition embedding for load current and ambient temperature as continuous inputs.
summary_en.result: The model achieves a root-mean-square error of 0.0024 K against finite-element references across fifteen operating conditions, reduces the governing-equation residual by about 28-fold compared to a data-driven network, and improves extrapolation to unseen ambient temperatures.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against finite-element simulations with a mesh refinement study, but no experimental cable-loop validation is included.

title: Kernel Methods for Learning Operators with Multiple Inputs and Outputs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通用的多输入多输出算子学习框架，其高效性和理论保证可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the operator learning method to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling in the context of design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多输入多输出算子学习问题，提升科学机器学习中映射学习的效率与可解释性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于核的编码器-解码器框架，分离观测、表示、学习和重建，并发展出KernelMO方法族。
summary_zh.result: 在五类参数化偏微分方程上达到与神经算子相当或更优的精度，同时显著降低训练和推理成本。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个参数化PDE基准上进行了数值实验，与神经算子及深度学习方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to develop a general and efficient operator learning framework for multi-input multi-output mappings between function spaces, addressing limitations of existing neural operator methods.
summary_en.method: It introduces a kernel-based encoder-decoder framework that separates observation, representation, learning, and reconstruction, and proposes KernelMO, a family of kernel methods with operator-valued and product-space formulations.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods achieve competitive or state-of-the-art predictive accuracy on five parametric PDE families while reducing training and inference costs compared to neural operators and deep learning models.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated through numerical experiments on multiple parametric PDE benchmarks, comparing accuracy and efficiency against neural operator baselines.

title: High-dimensional Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Learned Variable Interactions

summary_zh.method: 利用变量交互分析划分决策空间，并在子空间内进行局部贝叶斯优化。

summary_zh.validation: 通过合成和真实基准测试验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address the exponential sampling complexity of multi-objective Bayesian optimization in high-dimensional decision spaces.

summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art MOBO methods on synthetic and real-world benchmarks in approximating the Pareto front.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world benchmark problems.

title: Data-Driven and Surrogate Modelling Approaches for Nonlinear Bladed-Disk Dynamics: A Review
venue: International Journal of Research Publication and Reviews
relevance_to_user: 该综述系统梳理了数据驱动与代理模型在非线性结构动力学中的应用，其方法（如高斯过程、物理信息神经网络）可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学场景。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on bladed-disk dynamics in turbomachinery, with no application to implant biomechanics, no FEA surrogate for biomedical structures, and no experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性叶片盘动力学仿真成本高昂，亟需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 综述多项式混沌、高斯过程、神经网络及物理信息神经网络等代理建模方法。
summary_zh.result: 指出代理模型是解决耦合、温度相关、失谐问题计算成本的关键前提。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，属于文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: The computational cost of predicting nonlinear bladed-disk forced response is compounded by friction-contact, mistuning, temperature sweeps, and geometry optimization, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: This review surveys data-driven and surrogate-modelling approaches, including polynomial chaos, response surfaces, Gaussian process regression, neural networks, and physics-informed neural networks, with emphasis on mistuned and friction-damped bladed disks.
summary_en.result: The review concludes that surrogate modelling is not merely an accelerant but a practical precondition for solving the coupled, temperature-dependent, mistuned problem, and identifies required extensions.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: DC-PINN: Dual channel physics-informed neural network for crystal plasticity modeling

summary_zh.method: 提出双通道物理信息神经网络，结合物理约束与数据驱动进行代理建模。
summary_zh.result: 在晶体塑性模拟中实现高效且准确的预测，优于传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证模型精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate crystal plasticity finite element simulations by developing a surrogate model that reduces computational cost while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.method: A dual-channel physics-informed neural network (DC-PINN) is proposed, integrating physical laws with data-driven learning to approximate crystal plasticity responses.
summary_en.result: The DC-PINN achieves efficient and accurate predictions for crystal plasticity problems, outperforming conventional surrogate approaches.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated through numerical benchmark tests, demonstrating its effectiveness in capturing complex material behavior.

title: ContactIPM: A Structure-Exploiting Interior-Point Solver for Contact-Implicit Trajectory Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种面向接触隐式轨迹优化的高效求解器，其结构利用和数值方法可迁移至机器人或生物力学中的接触力学仿真，但与用户关注的植入物有限元设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, finite element analysis, or any biomedical application; it focuses on trajectory optimization for robotic systems with contact dynamics.

summary_zh.motivation: 接触隐式轨迹优化面临互补约束退化问题，现有求解器鲁棒性不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出ContactIPM，结合弹性内点松弛与Riccati递归，利用阶段结构高效求解MPCC。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上比CRISP和IMPACT更快，成功率更高。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准接触优化基准和鲁棒性套件上对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Contact-implicit trajectory optimization suffers from degeneracy due to complementarity constraints, and existing solvers lack robustness and efficiency.
summary_en.method: ContactIPM combines a barrier-coupled elastic interior relaxation with a Riccati recursion to exploit the stagewise optimal-control structure, solving the reduced Newton system efficiently.
summary_en.result: ContactIPM achieves 2.17-8.87x speedup over CRISP and competitive performance against IMPACT, with higher success rates on robustness suites.
summary_en.validation: The solver is validated on standard CRISP benchmarks and robustness suites, comparing runtime and success rates against two state-of-the-art solvers.

title: AgenticTwin: An Agentic LLM Framework Integrated with Digital Twin for Anomaly Detection

summary_zh.motivation: 数字孪生异常分析复杂，需智能解释与交互。

title: Additive manufacturing of TPMS structures for lightweight and multifunctional applications

summary_zh.motivation: 提高流体仿真中水动力与标量输运响应预测的效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用主动学习策略构建代理模型，自适应选择训练样本。
summary_zh.result: 在圆柱阵列案例中显著减少仿真次数并保持预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准案例验证代理模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of predicting hydrodynamic and scalar transport responses in fluid simulations by reducing the number of expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: An active learning approach is employed to build a surrogate model that adaptively selects training samples to maximize information gain.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces the number of simulations required while maintaining prediction accuracy in cylinder array configurations.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate model is validated on numerical benchmark cases of flow around cylinder arrays.

title: A Local Sinkhorn Framework for Conditional Distribution Reconstruction of Multidimensional Random Fields
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于局部Sinkhorn散度的条件分布重建框架，可迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化中。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanical implant design, and lacks any biomedical or solid-mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为多维随机场条件分布重建提供可扩展且高效的损失函数。
summary_zh.method: 利用去偏Sinkhorn散度构建局部分布匹配目标，训练随机神经网络。
summary_zh.result: 在精度与计算效率间取得平衡，并具有良好的可扩展性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例与其他损失函数及UQ框架对比。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a scalable and efficient loss function for reconstructing conditional distributions of multidimensional random fields.
summary_en.method: A local Sinkhorn divergence framework is proposed to train stochastic neural networks via a differentiable local distribution matching objective.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves a balance between reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency while maintaining scalability for multidimensional stochastic systems.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks comparing against other loss functions and machine-learning-based UQ frameworks.

title: A Factor Graph Approach to Scalable Multi-Output Gaussian Process Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可扩展的多输出高斯过程回归方法，其高效推理和不确定性量化能力可迁移至生物力学代理模型的构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on scalable multi-output Gaussian process regression for general time series and synthetic data.

summary_zh.motivation: 多输出高斯过程回归计算成本高，且难以处理不同输出在不同输入点观测的情况。
summary_zh.method: 将多输出高斯过程表示为Forney因子图，利用最近邻链和线性高斯转移实现精确消息传递。
summary_zh.result: 在低维输入下接近精确核矩阵方法，且计算复杂度线性扩展，在电力时间序列上精度相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据维度扫描和电力时间序列预测与多种基线对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-output Gaussian process regression suffers from cubic computational cost and difficulty in handling missing observations across outputs.
summary_en.method: The authors formulate multi-output Gaussian process regression as a Forney-style factor graph with a nearest-neighbor chain and linear-Gaussian transitions, enabling exact message passing.
summary_en.result: The factor-graph approach achieves accuracy close to exact kernel methods in low dimensions and scales linearly with data size, outperforming inducing-point baselines in speed.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic input-dimension sweeps and electricity time series forecasting, comparing against exact, sparse variational, and nearest-neighbor baselines.

title: Topological Feasibility Guarantees for Differentiable Predictive Control
relevance_to_user: 该论文为可微预测控制提供可行性保证，其拓扑分析与控制障碍函数方法可迁移至基于仿真的工程优化问题，但与生物力学有限元设计无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not address engineering simulation (FEA/FEM), biomechanical implant design, or any physical system beyond generic control examples, and lacks experimental validation on real hardware or patient-specific models.

summary_zh.motivation: 为可微预测控制提供确定性可行性保证，避免在线安全过滤器。
summary_zh.method: 利用拓扑分析可达安全集，结合控制障碍函数代理损失进行离线策略学习。
summary_zh.result: 证明随训练样本增加，约束违反单调降至零，获得形式化安全证书。
summary_zh.validation: 通过闭环仿真验证理论结果，未涉及实物实验。

summary_en.motivation: To establish deterministic feasibility guarantees for differentiable predictive control without relying on online safety filters, addressing a key gap in offline policy optimization.
summary_en.method: The paper employs a topological analysis of the reachable safe set and proposes a self-supervised learning strategy with a control barrier function proxy loss to train policies with formal guarantees.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields policies with provable feasibility, and simulations show that constraint violations monotonically decrease to zero as training samples increase.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through extensive closed-loop simulations, demonstrating the theoretical guarantees empirically.

title: Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction for Time Series
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于检索校正的共形预测方法，可迁移到有限元代理模型的不确定性量化中，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on time series forecasting uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高时间序列预测区间校准的效率与局部适应性。
summary_zh.method: 提出检索校正共形预测，检索相似历史残差并校正覆盖误差。
summary_zh.result: 在标准基准上达到目标覆盖率并降低Winkler分数。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个时间序列基准和预测器上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and local adaptivity of conformal prediction intervals for time series with temporally dependent errors.
summary_en.method: Proposes Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction (RCCP) that retrieves similar past residuals and applies a scalar conformal correction to the normalized retrieval error.
summary_en.result: RCCP achieves target coverage in all settings and lowest Winkler scores with fewer severe misses across benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard time series benchmarks with multiple backbone forecasters.

visual.caption: Figure 1 . Overview of Retrieval–Corrected Conformal Prediction. RCCP builds a retrieval knowledge base from evaluated prediction contexts, forms an asymmetric retrieved interval from one-sided residuals of similar contexts, and calibrates the interval with a scalar correction estimated from normalized retrieval errors.

title: Online neural fusion of deep reinforcement learning and model predictive control for comfort-aware greenhouse energy optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度强化学习与模型预测控制融合用于温室能源优化，其在线神经融合方法可迁移至生物力学仿真中的代理模型与优化控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA-based surrogate modeling, or any biomedical engineering context; it focuses on building energy management.

summary_zh.motivation: 温室能源优化需兼顾舒适度与能耗，传统方法难以在线自适应。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度强化学习与模型预测控制的在线神经融合框架，实现实时决策。
summary_zh.result: 融合方法在能耗与舒适度平衡上优于单一方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于温室环境仿真案例验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to improve greenhouse energy management by balancing occupant comfort and energy consumption through an adaptive online control strategy.
summary_en.method: It proposes an online neural fusion framework that integrates deep reinforcement learning with model predictive control to leverage both learning-based adaptability and constraint-aware optimization.
summary_en.result: The fused approach demonstrates superior performance in energy efficiency and comfort maintenance compared to standalone methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through simulation case studies of greenhouse environments.

title: Nitinol shape memory alloy (NiTi SMA): additive manufacturing processes in medical devices
relevance_to_user: 该综述系统比较了NiTi合金的多种增材制造技术，对生物医用植入物的制造工艺选择具有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper is a review of AM technologies for NiTi and does not include mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, stress shielding evaluation, or osseointegration studies.

summary_zh.motivation: 为生物医用NiTi合金的增材制造技术提供全面比较和工艺选择参考。
summary_zh.method: 系统综述了PBF、DED、MEX等多种AM技术及其对NiTi微观结构的影响。
summary_zh.result: 指出SLM是最广泛采用的NiTi医疗器件制造方法，并讨论了新兴混合制造技术。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，属于文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to provide a comprehensive comparison of additive manufacturing technologies for NiTi alloys in biomedical devices to guide process selection.
summary_en.method: It systematically reviews various AM techniques including powder bed fusion, directed energy deposition, and material extrusion, and analyzes their effects on NiTi microstructure.
summary_en.result: It identifies SLM as the most widely adopted method for NiTi medical devices and discusses emerging hybrid and multi-material approaches.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is included; the paper is a literature review.

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了利用3D打印微流控阵列和自动化算法实现多材料流动截面的像素级控制，其自动化设计算法和微流控技术可迁移至生物打印中的多材料图案化控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; the automated algorithm is a deterministic design tool, not a learning-based model, and there is no experimental validation of biological outcomes or printed constructs.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现任意复杂截面的多材料微流控流动，突破轴对称限制。
summary_zh.method: 利用3D打印微流控毛细管阵列和自动化算法生成流道模型，实现像素级流体控制。
summary_zh.result: 成功生成多种周期性和非对称多材料流动几何，并用于水凝胶微纤维生产。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验展示多种流动几何和微纤维生产，验证了方法的可行性。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve arbitrary cross-sectional control of multimaterial microfluidic flows, overcoming the limitations of axisymmetric designs.
summary_en.method: A 3D-printed array of microfluidic capillaries, combined with an automated algorithm for generating the flow extruder manifold, enables pixelated mapping of multiple fluids to define complex flow cross-sections.
summary_en.result: The approach successfully produced a variety of periodic and asymmetric multimaterial flow geometries and hydrogel microfibers, utilizing up to 2347 individually defined fluidic pixels.
summary_en.validation: Experimental demonstrations of diverse flow geometries and hydrogel microfiber production validated the method's capability.

title: Mechanical properties of additively manufactured TPMS structures: effect of heat treatment and dynamic loading
first_author_affiliation: College of Science and Engineering, James Cook University, Townsville, Australia

corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Science and Engineering, James Cook University, Townsville, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了增材制造TPMS结构的动态力学性能，虽面向航空航天，但其方法可迁移至生物医用植入物的力学评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implants, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on aerospace/automotive applications with Inconel 718, not biocompatible materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究TPMS结构在动态载荷下的力学性能，弥补准静态研究的不足。
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制造In718 TPMS，进行多步热处理，并开展准静态和动态冲击测试。
summary_zh.result: 热处理改善微观组织，动态加载下弹性模量提升541%，能量吸收近翻倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM微观表征和万能试验机力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study addresses the lack of dynamic loading performance data for additively manufactured TPMS structures, which are typically evaluated under quasi-static conditions.
summary_en.method: Inconel 718 TPMS samples were fabricated via laser powder bed fusion, subjected to a multi-step heat treatment, and then tested under quasi-static and dynamic impact loading at various velocities.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment improved the microstructure by dissolving detrimental phases and precipitating strengthening phases, leading to significantly enhanced mechanical properties under dynamic loading, with the diamond TPMS elastic modulus increasing by up to 541% and energy absorption nearly doubling.
summary_en.validation: The findings were validated through scanning electron microscopy for microstructural analysis and mechanical testing using a universal testing machine.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical applications; it is a review of ML in aluminum AM without experimental validation or UQ focus.

summary_zh.method: 系统综述机器学习在铝合金增材制造中的进展，涵盖数据物理融合、智能控制、GNN、Transformer、PINN及迁移学习等。
summary_zh.result: 机器学习正推动铝合金增材制造从经验驱动向知识驱动智能化转变。

summary_en.motivation: The intricate process-structure-property relationships in aluminum alloy additive manufacturing demand advanced modeling approaches beyond conventional methods.
summary_en.method: This review systematically categorizes machine learning applications in aluminum AM, including data-physics integrated modeling, reinforcement learning for process optimization, multimodal monitoring, graph neural networks, transformers, explainable AI, and physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.result: The integration of these ML techniques is shifting aluminum AM from experience-based practices toward knowledge-driven intelligent manufacturing, with emphasis on addressing data scarcity via meta-learning and transfer learning.
summary_en.validation: As a review article, it provides no experimental validation but synthesizes findings from prior studies.
