why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into any bioprinting stage, nor does it involve computational modeling or autonomous decision-making; it is purely an experimental acoustic manipulation platform.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服传统生物打印的细胞密度稀释和交联应激，实现无模板细胞微图案化。
summary_zh.method: 利用聚焦超声结合声流和辐射力，在GelMA水凝胶上非接触操控细胞和微粒。
summary_zh.result: 实现亚毫米级分辨率（约293微米）和高细胞活性（>94%），并构建肿瘤-内皮共培养模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活性测定和共培养形态学观察验证平台生物相容性和功能性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome limitations of conventional bioink-based bioprinting, such as cell density dilution and crosslinking-induced stress, by developing a template-free, non-contact cell patterning method.
summary_en.method: The FUS-pen system employs focused ultrasound to generate acoustic streaming and radiation forces, enabling precise manipulation of cells and microparticles on GelMA substrates with PDL modification.
summary_en.result: The system achieved sub-millimeter feature resolution (~293 μm line width), high cell viability (>94%), and successfully established a compartmentalized tumor-endothelial co-culture with capillary-like network formation.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through in vitro experiments, including cell viability assays and morphological assessment of co-cultured endothelial cells.

title: Efficient Weak-Entropy PINN for Solving Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN方法，用于处理具有不连续解的偏微分方程，其弱形式和熵条件思想可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的不连续或冲击问题。
why_not_core: 该论文未涉及生物医学或植入物力学背景，也未进行有限元代理建模或不确定性量化，仅针对一般双曲守恒律的数值求解。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN难以求解具有不连续解的双曲守恒律，需强先验或人工平滑。
summary_zh.method: 提出弱熵PINN，在弱积分形式中施加控制方程，结合熵条件选择物理解，并用离散快速傅里叶变换高效积分。
summary_zh.result: 在多个标量和系统守恒律上准确捕捉激波和稀疏波及其相互作用。
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维和二维数值实验验证，与基准方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks struggle with discontinuous solutions of hyperbolic conservation laws, often requiring strong priors or artificial smoothing that degrade accuracy.
summary_en.method: The proposed Weak-Entropy PINN enforces the governing equations in weak integral form, incorporates the entropy condition to select physically admissible solutions, and uses discrete fast Fourier transform for efficient numerical integration.
summary_en.result: Extensive numerical experiments on scalar and systems of conservation laws in 1D and 2D demonstrate accurate resolution of sharp discontinuities and capture of shock-rarefaction interactions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on standard hyperbolic conservation law problems, comparing with existing PINN variants.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高数据驱动本构建模中昂贵仿真采样的效率。

summary_zh.result: 在基准问题上减少了所需仿真次数，同时保持模型精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of expensive simulation sampling in data-driven constitutive modeling.
summary_en.method: Proposes a diversity-aware batch-mode active learning strategy that selects informative and diverse samples.
summary_en.result: Reduces the number of required simulations while maintaining model accuracy on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmark experiments.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究LPBF悬臂梁变形受刚度与约束控制的机制。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同跨度、厚度和支撑密度的TA15悬臂梁，结合三维扫描与热力耦合有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: 发现变形主要由几何刚度与约束决定，而非单纯残余应力大小。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量与有限元模拟对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to understand how geometry-dependent stiffness and constraints govern distortion in LPBF cantilevers, rather than solely the magnitude of residual stress.
summary_en.method: TA15 titanium alloy cantilevers with varying span, thickness, and support density were fabricated via LPBF, and warpage was measured with 3D scanning; a coupled thermo-mechanical finite element model was validated against experiments.
summary_en.result: The results show that post-release deformation is primarily governed by flexural rigidity and constraint, not the as-built stress magnitude alone.
summary_en.validation: The finite element model was validated against measured deformation profiles from 3D scanning of fabricated specimens.

title: Derivative Computation in PINNs: Automatic Differentiation, Finite Differences and Beyond
relevance_to_user: 该论文关于PINN中导数计算方法的改进，对提高代理模型训练效率有潜在价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not consider constraints or multi-objective optimization relevant to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN中导数计算的效率与准确性。
summary_zh.method: 系统比较有限差分与自动微分，提出随机有限差分变体。
summary_zh.result: 有限差分在精度相当下更快且省内存，随机变体在平稳问题上更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个基准PDE上验证。

summary_en.motivation: The paper aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of derivative computation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs).
summary_en.method: It systematically compares finite-difference (FD) derivative computation with automatic differentiation (AD) and proposes a stochastic FD variant.
summary_en.result: FD matches AD accuracy while being faster and more memory-efficient, and the stochastic variant outperforms AD on a stationary problem.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on three benchmark partial differential equations.

title: Data-driven surrogates for predicting thermal performance and response functions of thermo-active piles
venue: Machine Learning and Data Science in Geotechnics
first_author_affiliation: Imperial College London Science and Solutions for a Changing Planet DTP, , London, , and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Imperial College London, London, UK
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了用神经网络替代有限元仿真预测热响应函数的方法，其代理建模策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但领域为岩土工程而非植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on thermal performance of geo-structures rather than mechanical stress or bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低热活性桩有限元仿真的计算成本，提升设计效率。
summary_zh.method: 基于拉丁超立方采样生成三维瞬态有限元数据库，训练两个人工神经网络代理模型预测热功率和热响应函数。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型R²超过0.99，热响应函数预测误差小，计算时间大幅减少。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真数据训练，并用现场热响应试验验证外推能力。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of finite element simulations for thermo-active piles and facilitate their preliminary design and performance assessment.
summary_en.method: Two artificial neural network surrogates were trained on databases generated from 3D transient finite element simulations, with inputs sampled via Latin Hypercube sampling and enhanced by feature normalization, cross-validation, and SHAP interpretability.
summary_en.result: The surrogates achieved excellent predictive accuracy (R² > 0.99 for power output, 0.994–0.997 for thermal responses) and reduced computational time by orders of magnitude compared to finite element analysis.
summary_en.validation: Validation against a field thermal response test confirmed reliable extrapolation beyond the trained diameter range, supplementing the simulation-based training data.

title: Coordinate-bridging physics-informed neural network for temperature field reconstruction
venue: International Journal of Heat and Mass Transfer
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechanical Engineering, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou 310058, China

corresponding_authors.name: Guodong Sa
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Ningbo Global Innovation Center, Zhejiang University, Ningbo 315100, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种坐标桥接的物理信息神经网络用于温度场重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的场重建问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on heat transfer temperature field reconstruction, not on biomechanical implant stress shielding or FEA surrogate for solid mechanics, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决温度场重建中数据稀疏和物理约束融合的难题。
summary_zh.method: 提出坐标桥接的物理信息神经网络，通过坐标变换增强网络对复杂几何的适应能力。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数值案例中实现了高精度温度场重建，优于传统PINN方法。
summary_zh.validation: 采用数值基准案例验证，未涉及实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of reconstructing temperature fields from sparse measurements by integrating physical laws into neural networks.
summary_en.method: A coordinate-bridging physics-informed neural network is proposed, which uses coordinate transformations to improve the network's ability to handle complex geometries.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high-accuracy temperature field reconstruction in several numerical cases, outperforming standard PINN approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark cases without experimental data.

title: ALF: Open-Source Active Learning Framework for Atomistic Modeling
venue: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
first_author_affiliation: University of Illinois Urbana−Champaign , , , ,
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习框架虽面向原子模拟，但其不确定性驱动的采样策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的训练数据高效生成。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or structural mechanics; it focuses on atomistic simulations and interatomic potentials.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少机器学习原子间势训练数据的人工筛选负担。
summary_zh.method: 开发开源主动学习框架，自动选择高不确定性构象并调度电子结构计算。
summary_zh.result: 生成熔盐混合物数据集，训练的势函数准确预测多种物性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过预测熔盐的熔点、粘度等物性并与实验对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To automate the curation of training datasets for machine learning interatomic potentials, reducing manual effort and human bias.
summary_en.method: An open-source active learning framework that iteratively selects configurations with high model uncertainty, schedules electronic structure calculations, and retrains the potential.
summary_en.result: The framework produced a dataset for molten salt mixtures, and the trained potential accurately predicted multiple physical properties.
summary_en.validation: Predictions of melting point, viscosity, density, and other properties were validated against experimental data.

title: A physics-informed neural network framework for hemodynamic reconstruction and quantitative mitral regurgitation assessment
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络应用于心血管血流动力学重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或骨科力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, bone-implant interface, or structural FEA; it focuses on hemodynamics and cardiac function, lacking direct relevance to hip implant stress shielding or orthopedic biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高血流动力学重建效率并定量评估二尖瓣反流严重程度。
summary_zh.method: 构建物理信息神经网络，融合流体动力学方程与临床测量数据。
summary_zh.result: 实现了血流动力学参数的高效重建和反流程度的定量评估。
summary_zh.validation: 利用临床患者数据验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of hemodynamic reconstruction and enable quantitative assessment of mitral regurgitation severity.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network framework that integrates fluid dynamics equations with clinical measurement data.
summary_en.result: The framework achieved efficient reconstruction of hemodynamic parameters and quantitative evaluation of regurgitation severity.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated using clinical patient data.

title: Two-Step MV-DeepONet: Probabilistic Operator Learning for Uncertainty Propagation Driven by Random Input Fields
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，用于不确定性和相关性传播。
why_not_core: 该论文未涉及生物医学或植入物力学场景，也未进行有限元验证，仅针对PDE和航空航天问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有概率DeepONet无法捕捉输出场跨位置的条件相关性，需改进。
summary_zh.method: 提出两步训练MV-DeepONet，在低维系数空间建模高斯分布，映射回物理空间获得非对角协方差。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE和航空航天问题上，相比Prob-DeepONet，泛化更好，不确定性带更结构化，相关模式恢复准确。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和航空航天案例验证，无实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: Probabilistic DeepONet's diagonal covariance assumption limits its ability to represent cross-location dependencies in field outputs, motivating a more expressive yet efficient approach.
summary_en.method: A two-step mean-variance DeepONet is developed, which decouples basis learning from coefficient mapping and performs Gaussian modeling in a low-dimensional rotated coefficient space, inducing non-diagonal covariance in the physical output space.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates improved generalization, more structured uncertainty bands, and accurate recovery of off-diagonal correlation patterns compared to Prob-DeepONet across several PDE problems and a hypersonic aerothermal case.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical experiments on benchmark PDE problems and a hypersonic blunt-body case, with no experimental or clinical data.

title: Thermodynamically admissible neural solvers for stiff electro-elastodynamics via exact geometric constraints
first_author_affiliation: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, BITS Pilani , Dubai Campus, Dubai,

corresponding_authors.name: Suhas Suresh Bharadwaj
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering, BITS Pilani , Dubai Campus, Dubai,

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过精确几何约束改善刚性多物理场PINN训练的方法，对解决生物力学有限元代理模型中的约束处理和优化困难具有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not consider patient-specific or implant-related design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决刚性多物理场PINN训练中的梯度病态和能量泄漏问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用解析距离函数在神经网络拓扑中精确施加边界和初始条件，并采用拟牛顿优化。
summary_zh.result: 在1D压电弹性动力学中实现全局相对L2误差约1e-5，恢复最大边界应力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了方法的精度和稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome gradient pathologies and energy leakage in PINNs when solving stiff multiphysics systems such as piezoelectricity.
summary_en.method: A constrained PINN architecture that enforces exact Dirichlet boundaries and second-order initial conditions via analytical distance functions, combined with a quasi-Newton optimizer.
summary_en.result: Achieved global relative L2 error of O(1e-5) for mechanical displacement and electric potential in 1D electro-elastodynamics, enabling accurate boundary stress recovery.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmark simulations of a 1D coupled electro-elastodynamic problem.

title: Personalized Lower-limb Exoskeleton Assistance via Preference-based Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于偏好的贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学仿真或植入物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on exoskeleton control parameter tuning via user preference.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有外骨骼参数优化依赖大量人机交互，效率低且易疲劳。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于偏好的贝叶斯优化，利用候选集采样分布知识提升样本效率。
summary_zh.result: 20次迭代达到90.7%验证精度，代谢率降低14.5%-15.4%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过跑步机和户外实验验证优化参数的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper addresses the inefficiency and user fatigue in existing preference-based optimization methods for exoskeleton control parameter tuning.
summary_en.method: It proposes a preference-based Bayesian optimization (PbBO) framework that leverages knowledge of the sampling distribution of candidate sets to improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.result: PbBO achieves 90.7% validation accuracy in 20 iterations and reduces metabolic rate by 14.5%-15.4%, heart rate by 6.3%-7.6%, and muscle activation by 6.7%-31.5% compared to unassisted walking.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through treadmill and outdoor experiments with human subjects.

key_terms.zh: 基于偏好的贝叶斯优化

title: Particle-Based Conformal Prediction for Contact-Aware Uncertainty Calibration in Stratified Configuration Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于粒子的共形预测方法可用于不确定性量化，对生物力学代理模型的可靠预测具有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on robot motion planning with contact-rich tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器人运动模型在接触场景下不确定性估计不准确，导致任务失败。
summary_zh.method: 提出CaPTURe算法，利用校准数据局部校准粒子集，生成几何感知的共形预测区域。
summary_zh.result: 在迷宫和插销任务中，覆盖率达标，任务成功率提升30%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个仿真规划任务与基线对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate uncertainty representation is critical for safe robot interaction in contact-rich environments, but existing models often fail under contact-induced multimodality and model mismatch.
summary_en.method: CaPTURe uses conformal prediction on particle-based transition models to locally calibrate uncertainty estimates, producing valid prediction regions that adapt to contact and contactless motion.
summary_en.result: In simulated labyrinth and peg-in-hole tasks, CaPTURe achieves specified coverage and improves task success by up to 30% over baselines.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on two simulated planning tasks with comparisons to relevant baselines.

title: Nonlinear Model Predictive Control of a Robotic Soft Esophagus
relevance_to_user: 该论文将模型预测控制与系统辨识结合用于软体机器人控制，其方法可迁移至生物力学仿真中的代理模型或控制问题，但与用户关注的植入物有限元分析或生物打印AI方向关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, implant mechanics, or biomedical implant design; it focuses on soft robot control with MPC and SINDy, which is not directly aligned with the user's FEA-based implant or bioprinting directions.

summary_zh.motivation: 为软体食管机器人实现闭环控制，以精确模拟蠕动波。
summary_zh.method: 采用SINDy辨识动力学模型，并基于MPC实现蠕动波和气压的自主控制。
summary_zh.result: 成功生成不同幅度和速度的蠕动波，并用于支架迁移测试。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真和实验测试验证了控制效果。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve closed-loop control of a soft robotic esophagus for accurate peristaltic wave generation, addressing the limitations of open-loop control.
summary_en.method: The authors employ Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics with Control (SINDy) to discover dynamic models from sensor data and implement Model Predictive Control (MPC) to regulate peristalsis and air pressure.
summary_en.result: The MPC successfully generated peristaltic waves with specified speeds, wavelengths, and amplitudes, and enabled stent migration testing under various food bolus conditions.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated through simulation and experimental testing on the RoSEv2.0 platform.

key_terms.zh: 稀疏辨识非线性动力学

title: Multitask Scanning Probe Microscopy
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了多任务高斯过程在实验测量中的主动学习策略，可迁移至生物打印或植入物设计的代理建模与优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on experimental scanning probe microscopy. It also lacks uncertainty quantification in the sense of predictive variance for design decisions, and no constraints or multi-objective optimization are considered.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效分配扫描探针显微镜的多模态测量，避免耗时和损伤。
summary_zh.method: 采用多任务高斯过程实时学习空间与模态关系，自主选择测量位置和协议。
summary_zh.result: 在AlScN晶圆上实现非重合测量更新多任务响应图，扩展主动学习至模态分配。
summary_zh.validation: 在自动化原子力显微镜上对成分梯度晶圆进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently allocate multimodal measurements in scanning probe microscopy, reducing acquisition time and sample damage.
summary_en.method: A multitask Gaussian process learns spatial and cross-modal correlations and autonomously selects both measurement locations and experimental protocols in a closed-loop workflow.
summary_en.result: The approach enables noncoincident measurements to update multiple response landscapes, extending active learning from spatial sampling to modality allocation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a composition-spread AlScN wafer using an automated atomic force microscope with tapping-mode and DART measurements.

title: MoNo: Multiscale Optimal Transport Neural Operator for Solving PDEs on General Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于最优传输的多尺度神经算子，可提升PDE求解的效率和稳定性，对开发面向生物力学/植入物设计的代理模型具有潜在借鉴价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical or implant-specific FEA problems, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not demonstrate application to biomechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子在潜空间分配上存在不平衡，导致深层token崩溃，限制多尺度架构。
summary_zh.method: 提出MoNo，利用熵正则最优传输构建跨尺度平衡分配与双向投影，实现稳定多尺度潜空间。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上，MoNo在预测精度和计算效率上均优于现有最先进神经算子。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上进行了广泛实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing transformer-based neural operators suffer from imbalanced latent token assignment, which hinders the design of hierarchical architectures and leads to token collapse in deeper spaces.
summary_en.method: MoNo introduces CoTAP, a cross-scale optimal transport assignment and projection mechanism, to construct balanced bidirectional projections and stable latent spaces for multiscale PDE solving on general geometries.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments show that MoNo outperforms state-of-the-art neural operators in both prediction accuracy and computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard numerical benchmarks for PDEs, demonstrating superior performance over existing baselines.

title: Learning How the World Evolves: Extrapolative Video World Models via Latent Dynamics Reasoning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可外推的视频世界模型，其显式动力学积分思想可迁移到基于物理的仿真代理建模，但未涉及工程仿真或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not connect to engineering simulation (e.g., FEA/FEM data, physics simulators for design optimization) nor to biomedical/biomechanics contexts, focusing instead on video prediction benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有视频扩散模型只拟合像素，未建模时间演化规律，导致外推能力差。
summary_zh.method: 提出潜在动力学推理(LDR)，将潜在状态转移显式化为数值积分，仅回归高阶残差。
summary_zh.result: LDR在物理基准上外推误差比基线小20倍以上，参数少26倍，速度快143倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个白盒物理任务上验证，包括分布外场景和跨属性泛化。

summary_en.motivation: Current video diffusion models focus on pixel fitting without explicitly modeling temporal dynamics, leading to poor extrapolation beyond training distribution.
summary_en.method: LDR casts latent state transitions as explicit kinematic integration, numerically integrating lower-order dynamics and regressing only higher-order residuals on a structured latent.
summary_en.result: LDR achieves over 20x smaller in- vs out-of-distribution error gap compared to video diffusion baselines, with 26x fewer parameters and 143x faster inference.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a white-box physics benchmark with five tasks, including out-of-distribution scenarios and cross-attribute generalization.

title: Integrated simulation-experimental investigation of heat-treatment-induced residual stress evolution and wear behaviour in laser powder bed fusion fabricated SS316L
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造SS316L的热处理残余应力演变与磨损行为，虽未涉及生物医学植入物，但其工艺-性能关联方法可迁移至生物医用合金的疲劳与表面性能优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on residual stress and wear in a non-biomedical alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究LPBF SS316L热处理残余应力演变及其对磨损性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 集成模拟与实验，分析不同热处理条件下残余应力分布与磨损行为。
summary_zh.result: 发现热处理显著改变残余应力状态，进而影响磨损性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟与实验对比验证残余应力演变和磨损结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the evolution of residual stress during heat treatment and its influence on wear behavior in laser powder bed fusion fabricated SS316L.
summary_en.method: An integrated simulation-experimental approach was employed to analyze residual stress distributions and wear performance under various heat treatment conditions.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered residual stress states, which in turn affected the wear resistance of the material.
summary_en.validation: The simulation results were validated against experimental measurements of residual stress and wear behavior.

title: Geometrically negative Poisson's ratio via laser additive manufacturing: Synergistic energy absorption through multi-scale cooperative deformation
first_author_affiliation: Harbin Engineering University

corresponding_authors.name: Qichao Xue
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Harbin Engineering University

relevance_to_user: 该论文虽未直接涉及生物医学植入物，但其LPBF制造、力学测试和能量吸收方法可迁移至多孔植入物的应力屏蔽和疲劳性能研究。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on quasi-static and dynamic energy absorption of a metamaterial without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发新型负泊松比蜂窝超材料以提升能量吸收效率。
summary_zh.method: 结合内凹六边形与星形晶格，通过LPBF制造316L不锈钢试样，并进行准静态压缩和动态冲击测试。
summary_zh.result: 协同变形机制显著提高比能量吸收，内部孔隙导致动态应变率软化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过FEA和数字图像相关技术验证变形模式。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to develop a novel negative Poisson's ratio honeycomb metamaterial with enhanced energy absorption for lightweight protective applications.
summary_en.method: A composite structure combining re-entrant hexagonal and star-shaped lattices was fabricated via laser powder bed fusion from 316L stainless steel, and its mechanical response was characterized under quasi-static and dynamic loading.
summary_en.result: The synergistic deformation mechanisms significantly improved specific energy absorption, while internal voids contributed to strain-rate softening under dynamic impact.

summary_en.motivation: Local validation in scientific machine learning cannot guarantee that explanations assemble into a globally coherent account, motivating a computable audit framework.
summary_en.method: SEAM introduces a generator-agnostic framework that represents regions as structured explanations with state, closure, and observation channels, and detects inconsistencies via channel-resolved obstructions.
summary_en.result: Across synthetic PDE systems and out-of-distribution FNO monitoring, SEAM identifies incompatible explanations even when local predictions are accurate, attributing failures to specific channels and overlaps.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through nineteen numerical experiments on synthetic PDE systems and FNO monitoring, demonstrating its ability to detect global inconsistencies.

summary_en.method: Fe-30Mn-6Si alloy samples were fabricated via LPBF with varying processing parameters, followed by heat treatment, and then characterized for microstructure and shape recovery behavior.
summary_en.result: The results demonstrate that processing parameters and heat treatment significantly affect the microstructure and shape recovery ratio, with optimized conditions leading to improved functional performance.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was conducted through microstructural analysis and shape recovery testing.

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), surface roughness, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on relative density prediction for Inconel 718 LPBF.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统试错法难以确定LPBF稳定工艺窗口，需数据驱动方法。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional trial-and-error and energy-density rules are insufficient to determine stable processing windows for LPBF due to the coupled effects of multiple parameters.
summary_en.method: A data-driven printability framework using the AIMPOD workflow was developed, evaluating multiple machine learning models and an optimized ensemble to predict relative density from LPBF process parameters.
summary_en.result: The optimized ensemble achieved a test R² of 0.72 and RMSE of 0.79 percentage points, with scan speed, laser power, and hatch spacing identified as dominant predictors.
summary_en.validation: The models were validated on a dataset of 241 LPBF conditions using standard regression metrics (R², RMSE, MAE) without experimental validation.

title: An enhanced physics-informed deep learning framework for solving variable-coefficient heat conduction problems with temperature-dependent thermal conductivity and nonlinear source terms
first_author_affiliation: Bule Hora University

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的增强型PINN框架可处理变系数和非线性源项，对生物力学FEA代理建模具有方法迁移潜力，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical FEA, or any biomedical context; it focuses on heat conduction PDEs with no validation on structural or implant-related problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在变系数、不连续和复杂边界条件下精度下降，需改进框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出VC-PINN框架，统一处理多种边界条件，并有效应对不连续导热系数。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验显示L2和L∞误差低至10^-6，均方误差达10^-8，优于标准PINN和传统数值方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例与标准PINN、有限差分和有限元方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from accuracy degradation when solving PDEs with variable coefficients, discontinuities, and complex boundary conditions, motivating an enhanced framework.
summary_en.method: The proposed VC-PINN framework integrates a unified treatment of multiple boundary conditions and effectively handles discontinuous thermal conductivity coefficients within a single architecture.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate that the method achieves L2 and L∞ errors as low as 1e-6 and mean squared errors down to 1e-8, outperforming standard PINNs and classical numerical methods.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through numerical benchmarks on transient nonlinear heat conduction problems, including cases with discontinuous coefficients, compared against standard PINN, finite difference, and finite element methods.

title: Alternating Levenberg-Marquardt Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Fourier-Enhanced Features
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN训练方法，可提高高频和多尺度PDE求解的精度，对开发高效的FEA替代模型具有潜在借鉴价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical or implant mechanics, nor does it include any FEA validation or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在高频和多尺度PDE求解中的精度不足问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出FALM-PINN，将表示学习与系数拟合解耦，上层学习傅里叶增强基，下层用LM算法拟合系数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个高频非线性PDE上，相对L2误差比现有方法低两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准PDE案例验证，无实验或实际工程验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks struggle with high-frequency and multi-scale PDE solutions due to spectral bias and representation-coefficient coupling.
summary_en.method: The paper introduces FALM-PINN, an alternating optimization framework that decouples representation learning from coefficient fitting, using Fourier-enhanced basis functions and the Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm for the coefficient subproblem.
summary_en.result: FALM-PINN achieves relative L2 errors up to two orders of magnitude lower than state-of-the-art baselines on several challenging high-frequency and nonlinear PDEs.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark PDE problems, with no experimental or real-world engineering validation.

title: A framework for realisable data-driven active flow control using model predictive control applied to a simplified truck wake

summary_en.motivation: To develop a deployable data-driven active flow control framework that relies on few non-intrusive sensors.
summary_en.method: The framework employs LSTM-based reduced-order predictive models trained offline on open-loop data, coupled with gradient-based model predictive control and SHAP-based sensor sparsification.
summary_en.result: The LSTM-MPC controller achieved a 12.8% drag reduction in numerical simulations of a two-dimensional truck model.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated through numerical simulations of a simplified truck wake at Reynolds number 500.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络应用于电机温度估计，其处理稀疏采样和物理约束的方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物或生物医学场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, lacks contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis, and does not include any biomechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数据驱动模型在低频采样下预测精度差且缺乏物理约束的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息LSTM模型，将电机电压平衡方程作为损失函数，并训练电感参数。

summary_zh.validation: 使用公开电机温度数据集进行多工况实验和敏感性分析。

summary_en.motivation: To improve temperature estimation accuracy under sparse sampling and incorporate physical constraints into data-driven models.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed LSTM is proposed, embedding PMSM voltage balance equations into the loss function and treating inductances as trainable parameters.
summary_en.result: The model achieves superior prediction performance (MAE 1.6048°C, RMSE 2.1890°C, R2 0.9861) and robust high-temperature region accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a public motor temperature dataset with multiple operating conditions, downsampling, and sensitivity analyses.

title: A Label-Free Physics-to-Data Acceleration Framework for Parametric Time-Dependent PDEs with Latent-Space Differential-Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种标签自由的参数化时变PDE加速框架，其分离求解与超降阶思想可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context, and its validation is limited to benchmark PDEs without FEA-based implant simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化时变PDE求解对高保真数据集的依赖，提升多查询场景效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出PHD-SF框架，结合SD-TPD分离策略与微分算子学习，在统一DON架构下实现三种模式的无标签谱建模。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准PDE上，仅用一两个代表性参数案例即可实现跨参数准确推理，总成本低于训练单个PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过四个标准时变PDE基准测试验证，未涉及实验或生物医学案例。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the reliance on large-scale high-fidelity data for solving parametric time-dependent PDEs, thereby improving efficiency in many-query scenarios.
summary_en.method: The paper introduces PHD-SF, a unified deep operator network framework that combines separation of time-dependent and spatial variables with differential-operator learning, enabling label-free spectrum modeling across three operating modes.
summary_en.result: On four benchmark PDEs, the framework achieves accurate cross-parameter inference using only one or two representative training cases, with total cost lower than training a conventional PINN for a single case.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on four standard time-dependent PDE benchmarks, demonstrating numerical accuracy and efficiency without experimental or biomedical case studies.

title: A Comparative Study of Neural Network Solvers for Second‐Order Boundary Value Problems

why_not_core: This paper does not apply the solvers to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations or uncertainty quantification.

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to systematically compare several deep learning-based PDE solvers and analyze their error behavior to guide method selection.
summary_en.method: The authors conduct numerical experiments on PINN, WAN, DRM, and VPINN, and provide a rigorous error analysis for PINN with brief estimates for others.
summary_en.result: The results highlight the critical role of loss formulation and optimization strategy in achieving high accuracy, with no single solver universally superior.
summary_en.validation: The solvers are validated on standard numerical benchmarks, comparing accuracy and convergence across different problem settings.

title: Simulation-driven design of rigid and elastic baffles for sloshing suppression using Bayesian optimization

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently design rigid and elastic baffles for suppressing liquid sloshing in containers.

summary_en.result: The optimized baffle designs significantly reduce sloshing amplitudes compared to baseline configurations.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through numerical simulation cases of sloshing scenarios.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无反向传播的PINN训练框架，可加速PDE求解，对代理模型的高效训练具有借鉴意义，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not consider constraints or patient-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 为满足边缘实时决策需求，需加速PINN训练，但传统硬件训练延迟高。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time decision making in edge scenarios, the training latency of physics-informed neural networks must be drastically reduced, which motivates alternative computing paradigms.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a back-propagation-free training framework using a sparse-grid Stein derivative estimator, dimension-reduced zeroth-order optimization via tensor-train decomposition, and a scalable photonic accelerator design.
summary_en.result: The numerical methods are validated on low- and high-dimensional PDE benchmarks, and pre-silicon simulations demonstrate significant improvements in training speed and chip area efficiency.

title: Preservation of periprosthetic bone with a collum-fixated short stem versus conventional metaphyseal-fixated stems in total hip arthroplasty: a randomized controlled trial with 2-year follow-up in 61 patients
relevance_to_user: 该论文通过随机对照试验比较了两种股骨柄设计对假体周围骨密度的保留效果，为髋关节假体设计中的应力遮挡评估提供了临床证据。
why_not_core: 该论文未进行生物力学建模或有限元分析，未量化应力遮挡或微动，也未提供可用于FE工作的边界条件。

summary_zh.motivation: 比较短颈固定柄与传统干骺端固定柄对假体周围骨密度的保留效果。
summary_zh.method: 随机对照试验，61例患者接受两种股骨柄，随访2年，DXA测量Gruen分区BMD。
summary_zh.result: Primoris柄在Gruen 3、5、7区BMD显著高于Echo柄，PROMs无差异。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随机对照试验，2年随访，DXA测量。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effect of two femoral stem designs on periprosthetic bone mineral density after total hip arthroplasty in a randomized controlled trial.
summary_en.method: A randomized controlled trial with 61 patients receiving either a collum-fixated short stem (Primoris) or a conventional metaphyseal-fixated stem (Echo), with DXA scans at multiple time points up to 24 months.
summary_en.result: The Primoris stem showed significantly higher BMD in Gruen zones 3, 5, and 7 at 24 months, with relative differences of +19.1%, +9.1%, and +14.3% compared to the Echo stem, while patient-reported outcomes were similar.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through a randomized controlled trial with 2-year follow-up and DXA-based BMD measurements.

summary_en.method: A hybrid approach integrates the B4 creep model into a PINN loss function and employs GPR for Bayesian uncertainty intervals.
summary_en.result: The method reduces RMSE by 37%–77% compared to traditional and data-driven methods, with reliable credible intervals.

title: Efficient Solid‐Solution Strengthening Enhanced the Wear Resistance of Ti–Ta Alloys Manufactured by Laser Powder Bed Fusion

why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on wear resistance of Ti-Ta alloys without implant-level mechanical testing or porous structure design.

summary_en.motivation: The insufficient wear resistance of pure titanium can lead to implant loosening, necessitating the development of wear-resistant titanium alloys.

summary_en.method: A sequential Bayesian updating framework is proposed, combining a physicochemical surrogate with an LSTM-based evaporation pseudo-model to reduce computational cost.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化SLM工艺参数以改善316L零件的剪切强度和表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.method: 采用改进的深度信念网络（CD-DBN）结合自适应学习率，建立能量密度与侧表面粗糙度的预测模型。

summary_zh.validation: 通过动力叶片零件进行验证，并与传统方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the shear strength and surface quality of 316L parts fabricated by powder bed fusion by optimizing key process parameters.
summary_en.method: An improved deep belief network (CD-DBN) with adaptive hierarchical learning rate was developed to model the relationship between process parameters and energy density/surface roughness, trained on 12,000 datasets.
summary_en.result: The optimized parameters achieved a side surface roughness of 5.34 μm and an energy density of 16.001, with a 17.85% improvement over a baseline method and prediction error below 0.2%.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated using a power blade component, demonstrating practical applicability in aeronautics.

title: Continual-Learning Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Parameterized Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种持续学习PINN方法，可提高参数化PDE求解的效率和泛化能力，对开发面向植入物设计的FEA代理模型具有借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical or implant-specific mechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not validate on any biomechanical FEA case.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有参数化PINN训练效率低、参数泛化差，需高效且平衡的求解方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出CL-PINN，结合贝叶斯主动参数选择、动态损失加权、稀疏物理约束回放和参数子网络，顺序学习不同参数任务。
summary_zh.result: 在五个基准上，CL-PINN相比基线获得更高且更均衡的精度，并减少目标损失查询次数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多种子数值基准测试验证，包括连续函数和四个参数化PDE。

summary_en.motivation: Existing parameterized PINNs suffer from inefficient training and poor generalization across parameter domains, motivating a continual-learning approach to improve accuracy and resource efficiency.
summary_en.method: The proposed CL-PINN sequentially learns PDE instances at different parameter values, integrating Bayesian-optimization-based active selection, dynamic loss weighting, sparse physics-constrained replay, and an optional parameter subnetwork.
summary_en.result: Multi-seed experiments on five benchmarks show that CL-PINN achieves higher and more balanced accuracy than fixed-sampling and grid-greedy baselines while reducing objective-loss queries.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks on a continuous function and four parameterized PDEs, with multi-seed evaluations under prescribed resource protocols.

title: Benchmarking Multi-fidelity Neural Operators on Complex PDE Problems with Non-trivial Fidelity Differences
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统比较了多保真神经算子策略，对提高FEA代理模型的采样效率和鲁棒性具有参考价值，但未涉及生物医学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply multi-fidelity neural operators to biomedical or implant-related FEA problems, nor does it address constraints or uncertainty quantification in design optimization.

summary_zh.method: 在四个PDE案例上比较两步、残差、中间和迁移学习等策略，并引入两个新案例模拟真实保真度差异。
summary_zh.result: 迁移学习在保真度差异大时更稳健，直接馈送LF预测易误差放大。
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准PDE基准和新增复杂案例的数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically evaluate multi-fidelity neural operator strategies under realistic fidelity discrepancies beyond simple grid resolution differences.
summary_en.method: Benchmarking two-step, residual, intermediate, and transfer learning approaches on four PDE test cases, including two newly designed cases with nontrivial LF-HF mismatches.
summary_en.result: Transfer learning consistently outperforms other strategies, especially under large fidelity gaps, while direct LF feeding suffers from error amplification.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard and newly introduced PDE benchmarks.

title: Active Learning Guided Design Space Refinement for Scalable Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种主动学习引导的搜索空间缩减方法，可加速多目标贝叶斯优化，对提高植入物设计中的仿真采样效率具有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond Pareto front preservation, and does not involve finite element analysis or biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化在大规模离散设计空间中效率低下，常浪费评估预算。
summary_zh.method: 提出主动学习引导的自适应搜索空间缩减框架，结合多目标贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 候选空间缩减约一半，同时保留99%以上超体积，加速收敛和Pareto前沿发现。
summary_zh.validation: 在COF气体分离和压力容器设计两个数值案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional Bayesian optimization becomes inefficient when exploring large discrete design spaces, often wasting evaluation budget on low-value regions.
summary_en.method: The paper proposes an active-learning-guided adaptive search space refinement framework integrated with multi-objective Bayesian optimization to focus on Pareto-relevant regions.
summary_en.result: The approach reduces the candidate space by approximately half while preserving over 99% of the original hypervolume, improving early convergence and cumulative Pareto-front discovery.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on two numerical benchmark problems: CH4/N2 separation in covalent-organic frameworks and pressure-vessel design with material-direction stress components and thickness objectives.

title: Hierarchical Micro/Nanostructured Anodized Surface for a 3D-Printed Bioactive Kinetic Screw
first_author_affiliation: Biomedical Engineering Department, School of Engineering and Computing, American International University, Saad Al Abdullah, Block 3, Al Jahra 91100, Kuwait
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印植入体的表面改性，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向关联有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on surface anodization and preliminary FEA of nanotube mechanical response.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索3D打印植入体表面纳米形貌的整合，以提升生物活性。
summary_zh.method: 对3D打印和CNC加工的钛合金螺钉进行不同阳极氧化处理，并表征表面形貌和进行有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: PEO产生微孔表面，HA产生小孔，TNT形成纳米管，FEA显示纳米管可承受扭矩。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM表征和初步FEA模拟验证，无实验力学测试。

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to integrate additive manufacturing with controlled nanotopography to enhance the bioactivity of orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Three anodization protocols (PEO, hard anodization, and soft anodization for TiO2 nanotubes) were applied to 3D-printed and CNC-machined Ti6Al4V screws, followed by SEM characterization and finite element analysis of nanotube mechanical response.
summary_en.result: Distinct hierarchical surface morphologies were achieved, and FEA indicated that TiO2 nanotubes can withstand applied torque, suggesting mechanical resilience for early loading.
summary_en.validation: Validation was limited to SEM imaging and a preliminary finite element simulation, without experimental mechanical testing or biological assays.

title: Gradient-Based Equation Adaptive Weighting in Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Water Hammer Analysis
first_author_affiliation: School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering, North University of China, Taiyuan 030051, China

corresponding_authors.name: 任福德
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Chemistry and Chemical Engineering, North University of China, Taiyuan 030051, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的梯度自适应加权PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or any biomedical context; it focuses on water hammer PDEs with numerical validation only.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在多方程耦合时优化不稳定和损失不平衡的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于梯度的方程自适应加权策略，动态调整各PDE损失权重，并联合反演模型参数。
summary_zh.result: 在水锤案例中压力相对误差0.00742，速度0.0183，且对噪声和随机种子鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 使用高精度数值解作为参考，并测试不同随机种子和25dB噪声下的稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome optimization instability and imbalanced contributions of multiple governing equations in conventional PINNs for hydraulic transient problems.
summary_en.method: A gradient-based adaptive weighting strategy is integrated into the PINN framework to dynamically balance loss terms from different PDE constraints, with the Brunone model coefficient treated as a trainable parameter for simultaneous inversion.
summary_en.result: The proposed GEAW-PINN improves training stability and prediction accuracy, achieving relative errors of 0.00742 for pressure and 0.0183 for velocity in a reservoir-pipeline-valve system, and robust performance under noise and random seeds.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated against high-accuracy numerical solutions and tested for robustness under different random seeds and 25 dB noise.

title: Exploiting Separability in Multi-Scale Grey-Box Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用问题可分性的双层贝叶斯优化方法，可提升昂贵仿真优化效率，对植入物设计中的代理模型优化具有潜在借鉴意义。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA or biomechanical implant design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP posterior, and it lacks any biomedical or mechanical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升昂贵黑箱与白箱混合优化问题的求解效率。
summary_zh.method: 利用变量可分性，将问题分解为外层贝叶斯优化和内层全局优化。
summary_zh.result: 在13个基准问题上，双层BO以更少迭代和耗时取得更低遗憾。
summary_zh.validation: 通过13个数值基准问题验证，未涉及实际工程应用。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of optimizing expensive problems that combine black-box and white-box variables by exploiting their separable structure.
summary_en.method: A bilevel reformulation is proposed where an outer Bayesian optimization loop optimizes the black-box variables while an inner global optimizer solves the white-box subproblem exactly.
summary_en.result: The bilevel approach achieves lower regret with fewer iterations and reduced wall-clock time across 13 benchmark problems, with robustness to initialization and solver choices.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a suite of 13 numerical benchmark problems, without experimental or domain-specific testing.

title: Experimental Data Driven ANN Model for Permeability Prediction in TPMS Lattices
first_author_affiliation: Samrat Ashok Technological Institute
relevance_to_user: 该论文虽未涉及植入物力学性能，但其基于实验数据的机器学习预测TPMS晶格渗透率的方法，可迁移至骨植入物多孔结构的设计与性能预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on permeability prediction in TPMS lattices without any implant-specific mechanical or biological validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 为快速预测TPMS晶格渗透率，避免大量实验测量。
summary_zh.method: 基于五种TPMS晶格和四种孔隙率的实验渗透率数据，训练回归机器学习模型。
summary_zh.result: 模型可准确预测新设计的渗透率，并识别影响渗透率的关键几何特征。
summary_zh.validation: 采用定制流动装置在不同流速下进行实验测量，验证模型预测。

summary_en.motivation: To enable rapid prediction of permeability in TPMS lattice structures, reducing the need for extensive experimental measurements.
summary_en.method: Experimental permeability data from five TPMS lattice types at four porosity levels were used to train regression-based machine learning models linking geometry, porosity, flow rate, and permeability.
summary_en.result: The trained models achieve high predictive accuracy for new TPMS designs and identify dominant geometric features influencing permeability.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using a custom flow-through experimental setup across a range of flow rates, confirming consistency with Darcy's law.

title: Diffusion-based inverse design of organ-inspired auxetic metastructure patches
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Iowa Technology Institute, University of Iowa

corresponding_authors.name: Yingbin Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Iowa Technology Institute, University of Iowa

relevance_to_user: 该论文的扩散模型引导逆向设计与CNN代理模型方法可迁移至植入物力学性能的快速预测与多目标优化，但未涉及髋关节植入物或骨力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address hip implant stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics, and lacks any biomedical implant validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有器官贴片设计依赖预设结构，难以匹配组织非线性力学响应。
summary_zh.method: 构建CNN代理模型预测力学响应，结合扩散模型与ε-约束引导生成满足多目标的设计。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型R²高，逆向设计能恢复已知几何并生成替代方案，案例展示器官贴片候选。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元数据集训练代理模型，并用测试集和案例研究验证框架。

summary_en.motivation: Current organ-patch designs rely on predefined architectures and limited descriptors, failing to capture coupled tissue-like mechanical responses.
summary_en.method: A diffusion-based inverse design framework integrates a CNN surrogate with an ε-constraint guided reverse diffusion process to generate auxetic metastructure patches matching stress-strain and Poisson's ratio targets.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves near-perfect R² values, and the framework recovers known geometries and produces alternative designs, demonstrating one-to-many inverse mapping and application-dependent trade-offs.
summary_en.validation: Validation uses a finite element dataset for surrogate training, test-set verification, and organ-inspired case studies with secondary FE screening.

title: Curvature modulation of TPMS-based lattices: from geometric design to enhanced mechanical responses
first_author_affiliation: Chongqing University
relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦TPMS点阵的曲率调控与力学性能，虽未直接涉及植入物或应力屏蔽，但其设计-力学关系对骨科植入物刚度匹配具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or osseointegration assessment, and does not link porous structures to stress shielding or implant stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索曲率调控对TPMS点阵力学性能的影响，以扩展设计空间。
summary_zh.method: 通过几何设计改变TPMS点阵曲率，结合数值模拟分析力学响应。
summary_zh.result: 曲率调控可显著改变点阵的刚度与强度，实现性能定制。
summary_zh.validation: 采用数值模拟验证，无实验测试。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate how curvature modulation in TPMS-based lattices can tailor their mechanical responses, thereby expanding the design space for lattice structures.
summary_en.method: The authors systematically vary the curvature of TPMS unit cells through geometric design and employ numerical simulations to evaluate the resulting mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Curvature modulation is shown to significantly influence the stiffness and strength of TPMS lattices, enabling customized mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: The findings are validated through numerical benchmarks without experimental mechanical testing.

title: Comparative study of selective laser melted and spark plasma sintered Ti-6Al-4V with LaB6 addition
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology
first_author_affiliation: School of Physics and Chemistry, Hunan First Normal University, Changsha 410205, China

corresponding_authors.name: Taomei Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Third Hospital of Shanxi Medical University, Shanxi Bethune Hospital, Shanxi Academy of Medical Sciences, Tongji Shanxi Hospital, Taiyuan, 030032, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构和力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物方向相关性有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface morphology relevant to biomedical implants; it focuses on the effect of LaB6 addition on microstructure and compressive strength of dense SLM/SPS Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较LaB6添加对SLM和SPS制备Ti-6Al-4V微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 将Ti-6Al-4V粉末与LaB6混合，分别用SLM和SPS制备，并表征微观结构和压缩性能。
summary_zh.result: SLM样品因快速冷却形成α′马氏体，压缩强度更高；LaB6添加提高屈服强度但降低极限压缩强度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构观察和压缩力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to compare the effects of lanthanum hexaboride addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by spark plasma sintering and selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Gas-atomized Ti-6Al-4V powders were mixed with LaB6 and consolidated via SPS and SLM, followed by microstructural characterization and compressive testing.
summary_en.result: SLM-processed samples exhibited a fully acicular α′ martensitic structure and higher ultimate compressive strength (1920 MPa) compared to SPS (1540 MPa), while LaB6 addition increased yield strength but reduced ultimate compressive strength due to weak interfaces.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through microstructural analysis and compressive mechanical testing of the fabricated specimens.

title: Automatic Patient-Specific Microwave Ablation Planning Accelerated by a Physics-Guided Deep Learning Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了物理引导深度学习模型在医学治疗规划中的应用，其数字孪生和优化方法可迁移至生物打印的工艺规划与质量控制。
why_not_core: This paper does not address bioprinting, nor does it involve any experimental validation on biological or material systems; it focuses on microwave ablation planning with simulation-based validation only.

summary_zh.motivation: 微波消融规划依赖昂贵数值模拟，难以用于优化。
summary_zh.method: 提出数字孪生框架，用物理引导神经网络作为快速前向模型，结合遗传算法自动规划。
summary_zh.result: 在13例规划中效率提升54.3%，器官损伤降低55%，速度提高420倍。
summary_zh.validation: 基于多物理仿真数据训练，并在未见病例上评估，由专家判断临床可行性。

summary_en.motivation: Microwave ablation planning relies on expensive numerical simulations, limiting its use in optimization-based approaches.
summary_en.method: A digital twin framework is proposed that employs a physics-guided neural network as a fast forward model integrated with a genetic algorithm for automatic patient-specific planning.
summary_en.result: The framework improved ablation efficiency by 54.3% and reduced organ damage by 55.0% across 13 unseen cases, while achieving a 420-fold speedup over simulation-based planning.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed on simulation-generated data and unseen patient cases, with clinical applicability assessed by MWA specialists.

title: A thermal-fluidic-driven, retrievable shape memory polymer colonic stent: design and multi-objective optimization
venue: International Journal of Smart and Nano Materials

corresponding_authors.affiliation: The University of Tokyo

corresponding_authors.name: Mitsuhiro Fujishiro

corresponding_authors.affiliation: The University of Tokyo

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了结合有限元模拟、代理模型和多目标优化的设计框架，对用户研究中的FEA代理建模和优化方法具有可迁移的参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics (e.g., hip implant stress shielding) nor does it incorporate uncertainty quantification or patient-specific modeling, focusing instead on a colonic stent design with deterministic surrogate-based optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为满足临时结肠介入的临床需求，设计可回收且刚度可变的支架。
summary_zh.method: 采用DoE引导有限元模拟，结合RSM和GPR代理模型，用NSGA-II进行多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 获得帕累托前沿并聚类为七类设计，满足不同临床需求。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验验证了优化框架的准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the clinical need for temporary colonic interventions, a retrievable shape memory polymer stent with variable stiffness is proposed.
summary_en.method: A multi-objective optimization framework integrates Design of Experiments-guided finite element simulations with response surface and Gaussian process surrogate models, followed by NSGA-II optimization.
summary_en.result: The optimization yielded a Pareto-optimal front clustered into seven design families, offering tailored solutions for distinct clinical scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Experimental testing confirmed the accuracy of the surrogate-based optimization framework.

title: A shifted cohesive-zone method for non-interface-fitted meshes with applications to crystal plasticity
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Argonne National Laboratory, 9700 S Cass Ave, Lemont, IL 60439, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Cheng-Hau Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Argonne National Laboratory, 9700 S Cass Ave, Lemont, IL 60439, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需界面匹配网格的移位内聚区方法，其数值方法和网格处理技术可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的网格生成与界面处理问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on interface mechanics in crystal plasticity with non-interface-fitted meshes.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂微结构界面力学模拟中网格生成困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出移位内聚区方法，将牵引-分离定律从真实界面移至替代界面，并采用PCA增强点分类加速构建。
summary_zh.result: 在二维和三维基准测试中实现一阶收敛，与界面匹配参考解吻合良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维和三维数值基准测试验证精度和收敛性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the meshing burden of interface-conformal discretizations in simulating interface-dominated solid mechanics on complex microstructures.
summary_en.method: The Shifted Cohesive Zone Method (SCZM) extends the shifted boundary method to cohesive-zone formulations, shifting traction-separation enforcement to a surrogate interface and using a PCA-enhanced point classification for efficient domain construction.
summary_en.result: SCZM achieves first-order convergence and closely matches interface-fitted reference solutions in terms of reaction forces, energy release, stress fields, and damage evolution.
summary_en.validation: The method is verified through two- and three-dimensional benchmark problems demonstrating convergence and accuracy.

summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates improved accuracy and efficiency in reservoir parameter inversion compared to baseline methods.

summary_en.result: The hybrid approach outperforms single-model baselines in predicting elastic properties, demonstrating enhanced accuracy and generalization.

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration, focusing solely on solid material microstructure and static mechanical properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决钛合金强度与塑性难以兼得的问题。
summary_zh.method: 对比L-PBF和EB-PBF制备的TC4合金的微观组织与力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in titanium alloys by comparing two powder bed fusion techniques.

title: tFUSOperator: Operator Learning for Transcranial Focused Ultrasound Digital Twins
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于医学物理仿真的神经算子代理模型，其方法可迁移至骨科植入物有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物力学或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or any biomechanical context; it focuses on transcranial focused ultrasound field prediction, which is outside the user's core directions.

summary_zh.motivation: 经颅聚焦超声数字孪生需快速重复估计颅内声场，传统数值求解器太慢。
summary_zh.method: 提出坐标感知的神经算子tFUSOperator，将自由场压力、颅骨解剖和治疗参数映射到颅内声场。
summary_zh.result: 在未见颅骨上焦点定位Dice约72%，比数值模拟快5.6×10^4倍，且可从MR输入获得相近性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值模拟生成的颅骨数据上验证，包括已见和未见颅骨，并比较CT与MR输入。

summary_en.motivation: Transcranial focused ultrasound digital twins require rapid re-estimation of intracranial acoustic fields, which is computationally prohibitive with numerical solvers.
summary_en.method: The authors propose tFUSOperator, a coordinate-aware neural operator that maps free-field pressure, skull anatomy, and treatment parameters to the intracranial field in a shared coordinate frame.
summary_en.result: The model achieves about 72% Dice on unseen skulls, runs 5.6e4 times faster than numerical simulation, and performs nearly as well with MR input as with CT.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical simulation data for both seen and unseen skulls, including a comparison of CT and MR input modalities.

title: Two‐Stage Neural Network for Modeling Ductile Fracture in Structural Steel
venue: Fatigue & Fracture of Engineering Materials & Structures
first_author_affiliation: School of Sustainable Engineering and the Built Environment, Ira A. Fulton Schools of Engineering Arizona State University  Tempe Arizona USA
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种两阶段神经网络代理模型，用于加速GTN韧性断裂模拟，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical context, or patient-specific design; it focuses on ductile fracture in structural steel, lacking biomedical validation and contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: GTN模型计算开销大，限制其在结构钢有限元模拟中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出两阶段神经网络代理模型，解耦材料参数映射与应力状态依赖，训练于单单元GTN模拟数据。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型误差小，预测失效应变与GTN结果偏差小于5%，计算时间减少35-95倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过单单元模拟训练，并在ASTM A992钢试样上验证断裂位移预测。

summary_en.motivation: The coupled GTN fracture model is computationally expensive, hindering its use in large-scale finite element simulations of steel structures.
summary_en.method: A two-stage artificial neural network (TS-ANN) is proposed, which decouples material parameter mapping from stress-state dependence, trained on 49,875 single-element GTN simulations.
summary_en.result: The TS-ANN achieves a mean absolute error of 0.00143, predicts failure strain within 5% of GTN results for over 99% of data, and reduces computational time by 35-95 times when implemented in ABAQUS.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated by comparing predicted fracture displacement in ASTM A992 steel specimens against GTN-based results, showing less than 5% deviation.

title: Temperature prediction for in-situ consolidation in the AFP process using physics-informed neural network

summary_zh.method: 采用物理信息神经网络融合热物理方程与数据驱动预测。
summary_zh.result: 实现了对原位固结温度场的快速准确预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真案例验证了模型预测能力。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency and accuracy of temperature prediction during automated fiber placement in-situ consolidation.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network integrates thermal physics equations with data-driven learning to predict temperature fields.
summary_en.result: The model achieves fast and accurate prediction of temperature distribution during consolidation.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated through simulation cases, demonstrating its predictive capability.

title: Superior strength-ductility synergy in heterostructured zinc alloy implants fabricated via laser powder bed fusion
first_author_affiliation: Jiangxi University of Science and Technology - Nanchang Campus
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造生物医用锌合金植入物，但其重点在强度-塑性协同而非应力遮挡或骨整合，与用户方向部分相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升可降解锌合金植入物的强度与塑性协同性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF交替高低能量密度构建粗/细晶异质层状结构。
summary_zh.result: 获得抗拉强度245.6 MPa和延展性12.7%，实现优异强塑性协同。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in biodegradable zinc alloys for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Laser powder bed fusion was used to fabricate Zn-Cu alloys with alternating coarse- and fine-grained layers by varying energy density between layer groups.
summary_en.result: The heterostructured alloy achieved an ultimate tensile strength of 245.6 MPa and ductility of 12.7%, showing superior synergy.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing, degradation assessment, and osteogenic activity evaluation were performed.

title: Resource Assessment with Uncertainty Quantification of Intrusive Orebodies Using Level Sets with Stochastic Motion: Application to a Shear-Hosted Copper Deposit
first_author_affiliation: Geology and Sustainable Mining Institute, University Mohammed VI Polytechnic, Ben Guerir 43150, Morocco

corresponding_authors.name: Abdelaziz Zine
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Geology and Sustainable Mining Institute, University Mohammed VI Polytechnic, Ben Guerir 43150, Morocco

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于水平集和MCMC的几何不确定性量化框架，可迁移至植入物-骨界面几何不确定性的代理建模与UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on geological resource modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 地质模型几何不确定性常被忽略，导致资源量评估偏差。
summary_zh.method: 结合水平集隐式建模与MCMC采样，并耦合序贯高斯模拟生成几何与品位联合实现。
summary_zh.result: 在铜矿床案例中，确定性模型高估吨位，联合集合提供更现实的品位-吨位不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 应用于摩洛哥Tarmante铜矿床，对比确定性模型与集合结果。

summary_en.motivation: Geometric uncertainty in geological models is often neglected, leading to biased resource estimates.
summary_en.method: A sequential framework integrates level-set implicit modeling with MCMC sampling and Sequential Gaussian Simulation to generate joint geometry and grade realizations.
summary_en.result: Applied to a copper deposit, the deterministic model overestimates tonnage while the joint ensemble yields more realistic grade-tonnage uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on a real copper deposit case study, comparing deterministic and ensemble-based resource assessments.

title: QUEENS: an open-source Python framework for solver-independent analyses of large-scale computational models – from parameter studies and identification, sensitivity analysis, surrogates, optimization, (Bayesian) forward and backward uncertainty quantification to digital twinning
first_author_affiliation: AdCo Engineering GW GmbH, Oskar-Messter-Str. 33, 85737, Ismaning, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了一个开源框架，支持不确定性量化、代理模型和优化，可迁移至植入物生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: 该论文未涉及具体生物医学植入物或有限元代理模型的应用，也未提供针对应力遮挡或骨-植入物界面的验证案例。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大规模计算模型重复分析的效率问题，支持数字孪生等应用。
summary_zh.method: 开发开源Python框架QUEENS，集成参数研究、优化、UQ、代理模型和贝叶斯反演。
summary_zh.result: 提供模块化、可扩展的框架，支持多保真UQ和概率机器学习。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证框架功能。

summary_en.motivation: The paper addresses the need for efficient and systematic analysis of large-scale computational models, such as patient-specific digital twins, by providing a reusable open-source framework.
summary_en.method: QUEENS is a modular Python framework that integrates simulation management with algorithms for parameter studies, optimization, sensitivity analysis, surrogate modeling, and Bayesian uncertainty quantification, supporting multi-fidelity approaches.
summary_en.result: The framework enables flexible composition of analyses and facilitates hierarchical algorithm development, promoting adoption in engineering and research.
summary_en.validation: The framework's capabilities are demonstrated through numerical benchmark examples, though no specific application to implant biomechanics is presented.

title: Physics‐Informed Neural Networks for Flexoelectric Boundary Value Problems: A Reformulated Architecture for High‐ and Mixed‐Order Electromechanically Coupled Systems
venue: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering Mechanics, School of Aerospace Engineering Huazhong University of Science and Technology  Wuhan China
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN架构，用于处理高阶和混合阶耦合偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的复杂多物理场问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not include experimental validation or patient-specific cases.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决柔性电边界值问题中高阶混合阶耦合PDE导致PINN训练困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出重构的PINN架构，引入伪输出和辅助损失，降低微分阶数并平衡耦合场间的阶数差异。
summary_zh.result: 在代表性基准问题上表现出优于朴素PINN的精度和训练效率。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题验证，无实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the training difficulties of naive PINNs when solving flexoelectric boundary value problems governed by high-order and mixed-order coupled PDEs.
summary_en.method: A reformulated PINN architecture is proposed that incorporates pseudo outputs and auxiliary losses to reduce the differential order and balance the order disparity across coupled fields.
summary_en.result: The proposed architecture demonstrates superior accuracy and training efficiency over naive formulations on representative flexoelectric benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmark problems, without experimental data.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Sparse Strain-Field Reconstruction in 4D-STEM
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN稀疏重建方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks biomechanical context, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少4D-STEM应变成像的采样密度，避免损伤敏感样品。
summary_zh.method: 构建嵌入弹性平衡与相容性物理约束的PINN，结合正弦激活与自适应配点。
summary_zh.result: 在10%采样下R²达0.80，误差较压缩感知降低26%。
summary_zh.validation: 基于实验应变图与多种采样率对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the sampling density required for quantitative strain mapping in 4D-STEM, thereby minimizing beam damage to sensitive specimens.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network embedding elastic equilibrium and Saint-Venant compatibility in the loss, with sine activations and adaptive collocation.
summary_en.result: The PINN achieves R² of 0.80 at 10% sampling and reduces mean absolute error by 26% compared to compressed sensing.
summary_en.validation: Validated on an experimental strain map of PbGeSnSe1.5Te1.5 with varying sampling rates and compared against compressed sensing and Gaussian process regression.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Network Coupled with an Extended Kalman Filter for Turbulent Channel Flow Reconstruction Across Multiple Reynolds Numbers
venue: European Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
first_author_affiliation: University of Antananarivo, Madagascar
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与扩展卡尔曼滤波结合用于湍流重建，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化与数据同化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, lacks contact mechanics or implant-specific constraints, and does not validate on any biomechanical or structural mechanics problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN在稀疏或分布外数据下的湍流重建精度。
summary_zh.method: 将PINN与扩展卡尔曼滤波结合，进行顺序空间校正并自适应调整噪声协方差。
summary_zh.result: 相比单独PINN，MSE降低46.6%至51.2%，平均改善49.1%。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个雷诺数下用DNS数据评估，未重新训练。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural network reconstructions of turbulent statistics when data are sparse or out-of-distribution.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework couples a PINN parameterized by friction Reynolds number with an extended Kalman filter that performs sequential spatial corrections with adaptive noise covariance tuning.
summary_en.result: The PINN+EKF approach reduces mean squared error by 46.6% to 51.2% across Reynolds numbers compared to the standalone PINN, with a mean improvement of 49.1%.
summary_en.validation: The model is trained on DNS data at Re_tau=5200 and evaluated without retraining on multiple Reynolds numbers (550, 2000, 5200, 10000).

why_not_core: This paper does not use LPBF fabrication, does not include mechanical testing (only FEA), and does not address stress shielding or fatigue behavior.

summary_zh.validation: 仅通过FEA模拟和形态学分析验证，无机械测试。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a patient-specific scaffold design workflow for maxillary bone regeneration using TPMS structures.
summary_en.method: Reconstructed a bone defect from CT images, designed five TPMS variants in CAD, evaluated their compressive behavior via FEA, and fabricated prototypes using SLA.
summary_en.result: Lidinoid and Schwarz P topologies showed minimal deformation under load, and fabricated scaffolds exhibited interconnected porosity with pore sizes suitable for cell infiltration.
summary_en.validation: Validation was limited to computational FEA and morphological analysis of SLA-fabricated prototypes, without mechanical testing.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical FEA, or any biomedical context; it focuses on thermal modeling of electric spindles.

summary_en.method: A surrogate model combining Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) for dimensionality reduction and a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) based Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) is developed to predict temperature fields.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves high prediction accuracy while significantly reducing computational time compared to full-order simulations.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated on numerical simulation cases of electric spindle thermal behavior.

title: Machine learning in laser powder bed fusion: a data-centric review of structural prediction and process optimization
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: The high cost of experimental defect identification in LPBF motivates the development of efficient predictive approaches.
summary_en.method: This review systematically surveys machine learning applications in LPBF, emphasizing the role of physical understanding in data collection, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
summary_en.result: It provides a structured framework for leveraging ML to enhance predictive accuracy and computational efficiency, particularly via simulation-driven data generation.

title: Machine Learning-Based Static Performance Prediction of Bonded Structural Patch Repairs
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, The City College of New York, New York, NY 10031, USA
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了FE增强机器学习框架在结构修复中的应用，其数据增强和回归方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification beyond point predictions, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决结构修复中实验数据有限的问题，提高失效载荷预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 结合有限元模拟与多种机器学习回归模型，利用FE数据扩充训练集。
summary_zh.result: 最优模型对未见配置的预测误差低于3.5%，但合成数据增强无益。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验与有限元结果对比验证，并采用嵌套交叉验证评估泛化性。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the scarcity of experimental data in structural repair applications by developing a data-efficient framework that integrates finite element simulations with machine learning for accurate failure load prediction.
summary_en.method: A FE-augmented ML framework was proposed, where high-fidelity FE models generated additional training data, and ten regression models (including GP, XGBoost, and KANs) were trained under leakage-free nested cross-validation with optional GMM-based synthetic augmentation.
summary_en.result: The best models achieved mean absolute percentage errors of 2.78% (patched) and 3.33% (unpatched) on unseen configurations, while ablation showed that GMM augmentation did not improve accuracy and often degraded it.
summary_en.validation: The approach was validated using experimental quasi-static tests on aluminum and steel specimens with composite patches at multiple temperatures, and FE predictions were confirmed to match experimental results closely.

title: Machine Learning-Based Investigation of the Compressive Behavior of TI6AL4V Lattice Structures

corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Debrecen

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface, and lacks experimental validation or uncertainty quantification beyond basic cross-validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高效预测Ti6Al4V点阵结构的弹性模量，减少仿真成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于25组仿真数据，比较线性回归、多项式回归、支持向量回归和高斯过程回归四种模型。

summary_zh.validation: 采用5折交叉验证和学习曲线评估数据充分性与模型可靠性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict the effective Young's modulus of Ti6Al4V lattice structures, reducing reliance on expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: Four regression-based machine learning models (LR, PR, SVR, GPR) were developed and compared using 25 simulation datasets in MATLAB.
summary_en.result: PR and GPR achieved the best predictive performance with lowest RMSE and highest R², and optimal training set size was identified around 36%-52% of the data.
summary_en.validation: Model reliability was assessed via 5-fold cross-validation and learning curves to analyze error versus training sample size.

title: Learning 1D stress resultant plasticity from 2D continuum plasticity: a physics-informed neural network model reduction approach

summary_zh.motivation: 为加速结构塑性仿真，需从细观塑性中学习降阶本构模型。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate structural plasticity simulations, a reduced-order constitutive model is learned from detailed continuum plasticity.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is trained to identify a closed-form moment-curvature law for elastoplastic beams, with the algorithmic return mapping embedded to enforce admissibility.

summary_en.method: It proposes an optimized adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter framework that uses a physics-aware objective function to tune hyperparameters, enabling virtual sensing, damage quantification, and uncertainty quantification.

summary_en.method: Finite element models of the bone-implant system were developed, with mesh convergence studies and design optimization for both mono-block and modular configurations.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on atomistic simulations and interatomic potentials, not on finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or structural mechanics, and does not address constraints or multi-objective design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有机器学习势缺乏不确定性量化，限制主动学习和可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯E(3)等变消息传递势，采用联合能量-力负对数似然损失。

summary_en.motivation: Machine learning potentials for atomistic simulations lack reliable uncertainty quantification, hindering active learning and out-of-distribution detection.
summary_en.method: The authors develop Bayesian E(3)-equivariant message passing potentials with a joint energy-force negative log-likelihood loss to model uncertainties in both energies and forces.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework achieves competitive accuracy while enabling uncertainty-guided active learning, OOD detection, and calibration, outperforming random and energy-uncertainty sampling.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on benchmark datasets through systematic comparison of multiple Bayesian inference techniques for uncertainty prediction and active learning tasks.
