title: Influence of volume energy density on the microstructure and properties of parts fabricated by laser powder bed fusion using recycled Ti6Al4V powder blends
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了回收Ti6Al4V粉末的LPBF工艺参数对微观结构和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究回收Ti6Al4V粉末的LPBF工艺参数对成形件性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过改变体积能量密度进行LPBF实验，分析微观结构和力学性能
summary_zh.result: 确定了最佳体积能量密度范围，获得了高致密度和良好力学性能的零件
summary_zh.validation: 通过密度测量、金相观察和拉伸/硬度测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of volume energy density on the microstructure and mechanical properties of parts fabricated by laser powder bed fusion using recycled Ti6Al4V powder blends.
summary_en.method: LPBF experiments were conducted with varying volume energy densities, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: An optimal volume energy density range was identified, yielding high density and satisfactory mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through density measurements, metallographic observation, and tensile/hardness tests.

title: INI-VPINN: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network with Implicit Neumann and Interface Handling for Multi-Material Domains with Geometric Singularities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理多材料域和几何奇异性的变分物理信息神经网络方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的多材料界面问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on solving PDEs with implicit Neumann/interface conditions in a variational PINN framework.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN难以自然处理多材料域中的Neumann边界和界面条件。
summary_zh.method: 提出INI-VPINN，通过紧支撑权函数和分部积分隐式施加通量和连续性约束。
summary_zh.result: 在Poisson和Laplace问题上相比其他PINN方法精度更高、收敛更平滑快速。
summary_zh.validation: 在具有尖锐界面和复杂几何的数值基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN approaches struggle to naturally incorporate Neumann boundary and interface conditions in multi-material domains.
summary_en.method: INI-VPINN implicitly enforces flux and continuity constraints via compact support weighting functions and integration by parts in a variational formulation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves higher accuracy, smoother and faster convergence on Poisson and Laplace problems compared to several other PINN formulations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems with sharp interfaces and complex geometries.

title: INI-VPINN: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network with Implicit Neumann and Interface Handling for Multi-Material Domains with Geometric Singularities
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的INI-VPINN方法能够高效处理多材料域和几何奇异性，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on solving Poisson/Laplace problems with geometric singularities, not on expensive simulation sampling or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN处理多材料域和界面条件时需额外损失项或子网络，效率低且精度不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出INI-VPINN，通过紧支撑权函数和分部积分隐式施加通量和连续性约束。
summary_zh.result: 在泊松和拉普拉斯问题上，相比其他PINN方法精度更高、收敛更平滑快速。
summary_zh.validation: 在具有尖锐界面和复杂几何的数值基准问题上进行测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN approaches require additional loss terms or multiple subdomain networks to handle Neumann and interface conditions, leading to inefficiency and reduced accuracy.
summary_en.method: INI-VPINN implicitly enforces flux and continuity constraints via compact support weighting functions and integration by parts within a variational formulation.
summary_en.result: The method achieves higher accuracy, smoother and faster convergence compared to several other PINN formulations on Poisson and Laplace problems with sharp interfaces.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on problems with complex geometries and mixed boundary conditions.

title: How Sparse and How Noisy? Systematic Benchmarking of Inverse Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Manning Friction Estimation in Shallow Water Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统评估了逆物理信息神经网络在稀疏噪声数据下参数估计的可靠性，其方法可迁移至生物力学中基于稀疏观测的材料参数反演。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on Manning friction estimation in shallow water equations, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估逆PINN在稀疏噪声数据下估计水力参数的可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 在1D和2D浅水方程中，将Manning系数作为可训练标量，采用两阶段策略联合反演流场和参数。
summary_zh.result: 2D案例在10个观测点且噪声≤10%时误差<5%，1D案例存在约15%的系统偏差。
summary_zh.validation: 基于解析解和有限体积数值解进行基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically benchmark the reliability of inverse physics-informed neural networks for estimating hydraulic parameters under varying observation sparsity and noise levels.
summary_en.method: The Manning friction coefficient is treated as a trainable scalar and jointly recovered with the flow field using a two-phase strategy that first fits observations and then incorporates the physics residual, tested on 1D and 2D shallow water equations.
summary_en.result: The 2D case achieves robust recovery with errors below 5% when at least 10 observations are available with noise ≤10%, while the 1D case exhibits a persistent positive bias of about 15% regardless of data density.
summary_en.validation: Validated against analytical steady reference solution for 1D and balanced finite-volume solver for 2D.

title: Generalization Guarantees for Multi-Input Neural Operator Learning in Sobolev Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文为多输入神经算子提供了理论保证，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的多物理场耦合问题。
why_not_core: No experimental validation on FEA or biomechanics problems; purely theoretical analysis without application to implant design or surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 为多输入神经算子提供严格的逼近与泛化误差界。
summary_zh.method: 在Sobolev范数下推导多输入神经算子的误差界，量化各输入空间贡献。
summary_zh.result: 得到了平衡状态下由输入维数、正则性和Sobolev阶数共同决定的误差率。
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论推导，无数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To establish rigorous approximation and generalization error bounds for neural operators with multiple input functions.
summary_en.method: Derives error estimates in Sobolev norms for multi-input neural operators, explicitly quantifying the contribution of each input space.
summary_en.result: Obtains error rates governed by input dimensions, regularities, and Sobolev orders in the balanced regime.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only, without numerical experiments.

title: Anisotropic porous hydrogel fiber coating modified titanium modulates the immune microenvironment to enhance endogenous bone regeneration.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛植入物的表面改性以促进骨整合，但未涉及LPBF制造、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding, or porous structure design for stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 钛植入物生物惰性导致骨整合差，需改善表面性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过静电纺丝和交联制备各向异性水凝胶纤维涂层修饰钛表面。
summary_zh.result: 涂层引导细胞排列、抑制炎症、促进成骨，体内减少纤维包裹并增强骨形成。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内大鼠模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: Titanium implants suffer from bioinertness compromising osseointegration, necessitating surface modification strategies.
summary_en.method: An anisotropic hydrogel fibrous coating composed of nano-hydroxyapatite, gelatin methacryloyl, and silk fibroin was fabricated via electrospinning and multimodal crosslinking on titanium.
summary_en.result: The coating guided BMSC alignment and migration, suppressed M1 macrophage polarization, promoted M2 transition, and enhanced peri-implant bone formation in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and in vivo rat implantation model.

title: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework Using Petrov-Galerkin Method for Solving Singularly Perturbed Boundary Value Problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种变分物理信息神经网络框架，可提高求解奇异摄动问题的精度，但其应用领域为偏微分方程数值求解，而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on 1D singularly perturbed BVPs and parabolic PDEs with no extension to 3D solid mechanics or design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络对奇异摄动问题的求解精度
summary_zh.method: 结合Petrov-Galerkin变分公式与深度神经网络，采用hat函数作为测试空间
summary_zh.result: 在L2和最大范数下精度显著优于标准VPINN
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维奇异摄动基准问题数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of physics-informed neural networks for singularly perturbed boundary value problems with sharp boundary layers.
summary_en.method: A variational PINN framework using Petrov-Galerkin formulation with neural network trial space and hat function test space, enforcing Dirichlet BCs via hard constraints.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves significantly higher accuracy in both L2 and maximum norms compared to standard VPINN on 1D singularly perturbed problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark 1D singularly perturbed differential equations and parabolic PDEs.

title: A Diagnostic Software Suite for Auditing Learned PDE Simulators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了评估学习型PDE模拟器的诊断工具，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型的验证，但未直接涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, does not handle design constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准L2误差不足以评估学习型PDE模拟器的结构一致性。
summary_zh.method: 开发了架构无关的诊断软件套件，包含多项结构诊断指标。
summary_zh.result: 结构诊断指标比L2误差更敏感，能揭示模型退化。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个PDE基准任务上使用多种神经网络架构验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard relative L2 error is insufficient to assess whether learned PDE simulators behave as coherent numerical time propagators.
summary_en.method: We develop an architecture-independent diagnostic software suite that evaluates semigroup consistency, generator discrepancy, energy behavior, integral balance, admissibility constraints, perturbation response, and scaling-law consistency.
summary_en.result: Structural diagnostics reveal substantial deterioration even when L2 error remains moderate or improves, providing a more informative audit than a single state-error score.
summary_en.validation: The suite is validated on five benchmark PDE tasks (2D Navier-Stokes, shallow water, active matter, 3D compressible Navier-Stokes, 3D MHD) using FNO, DeepONet, U-Net, and ResNet surrogates.

title: A Convex Quasilinearization Method for Solving Nonlinear PDEs with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过凸拟线性化替代非凸优化，可显著提高PINN求解非线性PDE的效率，有望迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型中。
why_not_core: The paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN依赖非凸梯度优化，收敛慢且不稳定。
summary_zh.method: 提出LiL-Q方法，用Bellman-Kalaba拟线性化将非线性PDE转为线性子问题，每步直接QR分解求解。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上，LiL-Q在少量外迭代内收敛，参数少且无需梯度优化。
summary_zh.validation: 在Bratu、Burgers、Navier-Stokes等七个基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from nonconvex gradient-based optimization, leading to slow and unstable convergence.
summary_en.method: LiL-Q uses Bellman-Kalaba quasilinearization to reduce nonlinear PDEs to a sequence of linear subproblems, each solved by direct QR factorization on a linear-in-parameters trial space.
summary_en.result: The method converges in few outer iterations across multiple benchmarks, matches or exceeds published PINN solvers with far fewer parameters and no gradient optimization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on seven nonlinear PDEs including Bratu, Burgers, Navier-Stokes, and Darcy flow.

title: Uncertainty Quantification of Engineering Structures by Polynomial Chaos Expansion and Multivariate Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多输出自适应采样方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型构建，提高多目标响应（如应力、位移）的采样效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真模型多输出响应下单一实验设计难以兼顾所有输出精度
summary_zh.method: 提出基于多项式混沌展开的多变量主动学习自适应采样方法
summary_zh.result: 相比拉丁超立方采样，代理模型精度和稳定性提升，二阶统计量估计更可靠
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个工程数值算例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: A single experimental design often fails to provide adequate surrogate accuracy for multiple quantities of interest simultaneously due to varying output sensitivities.
summary_en.method: An adaptive sequential sampling method for polynomial chaos expansion surrogates is generalized to vector-valued outputs, balancing exploration and exploitation of aggregated variance.
summary_en.result: The proposed strategy improves surrogate accuracy and stability, yielding more reliable second-order statistics compared to non-sequential Latin Hypercube Sampling.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples from engineering problems demonstrate the method's performance.

why_not_core: This is a review paper without original experimental data, and it does not specifically address stress shielding or osseointegration in biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 从数学理想结构到可靠工程部件的转变需要可靠性导向设计。
summary_zh.method: 综述几何控制、制造缺陷、疲劳行为及服务性能的交互关系。
summary_zh.result: 提出未来TPMS设计应向缺陷容限、工艺感知和服务特定优化发展。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述性讨论。

summary_en.motivation: The transition from mathematically ideal TPMS structures to reliable engineering components requires a reliability-oriented design perspective.
summary_en.method: This review discusses the interplay among geometry encoding, manufacturability limits, surface/internal defects, post-processing, fatigue behavior, and application-specific trade-offs.
summary_en.result: Future TPMS design should shift from performance maximization under ideal conditions toward defect-tolerant, process-aware, and service-specific optimization.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a review paper.

title: Petrov-Galerkin Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Two-Dimensional Singularly Perturbed Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Petrov-Galerkin变分物理信息神经网络方法可推广到生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on singularly perturbed PDEs with no FEA surrogate or UQ component.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解二维奇异摄动问题中的尖锐边界层。
summary_zh.method: 采用神经网络构建试验解空间，张量积帽函数作为测试函数，实现Petrov-Galerkin变分形式。
summary_zh.result: 在最大范数和L2范数下均达到高精度，有效捕捉多尺度特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准二维算例验证精度和鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve two-dimensional singularly perturbed problems with sharp boundary layers using a neural network framework.
summary_en.method: A Petrov-Galerkin variational PINN is proposed, where neural networks construct the trial space and tensor-product hat functions serve as test functions to enforce the variational form.
summary_en.result: High accuracy in both maximum and L2 norms is achieved on standard 2D problems, demonstrating robust capture of multiscale features.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark 2D singularly perturbed problems validate the method's accuracy and efficiency.

summary_en.motivation: This review consolidates biophysical characterization techniques for ultra-short peptide hydrogels to enable rational design for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: It critically summarizes rheology, microscopy, spectroscopy, and thermal analysis methods, and highlights the emerging role of machine learning in predictive peptide engineering.
summary_en.result: Integrating multiple characterization techniques allows tailoring hydrogel properties, and AI/ML offers a promising avenue for accelerating peptide design.

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on geotechnical consolidation without experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决层状土体固结问题中解析解有限且传统数值方法效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 采用域分解XPINN框架，嵌入控制方程、边界条件和界面连续性约束，结合自适应激活函数和残差重采样。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of analytical solutions for layered soil consolidation and the inefficiency of traditional numerical methods for forward and inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A domain-decomposed XPINN framework is developed, embedding governing equations, boundary conditions, and interface continuity constraints, enhanced with layer-wise locally adaptive activation functions and residual-based adaptive resampling.
summary_en.result: The XPINN achieves a relative L2 error of 0.0173 for two-layered consolidation forward problems and successfully identifies unknown drainage coefficients in inverse tests.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against analytical solutions and finite difference benchmarks, without experimental or field data.

title: MR-GVNO: A Geometry-Aware Variational Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Mindlin-Reissner Plates on Irregular Domains

title: Transformer-Guided Graph Attention for Direct Cardiac Mesh Reconstruction: A Structural Digital Twin Framework
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种端到端的网格生成方法，可迁移至生物打印中的数字孪生或模型重建任务。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting, bioink, or any AI-driven bioprinting workflow stage (pre/in/post-printing).

summary_zh.motivation: 传统心脏网格生成流程繁琐耗时，阻碍临床数字孪生应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出3D Swin Transformer与图注意力网络结合的端到端模型，直接从医学图像生成网格。
summary_zh.result: 在MM-WHS 2017基准上，Dice分数0.84（CT）和0.83（MRI），Chamfer距离1.8 mm。
summary_zh.validation: 在公开数据集上评估分割精度和网格质量指标。

summary_en.motivation: The standard cardiac mesh generation pipeline is slow and operator-dependent, hindering clinical adoption of digital twins.
summary_en.method: An end-to-end network combining a 3D Swin Transformer encoder-decoder with a Graph Attention Network head that deforms a template mesh to patient anatomy from raw medical images.
summary_en.result: Competitive segmentation (Dice 0.84 on CT, 0.83 on MRI) and high-quality meshes (mean Chamfer distance 1.8 mm) in a single forward pass.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the MM-WHS 2017 benchmark using CT and MRI volumes, with quantitative metrics for segmentation and mesh quality.

title: Precision bioprinting-based extrusion of tumour spheroids on pre-matured in vitro tissue models on demand.

title: Multi-Objective Optimization of a Composite FRP Laminated Sandwich Structure Using Artificial Neural Network and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on composite sandwich structures.

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of high-fidelity finite element analyses in multi-objective optimization of composite sandwich structures.
summary_en.method: An ANN surrogate model approximates structural responses, integrated with a multi-objective niching memetic particle swarm optimization algorithm.
summary_en.result: A diverse set of Pareto-optimal solutions is obtained and validated through detailed FE simulations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing surrogate-predicted optimal designs against detailed finite element simulations.

title: Mechanical, electrochemical corrosion, and biocompatibility analysis of EBM-printed Ti6Al4V scaffolds to reduce stress shielding in medical implants

why_not_core: This paper focuses on porous scaffolds for general stress shielding reduction, not on femoral stem implants, proximal femur stress distribution, or micromotion at the bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少医用植入物应力遮挡效应

summary_zh.validation: 力学测试、电化学腐蚀测试和细胞相容性实验

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding in medical implants by designing porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds with tailored mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Electron beam melting (EBM) was used to fabricate Ti6Al4V scaffolds with varying porosity, followed by mechanical compression, electrochemical corrosion, and biocompatibility tests.
summary_en.result: The porous scaffolds exhibited reduced stiffness compared to solid Ti6Al4V, potentially mitigating stress shielding, while maintaining adequate corrosion resistance and cytocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing (compression), electrochemical corrosion analysis, and in vitro cell viability assays.

title: Reliable Error Estimation for PINNs: Lower and Upper A Posteriori Bounds
relevance_to_user: 该论文为PINN提供严格的后验误差界，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型的可靠性评估。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on ODEs and does not address PDE-based FEA surrogate modeling, implant design constraints, or biomechanical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN提供可计算的上下界误差证书，弥补现有上界估计的不足。
summary_zh.method: 推导基于局部强单调性和单边Lipschitz条件的后验误差下界与上界。
summary_zh.result: 获得不依赖精确解的严格误差界，并设计证书引导的训练策略。
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与线性系统显式公式验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide computable two-sided error bounds for PINNs, addressing the lack of lower error estimates in existing certification frameworks.
summary_en.method: Derives a posteriori lower bounds under localized strong monotonicity and upper bounds under one-sided Lipschitz conditions, using only the neural network approximation and ODE residual.
summary_en.result: Rigorous error certificates are obtained without access to exact solutions, and a certificate-informed training strategy improves accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis and explicit formulas for linear time-invariant/varying systems demonstrate the bounds.

title: Range-Aware Bayesian Optimization for Discovering Diverse Designs within Target Property Windows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的范围感知贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no implant design application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决设计问题中目标属性需落在指定范围内而非单一最优值的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出范围感知贝叶斯优化框架，采集函数直接评估候选点满足目标范围的后验概率。
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试和案例研究中，该方法比标准BO和现有方法找到更多样化的有效设计。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和两个化学设计案例（聚合物合成、寡聚物发现）验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address design problems where desirable candidates must satisfy property ranges rather than a single optimum, enabling diverse solutions.
summary_en.method: Develops a range-aware Bayesian optimization framework with an acquisition function that scores the posterior probability of satisfying a target range.
summary_en.result: Range-aware acquisition consistently recovers larger and more diverse sets of valid designs than standard BO baselines and goal-seeking methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and two practical case studies in polymer synthesis and oligomer discovery with quantum chemical calculations.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Radial Basis Functions for PDEs with Dirac Delta Sources
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理Dirac delta源项的PINN方法，可迁移至生物力学中集中载荷或点源的FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on PDEs with Dirac delta sources in groundwater flow.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN处理Dirac delta源项时近似误差大，需改进方法。
summary_zh.method: 将PINN视为残差最小二乘法，利用弱形式直接处理Dirac delta，并与RBF方法对比。
summary_zh.result: RBF-RLS在输运问题中表现优于PINN，NTK理论解释差异。
summary_zh.validation: 通过地下水流动和河流输运的线性PDE算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) suffer from modeling errors when approximating Dirac delta sources with smooth surrogates, motivating a direct treatment.
summary_en.method: We reinterpret PINNs as Residual Least Squares (RLS) methods and integrate the weak-form equation to handle Dirac delta terms exactly, comparing with Radial Basis Function (RBF) expansion.
summary_en.result: RBF-RLS consistently yields accurate forward and inverse solutions for transport problems, while PINN residuals fail to converge to zero, as explained by Neural Tangent Kernel theory.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on linear PDEs representing groundwater flow and transport in porous media and rivers, including synthetic and real-world data.

title: LDDMM stochastic interpolants: An application to domain uncertainty quantification in hemodynamics
venue: Computer Methods in Applied Mechanics and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: WIAS im Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V., Anton-Wilhelm-Amo-Str. 39, Berlin, 10117, Berlin, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Alfonso Caiazzo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: WIAS im Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V., Anton-Wilhelm-Amo-Str. 39, Berlin, 10117, Berlin, Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于LDDMM随机插值的域不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学中植入物几何不确定性分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hemodynamics and vascular geometry uncertainty, not on implant mechanics, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for structural FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化血管几何不确定性对血流动力学模拟的影响。
summary_zh.method: 利用LDDMM随机插值生成随机几何变形，结合蒙特卡洛采样进行不确定性传播。
summary_zh.result: 该方法能有效捕捉几何不确定性导致的血流动力学响应变化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过理想化血管模型和患者特异性动脉瘤案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the impact of geometric uncertainty in vascular domains on hemodynamic simulation outputs.
summary_en.method: LDDMM stochastic interpolants are used to generate random diffeomorphic deformations of the domain, enabling Monte Carlo sampling for uncertainty propagation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method effectively captures the variability in hemodynamic quantities induced by geometric uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on idealized vessel models and a patient-specific cerebral aneurysm case.

key_terms.zh: 大形变微分同胚度量映射

title: Hyperparameter Optimisation of Physics-Informed Neural Network using Particle Swarm Optimisation for predicting Lift and Drag Coefficient of NACA Airfoils.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与PSO结合用于气动系数预测，其超参数优化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但缺乏UQ和约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling beyond boundary conditions, and no implant/biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN预测气动系数的精度，解决超参数手动调优效率低的问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用粒子群优化自动选择PINN的9个超参数，包括学习率、物理损失权重和配点密度缩放因子。
summary_zh.result: PSO优化后RMSE降低约48%，R²提升至0.998。
summary_zh.validation: 在10种NACA翼型、0-10°攻角下与基准PINN对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of PINN predictions for aerodynamic coefficients by automating hyperparameter selection.
summary_en.method: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to automatically tune 9 hyperparameters of PINN, including learning rate, physics loss weights, and collocation density scaling factors.
summary_en.result: The PSO-optimized PINN reduces RMSE by approximately 48% and improves R² to 0.998 for combined lift and drag coefficients.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on 10 NACA airfoils from three families at angles of attack 0°–10° and Re=100,000, comparing against baseline PINN.

title: How Low Can You Go? Active Learning for Sparse Model Discovery in the Ultra-Low-Data Limit
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的稀疏数据采样，提高昂贵仿真数据的利用效率。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on discovering governing equations of dynamical systems, not on building surrogate models for expensive FEA simulations, and lacks validation on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 在数据获取成本高昂的场景下，如何用极少数据识别复杂动力系统的控制方程。
summary_zh.method: 基于E-SINDy的主动学习策略，迭代选择信息量最大的区域采样，用于ODE和PDE系统。
summary_zh.result: 在Lorenz、Burgers和Kuramoto-Sivashinsky系统中，该方法用远少于随机采样的数据准确识别了动力学方程。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个经典数值基准（Lorenz ODE、Burgers PDE、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky PDE）上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To identify governing equations of complex dynamical systems when data acquisition is expensive, using minimal samples.
summary_en.method: An active learning strategy based on ensemble SINDy (E-SINDy) that iteratively selects the most informative sampling regions guided by epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The method accurately discovers dynamics for Lorenz, Burgers, and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky systems with significantly fewer data points than random sampling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical benchmarks: Lorenz ODE, Burgers PDE, and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky PDE.

key_terms.zh: 稀疏非线性动力学辨识

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Active learning loop with E-SINDy for ODE dynamics discovery. Using the Lorenz system as an example, candidate initial conditions are sampled around the attractor and used to initialize short trajectories. An ensemble of SINDy models is trained on the current dataset, and the candidate with the highest predictive uncertainty is iteratively added to the training set until convergence, defined as agreement among all ensemble members on both the predictive error and values of the active coefficients.

title: HAMNO: A Hierarchical Adaptive Multi-scale Neural Operator with Physics-Informed Learning for Dynamical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and validation only on PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子难以处理多尺度、长程依赖的非线性时变系统。
summary_zh.method: 提出HAMNO，结合局部卷积、全局谱算子和层次编解码，并引入数据依赖门控机制。
summary_zh.result: 在Allen-Cahn等方程上，HAMNO优于基线，PI-HAMNO提升稳定性和数据效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在非周期Allen-Cahn、Cahn-Hilliard、Swift-Hohenberg方程上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle to represent nonlinear time-dependent systems with multi-scale structures and long-range interactions.
summary_en.method: HAMNO combines local convolutional representations, global spectral operators, and hierarchical encoder-decoder processing with a data-dependent gating mechanism, and PI-HAMNO adds strong- and weak-form physics constraints.
summary_en.result: HAMNO improves predictive accuracy over standard baselines on Allen-Cahn, Cahn-Hilliard, and Swift-Hohenberg equations, and PI-HAMNO enhances stability and data efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on non-periodic Allen-Cahn, Cahn-Hilliard, and Swift-Hohenberg equations defined on cubic domains.

title: GW-RAR-PINN: a novel physics-informed neural network framework for dam-break flow simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的梯度加权与残差自适应细化PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dam-break flow simulation, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在溃坝流强非线性问题中精度下降的挑战
summary_zh.method: 提出梯度加权损失与残差自适应细化结合的GW-RAR-PINN框架
summary_zh.result: 在干床和湿床溃坝案例中，水深和流速的MAE与RMSE显著降低
summary_zh.validation: 通过一维干床和湿床溃坝数值基准验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the accuracy degradation of standard PINNs in dam-break flows with strong nonlinearities and discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A Gradient-Weighted and Residual-based Adaptive Refinement PINN (GW-RAR-PINN) that modulates loss gradients and adaptively adds collocation points in high-gradient regions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method reduces MAE and RMSE for water depth and discharge/velocity by up to 38.7% compared to baseline PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on one-dimensional dry-bed and wet-bed dam-break benchmark problems.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on dam-break flow simulation, not on biomedical implant mechanics, surrogate modeling for FEA, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在溃坝流模拟中因强非线性和间断导致的精度下降问题。

summary_zh.validation: 通过一维干床和湿床溃坝问题的数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the performance degradation of PINNs in dam-break flow simulation caused by strong nonlinearities and flow discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A Gradient-Weighted and Residual-based Adaptive Refinement PINN (GW-RAR-PINN) is proposed, combining gradient-weighted loss modulation with adaptive collocation point enrichment.

title: Data augmented physics informed neural networks for turbulent flow modelling in urban street canyons

corresponding_authors.name: Mohammad Jadidi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil, Aerospace and Design Engineering

relevance_to_user: 该论文将数据增强的PINN应用于湍流建模，其方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on fluid dynamics in urban canyons.

summary_zh.motivation: 需要快速预测城市街道峡谷湍流，但高保真CFD成本高，纯数据驱动模型泛化差。
summary_zh.method: 采用数据增强的PINN，嵌入N-S方程和边界条件，并注入稀疏CFD样本。
summary_zh.result: 目标数据增强提升鲁棒性，但超过阈值后收益递减。
summary_zh.validation: 与CFD参考解对比场误差，分析数据位置和密度影响。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate and fast prediction of turbulent flow in urban street canyons is needed, but high-fidelity CFD is too costly and purely data-driven models lack generalization.
summary_en.method: A data-augmented physics-informed neural network (PINN) is trained by embedding Navier-Stokes equations and boundary conditions, with sparse CFD velocity samples injected to strengthen learning near sharp gradients.
summary_en.result: Targeted CFD augmentation improves robustness over a physics-only baseline, but beyond a case-dependent threshold, additional samples yield diminishing returns.
summary_en.validation: Field-wise error metrics are computed against CFD reference data, with systematic variation of data placement and sampling density.

title: Adjoint Method versus Physics-Informed Neural Networks in PDE-Constrained Inverse Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了伴随方法与PINN在PDE约束逆问题中的性能，其方法可迁移到生物力学植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on general PDE-constrained inverse problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 公平比较伴随方法与PINN在PDE逆问题中的性能。
summary_zh.method: 在统一框架下实例化两种方法，匹配优化器、参数化等条件。
summary_zh.result: 未知参数表示决定方法优劣：网格场适合伴随，神经表示适合PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个基准问题（Burgers、Darcy、Allen-Cahn、Navier-Stokes）验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a fair comparison between adjoint-based optimization and physics-informed neural networks for PDE-constrained inverse problems under consistent formulations.
summary_en.method: Both methods are instantiated from a common abstract formulation with matched optimizers, parameterizations, and regularization on identical domains and governing equations.
summary_en.result: The representation of the unknown field determines the preferred method: grid-based fields favor the discrete adjoint, while neural representations are native to PINNs and more efficient for time-dependent problems.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on hemodynamic WSS reconstruction from scalar fields, not on surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations in implant design, and lacks uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 从被动标量场重建壁面剪切应力，解决血流动力学中难以直接测量的问题。
summary_zh.method: 对比可微物理（离散伴随优化）和PINN两种逆问题框架，从浓度观测重建WSS。
summary_zh.result: 可微物理方法在所有测量场景下均优于PINN，尤其在远场数据时表现稳健。
summary_zh.validation: 在2D后向台阶和3D患者特异性冠状动脉案例中验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct wall shear stress from passive scalar observations, addressing the challenge of direct measurement in hemodynamics.
summary_en.method: Two inverse frameworks are compared: a differentiable physics approach using discrete adjoint PDE-constrained optimization and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with soft constraints.
summary_en.result: The differentiable physics framework outperforms PINNs in all scenarios, especially when only far-field measurements are available.
summary_en.validation: Validation on a 2D backward-facing step and a 3D patient-specific stenotic coronary artery case.

title: Wall Shear Stress Reconstruction from Concentration: Differentiable Physics and Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用可微物理和PINN从标量场重建壁面剪切应力，方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的约束优化和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on hemodynamic WSS reconstruction from scalar fields, not on surrogate modeling for expensive FEA simulations in implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从被动标量场重建壁面剪切应力，克服传统方法依赖精确速度梯度的局限。
summary_zh.method: 比较可微物理（离散伴随PDE约束优化）与PINN两种逆框架，在2D和3D算例中重建WSS。
summary_zh.result: 可微物理在所有测量场景下均优于PINN，尤其在远场数据下仍能准确重建WSS。
summary_zh.validation: 通过2D后向台阶和3D患者特异性狭窄冠状动脉算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct wall shear stress from passive scalar observations, overcoming the need for precise near-wall velocity gradients.
summary_en.method: Two inverse frameworks are compared: differentiable physics using discrete adjoint PDE-constrained optimization (hard constraints) and physics-informed neural networks (soft constraints).
summary_en.result: The differentiable physics approach accurately recovers WSS in all measurement scenarios, outperforming PINNs, especially when only far-field data are available.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a 2D backward-facing step and a 3D patient-specific stenotic coronary artery simulation.

relevance_to_user: 该论文构建了股骨近端统计形状模型，可用于优化髋关节植入物设计，但未涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses solely on anatomical shape modeling without any FEA or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 通用假体与患者解剖不匹配导致并发症，需基于人群数据优化设计。
summary_zh.method: 通过图像分割、三维重建、地标标注和主成分分析构建股骨近端统计形状模型。
summary_zh.result: 前11个主成分解释92.85%方差，模型特异性和泛化性分别为1.33 mm和0.83 mm。
summary_zh.validation: 通过紧凑性、特异性和泛化性指标验证模型质量。

summary_en.motivation: Generic prosthetic implants often mismatch patient anatomy, leading to complications; population-specific optimization is needed.
summary_en.method: A statistical shape model of the proximal femur was built using image segmentation, 3D reconstruction, landmark annotation, and principal component analysis.
summary_en.result: The first 11 principal components captured 92.85% of total variance, with specificity and generalizability of 1.33 mm and 0.83 mm, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Model quality was validated via compactness, specificity, and generality metrics.

title: Robust Design of Composite Laminates Enabled by Physics-Based Uncertainty Modeling
first_author_affiliation: University of California
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于物理的降阶不确定性量化框架，可高效实现鲁棒设计，其方法有潜力迁移到植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on composite laminates, not biomedical implants or biomechanics, and lacks experimental validation or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 复合材料不确定性量化计算成本高，难以集成到优化流程中。
summary_zh.method: 利用刚度张量分解，通过标量迹缩放实现随机响应快速预测。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在梁弯曲和屈曲问题中准确匹配完整UQ的均值、方差和分布尾部。
summary_zh.validation: 在解析和有限元基准问题上验证，包括单轴/双轴加载下的层合板屈曲。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in composite structures is computationally prohibitive for integration into optimization workflows due to repeated high-fidelity evaluations.
summary_en.method: A physics-based reduced-order framework decomposes the stiffness tensor into a scalar trace and a normalized anisotropic component, enabling stochastic response via algebraic scaling of a single deterministic solution.
summary_en.result: The trace-based predictions accurately match full UQ results in mean, variance, and distribution tails for beam deflection and buckling problems.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on analytical and finite element benchmark problems, including uniaxial and biaxial buckling of composite laminates.

title: On the training of physics-informed neural operators for solving parametric partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统研究了物理信息神经算子（PINO）的训练策略，其方法可直接迁移到生物力学代理模型中，提高采样效率和鲁棒性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 物理信息神经算子训练效率与鲁棒性尚不明确，需系统研究。
summary_zh.method: 对比DeepONet、FNO、CViT三种架构，分析优化器、损失平衡、采样策略等关键组件。
summary_zh.result: CViT性能稳定，PINN中的优化问题在PINO中同样存在，且缓解方法有效。
summary_zh.validation: 在五个参数化PDE基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: The training efficiency and robustness of physics-informed neural operators (PINOs) are not well understood, motivating a systematic empirical study.
summary_en.method: We compare three operator backbones (DeepONet, FNO, CViT) and analyze key training components including optimizer, loss balancing, and collocation sampling.
summary_en.result: CViT consistently outperforms other architectures, and optimization pathologies from PINNs (e.g., gradient conflicts) also arise in PINOs, with existing mitigation strategies remaining effective.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on five parametric PDE systems validate the findings.

title: Multi-ResNets for Subspace Preconditioning in Constrained Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于约束优化的多阶段残差网络架构，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决约束优化中高优先级约束难以满足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出多阶段残差网络MResOpt，通过阶段感知损失和中间重完成实现有序约束满足。
summary_zh.result: 在凸和非凸基准上提高了高优先级约束的满足度，在AC最优潮流中保持等式流形。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成QP、QCQP、SOCP基准和AC最优潮流问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve high-priority constraint satisfaction in constrained optimization problems by leveraging ordinal structure.
summary_en.method: Proposes MResOpt, a staged residual neural network with stage-aware losses and intermediate re-completion for ordered constraint satisfaction.
summary_en.result: Achieves substantially lower high-priority violation on synthetic benchmarks and AC optimal power flow compared to reprojected baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic QP, QCQP, SOCP benchmarks and a physics-motivated AC optimal power flow case.

title: Bridging CAD and Data-Driven Design: Attributed Feature Graphs for Engineering Design
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于特征图的CAD表示方法，可结合图神经网络进行代理建模，其方法可迁移至植入物或生物力学设计中的代理建模与可解释性分析。
why_not_core: The paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics-specific design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有数据驱动设计方法忽略CAD特征语义，难以与设计流程集成。
summary_zh.method: 提出属性特征图（AFG）表示设计特征与关系，并用图神经网络进行代理建模。
summary_zh.result: 在汽车发动机罩数据集上，AFG代理模型性能与传统方法相当，且支持特征级可解释性。
summary_zh.validation: 在CarHoods10K数据集上通过代理建模案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing data-driven design methods discard parametric and feature-level semantics, limiting integration with CAD workflows and interpretability.
summary_en.method: This work introduces Attributed Feature Graphs (AFGs) that encode design features as nodes and relations as edges, enabling graph neural network-based surrogate modeling directly on CAD-derived graphs.
summary_en.result: The GNN surrogate achieves competitive performance on the CarHoods10K dataset while allowing engineers to map predictions back to specific CAD features for interpretability.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via a surrogate modeling case study on the CarHoods10K automotive hood frame dataset.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of nonlinear vibrational regimes on the structural and functional integrity of extrusion-based 3D-printed scaffolds.
summary_en.method: A coupled Van der Pol-Duffing oscillator model was developed to simulate vibrational dynamics during deposition, validated by MEMS accelerometry and scaffold characterization.
summary_en.result: Vibrational excitation caused a ~17% reduction in compressive strength and a ~78% decline in electrical conductivity due to disrupted graphene networks.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed using MEMS accelerometry, mechanical testing, and electrical conductivity measurements.

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了基于DNN代理模型和遗传算法的优化框架，包含不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物设计中的力学优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on composite slab vibration optimization, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低多层复合板基频优化中有限元计算的高成本。
summary_zh.method: 使用DNN代理模型替代有限元模态分析，结合遗传算法进行确定性及分位数优化。
summary_zh.result: 优化结果与贝叶斯优化偏差小于0.5%，且考虑不确定性后鲁棒性提升。
summary_zh.validation: 与文献中贝叶斯优化结果对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of finite element modal analysis in optimizing the fundamental frequency of multi-layer composite slabs.
summary_en.method: A DNN surrogate model replaces FEM modal analysis, combined with a genetic algorithm for deterministic and quantile-based optimization under uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The optimized non-dimensional parameters deviate less than 0.5% from Bayesian optimization benchmarks, and uncertainty-aware optimization improves robustness with minimal performance loss.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing deterministic optimization results with Bayesian optimization results from the literature.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发简单快速的角膜缘干细胞龛体外模型
summary_zh.method: 利用数字光处理和灰度UV投影实现水凝胶差异化交联，通过热收缩形成起伏形貌

summary_en.motivation: To develop a simple and scalable strategy for fabricating 3D scaffolds with undulating topography that mimic the limbal epithelial stem cell niche.
summary_en.method: A photocrosslinkable bioink containing methacrylated collagen, hyaluronic acid, and silk fibroin was patterned using grayscale UV projection via Digital Light Processing, enabling spatially controlled crosslinking densities and subsequent shape-morphing through differential shrinking at 37°C.
summary_en.result: The undulating scaffolds supported corneal epithelial stratification for at least three weeks, with nuclear YAP localization in soft areas, P63-positive progenitor cells in basal layers, and PAX6-positive differentiated cells in apical layers.
summary_en.validation: In vitro culture with immunohistochemistry and barrier function assays confirmed physiological epithelial organization and maturation.

title: Curvature-aware dynamic precision approach for physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自适应精度控制方法，可降低PINN训练成本，对用户构建高效代理模型具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on numerical precision in PINN training for general PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低双精度PINN训练的高计算成本，同时保持预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 利用L-BFGS优化器的曲率信息构建自适应精度控制器，在训练中动态切换FP32/FP64。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准测试中，该方法匹配或超过全双精度精度，同时减少训练时间。
summary_zh.validation: 在四个典型PINN失效模式基准和一个ODE示例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of double-precision PINN training while maintaining prediction accuracy by adapting numerical precision during training.
summary_en.method: A curvature-aware precision controller reuses curvature information from the L-BFGS optimizer to dynamically switch between FP32 and FP64 based on training dynamics.
summary_en.result: The proposed method matches or slightly exceeds full FP64 accuracy while reducing training time across all benchmark equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four canonical PINN failure-mode benchmarks and an irradiance-driven ODE example.

visual.caption: Figure 1: (Left) Trade-off between prediction accuracy and training speed when using different training precisions. (Right) As loss curvature has been widely used to characterise training difficulty and ill-conditioning in PINNs, we propose a curvature-aware controller that adjusts numerical precision during training. The controller switches to FP64 (the blue part in the curve) in difficult training phases (high curvature) based on curvature signals derived from the L-BFGS optimiser.

relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了AI在生物打印全流程中的应用，包括生物墨水设计和自主制造，但缺乏具体实验验证和自主决策实现。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no experimental validation and no demonstration of autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述AI如何推动生物打印从设计到自主制造。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾AI在生物墨水设计、打印过程优化和自动化中的应用。
summary_zh.result: 指出AI可提升生物打印精度和效率，但自主决策仍待突破。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review explores how artificial intelligence can be integrated into 3D bioprinting workflows to enable autonomous tissue and organ manufacturing.
summary_en.method: The paper systematically reviews AI applications in bioink formulation, process parameter optimization, and real-time monitoring for bioprinting.
summary_en.result: AI shows promise in improving print fidelity and reproducibility, but fully autonomous bioprinting remains a future goal.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: The Influence of Mechanical and Microstructural Characteristics on the Durability of a Femoral Implant Made of Different Alloys
first_author_affiliation: Department of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics, Agribusiness Faculty, Don State Technical University, 1 Gagarin Square, 344003 Rostov-on-Don, Russia
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了不同合金股骨植入物的力学性能和微观结构，但未涉及多孔结构设计或增材制造工艺。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure design, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同合金股骨植入物的力学与微观结构对耐久性的影响
summary_zh.method: 结合纳米压痕、显微表征和有限元分析，模拟动态载荷下的应力应变
summary_zh.result: CoCrMo承载能力比Ti-6Al-4V低约30%
summary_zh.validation: 通过纳米压痕实验获取材料参数，并用于有限元模拟

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how mechanical and microstructural characteristics influence the durability of femoral implants made from different alloys.
summary_en.method: Nanoindentation, SEM/EDX, and optical microscopy were combined with finite element analysis to evaluate stress-strain states under dynamic loading.
summary_en.result: CoCrMo exhibited approximately 30% lower load-bearing capacity compared to reference Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.validation: Material properties from nanoindentation were used as input for numerical simulations.

title: Qualification of an Additive-Subtractive Process for Medical Implants Via Powder Bed Fusion of Commercially Pure Titanium Using a Laser Beam
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了纯钛PBF-LB/M工艺的力学性能和表面后处理，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡匹配。
why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, and no osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估PBF-LB/M纯钛用于医疗植入物的增材-减材工艺可行性。
summary_zh.method: 在不同构建方向制备试样，进行显微CT、拉伸/压缩测试及表面后处理。
summary_zh.result: 拉伸强度各向异性，压缩无各向异性；表面粗糙度可通过后处理显著降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和显微CT验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To qualify PBF-LB/M processed commercially pure titanium for additive-subtractive manufacturing of medical implants.
summary_en.method: Specimens were fabricated in different build orientations and characterized via micro-CT, tensile/compression testing, and surface post-processing.
summary_en.result: Tensile strength showed anisotropy while compression did not; surface roughness was reduced from 6.3 µm to 0.36 µm after disc finishing.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and micro-CT confirmed material properties and low defect density.

key_terms.en: powder bed fusion using a laser beam

title: Modelling the hierarchical microstructure of L-PBF Ti–6Al–4V: a multiphysics framework for texture-induced mechanical anisotropy
relevance_to_user: 该论文建立了L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的多物理场建模框架，可迁移至生物医用植入物的各向异性力学性能预测，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有模型难以准确捕捉L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构及力学各向异性。
summary_zh.method: 集成热流体、相变、变体选择和晶体塑性的多物理场建模框架。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺诱导的各向异性微观结构对宏观屈服点的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 对每个模拟模块进行了实验验证，包括热流体、凝固、相变和晶体塑性分析。

summary_en.motivation: Current models fail to accurately capture the as-built microstructure and resulting mechanical anisotropy of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: An integrated multiphysics framework linking thermal history, solidification, solid-state phase transformation, variant selection, and crystal plasticity.
summary_en.result: The process-induced anisotropic microstructure significantly influences macroscopic yield points under different loading directions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed for each simulation module: thermo-fluid, cellular automaton solidification, crystallographic SSPT, and crystal plasticity.

title: Modelling the hierarchical microstructure of L-PBF Ti–6Al–4V: a multiphysics framework for texture-induced mechanical anisotropy
first_author_affiliation: Soongsil University
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构各向异性与力学性能关系，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface roughness relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 准确模拟L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V的微观结构各向异性及其对力学响应的影响。
summary_zh.method: 集成热流体、相变、变体选择和晶体塑性的多物理场框架。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺诱导的各向异性微观结构对宏观屈服点的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 对每个模拟模块进行了实验验证，包括热流体、凝固、相变和晶体塑性分析。

summary_en.motivation: To accurately model the process-induced anisotropic microstructure of L-PBF Ti-6Al-4V and its influence on mechanical response.
summary_en.method: An integrated multiphysics framework coupling thermo-fluid dynamics, phase transformation, variant selection, and crystal plasticity.
summary_en.result: The framework reveals that build-direction-oriented prior β grains and specific variant selection significantly affect macroscopic yield points under different loading directions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation is provided for each simulation module, including thermo-fluid, solidification, SSPT, and crystal plasticity analyses.

title: A Systematic Benchmark of Physics-Informed Neural Network Architectures for the Stiff Poisson-Nernst-Planck System: Adaptive LossWeighting and Multi-Scale Resolution
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统评估了多种PINN架构在刚性耦合PDE上的表现，其自适应损失加权和多尺度方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on a specific electrochemical PDE rather than solid mechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决刚性PNP系统中PINN的谱偏差和损失不平衡问题
summary_zh.method: 系统比较11种PINN配置，包括自适应损失加权和多尺度分辨率策略
summary_zh.result: BRDR方案在精度与计算效率间取得最佳平衡
summary_zh.validation: 与有限体积法数值基准对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome spectral bias and multi-task loss imbalance that limit PINN accuracy on stiff coupled PDE systems.
summary_en.method: A systematic benchmark of eleven PINN configurations across four strategy groups, including adaptive loss weighting and multi-scale resolution, implemented in NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo Sym.
summary_en.result: The balanced residual decay rate (BRDR) scheme achieves comparable accuracy to NTK-based methods while reducing wall-clock time.
summary_en.validation: Validated against a finite volume method (FVM) reference solution on a 1D PNP model.

title: Rheological characterisation and printability assessment of an optimised bioink for extrusion-based 3D bioprinting.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Medical Science, Canterbury Christ Church University, Canterbury, UK.

why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a rheological characterization study without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 验证优化生物墨水的流变性能以确保可打印性
summary_zh.method: 通过流变学测试（流动曲线、振荡扫描、触变性恢复）表征墨水

summary_en.motivation: To validate the rheological properties of a statistically optimized bioink for extrusion-based 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Comprehensive rheological characterization including flow curve analysis, oscillatory amplitude/frequency sweeps, and three-stage thixotropy testing.
summary_en.result: The bioink exhibits shear-thinning behavior, rapid thixotropic recovery, and stable viscoelasticity, confirming its suitability for cell-laden printing.
summary_en.validation: Experimental rheological measurements (flow curves, oscillatory tests, thixotropy recovery).

title: Physics-Informed Residuals for Adaptive Mesh Refinement in Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN作为残差探针用于自适应网格细化，可转移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高有限差分求解器效率，避免均匀网格浪费自由度。
summary_zh.method: 用PINN残差作为网格细化指示器，指导有限差分求解前的自适应网格。
summary_zh.result: PINN引导的细化在相同自由度下误差降低约67.5%。
summary_zh.validation: 一维Burgers方程及2D/3D代理测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of finite-difference PDE solvers by avoiding wasteful uniform mesh refinement.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) is used as an off-grid residual probe to generate cellwise indicators for adaptive mesh refinement before the final finite-difference solve.
summary_en.result: PINN-guided refinement achieves a 67.5% error reduction at matched mesh size compared to uniform refinement on the 1D viscous Burgers equation.
summary_en.validation: Validated on 1D Burgers equation with full finite-difference solver, and on 2D/3D manufactured proxy tests for nonlinear Schrödinger and Navier-Stokes equations.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Multi-Stage Transfer Learning for Electromagnetic Field Prediction in Electroslag Remelting Process
venue: Journal of Materials Research and Technology
first_author_affiliation: School of Metallurgy, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

corresponding_authors.name: Zhouhua Jiang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Key Laboratory of Ecological Metallurgy of Multimetallic Mineral, Northeastern University, Shenyang 110819, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与迁移学习结合用于电磁场预测，方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但缺乏不确定性量化和植入物设计验证。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling beyond boundary conditions.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电渣重熔过程电磁场快速预测问题，替代昂贵数值模拟。
summary_zh.method: 提出多阶段迁移学习PINN，嵌入麦克斯韦方程残差和稀疏测量数据。
summary_zh.result: 基线模型磁通密度预测误差0.16%，频率和渣池厚度参数化成功。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和噪声测试验证，误差5.44%。

summary_en.motivation: To enable rapid and physically consistent electromagnetic field prediction for electroslag remelting process control and optimization.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network with multi-stage transfer learning is developed, embedding Maxwell equation residuals, axisymmetric boundary constraints, and sparse magnetic flux density measurements into a composite loss.
summary_en.result: The baseline model achieves 0.16% mean relative error for magnetic flux density, and frequency/geometry parameterization reveals slag pool power fraction variations from 62% to 88%.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via numerical benchmarks, ablation studies, and noise tests, with 5.44% prediction error under 10% noise.

title: Neural Spectral Element Methods for stiff multiphysics PDEs with electrochemical transport benchmarks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经谱元方法可高效求解多物理场PDE，其高精度和低采样点特性对生物力学FEA代理建模具有迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on electrochemical transport benchmarks and does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多物理场PDE求解的精度和效率，减少采样点需求。
summary_zh.method: 提出神经谱元法，利用谱微分矩阵和L-BFGS优化实现高精度求解。
summary_zh.result: 在PNP基准上达到10^-4至10^-7相对误差，采样点比PINN少两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PNP数值基准上验证，与自适应PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve accuracy and efficiency in solving stiff multiphysics PDEs by reducing collocation point requirements.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Neural Spectral Element Method that uses precomputed spectral differentiation matrices and L-BFGS optimization for deterministic training.
summary_en.result: Achieves relative pointwise errors of 10^-4 to 10^-7 on the Poisson-Nernst-Planck benchmark with two orders of magnitude fewer collocation points than adaptive PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the four-example PNP numerical benchmark from Huang et al., comparing against adaptive-resampling PINN baselines.

title: Local Preferential Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法将局部搜索策略引入偏好贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标约束优化问题，但未涉及FEA或生物力学验证。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有偏好贝叶斯优化在高维问题上效率低，需局部搜索策略。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部偏好贝叶斯优化，结合信任域和导数信息进行局部搜索。

summary_en.motivation: Existing preferential Bayesian optimization methods struggle with high-dimensional problems due to global search, motivating local search approaches.
summary_en.method: A family of local preferential Bayesian optimization methods is developed, adapting trust-region and derivative-informed local search to pairwise preference feedback.
summary_en.result: Local PBO methods substantially reduce cumulative regret on GP sample paths, standard benchmarks, and policy-search tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including GP sample paths, standard optimization functions, and policy-search tasks.

title: Is the Last Layer Sufficient for Uncertainty Quantification?

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses purely on neural network UQ methodology.

summary_zh.method: 利用随机矩阵理论和大规模实验对比两种线性化方法。
summary_zh.result: 最后一层近似在不确定性量化上性能相当，但计算效率显著提升。

summary_en.method: Theoretical analysis using random matrix theory combined with large-scale empirical evaluation across diverse machine learning tasks.
summary_en.result: Last-layer linearization achieves comparable UQ performance to full-network linearization while being substantially more computationally efficient.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on multiple modern machine learning benchmarks.

summary_en.result: The reduced-order model recovers the exact posterior when its rank equals the intrinsic dimension of the inverse problem.
summary_en.validation: Two numerical experiments from structural engineering demonstrate the performance of the derived error bounds.

summary_en.method: A multicomponent bioink comprising alginate, fibrinogen, and aldehyde hyaluronic acid was engineered with tunable polymer ratios to optimize printability, stability, and cell-matrix interactions.

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional PDE-governed inverse problems suffer from complex non-Gaussian posteriors, expensive forward models, and misspecified priors.
summary_en.method: A deep adaptive dimension-reduction Bayesian inference framework is proposed, integrating VAE-based nonlinear dimension reduction with dual normalizing flows and an adaptively fine-tuned Fourier Neural Operator surrogate.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive or superior accuracy compared to MCMC, UKI, and SVGD baselines on a 100-dimensional Rosenbrock problem and three standard PDE inverse problems, especially under high noise and high dimensionality.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic problems with varying noise levels and parameter dimensions.

title: Active learning strategy for excursion-set confidence regions of functional simulator outputs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习策略用于估计功能模拟器输出的置信区域，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently estimate confidence regions where a functional simulator output exceeds a threshold, reducing computational cost.
summary_en.method: A surrogate-based approach combining PCA and Gaussian process regression with a max-min active learning criterion using Karhunen-Loève expansion.
summary_en.result: The method accurately estimates excursion set confidence regions while reducing modeling uncertainties, outperforming reference methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a synthetic function, hypersonic vehicle pressure distribution, and reusable launcher trajectory, with benchmark comparisons.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合神经世界模型，用于物理动力学的高效替代建模，其误差图方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的不确定性量化。

summary_en.validation: Validated on reaction-diffusion, compressible Euler, and rigid-body collision dynamics benchmarks against textbook solvers.

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks biomedical context, and does not handle multi-objective constraints or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统数值方法求解随机微分方程计算成本高，尤其在多维场景下。
summary_zh.method: 将物理定律嵌入神经网络损失函数，构建PINN框架求解SDE。
summary_zh.result: PINN在基准问题上精度与传统方法相当，计算速度提升达1000倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过几何布朗运动、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck过程等数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional numerical methods for stochastic differential equations suffer from high computational cost, especially in high-dimensional settings.
summary_en.method: A Physics-Informed Neural Networks framework is developed by embedding physical laws and stochastic dynamics into the loss function to solve SDEs.
summary_en.result: The PINN framework achieves accuracy comparable to traditional methods while providing up to 1000x speedup after training.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on benchmark problems including geometric Brownian motion, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes, and multi-dimensional stochastic systems.

title: Demand-driven inverse structural design of perforated auxetic tubes featuring dual tunability in stiffness and natural frequency
relevance_to_user: 该论文将BPNN代理模型与遗传算法结合，用于多约束下的结构逆设计，方法可迁移至植入物力学性能优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on auxetic tube design, not implant biomechanics, and lacks uncertainty quantification or patient-specific considerations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决穿孔辅助管刚度和频率双目标逆设计难题
summary_zh.method: BPNN代理模型结合遗传算法进行多约束优化
summary_zh.result: 实现了高效准确的刚度-频率比定制化设计
summary_zh.validation: 有限元仿真数据集验证代理模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of inverse structural design of perforated auxetic tubes with dual tunability in stiffness and natural frequency under multiple deformation modes.
summary_en.method: A data-driven strategy integrating backpropagation neural network as surrogate model and genetic algorithm for constrained multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves efficient and accurate design updates, finding stiffness-frequency ratios beyond the training dataset.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using finite element simulation datasets comparing surrogate predictions with direct FEM results.

why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on crack mitigation in TiAl alloys via alloy modulation and grading with Ti64.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决TiAl合金LPBF成形中的裂纹问题
summary_zh.method: 通过合金成分调控和与Ti64功能梯度设计实现无裂纹制造

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate cracking during laser powder bed fusion of β-solidifying TiAl alloys.
summary_en.method: Alloy modulation combined with functional grading using Ti64 to achieve crack-free fabrication.
summary_en.result: Crack-free TiAl alloy samples were produced with improved mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing confirmed the absence of cracks and acceptable performance.

title: Physics-informed neural network surrogate and grid-based multi-objective evolutionary optimization for sustainable concrete mix design

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on civil engineering materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决混凝土配比设计中昂贵实验与多目标冲突问题
summary_zh.method: 构建PINN代理模型替代物理实验，结合网格多目标进化优化
summary_zh.result: 代理模型准确预测性能，优化获得Pareto前沿配比方案
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟案例验证代理模型精度与优化效果

summary_en.motivation: To address the high cost of physical experiments and conflicting objectives in concrete mix design.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network surrogate is built to replace physical experiments, combined with a grid-based multi-objective evolutionary optimization algorithm.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts concrete properties, and the optimization yields a Pareto front of mix designs.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulation cases demonstrating surrogate accuracy and optimization effectiveness.

why_not_core: This paper does not address porous implant structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on microstructural porosity-driven fatigue in bulk material.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究增材制造Ti-6Al-4V中微孔对疲劳裂纹萌生和扩展的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用晶体塑性有限元模型模拟孔隙周围的局部应力和裂纹演化
summary_zh.result: 揭示了孔隙尺寸和分布对裂纹路径和寿命的定量影响
summary_zh.validation: 与文献中实验数据对比验证模型预测

summary_en.motivation: To understand how microstructural porosity in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V influences fatigue crack initiation and propagation.
summary_en.method: A crystal plasticity finite element model was developed to simulate local stress concentrations and crack evolution around pores.
summary_en.result: The model quantitatively revealed the effects of pore size and distribution on crack path and fatigue life.
summary_en.validation: Model predictions were validated against experimental data from the literature.

title: Coupling-Robust Accuracy in Multiphysics Physics Informed Neural Networks via Kronecker-Preconditioned Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Kronecker预条件优化方法可提升多物理场PINN的耦合鲁棒性，对生物力学中多物理场代理模型构建具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not address constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 多物理场PINN在强耦合时精度下降，需理论解释与优化方法。
summary_zh.method: 通过NTK分析证明耦合强度导致谱半径增长，提出Kronecker预条件优化器SOAP+GN。
summary_zh.result: SOAP+GN在强耦合下保持L2误差比小于1.1倍，而Adam+GN超过100倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在1D和2D多物理场PDE系统上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Physics-informed neural networks for coupled multiphysics systems suffer accuracy degradation under strong coupling, lacking theoretical understanding and robust optimization.
summary_en.method: The paper provides NTK analysis showing spectral radius grows as Ω(γ²) with coupling strength, and proposes Kronecker-preconditioned optimizer SOAP+GN with inverse-gradient-norm loss balancing.
summary_en.result: SOAP+GN maintains final-epoch L2 degradation ratio ≤1.1× across coupling strengths varying over orders of magnitude, while Adam+GN exceeds 100×.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on 1D symmetric, asymmetric, nonlinear coupled PDE systems and a 2D electroosmotic flow benchmark validate the theoretical findings and optimizer performance.

title: Automated Random Embedding for Practical Bayesian Optimization with Unknown Effective Dimension
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的动态随机嵌入贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的高维参数优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化面临维度灾难，且有效维度未知时固定子空间维度效果差。
summary_zh.method: 提出动态共享嵌入贝叶斯优化，从低维子空间开始，收敛后自动切换更高维子空间。
summary_zh.result: 在多种高维函数和实际任务中，优化遗憾和时间均优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和真实世界任务进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from the curse of dimensionality, and the unknown effective dimension hinders the performance of random embedding methods.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes Dynamic Shared Embedding Bayesian Optimization (DSEBO), which starts with a low-dimensional subspace and dynamically switches to higher dimensions upon detecting convergence, sharing queried solutions for initialization.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments on functions with varying dimensionality and real-world tasks show that DSEBO significantly improves optimization regret and time compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world optimization tasks.

why_not_core: This is a review paper with no original LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no quantitative analysis of stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 多孔钛植入体长期成功取决于表面特性，需系统综述表面功能化进展。
summary_zh.method: 综述原位改性、涂层和孔隙填充三类表面功能化策略及其机制。
summary_zh.result: 表面功能化可显著提升耐腐蚀、抗菌和成骨性能，促进骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 引用文献中的体外实验和抗菌测试数据，无原始验证。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review recent advances in surface functionalization of porous titanium implants for enhanced biological performance and clinical applicability.
summary_en.method: Categorizes surface modification strategies into in-situ modification, coating-based, and pore-filling approaches, discussing their mechanisms and comparative advantages.
summary_en.result: Surface functionalization improves corrosion resistance by 1-2 orders of magnitude, achieves >90% antibacterial efficacy, and enhances osteogenic responses including cell adhesion and differentiation.
summary_en.validation: The review summarizes existing in vitro and antibacterial studies from the literature, without presenting original experimental validation.

summary_en.method: Summarizing technological progress in light-based bioprinting, bioresin development, and current limitations.
summary_en.result: Suggesting next-generation bioresin and printing strategies for improved clinical translation.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a perspective review.

summary_zh.method: 提出校准残差物理信息神经网络作为有限元代理模型。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient surrogate models are needed for junction temperature prediction and heat-sink optimization of airborne solid-state power controllers.
summary_en.method: A calibrated residual physics-informed neural network is proposed as a surrogate for finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts junction temperatures and enables successful heat-sink design optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing surrogate predictions with finite element simulation results.

title: Therm-FM: Foundation Model is ALL YOU NEED for 3D-ICs Thermal Simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低3D-IC热仿真中高保真数据生成成本
summary_zh.method: 基于预训练PDE基础模型的神经算子框架，结合多保真训练策略
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试中误差降低10.6倍，仅需20%训练数据即达最优精度
summary_zh.validation: 在HotSpot和工业3D-IC封装基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high cost of generating high-fidelity finite-element simulation data for 3D-IC thermal prediction.
summary_en.method: A neural operator framework that adapts a pretrained PDE foundation model with a thermal-equivalent multi-fidelity training strategy.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 10.6x reduction in mean error and surpasses prior best accuracy with less than 20% of training data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on public HotSpot benchmarks and industrial 3D-IC package benchmarks.

title: The Neural Compiler: Program-to-Network Translation for Hybrid Scientific Machine Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将符号方程自动编译为可微模块的方法，可用于构建混合科学模型，但未涉及有限元代理建模或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有科学机器学习方法难以自动结合已知物理与数据驱动模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出神经编译器，将符号方程自动翻译为可微PyTorch模块。
summary_zh.result: 编译模块数值精度与手写代码一致，且可组合无误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在六个物理方程基准上验证，与手写实现和PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing scientific machine learning approaches either ignore known physics, encode it as soft penalties, or require manual coding for each equation.
summary_en.method: The Neural Compiler translates programs written in a first-order Scheme-like language into frozen, differentiable PyTorch modules that exactly encode known physics.
summary_en.result: Compiled modules match hand-coded implementations to floating-point precision, recover physical constants with <1% error using few parameters, and compose with zero error.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on six experiment domains including Feynman equations, Lotka-Volterra, damped pendulum, heat equation, 3D vector mechanics, and compositional generalization.

title: Regret-Based $(ε,δ)$-optimal Stopping Criteria for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于遗憾的贝叶斯优化停止准则，可提高采样效率，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on stopping criteria for Bayesian optimization without addressing constraints, uncertainty quantification beyond GP-UCB, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化缺乏理论保证的停止准则，导致不必要的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于GP-UCB的瞬时遗憾界，提出(ε,δ)-最优停止准则。
summary_zh.result: 新准则在保证ε-最优解的同时显著减少迭代次数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证停止准则的有效性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization lacks theoretically sound stopping criteria, leading to unnecessary computational cost.
summary_en.method: Tighter instantaneous regret bounds for GP-UCB are derived to propose (ε,δ)-optimal stopping criteria.
summary_en.result: The proposed criteria guarantee an ε-optimal solution with high probability while significantly reducing iterations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the stopping criteria.

title: Numerical Simulation of Bone Defect Repair Using a Triply Periodic Minimal Surface Scaffold

why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (only numerical simulation), no fatigue or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过数值模拟预测TPMS支架降解和骨再生行为，指导支架设计。
summary_zh.method: 构建PLA水解和骨重塑控制方程的TPMS-界面-组织三相复合模型，进行有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: 机械刺激加速支架降解并促进骨形成；不同TPMS结构力学性能变化非线性。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict scaffold degradation and bone regeneration behavior via numerical simulation for guiding TPMS scaffold design.
summary_en.method: A three-phase composite model (TPMS scaffold, interfacial layer, tissue) was developed using PLA hydrolysis and bone remodeling governing equations, solved by finite element simulation.
summary_en.result: Mechanical stimulation accelerated scaffold degradation and promoted bone formation; the mechanical performance of fused TPMS RVEs showed nonlinear behavior.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation only, without experimental validation.
