title: LABO: LLM-Accelerated Bayesian Optimization through Broad Exploration and Selective Experimentation
relevance_to_user: 该方法将LLM作为低成本代理加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics; it focuses on general scientific optimization with LLM integration.

summary_zh.motivation: 科学实验中数据稀缺且成本高，需提升贝叶斯优化采样效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出LABO框架，通过门控准则动态平衡LLM预测与真实实验。
summary_zh.result: 在多个科学任务中，相同预算下LABO优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准科学优化基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve sample efficiency in Bayesian optimization under high experimental cost and data scarcity by leveraging LLM predictions as a low-cost surrogate.
summary_en.method: LABO introduces a gating criterion that dynamically balances between inexpensive LLM evaluations and costly real experiments within a single BO loop.
summary_en.result: LABO consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse scientific tasks under identical experimental budgets.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on standard scientific optimization benchmarks.

title: IKNO: Infinite-order Kernel Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高阶核神经算子，可显著提升代理模型的精度，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计验证。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate tasks, no biomedical or implant mechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子仅用一阶核积分，表达能力受限。
summary_zh.method: 提出无限阶核神经算子IKNO，通过Kronecker特征分解实现闭式有限近似。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上达到最先进精度，且可扩展至大规模点云。
summary_zh.validation: 在时间依赖与非时间依赖基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators rely on first-order kernel integral approximations, limiting their expressivity.
summary_en.method: IKNO constructs infinite-order kernel integrals with a closed-form finite approximation via Kronecker eigendecomposition.
summary_en.result: IKNO achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on nearly all benchmarks while maintaining scalability to large point clouds.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on time-dependent and time-independent benchmarks including large-scale industrial datasets.

title: EMMA: Extracting Multiple physical parameters from Multimodal Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法从多模态数据中提取物理参数，可迁移至基于FEA的植入物设计中的参数识别或代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply to FEA-based implant design or biomechanics simulation; it focuses on general dynamical system parameter recovery from video/audio data.

summary_zh.motivation: 从多模态观测数据中恢复物理系统参数，无需已知初始条件或专用传感器。
summary_zh.method: 使用LTC网络学习潜在动力学，结合物理约束损失和统一特征对齐管道。
summary_zh.result: 在100多个场景中优于单模态和方程发现基线，鲁棒恢复多参数。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准、真实机器人和仿真案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To recover all identifiable dynamical parameters of a physical system directly from raw multimodal observations without requiring known initial conditions or specialized sensors.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed multimodal framework using Liquid Time-Constant networks to learn latent dynamics and a unified feature pipeline for cross-modal alignment, with a physics-constrained loss enforcing differential equation consistency.
summary_en.result: EMMA achieves robust multi-parameter recovery across 100+ scenarios, outperforming single-modality and equation-discovery baselines on standard benchmarks, real-world robots, and simulation case studies.
summary_en.validation: Validated on five standard dynamical benchmarks (75 Delfys videos), real-world rover and quadrotor systems with hidden inputs, and simulation-chart case studies.

title: A multiscale modeling framework for correlating mesoscale and macroscale fatigue behavior in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400076, India

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究声学操控细胞组装，但未涉及AI或机器学习方法，与AI生物打印方向不直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on acoustic parameter control without autonomous decision-making or experimental validation of AI models.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解声学参数对细胞图案化影响的机制不足。
summary_zh.method: 建立可控声学操控平台，系统研究频率、功率等参数对颗粒聚集的影响。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了调控机制，实现了可重复的细胞图案化并促进肌原基因表达。
summary_zh.validation: 通过温度监测和细胞实验验证生物相容性和图案化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of comprehensive understanding of how acoustic parameters, device architecture, and sample properties collectively influence patterning outcomes.
summary_en.method: A controllable acoustic patterning platform was established to systematically investigate the effects of frequency, power, channel height, and pattern window on particle aggregation and spatial distribution.
summary_en.result: Clear regulatory mechanisms were revealed, enabling precise and reproducible control, and acoustically patterned cells showed enhanced alignment and upregulated myogenic gene expression.
summary_en.validation: Temperature monitoring ensured biocompatibility, and in vitro experiments with C2C12 and NIH/3T3 cells validated the patterning efficacy and biological response.

title: MPINeuralODE: Multiple-Initial-Condition Physics-Informed Neural ODEs for Globally Consistent Dynamical System Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过多初始条件课程学习与物理信息残差结合，提升了神经ODE的泛化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的采样效率与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on dynamical system learning with ODEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经ODE对未见过初始条件和长时域泛化差。
summary_zh.method: 提出MPINeuralODE，结合软物理信息残差与多初始条件多步打靶课程。
summary_zh.result: 在Lotka-Volterra上，相比基线神经ODE，均方误差降低26%，长时域稳定性提升。
summary_zh.validation: 在Lotka-Volterra系统上评估样本外误差、长时域稳定性和哈密顿漂移。

summary_en.motivation: Neural ODEs suffer from poor generalization to unseen initial conditions and long horizons.
summary_en.method: MPINeuralODE combines a soft physics-informed residual with a multiple-initial-condition multiple-shooting curriculum.
summary_en.result: On Lotka-Volterra, it achieves 26% lower MSE than baseline Neural ODE and matches PINN on Hamiltonian drift.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on out-of-sample error, long-horizon stability, and Hamiltonian drift using the Lotka-Volterra system.

title: Functional Graded PEEK Cellular Lattice as a Bone Implant

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了功能梯度PEEK多孔晶格结构作为骨植入物的力学性能，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关。
why_not_core: The paper uses PEEK instead of metal LPBF, lacks fatigue testing, and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发功能梯度PEEK多孔结构以匹配骨力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 设计并3D打印了不同孔隙率的PEEK晶格结构。
summary_zh.result: 梯度结构有效降低了应力遮挡，力学性能接近骨组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试验证了结构的力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop functionally graded PEEK cellular lattices that mimic the mechanical properties of bone for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Designed and 3D printed PEEK lattice structures with graded porosity and tested them under compression.
summary_en.result: The graded structures reduced stress shielding and achieved mechanical properties comparable to bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests were performed to validate the stiffness and strength of the lattices.

title: Frequency Bias and OOD Generalization in Neural Operators under a Variable-Coefficient Wave Equation
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了神经算子在分布偏移下的泛化能力，对用户构建可靠代理模型具有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomedical application context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究神经算子在分布偏移下的泛化能力，特别是频率和系数平滑度变化的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用FNO和DeepONet求解一维变系数波动方程，并设计结构化分布偏移实验。
summary_zh.result: FNO在频率偏移下误差剧增，DeepONet退化较缓但整体误差更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟对比不同架构在分布偏移下的性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the generalization behavior of neural operators under structured distribution shifts, specifically varying input frequency and coefficient smoothness in wave propagation.
summary_en.method: Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) and Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) are trained on a 1D variable-coefficient wave equation and evaluated under out-of-distribution scenarios with independent shifts in frequency and smoothness.
summary_en.result: FNO shows a sharp error increase under unseen high-frequency inputs, while DeepONet exhibits milder degradation despite higher overall error, revealing architectural bias in frequency representation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on the wave equation with controlled distribution shifts, comparing FNO and DeepONet performance.

title: Feasibility of Ti-6Al-4V Alloys with Nanoporous and Nanotubular Surfaces for the Treatment of Femoral Defects

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V多孔植入物用于股骨缺损修复，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue behavior; it focuses on in vivo bone regeneration and static mechanical testing only.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估增材制造与阳极氧化处理的多孔钛合金植入物修复股骨缺损的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 大鼠股骨缺损模型，植入非阳极氧化、纳米多孔和纳米管表面Ti-6Al-4V植入物，6周后评估骨再生与力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 阳极氧化组骨体积和骨强度均高于对照组，纳米多孔组骨再生最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠体内实验验证骨再生和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the feasibility of additively manufactured porous Ti-6Al-4V implants with anodized surfaces for repairing critical-sized femoral defects.
summary_en.method: Eighty rats received either no graft, non-anodized, nanoporous, or nanotubular Ti-6Al-4V implants; bone regeneration and mechanical strength were assessed after six weeks.
summary_en.result: Anodized implants, especially nanoporous ones, significantly increased new bone volume and maintained comparable bone strength to non-anodized implants.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat model with histological and mechanical testing validation.

title: Bayesian Nonparametric Mixed-Effect ODEs with Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯非参数混合效应ODE模型可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的代理建模，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant mechanics, no contact mechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有参数化混合效应ODE模型易受模型误设影响，缺乏不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出MEGPODE，用高斯过程对群体和个体动力学分别建模，结合状态空间GP和虚拟观测实现高效推断。
summary_zh.result: 在异质性ODE基准上，MEGPODE改善了群体场恢复和个体轨迹预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在振荡和生物医学系统的数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Parametric mixed-effects ODE models are vulnerable to structural misspecification and lack principled uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: MEGPODE decomposes each subject's vector field into shared population and subject-specific components, both with GP priors, and uses state-space GP trajectory priors with virtual collocation observations for efficient inference.
summary_en.result: MEGPODE improves population-field recovery and subject-level trajectory prediction on heterogeneous ODE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on oscillatory and biomedical ODE systems.

title: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Model for Reservoir Seepage in Porous Media Based on Darcy’s Law
first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Oil and Gas Reservoir Geology Exploitation, Southwest Petroleum University, Chengdu 610500, China

corresponding_authors.name: Y Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Oil and Gas Reservoir Geology Exploitation, Southwest Petroleum University, Chengdu 610500, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络应用于多孔介质渗流模拟，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的植入物-骨界面流体流动或组织工程中的多孔支架渗透性预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on reservoir seepage in oil and gas applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服数据驱动方法物理可解释性弱和井位数据稀疏的问题
summary_zh.method: 将达西渗流方程作为物理约束嵌入深度学习损失函数构建PINN
summary_zh.result: PINN在稀疏数据和强非均质性条件下保持高预测精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过非均质多孔介质数值模拟对比纯数据驱动模型

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the weak physical interpretability of purely data-driven methods and the performance degradation caused by sparse well-site data in reservoir seepage simulation.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is constructed by embedding Darcy's law-based seepage equations as physical constraints into the loss function of a deep learning framework.
summary_en.result: The PINN maintains high predictive accuracy even with reduced training samples and outperforms purely data-driven models under sparse data and strong heterogeneity.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations in heterogeneous porous media are performed, comparing the PINN against conventional data-driven approaches using R2 and RMSE metrics.

title: UFO: A Domain-Unification-Free Operator Framework for Generalized Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种跨域神经算子框架，能够处理分布偏移和不规则采样，对生物力学代理模型中的昂贵仿真替代具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, and implant-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子局限于单一表示域，无法处理输入输出分辨率不一致的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出UFO框架，通过自适应联合条件交互实现跨域算子学习。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准测试中，UFO在分布偏移下仍能给出准确、鲁棒的预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证，包括不连续输入、不规则采样和非线性动力学。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators are confined to a single representational domain, limiting their ability to handle mismatched input-output resolutions and distribution shifts.
summary_en.method: UFO introduces a cross-domain operator framework that learns mappings via adaptive, jointly conditioned interactions across distinct domains.
summary_en.result: UFO achieves accurate and physically coherent predictions under distribution shifts on four benchmarks covering discontinuous inputs, irregular sampling, nonlinear dynamics, and stochastic fields.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including discontinuous inputs, irregular sampling with spectral mismatch, nonlinear dynamics, and stochastic high-frequency fields.

title: Self-Supervised Laplace Approximation for Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自监督拉普拉斯近似方法可用于贝叶斯不确定性量化，可迁移至有限元代理模型中的预测不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on general Bayesian inference for regression models.

summary_zh.motivation: 绕过参数后验直接近似预测后验，高效量化不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 通过自预测数据重新拟合模型，提出自监督拉普拉斯近似（SSLA）。
summary_zh.result: 在回归任务中优于经典拉普拉斯近似，计算高效且校准良好。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟和真实数据集上对贝叶斯线性模型和神经网络进行实证验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify predictive uncertainty in Bayesian models without computing the full posterior parameter distribution.
summary_en.method: Proposes Self-Supervised Laplace Approximation (SSLA) that refits the model on self-predicted data to approximate the posterior predictive distribution.
summary_en.result: Outperforms classical Laplace approximations in predictive calibration across various regression tasks while maintaining computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on simulated and real-world datasets using Bayesian linear models and Bayesian neural networks.

title: Random-Set Graph Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的随机集图神经网络不确定性量化方法可迁移至代理模型，用于评估植入物设计中的预测不确定性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 图神经网络预测不确定性限制了其工业应用，需有效量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出随机集图神经网络，用信念函数头建模节点级认知不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在9个图学习数据集上展示了优越的不确定性量化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图学习基准和自动驾驶数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty in GNN predictions hinders industrial adoption, necessitating a principled quantification framework.
summary_en.method: Proposes Random-Set Graph Neural Networks with a belief-function head that models epistemic uncertainty as random sets over class labels.
summary_en.result: RS-GNN achieves superior uncertainty quantification on 9 graph learning datasets, including autonomous driving benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard graph learning benchmarks and real-world autonomous driving datasets (Nuscenes, ROAD).

title: Online Conformal Prediction: Enforcing monotonicity via Online Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的在线不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no constraint handling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有在线共形预测仅针对单一置信水平，无法满足多风险容忍度需求。
summary_zh.method: 提出两种在线共形预测方法，通过在线优化强制嵌套预测集，实现多水平同时校准。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据上，方法实现了稳定覆盖、严格嵌套和更高效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在天气预测等任务上验证，与基线方法对比覆盖率和嵌套性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing online conformal prediction methods focus on a single coverage level, failing to provide consistent uncertainty estimates across heterogeneous risk tolerances.
summary_en.method: Two novel online conformal prediction methods are proposed that enforce nested prediction sets via online optimization with small regret, enabling simultaneous calibration across multiple coverage levels.
summary_en.result: Empirical results on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate stable coverage, strictly nested sets, and improved efficiency over existing baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on forecasting tasks (e.g., weather) by comparing coverage and nestedness against baseline online conformal methods.

title: Numerical evaluation of elongated dodecahedron porous structures
venue: Modelling and Simulation in Materials Science and Engineering
first_author_affiliation: School of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Curtin University, Kent Street, Bentley, Perth, Western Australia, 6102, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Rajat Pal
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil and Mechanical Engineering, Curtin University, Kent Street, Bentley, Perth, Western Australia, 6102, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过数值模拟评估了多孔结构的刚度与孔隙率、长径比的关系，为骨科植入物的应力屏蔽缓解提供了设计指导。
why_not_core: This paper is purely numerical with no LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究长菱形十二面体多孔结构的刚度与孔隙率、长径比的关系，以指导骨科植入物设计。
summary_zh.method: 通过有限元分析评估不同孔隙率、长径比和材料下单元胞的弹性响应。
summary_zh.result: 归一化弹性模量随孔隙率增加而降低，长径比增大增强刚度，体积响应主要受母材泊松比影响。
summary_zh.validation: 与解析表达式对比验证，结果吻合良好。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the mechanical behavior of elongated dodecahedron lattice structures for stiffness matching in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis of unit cells across porosities 10–90%, aspect ratios 0.125–5, and six implant materials.
summary_en.result: Normalized elastic modulus decreases from 0.84 to 0.03 with porosity; increasing aspect ratio enhances stiffness at intermediate porosities; volumetric response is governed by parent material Poisson's ratio.
summary_en.validation: Numerical results were benchmarked against analytical expressions, showing good agreement across the full porosity range.

title: Multi-Variable Conformal Prediction: Optimizing Prediction Sets without Data Splitting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需数据分割的多变量共形预测方法，可应用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses purely on conformal prediction methodology.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测需数据分割且预测集形状固定，效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出多变量共形预测框架，将预测集设计与校准统一为优化问题。
summary_zh.result: 无需数据分割即可达到目标覆盖率，且预测集更小、方差更低。
summary_zh.validation: 在椭球和多模态预测集上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard conformal prediction requires data splitting and fixes prediction set shapes before calibration, limiting efficiency.
summary_en.method: We propose multi-variable conformal prediction (MCP) that unifies prediction set design and calibration into a single optimization problem using scenario theory.
summary_en.result: MCP achieves target coverage without data splitting, with smaller or comparable prediction set sizes and reduced variance across calibration runs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on ellipsoidal and multi-modal prediction sets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

title: Micro‐Mechanism Informed Neural Networks for Process‐Property Prediction in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
first_author_affiliation: Graduate Institute of Manufacturing Technology National Taipei University of Technology  Taipei Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Yo-Lun Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Graduate Institute of Manufacturing Technology National Taipei University of Technology  Taipei Taiwan

relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理机制嵌入神经网络预测LPBF工艺-性能关系，方法可迁移至生物医学植入物的力学性能预测。
why_not_core: No porous structure design, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 数据驱动机器学习在增材制造中面临数据稀缺和外推能力差的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出微机制知情神经网络，嵌入六种冶金机制作为可微约束。
summary_zh.result: 硬约束物理引导模型在外推数据上保持高精度，优于软约束方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在SiC增强SKD61工具钢的LPBF数据集上验证外推性能。

summary_en.motivation: Data-driven machine learning for additive manufacturing suffers from data scarcity and poor extrapolation beyond training distributions.
summary_en.method: Micro-mechanism informed neural networks embed six metallurgical mechanisms as differentiable constraints, including thermal physics, martensite kinetics, and strengthening models.
summary_en.result: Hard physics embedding substantially outperforms soft constraints for generalization, maintaining high accuracy on extrapolation data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a novel SiC-reinforced SKD61 tool steel LPBF dataset with no prior published studies.

title: Manifold Sampling via Entropy Maximization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种在约束流形上高效采样的方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的约束优化或不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general constrained sampling with no validation on engineering design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决可行集由多个不连通分量组成时的约束采样难题。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于熵最大化的重采样方案，结合k近邻密度估计。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和机器人基准测试中，Sinkhorn距离提升一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试和机器人运动规划案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient sampling from disconnected feasible sets under constraints remains challenging in Bayesian optimization and robotics.
summary_en.method: MASEM employs a resampling scheme that maximizes entropy via k-nearest neighbor density estimation to sample on implicitly defined manifolds.
summary_en.result: MASEM achieves an order-of-magnitude improvement in Sinkhorn distance over alternatives on synthetic and robotics benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and robotics motion planning problems.

title: GPR-Based Surrogate Model for Probabilistic Fatigue Safety Factor Prediction in Stepped Shafts
first_author_affiliation: student

relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了高斯过程回归替代模型在疲劳安全系数预测中的应用，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle multi-objective constraints or patient-specific geometries.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统有限元疲劳分析计算成本高、网格约束大的问题。
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程回归构建替代模型，使用拉丁超立方采样生成314个高保真样本。
summary_zh.result: 模型R²达0.9905，RMSE为0.187，参数重要性排序与物理理论一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过5折交叉验证和与Goodman理论趋势对比验证模型泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high computational cost and meshing constraints of traditional finite element fatigue analysis.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian Process Regression surrogate model is trained on 314 high-fidelity ANSYS simulations generated via Latin Hypercube and custom sampling.
summary_en.result: The model achieves exceptional accuracy (R²=0.9905, RMSE=0.187) and physically consistent parameter importance ranking.

title: Few-Shot Physics-Informed Neural Network for Shape Reconstruction of Concentric-Tube Robots

summary_en.result: Theory-based simulation can predict printability and optimize parameters, but faces challenges in data availability and overfitting compared to machine learning.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: Physics-informed operator learning for transferable energy-dissipative microstructure dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学中的替代建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or uncertainty quantification, and its validation is limited to phase-field benchmarks without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 相场模拟计算成本高，需高效替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出PFNet，结合U-Net与物理信息学习条件演化算子。
summary_zh.result: 在Cahn-Hilliard和马氏体相变基准上实现稳定自回归预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证预测精度与泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity phase-field simulations over long horizons and broad parameter spaces are computationally prohibitive, motivating the development of efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: PFNet integrates a diffusion-inspired U-Net with periodic padding, entropy-based state conditioning, and thermodynamic-parameter modulation to learn conditional evolution operators.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves accurate one-step prediction and stable autoregressive rollouts across varying compositions, gradient-energy coefficients, and morphology classes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including Cahn-Hilliard coarsening and a four-channel martensitic-transformation problem.

title: Neural Operators as Efficient Function Interpolators
relevance_to_user: 该论文将神经算子重新定义为函数插值器，其高效参数化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 将神经算子重新用于有限维函数插值，提升参数效率。
summary_zh.method: 引入辅助基空间，将有限维函数视为算子，使用TFNO进行学习。
summary_zh.result: 在解析函数和核质量数据上，NO以更少参数匹配或超越MLP和KAN。
summary_zh.validation: 在解析函数基准和核质量残差场上验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reframe neural operators as efficient function interpolators for finite-dimensional problems, reducing parameter count and training time.
summary_en.method: Introduce an auxiliary base-space to treat finite-dimensional functions as operators acting by composition, and apply a Tensorized Fourier Neural Operator (TFNO) for learning.
summary_en.result: Neural operators match or outperform MLPs and KANs on analytic benchmarks and achieve competitive RMSE on nuclear mass data with high parameter efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validated on analytic functions of increasing complexity and on a real-world nuclear mass residual field using a TFNO ensemble.

title: Gyroid Structures under Compression: Design, Simulation and Validation through ANN and Experimental Testing
first_author_affiliation: Vellore Institute of Technology

corresponding_authors.name: D Harsha Vardhan Reddy
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Vellore Institute of Technology

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Gyroid结构的压缩行为，包含FDM制造、实验测试和ANN预测，但未涉及LPBF制造、疲劳测试或生物医学植入物背景。
why_not_core: This paper uses FDM (not LPBF), tests only static compression (no fatigue), and lacks biomedical context such as stress shielding or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Gyroid结构的压缩行为与能量吸收性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过FDM制造ABS试样，结合FEA模拟和ANN预测压缩强度。
summary_zh.result: 实验与模拟结果吻合良好，ANN能有效预测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 万能试验机压缩测试验证FEA和ANN预测。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the compressive behavior and energy absorption of gyroid structures fabricated via FDM.
summary_en.method: Gyroid ABS specimens were fabricated by FDM, simulated with FEA, and an ANN was trained to predict compressive strength and optimize parameters.
summary_en.result: Experimental and simulation results showed good agreement, demonstrating ANN's effectiveness in predicting mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Compression tests on a universal testing machine validated both FEA and ANN predictions.

title: Don't Get Your Kroneckers in a Twist: Gaussian Processes on High-Dimensional Incomplete Grids
relevance_to_user: 该方法可扩展到高维生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化在植入物设计中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for implant design, or biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维高斯过程回归的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 结合加性核与不完全网格实现快速核矩阵-向量乘积
summary_zh.result: 在数十亿数据点和数千维上实现近线性扩展
summary_zh.validation: 在势能面基准上验证计算效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of Gaussian process regression in high-dimensional settings.
summary_en.method: Combines an additive kernel with an incomplete grid to achieve fast kernel matrix-vector products with near-linear scaling.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates near-linear scaling with data size and low-order polynomial scaling with dimensionality, enabling Bayesian modeling of high-dimensional potential energy surfaces.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark potential energy surface datasets with up to billions of data points and thousands of dimensions.

title: Comparative Fatigue Analysis of CF-PLA Metamaterial Bone Plates for Orthopaedic Fixation.
first_author_affiliation: Centre for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (CAMM), School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Joondalup, WA 6027, Australia.

corresponding_authors.name: Majid Tolouei-Rad
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (CAMM), School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Joondalup, WA 6027, Australia.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了CF-PLA骨板的疲劳性能，但材料为聚合物而非金属LPBF，且未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no metallic implant, no stress shielding quantification, no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统金属骨板存在应力遮挡，需开发聚合物基骨板并评估疲劳性能。
summary_zh.method: FDM打印CF-PLA骨板，测试四种超结构在循环压缩下的疲劳行为。
summary_zh.result: 内凹结构疲劳性能最佳，旋转方形和六边形在高应变下早期失效。
summary_zh.validation: 通过应变控制循环加载实验验证疲劳寿命和刚度退化。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional metallic bone plates cause stress shielding, motivating the exploration of polymer-based metamaterial bone plates with improved fatigue performance.
summary_en.method: Fused deposition modelling (FDM) was used to fabricate CF-PLA bone plates with four metamaterial architectures (tetrachiral, re-entrant, rotating square, hexagonal), and their compressive fatigue behavior was evaluated under strain-controlled cyclic loading at 20-80% yield strain.
summary_en.result: The re-entrant structure exhibited the best fatigue performance, sustaining up to 100,000 cycles at moderate strains, while rotating square and hexagonal structures showed early stiffness degradation and failure at higher strains.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing under cyclic compression was conducted, with stiffness degradation and cycle-to-failure recorded for each lattice geometry.

title: CONTRA: Conformal Prediction Region via Normalizing Flow Transformation
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过归一化流生成多维预测区域，可迁移至FEA代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no implant design application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决共形预测在多维输出中预测区域不准确的问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用归一化流将输出映射到潜在空间，基于中心距离定义非一致性分数。
summary_zh.result: 生成比传统超矩形或椭圆区域更精确的预测区域，并保证覆盖概率。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准数据集上对比现有方法，验证预测区域质量。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction struggles with multi-dimensional outputs due to reliance on one-dimensional nonconformity scores, motivating a method for sharper prediction regions.
summary_en.method: CONTRA uses normalizing flows to map outputs to a latent space and defines nonconformity scores based on distances from the center, enabling high-density prediction regions.
summary_en.result: The method produces sharper prediction regions than traditional hyperrectangular or elliptical approaches while maintaining guaranteed coverage probability.
summary_en.validation: Empirical evaluation on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrates superior prediction region accuracy compared to existing conformal prediction methods.

title: Bioelectric ink bridge: An electroactive casein bioink for cartilage regeneration by actively restoring the electrophysiological niche.
relevance_to_user: 该论文开发了一种电活性生物墨水用于软骨再生，但未涉及AI在生物打印流程中的集成。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on material design and biological evaluation without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发能模拟电生理微环境的生物墨水以促进软骨再生。
summary_zh.method: 设计季铵化-甲基丙烯酸化酪蛋白电活性生物墨水，结合DLP打印。
summary_zh.result: QCMA墨水在电场下促进软骨细胞迁移、增殖和基质沉积，大鼠模型显示修复效果。
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠骨软骨缺损模型体内验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a bioink that recapitulates endogenous bioelectric cues for enhanced cartilage regeneration.
summary_en.method: A filler-free electroactive bioink (QCMA) was synthesized by quaternizing and methacrylating casein, enabling DLP bioprinting with high fidelity.
summary_en.result: QCMA constructs under pulsed electric field activated MAPK signaling, upregulated chondrogenic markers, and improved cartilage repair in a rat model.
summary_en.validation: In vivo validation using a rat osteochondral defect model with impedance and voltage recovery measurements.

title: AdamFLIP: Adaptive Momentum Feedback Linearization Optimization for Hard Constrained PINN Training
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过硬约束优化提升PINN训练精度，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代模型，但未涉及具体工程约束或UQ。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN软约束训练存在病态和约束不满足问题
summary_zh.method: 将约束残差视为受控动力系统，用反馈线性化计算拉格朗日乘子，结合Adam自适应优化
summary_zh.result: 在Navier-Stokes等基准问题上相对L2误差降低三分之二以上
summary_zh.validation: 在多个前向和逆向PDE基准上测试，与软约束及先进约束优化器对比

summary_en.motivation: Standard soft-constrained PINN training suffers from ill-conditioning and poor constraint satisfaction due to manually chosen loss weights.
summary_en.method: Reformulates PINN training as equality-constrained optimization, treats constraint residuals as a controlled dynamical system, and computes Lagrange multipliers via feedback linearization with Adam-style moment adaptation.
summary_en.result: Achieves over two-thirds reduction in relative L2 error on Navier-Stokes benchmarks compared to the next best method.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple forward and inverse PDE benchmarks against soft-constrained PINN and state-of-the-art constrained optimizers.

title: Tyche: One Step Flow for Efficient Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的单步条件流模型用于概率天气预报，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化与高效采样。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on weather forecasting.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低概率天气预报中扩散模型的推理成本
summary_zh.method: 提出单步条件流模型Tyche，使用JVP正则化整流目标实现一步生成
summary_zh.result: 单步评估即可匹配或超越多步生成模型和ECMWF IFS集合预报的精度
summary_zh.validation: 在ERA5全球再分析数据上验证预报技巧和校准性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the inference cost of diffusion-based probabilistic weather forecasting while maintaining forecast skill and calibration.
summary_en.method: Tyche employs a one-step conditional flow with a JVP-regularized rectification objective and an isotropic Swin transformer to map noise directly to future states.
summary_en.result: With a single function evaluation, Tyche matches or exceeds the performance of multi-step generative baselines and the operational ECMWF IFS ensemble.
summary_en.validation: Validated on ERA5 reanalysis data at 1.5° and 6-hour resolution, comparing forecast skill and CRPS calibration.

title: Structure-Preserving Gaussian Processes Via Discrete Euler-Lagrange Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过保持几何结构的Gaussian Process学习动力学，可迁移到生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模中，但未直接处理有限元仿真或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on learning dynamics from position data using structure-preserving GPs, but does not address expensive finite element sampling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从离散位置数据中学习物理一致的动力学，避免能量漂移。
summary_zh.method: 提出拉格朗日高斯过程，利用离散欧拉-拉格朗日方程构建条件算子。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实案例中实现数据高效、长期稳定的预测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过软机器人等案例验证物理一致性和不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To learn physically consistent dynamics from discrete position measurements while preserving geometric structure and avoiding energy drift.
summary_en.method: Lagrangian Gaussian Processes (LGPs) are proposed, conditioning on discrete forced Euler-Lagrange equations derived from variational discretization.
summary_en.result: LGPs achieve data-efficient learning and stable long-term predictions with uncertainty quantification, demonstrated on synthetic and real-world soft robot data.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes synthetic benchmarks and a real-world soft robot with hysteresis, showing physically consistent dynamics from sparse positional data.

title: Reduced-Order Modeling of Parameterized Visco-Plastic Shallow Flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非侵入式降阶建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on visco-plastic shallow flows with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 参数化粘塑性浅水流动的高效代理建模面临强非线性和非光滑流变挑战。
summary_zh.method: 基于张量分解的非侵入式降阶模型，利用高阶奇异值分解压缩解流形。
summary_zh.result: 准确捕捉前沿传播、塞流和剪切区域，实现显著计算加速。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验与全阶模拟对比验证精度和加速比。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient surrogate modeling of parametrized visco-plastic shallow flows is challenging due to strong nonlinearities and non-smooth rheology.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive reduced-order model based on tensor decomposition (higher-order SVD) compresses the solution manifold and enables rapid online evaluation via multilinear decoding.
summary_en.result: The method accurately captures key flow features such as front propagation, plug and shear regions, and achieves substantial computational speedups.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments compare the reduced-order model against full-order simulations to assess accuracy and speedup.

title: Physics-informed neural networks for predicting laser-tissue interaction in maxillofacial reconstruction surgery

why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant mechanics, no contact mechanics or stress analysis, and no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 用PINN高效模拟激光与生物组织的热相互作用。
summary_zh.method: 构建三层隐藏层PINN，嵌入热传导和辐射传输方程。
summary_zh.result: PINN准确预测温度分布，与解析解高度吻合。
summary_zh.validation: 与解析解对比，未进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently simulate laser-tissue thermal dynamics using physics-informed neural networks as an alternative to traditional solvers.
summary_en.method: A PINN with three hidden layers of 50 neurons and Tanh activation was trained by embedding heat transfer and radiative transport equations.
summary_en.result: The PINN accurately predicted temperature distributions and thermal penetration depths for different laser types, matching analytical solutions.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed against analytical benchmarks only, without experimental or in vitro confirmation.

title: MTRBO: Multiple trust-region based Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出多信任区域贝叶斯优化，可提高高维黑箱函数优化效率，对植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No application to FEA, implant mechanics, or biomechanics; no constraint handling; no uncertainty quantification beyond GP posterior.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在高维问题中效率低下，需改进采样策略。
summary_zh.method: 提出多信任区域贝叶斯优化，同时利用后验均值和方差进行局部开发和全局探索。
summary_zh.result: 在多种非凸高维测试函数上优于现有方法，并应用于投资组合优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准测试函数和投资组合优化案例验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from inefficiency in high-dimensional problems due to exponential search space growth and low sampling budgets.
summary_en.method: A multiple trust-region Bayesian optimization method is proposed, adaptively exploiting near promising solutions and exploring uncertain regions using GP posterior mean and variance.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms state-of-the-art trust-region BO algorithms on various non-convex high-dimensional test functions and a portfolio optimization problem.
summary_en.validation: Benchmarked on synthetic test functions and a real-world portfolio optimization case.

title: MTRBO: Multiple trust-region based Bayesian optimization

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from inefficiency in high-dimensional problems due to search space explosion and limited sampling budget.
summary_en.method: A multiple trust-region Bayesian optimization method is proposed, adaptively exploiting near promising solutions and exploring uncertain regions using GP posterior mean and variance.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic test functions and a real-world portfolio optimization case.

title: Distortion-minimized de-homogenization for optimization of cell-size distribution in TPMS structures
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的TPMS结构去均质化方法可用于优化多孔植入物的刚度分布，但未涉及应力遮挡或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on TPMS cell-size optimization and de-homogenization accuracy, but does not address stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高TPMS结构空间胞元尺寸优化的去均质化精度
summary_zh.method: 提出基于波数最小化的去均质化方法，利用离散余弦变换求解泊松方程
summary_zh.result: 优化后结构刚度比均匀结构提高54.2%，远优于传统周期调制法
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例和实验压缩测试验证有效刚度

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of de-homogenization for spatially optimized TPMS structures, enabling effective stiffness maximization.
summary_en.method: A novel de-homogenization technique minimizes the wavenumber difference between target and actual size distributions by solving a Poisson equation via discrete cosine transform.
summary_en.result: The optimized structure achieves 54.2% higher effective stiffness than the uniform case in experiments, compared to a 77.3% decrease with the conventional periodic modulation method.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples and experimental compression tests on additively manufactured TPMS specimens validate the effective stiffness improvement.

title: Decoupled PFNs: Identifiable Epistemic-Aleatoric Decomposition via Structured Synthetic Priors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种解耦认知不确定性与偶然不确定性的方法，可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PFN无法区分认知与偶然不确定性，导致主动学习/贝叶斯优化中探索策略失效。
summary_zh.method: 利用合成数据生成过程的可控性，训练解耦PFN分别预测无噪声信号和噪声方差。
summary_zh.result: 解耦模型在超参数优化和合成BO中优于基线，缓解了总方差探索的失败模式。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准和超参数优化任务上对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Prior-Fitted Networks fail to separate epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty, leading to suboptimal exploration in active learning and Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Exploiting the controllable synthetic data generation process, a decoupled PFN is trained with separate heads for the latent signal and observation noise variance, and the predictive is induced by convolution.
summary_en.result: Decoupled models mitigate the failure mode of total-variance exploration in noisy settings and achieve the best average rank in HPO and synthetic BO.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on synthetic benchmarks and hyperparameter optimization tasks.

title: Adaptive Coordinate Transforms for Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种自适应坐标变换模块，可提升神经算子在PDE求解中的精度，其方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。

relevance_to_user: 该论文为神经算子的Sobolev逼近提供了理论保证，但仅在一维Burgers方程上验证，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and validation only on a simple 1D PDE benchmark.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子在Sobolev范数下的逼近性质缺乏定量分析。
summary_zh.method: 建立算子学习的泛函分析框架，证明FNO在H^t范数下的逼近界，并用H^1损失训练FNO。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers方程上获得H^1误差低至10^{-7}，经验标度律指数约1.4。
summary_zh.validation: 在一维粘性Burgers方程数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: The approximation properties of neural operators in Sobolev norms, which are natural for PDE well-posedness and stability, lack quantitative characterization.
summary_en.method: A functional-analytic framework is developed to prove uniform H^t-approximation bounds for neural operators with explicit complexity-error relations, and Fourier Neural Operators are trained with H^1 loss on the Burgers equation.
summary_en.result: Test H^1 errors as low as 10^{-7} and relative errors of order 10^{-3} are achieved, with an empirical scaling exponent α≈1.4 matching theoretical predictions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation benchmark.

title: Multi-fidelity surrogates for mechanics of composites: from co-kriging to multi-fidelity neural networks

summary_en.result: Applications are categorized into forward prediction, inverse optimization, and workflow integration, with open challenges discussed.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: Isotropic Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种保持空间对称性的傅里叶神经算子改进方法，可提高代理模型效率并减少参数，适用于FEA替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on isotropic symmetry in PDE surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准傅里叶神经算子不保证空间对称性，影响物理一致性。
summary_zh.method: 提出各向同性傅里叶神经算子，修改线性变换以尊重旋转对称性。
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时，参数数量在2D减少16倍，3D减少96倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准测试上验证性能提升。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Fourier Neural Operators do not enforce spatial symmetries, which are inherent in many physical systems, potentially degrading performance and physical consistency.
summary_en.method: The Isotropic Fourier Neural Operator modifies the linear transformations in Fourier layers to respect rotational symmetries, reducing parameter count while improving accuracy.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves up to 16x parameter reduction in 2D and 96x in 3D with improved or comparable performance on PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE benchmarks (e.g., Darcy flow, Navier-Stokes) demonstrate improved accuracy and efficiency.

title: Fast and accurate conditioning for large-scale and online Gaussian process prediction problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法可加速大规模高斯过程预测，适用于代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未直接应用于生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模高斯过程预测计算成本高，需高效近似方法。
summary_zh.method: 通过精心设计的数据对比进行条件化，实现快速精确预测。
summary_zh.result: 少量对比即可达到机器精度，在线预测复杂度为O(1)。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准核函数和数值基准上验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: Exact Gaussian process prediction scales cubically with data size, necessitating efficient approximations for large-scale and online settings.
summary_en.method: The proposed method conditions on a small number of carefully designed linear combinations (contrasts) of data, achieving machine-precision accuracy with O(T r^2) precomputation and O(1) online cost.
summary_en.result: For smooth kernels, conditioning on r contrasts yields exact conditional distributions, enabling fast and accurate predictions for large connected regions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate machine-precision accuracy and near-linear scaling for well-conditioned covariance matrices.

title: Conformalized Percentile Interval: Finite Sample Validity and Improved Conditional Performance
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的保形分位数区间方法可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，提高预测区间的条件覆盖率和效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical implant design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation data.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有保形预测区间在条件有效性和区间效率上不足。
summary_zh.method: 在概率积分变换空间校准分位数区间，结合神经网络估计条件CDF。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上实现了更好的条件校准和更短的区间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实数据集与现有方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing conformal prediction intervals often lack conditional validity and efficiency, especially under heteroskedasticity and skewed responses.
summary_en.method: A conformal calibration method in probability integral transform space adjusts percentile intervals using estimated conditional CDF from neural networks.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves finite-sample marginal coverage, asymptotic conditional coverage, and shorter intervals on diverse benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and real-world datasets, comparing conditional calibration and interval length against baselines.

title: Robust Conditional Conformal Prediction via Branched Normalizing Flow
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的条件共形预测方法可用于提高代理模型在分布偏移下的预测可靠性，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical design context; it focuses on conformal prediction under distribution shift.

summary_zh.motivation: 共形预测在分布偏移下条件覆盖不可靠，需要鲁棒方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出分支归一化流，将测试输入变换到校准分布并反向变换预测集。
summary_zh.result: 在九个数据集上一致提高了条件覆盖鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准数据集上对比实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction suffers from conditional coverage degradation under distribution shift, motivating a method to bound and mitigate this issue.
summary_en.method: A branched normalizing flow architecture is introduced to transport test inputs to the calibration distribution and transform prediction sets back while preserving conditional guarantees.
summary_en.result: The proposed method consistently improves conditional coverage robustness across nine datasets and various confidence levels.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on multiple benchmark datasets comparing conditional coverage error against baselines.

title: Possibilistic Predictive Uncertainty for Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的认知不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度神经网络不确定性建模方法在原理严谨性与计算效率之间存在矛盾。

summary_en.motivation: Deep neural networks suffer from overconfidence on unseen inputs, and existing uncertainty quantification methods face a trade-off between principled Bayesian inference and computational efficiency.
summary_en.method: We introduce Dirichlet-approximated possibilistic posterior predictions (DAPPr), which projects a possibilistic posterior over parameters to prediction space via supremum operators and approximates it with learnable Dirichlet possibility functions.
summary_en.result: DAPPr achieves competitive or superior uncertainty quantification performance compared to state-of-the-art evidential deep learning methods on diverse benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple standard classification and regression benchmarks, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免对每个新几何重新网格划分和有限元求解，实现快速预测。
summary_zh.method: 用符号距离函数编码几何，作为DeepONet分支网络输入，学习几何到散射场的映射。
summary_zh.result: 模型对未见几何具有泛化能力，且比有限元计算更轻量。
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元结果对比验证预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To avoid remeshing and expensive FEM solves for each new geometry by learning a surrogate operator.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet is trained with signed distance functions encoding scatterer geometry as branch input and spatial coordinates as trunk input to map geometry to scattered field.
summary_en.result: The trained model generalizes to unseen geometries and provides a computationally lighter alternative to FEM.
summary_en.validation: Predictions are compared against FEM solutions for unseen geometries to assess accuracy.

title: Knowing when to trust machine-learned interatomic potentials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的UQ方法可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有MLIP不确定性量化方法扩展性差且误差信号弱。
summary_zh.method: 利用预训练MLIP的冻结表示训练判别分类器进行选择性分类。
summary_zh.result: PROBE方法在可靠性概率与误差单调性上优于集成方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在两个MLIP架构的大规模测试集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing uncertainty quantification methods for MLIPs scale poorly and provide weak error signals.
summary_en.method: A discriminative classifier is trained on frozen per-atom representations of a pretrained MLIP to perform selective classification.
summary_en.result: PROBE yields reliability probabilities that monotonically track actual error, outperforming ensemble disagreement.
summary_en.validation: Validated on large held-out evaluation sets across two distinct MLIP architectures.

title: Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles for Scalable Operator Learning with Distribution-Free Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合量子神经网络的算子学习方法，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学代理模型。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant-related FEA problems; method is demonstrated only on synthetic PDEs and power systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有算子学习方法推理复杂度高且缺乏可靠的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 提出共形量子DeepONet集成，利用量子正交网络降低复杂度，结合共形预测提供分布自由的不确定性保证。
summary_zh.result: 在合成PDE和电力系统动力学上实现了准确预测和校准的不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准（合成PDE和真实电力系统数据）上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing operator learning methods suffer from quadratic inference complexity and lack reliable uncertainty quantification for safety-critical applications.
summary_en.method: We propose Conformalized Quantum DeepONet Ensembles, which use Quantum Orthogonal Neural Networks to reduce complexity to O(n) and combine ensemble-based epistemic modeling with adaptive conformal prediction for distribution-free coverage guarantees.
summary_en.result: Experiments on synthetic PDEs and real-world power system dynamics demonstrate accurate predictions with calibrated uncertainty under realistic quantum noise.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including synthetic PDEs and real-world power system dynamics data.

title: An ALE-Consistent Graph Neural Operator-Transformer Framework for Fluid-Structure Interaction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的ALE一致图神经算子-Transformer框架可用于流固耦合问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的植入物-骨界面模拟，但未涉及植入物设计或应力遮挡。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, stress shielding, or biomechanics; it focuses on fluid-structure interaction with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决流固耦合长期预测中变形网格上的计算效率问题
summary_zh.method: 提出ALE一致的GNO-Transformer框架，耦合LSTM结构预测，采用两阶段训练
summary_zh.result: 在柔性梁振动基准问题上实现长期相位一致预测，并泛化到入口剖面变化
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（圆柱绕流柔性梁振动）及消融研究

summary_en.motivation: To achieve efficient and stable long-term fluid-structure interaction prediction on deforming unstructured meshes.
summary_en.method: An ALE-consistent framework coupling a GNO-ViT surrogate for fluid dynamics with an LSTM for structural kinematics, using two-stage training with autoregressive fine-tuning.
summary_en.result: Accurate phase-consistent predictions over long rollouts and robust generalization under inlet-profile variations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark of a flexible beam vibrating in a cylinder wake, with ablation studies.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印陶瓷骨螺钉的生物相容性和力学性能，但未涉及LPBF金属植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper uses DLP printing of ceramic composites, not LPBF of metals; focuses on bone screws for non-weight-bearing sites, not hip implants or stress shielding; no fatigue testing or surface roughness analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适用于非承重部位的高骨整合、低骨损伤陶瓷骨螺钉。
summary_zh.method: 采用DLP 3D打印制备Al2O3/MgSiO3复合陶瓷骨螺钉，并进行力学测试和有限元模拟。
summary_zh.result: 15wt% MS掺杂组抗压强度提升222.9%，失效扭矩3.42 N·m，拔出力428.47 N。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试、体外矿化、细胞实验和有限元模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop ceramic bone screws with moderate strength, high osseointegration, and low bone damage for non-weight-bearing applications.
summary_en.method: Alumina/magnesium silicate composite ceramic bone screws were fabricated via DLP 3D printing and evaluated through mechanical tests, in vitro mineralization, cell assays, and finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: The MS15 group exhibited 222.9% higher compressive strength than pure alumina, with a failure torque of 3.42 N·m and pull-out force of 428.47 N.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical compression tests, in vitro mineralization and cell experiments, and finite element simulation of thread design.

title: 3D-printed CF-PLA bone plates with metamaterial structures: Design, fabrication, and mechanical evaluation.
venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials
first_author_affiliation: Centre for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (CAMM), School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Joondalup, WA, 6027, Australia. Electronic address: ANID@our.ecu.edu.au.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (CAMM), School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Joondalup, WA, 6027, Australia. Electronic address: ANID@our.ecu.edu.au.

corresponding_authors.name: Majid Tolouei-Rad
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing (CAMM), School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, Joondalup, WA, 6027, Australia. Electronic address: m.rad@ecu.edu.au.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了CF-PLA骨板的力学性能，与用户关注的LPBF金属植入物方向不同，但应力遮挡和结构设计思路可借鉴。
why_not_core: This paper uses FDM with CF-PLA, not LPBF for metallic implants, and lacks fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发低刚度CF-PLA骨板以减少应力遮挡
summary_zh.method: 设计四种超结构骨板并用FDM打印，测试其力学性能
summary_zh.result: 四手性结构在弯曲、拉伸和压缩中表现最佳，刚度低于金属板
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、压缩和弯曲实验验证力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To develop low-stiffness bone plates using metamaterial structures to mitigate stress shielding.
summary_en.method: Four lattice-structured CF-PLA bone plates (re-entrant, rotating square, tetrachiral, hexagonal) were designed and fabricated via FDM, then mechanically tested.
summary_en.result: The tetrachiral structure exhibited the highest flexural stress (17 MPa) and modulus (1214 MPa), and all CF-PLA plates showed substantially lower stiffness than metallic plates.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through flexural, tensile, and compressive tests.

title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion of SS316L Stainless Steel for Strut Based Lattice Structures in Biomedical Implant Applications: A Comprehensive Review
venue: International Scientific Journal of Engineering and Management
relevance_to_user: 该综述总结了SS316L点阵结构的LPBF工艺、力学性能及应力屏蔽问题，但缺乏实验验证和疲劳数据。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no original experimental validation, no fatigue testing, and no quantitative link between porous structure and stress shielding reduction.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述LPBF制备SS316L点阵结构用于生物医学植入物的研究现状
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾80余篇文献，涵盖工艺、力学、设计及生物学验证
summary_zh.result: 总结了工艺参数、力学性能及点阵拓扑对骨植入物适配性的影响
summary_zh.validation: 无原始实验验证，仅文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To consolidate the state of the art in LPBF of SS316L lattice structures for biomedical implants, focusing on process-structure-property relationships.
summary_en.method: A comprehensive review of over 80 peer-reviewed studies covering LPBF process parameters, mechanical properties, lattice topologies, and biological evidence.
summary_en.result: Identified key gaps including lack of integrated process-structure-biology studies and weak quantitative mapping of strut size to compressive strength.
summary_en.validation: No original experimental validation; the paper is a literature review.

title: In Situ Programming of Shape-Morphing Hydrogels via Vat Photopolymerization for 4D Bioprinting.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Materials and Chemical Engineering "Giulio Natta", Politecnico di Milano, 20133 Milan, Italy.

corresponding_authors.name: Marinella Levi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Chemistry, Materials and Chemical Engineering "Giulio Natta", Politecnico di Milano, 20133 Milan, Italy.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及4D生物打印的形状变形，但未集成AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on process-driven shape-morphing without autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服水凝胶力学性能限制，实现复杂形状变形。
summary_zh.method: 通过逐层调节光曝光时间，在光聚合中引入交联密度梯度。
summary_zh.result: 实现了可控弯曲变形，曲率半径11-20毫米，细胞活性>95%。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元模拟与实验变形对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the geometric limitations of hydrogel-based bioprinting by encoding shape-morphing behavior during fabrication.
summary_en.method: Spatial variations in crosslinking density were introduced in GelMA constructs by modulating light exposure time layer-by-layer in vat photopolymerization.
summary_en.result: Controlled bending with radii of curvature between 11 and 20 mm was achieved, and high cell viability (>95%) was maintained.
summary_en.validation: Finite element simulations reproduced the experimentally observed deformation, confirming the predictive capability.

title: Human-in-the-Loop Meta Bayesian Optimization for Fusion Energy and Scientific Applications
relevance_to_user: 该方法将元学习与贝叶斯优化结合，适用于数据稀缺的高成本实验优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics/implant design; it focuses on fusion energy and scientific optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数据稀缺、高成本科学实验中的优化效率问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出人机协同元贝叶斯优化框架，结合专家知识与元学习代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在ICF能量产额优化及分子优化等基准上优于现有贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值基准和科学应用案例上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate discovery in data-scarce, high-stakes scientific domains by integrating expert knowledge with uncertainty-aware machine learning.
summary_en.method: A human-in-the-loop meta Bayesian optimization framework with a meta-learned surrogate model and an expert-informed acquisition function.
summary_en.result: Outperforms current BO methods on ICF energy yield optimization, molecular optimization, and superconducting material benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and scientific optimization tasks including ICF, molecular, and materials design.

title: Bayesian Optimization in Linear Time
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出线性复杂度的贝叶斯优化，可加速昂贵目标函数的优化，适用于生物医学工程中的代理模型调优。
why_not_core: This paper presents a general Bayesian optimization method on synthetic test functions, lacking FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomedical/implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化计算复杂度高且全局建模对局部优化效率低。
summary_zh.method: 采用递归二分划分搜索空间，结合局部建模与采集函数，实现线性复杂度。
summary_zh.result: 在6至124维测试函数上优于常用库，且计算复杂度为线性。
summary_zh.validation: 基于七个标准数值测试函数进行性能对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization suffers from cubic complexity in training set size and global modeling that is suboptimal for local minimization.
summary_en.method: We propose a recursive binary partitioning of the search space that harmonizes both modeling and acquisition in a linear-time framework.
summary_en.result: The method achieves superior optimization performance on seven test functions with dimensionality up to 124, while maintaining linear computational complexity.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing against a common Bayesian optimization library on a set of challenging benchmark functions.

title: An adaptive wavelet-based PINN for problems with localized high-magnitude source
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应小波PINN方法可解决局部高源项导致的损失不平衡问题，对生物力学FEA代理建模中的多尺度问题具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on PDE solution accuracy for localized sources without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在局部高源项问题中的谱偏差和损失不平衡。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应小波PINN，动态调整小波基函数并避免自动微分。
summary_zh.result: 在多个挑战性PDE上优于现有方法，处理损失比高达10^10:1。
summary_zh.validation: 通过瞬态热传导、泊松问题等数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome spectral bias and loss imbalance in PINNs when solving PDEs with localized high-magnitude source terms.
summary_en.method: An adaptive wavelet-based PINN (AW-PINN) dynamically adjusts wavelet basis functions and avoids automatic differentiation for faster training.
summary_en.result: AW-PINN consistently outperforms existing methods on challenging PDEs with extreme loss imbalances up to 10^10:1.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including transient heat conduction, localized Poisson, oscillatory flow, and Maxwell equations.

why_not_core: This is a clinical review of 3D-printed porous titanium cages for spinal fusion, not a study on LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 总结3D打印多孔钛椎间融合器的材料、生物力学和临床进展
summary_zh.method: 综述文献，分析多孔结构对弹性模量、应力遮挡和骨整合的影响
summary_zh.result: 3D打印多孔钛融合器可降低弹性模量、减少应力遮挡，早期临床融合率高
summary_zh.validation: 引用临床前和早期临床研究，但缺乏系统实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To review the material properties, biomechanical rationale, and clinical outcomes of 3D-printed porous titanium interbody cages for lumbar fusion.
summary_en.method: Literature review summarizing the effects of porous architecture on elastic modulus, stress shielding, and osseointegration.
summary_en.result: 3D-printed porous titanium cages achieve lower elastic modulus, reduced stress shielding, and high early fusion rates.
summary_en.validation: Preclinical and early clinical studies are cited, but no original experimental validation is performed.

title: Parallel 3D Bioprinting on SLIPS‐Microarrays

why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on hardware and surface chemistry for parallel fabrication.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现高通量3D生物打印，克服串行制造的速度瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 集成DLP立体光刻与SLIPS液滴微阵列，实现并行打印。
summary_zh.result: 10分钟内制造数十至数百个细胞负载水凝胶结构，保持细胞活性和分隔。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活性和分隔实验验证打印效果。

summary_en.motivation: To enable high-throughput screening by parallelizing 3D bioprinting, overcoming the speed limitations of serial fabrication.
summary_en.method: Integrates Digital Light Processing stereolithography with a wettability-patterned slippery liquid-infused porous surface droplet microarray for parallel fabrication.
summary_en.result: Tens to hundreds of cell-laden GelMA structures are fabricated within 10 minutes while preserving cell viability and compartmentalization.
summary_en.validation: Cell viability and compartmentalization assays confirm the functionality of the printed arrays.

title: Conductive and Antioxidant Silk‐Polyaniline‐Gelatin Bioink for DLP 3D Printing: Enhancing Facial Nerve Regeneration and Myelination

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物墨水和DLP打印，但未使用AI技术，与AI生物打印方向不直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it include experimental validation of an AI model or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发兼具导电和抗氧化性能的生物墨水用于神经修复。
summary_zh.method: 将聚苯胺衍生物与明胶和丝素蛋白复合，制备可DLP打印的导电抗氧化生物墨水。
summary_zh.result: 该生物墨水能缓解氧化应激，促进施万细胞与神经元相互作用，增强髓鞘形成。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证生物相容性和神经修复效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a bioink with both conductivity and antioxidant properties for fabricating nerve guidance conduits.
summary_en.method: A composite bioink (SMPG) was formulated by integrating poly-3-amino-4-methoxybenzoic acid-gelatin with methacrylated silk fibroin, enabling DLP printing without photoabsorbers.
summary_en.result: The SMPG bioink alleviated macrophage oxidative stress, modulated Schwann cell-neuron interactions, and promoted myelination in vitro.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays demonstrated biocompatibility and functional nerve regeneration capabilities.

title: Shearlet Neural Operators for Anisotropic-Shock-Dominated and Multi-scale parametric partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的剪切波神经算子（SNO）在解决各向异性和间断主导的PDE问题上优于FNO，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中处理应力集中等特征。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomedical or implant-related FEA validation, nor does it address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有傅里叶神经算子难以有效处理各向异性和间断特征。
summary_zh.method: 提出剪切波神经算子，用剪切波变换替代傅里叶变换以增强方向性和局部性。
summary_zh.result: 在七个基准PDE族上，SNO在精度和特征保真度上一致优于FNO。
summary_zh.validation: 通过七个基准PDE族（包括各向异性对流、扩散、非线性守恒律等）进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Fourier Neural Operators struggle to resolve anisotropic structures and sharp gradients in shock-dominated PDEs due to global Fourier representations.
summary_en.method: The Shearlet Neural Operator replaces the Fourier transform with a shearlet-based representation to provide directional, multiscale, and localized atoms for learning PDE solution operators.
summary_en.result: Across seven benchmark PDE families, SNO consistently outperforms FNO baselines in predictive accuracy and feature fidelity, especially for anisotropic and discontinuity-dominated settings.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on seven PDE families including anisotropic advection, diffusion, and nonlinear conservation laws with various shock structures.

title: Conditional Flow Matching for Probabilistic Downscaling of Maximum 3-day Snowfall in Alaska
relevance_to_user: 该论文的生成式模型方法可用于生物力学设计中的代理建模，但应用领域为气候降尺度，非植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no FEA surrogate, no structural constraints or uncertainty quantification in biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 气候模型分辨率低，动力降尺度计算成本高，无法生成大集合。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有高斯过程序贯设计方法积分计算困难，缺乏高效闭式解。
summary_zh.method: 利用Hilbert空间截断特征基实现IMSE采集函数的闭式评估。
summary_zh.result: 在γ稳定化数值实验中，预测误差和计算时间均显著低于现有基准。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准实验验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Gaussian process sequential design methods suffer from intractable integrals for the IMSE acquisition function, limiting computational efficiency.
summary_en.method: A Hilbert space Gaussian process approximation is proposed, enabling closed-form evaluation of the IMSE acquisition function via a truncated eigenbasis representation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves substantially lower prediction error and reduced computation time compared to existing benchmarks in γ-stabilizing numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a series of numerical benchmark experiments demonstrating accuracy and computational gains.

title: Droplet-LNO: Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operators for Accurate Prediction of Droplet Spreading Dynamics on Complex Surfaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子，用于高效预测液滴扩散动力学，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical structural FEA problem; it focuses on fluid dynamics of droplet spreading.

summary_zh.motivation: 液滴扩散的CFD模拟耗时过长，需要高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息拉普拉斯神经算子(PI-LNO)，以拉普拉斯积分变换为学习基函数。
summary_zh.result: PI-LNO在预测精度上优于UNet、DeepONet等五种方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于多表面CFD数据，与五种基线方法进行数值基准对比。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate CFD simulations of droplet spreading are computationally prohibitive, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: A Physics-Informed Laplace Neural Operator (PI-LNO) is introduced, using the Laplace integral transform as a learned physics-informed functional basis.
summary_en.result: PI-LNO outperforms five state-of-the-art methods (UNet, UNet-AM, DeepONet, PI-UNet, LNO) in predicting droplet spreading dynamics.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmarks on multi-surface CFD data with contact angles ranging from 20° to 160°.

title: Data-Driven Surrogate Models for Agromaritime Applications: Finite Element-Neural Network Integration
relevance_to_user: 该论文将有限元与神经网络结合构建代理模型，方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的高效仿真。
why_not_core: This paper applies surrogate modeling to agromaritime nutrient transport, not to implant biomechanics or structural FEA, and lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PDE模型在实时预测中可扩展性差，需高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 结合有限元求解器生成数据，用POD降维和神经网络映射参数到系数。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型速度提升956倍，平均相对L2误差15%，适用于快速场景筛选。
summary_zh.validation: 在简化扩散-反应模型上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PDE-based models for nutrient transport lack scalability and real-time adaptability, motivating a hybrid surrogate approach.
summary_en.method: A hybrid method combines finite element discretization to generate training data, proper orthogonal decomposition for dimensionality reduction, and a neural network to map input parameters to reduced coefficients.
summary_en.result: The neural network surrogate achieves a 956x speed-up over the FEM solver with a mean relative L2 error of 15%, enabling rapid scenario screening.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a simplified steady-state diffusion-reaction model via numerical experiments.

title: Bioactive glass coating endows porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds with enhanced interfacial activity and biocompatibility for bone tissue engineering

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the bio-inertness of Ti6Al4V scaffolds for improved bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: Diamond lattice Ti6Al4V scaffolds were fabricated by LPBF and coated with bioactive glass via low-temperature plasma spraying.
summary_en.result: The coating exhibited strong adhesion, prevented ion leaching, and enhanced cell proliferation and osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and mechanical bond strength tests.

why_not_core: This paper uses extrusion-based 3D printing (not LPBF), focuses on cranial bone regeneration (not hip implant), and lacks mechanical testing (fatigue, stiffness matching) or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PEEK颅骨修复中生物惰性和骨整合不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 3D打印仿生PEEK/HA支架，模拟天然骨结构和成分
summary_zh.result: 支架促进BMSCs增殖和成骨分化，在大鼠颅骨缺损模型中诱导骨再生
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内大鼠颅骨缺损模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the bioinertness and poor osseointegration of PEEK in cranial defect repair by mimicking natural bone structure and composition.
summary_en.method: A biomimetic PEEK/HA scaffold with stochastic lattice structure was fabricated via extrusion-based 3D printing.
summary_en.result: The scaffold promoted BMSC proliferation and osteogenic differentiation, and induced bone regeneration in a rat critical-sized cranial defect model.
summary_en.validation: In vitro co-culture with BMSCs and in vivo rat cranial defect model.

title: Osseointegration dynamics of mandibular patient-specific implants: A mechanoregulation-based finite element study.
first_author_affiliation: PhD Candidate, Department of Biomedical Engineering, Science and Research Branch, Islamic Azad University, Tehran, Iran.

corresponding_authors.name: Farzam Farahmand
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Professor, Mechanical Engineering Department, Sharif University of Technology, Tehran, Iran. Electronic address: farahmand@sharif.edu.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了下颌骨植入体的骨整合动力学，其基于力学调控的有限元方法可迁移至髋关节植入物的应力遮挡和微动分析。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on mandibular reconstruction, not hip implant or femoral stem, and does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 下颌骨重建中骨整合的动态过程缺乏研究，现有工作多关注初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 结合体素有限元模型与力学调控算法，模拟界面组织成熟过程。
summary_zh.result: 骨整合从固定翼远端向近端发展，40周模式与1年QCT骨密度分布中度相关。
summary_zh.validation: 与术后1年定量CT骨密度数据进行元素级Spearman相关分析。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the time-dependent progression of osseointegration in mandibular patient-specific implants, which has been underexplored compared to initial mechanical stability.
summary_en.method: A voxel-based finite element model combined with a mechanoregulation algorithm simulated interfacial tissue maturation over multiple time steps using local micromotion and gap as stimuli.
summary_en.result: Osseointegration progressed from distal to proximal, covering over 80% of the fixation wing area by 36 weeks, and the 40-week pattern showed moderate positive correlation with 1-year QCT-derived BMD.
summary_en.validation: The predicted osseointegration pattern was validated against 1-year postoperative periprosthetic bone mineral density from quantitative computed tomography using element-wise Spearman correlation.

title: Mapping-based Hard-constrained Physics-Informed Neural Networks for unbounded wave problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的硬约束物理信息神经网络和坐标映射技术可迁移至生物力学领域的声波或弹性波模拟，但未涉及植入物设计或应力分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate modeling for structural optimization; it focuses on wave propagation in unbounded domains with no biomedical or design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效精确求解无界波动问题，避免截断误差和采样困难
summary_zh.method: 提出坐标映射将无限域压缩至有限域，设计硬约束网络自动满足边界与辐射条件
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明算法在声学和弹性动力学场景中高效准确
summary_zh.validation: 通过声辐射、散射及弹性动力学算例验证算法性能

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently and accurately solve unbounded wave problems while avoiding truncation errors and sampling difficulties inherent in standard PINNs.
summary_en.method: A coordinate mapping technique compactifies the infinite domain into a finite computational space, and a physics-based hard-constrained network structure automatically satisfies inner boundary and far-field radiation conditions.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples in acoustic radiation, scattering, and elastic dynamics demonstrate the algorithm's efficiency and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarks including various wave propagation scenarios.

title: Debiased neural operators for estimating functionals
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于神经算子输出泛函的无偏估计方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经算子预测完整轨迹成本高，实际只需标量泛函，直接估计有偏。
summary_zh.method: 提出DOPE框架，用Neyman正交估计和Riesz回归消除偏差。
summary_zh.result: 相比朴素估计，DOPE在多种数值实验中显著降低偏差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准实验验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators are expensive for full trajectory prediction, but many applications only require scalar functionals; naive plug-in estimation suffers from first-order bias.
summary_en.method: We propose DOPE, a semiparametric estimator using Neyman-orthogonal one-step correction and Riesz regression to debias functional estimates from neural operators.
summary_en.result: DOPE significantly reduces bias compared to naive plug-in estimation across various numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple numerical benchmark problems involving functionals of PDE solutions.

title: Uncertainty-aware phase fraction prediction and active-learning-guided out-of-domain discovery of refractory multi-principal element alloys
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不确定性感知主动学习方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的约束优化与设计空间探索。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on phase fraction prediction in alloy design, not on FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or structural optimization with constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有机器学习预测合金相分数忽略不确定性，影响设计可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 使用混合密度网络预测相分数并量化偶然不确定性，结合主动学习发现新合金。
summary_zh.result: 高预测精度且不确定性校准良好，主动学习有效发现含新元素的目标相。
summary_zh.validation: 基于CALPHAD数据的数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing machine learning approaches for phase stability prediction neglect uncertainty, compromising robust alloy design.
summary_en.method: A deep learning framework using Mixture Density Networks predicts phase fractions and quantifies aleatoric uncertainty, combined with an active learning strategy for out-of-domain discovery.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves high predictive accuracy with well-calibrated uncertainty and successfully discovers novel alloys with target phases containing unseen elements.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on CALPHAD-derived numerical benchmarks without experimental confirmation.
