relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了钛合金表面多孔涂层对骨整合和机械转导的影响，与AM生物医学方向中的骨植入物表面改性相关。
why_not_core: This paper uses micro-arc oxidation (MAO) coating, not LPBF additive manufacturing, and does not include fatigue testing or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究钛合金表面多孔涂层对骨再生和机械转导的调控机制。
summary_zh.method: 通过微弧氧化制备不同粗糙度的仿生涂层，并进行细胞和动物实验。
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率35.6%和粗糙度15.8 µm的涂层显著促进成骨分化和骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞实验、Micro-CT和组织学分析验证涂层效果。

summary_en.motivation: To elucidate the mechanism by which micro-arc oxidation coatings with varying surface roughness regulate osteogenic differentiation and mechanotransduction on titanium alloy implants.
summary_en.method: Biomimetic hydroxyapatite-containing coatings with different porosities and roughness were fabricated via MAO, and their effects on cell behavior and in vivo osseointegration were evaluated.
summary_en.result: The coating with 35.6% porosity and 15.8 µm roughness significantly enhanced cell adhesion, proliferation, osteogenic differentiation, and bone-implant contact ratio.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays, micro-CT imaging, histological analysis, and bond strength testing were performed.

title: Optimal Linear Interpolation under Differential Information: application to the prediction of perfect flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于线性PDE约束的克里金插值方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling beyond linear PDEs, no uncertainty quantification beyond Kriging variance.

summary_zh.motivation: 稀疏观测下高效近似PDE解，避免大量训练数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出共克里金和拉格朗日乘子两种线性PDE约束插值方法。
summary_zh.result: 拉格朗日乘子法计算高效但牺牲严格插值，共克里金更精确但计算成本高。
summary_zh.validation: 在常微分方程、二维调和PDE和圆柱绕流案例上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently approximate PDE solutions from sparse observations without requiring large training datasets.
summary_en.method: Two approaches are proposed: collocated co-Kriging with differential observations and constrained Kriging via Lagrangian multipliers enforcing linear PDE constraints at prediction points.
summary_en.result: The Lagrangian multiplier approach offers computational efficiency at the cost of exact interpolation, while co-Kriging maintains strict interpolation but is more expensive.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on ODEs, 2D harmonic PDEs, and perfect flow around a cylinder demonstrate the trade-off.

title: Learning the Riccati solution operator for time-varying LQR via Deep Operator Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的算子学习方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 避免重复求解微分Riccati方程，降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 用DeepONet学习系统参数到Riccati轨迹的映射。
summary_zh.result: 方法在时变LQR问题上精度高、泛化强，计算加速显著。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证了精度与泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: To replace repeated numerical integration of differential Riccati equations in finite-horizon LQR problems with a learned operator surrogate.
summary_en.method: A DeepONet-based framework is designed to approximate the solution operator mapping time-dependent system parameters to Riccati trajectories, with a progressive learning strategy for scalability.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves high accuracy and strong generalization across time-invariant and time-varying LQR problems, delivering substantial computational speedups.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on LQR benchmarks validate accuracy, generalization, and computational efficiency.

title: Femoral component collar and calcar contact during total hip arthroplasty: gap incidence, subsidence, and biomechanical testing - a scoping review
first_author_affiliation: Mayo Clinic

corresponding_authors.name: Sandeep Yanamala
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Mayo Clinic

relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了股骨柄领与股骨距接触间隙对全髋关节置换术后生物力学的影响，直接涉及应力遮挡和微动，但缺乏具体数值和患者特异性建模。
why_not_core: This is a scoping review, not a primary study; it does not provide new finite element simulations, patient-specific models, or quantitative stress/micromotion data in Gruen zones.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述股骨柄领与股骨距接触间隙对THA术后稳定性的影响
summary_zh.method: 遵循PRISMA指南进行系统文献检索和筛选
summary_zh.result: 间隙发生率18.7%-53.9%，多数随时间闭合，但持续间隙导致下沉增加
summary_zh.validation: 纳入11篇研究，包括临床和有限元分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the incidence and biomechanical implications of collar-calcar gap after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A PRISMA scoping review was performed across four databases with dual independent screening.
summary_en.result: Postoperative collar-calcar gap incidence ranged from 18.7% to 53.9%, with most gaps closing over time, but persistent gaps led to increased subsidence and biomechanical behavior similar to collarless stems.
summary_en.validation: The review included 11 studies comprising clinical and finite element analyses.

title: Faster by Design: Interactive Aerodynamics via Neural Surrogates Trained on Expert-Validated CFD
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的GIST神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on aerodynamics surrogate modeling without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真CFD计算成本高昂，限制赛车空气动力学设计空间探索。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于图神经算子的GIST模型，利用专家验证的RANS数据集进行训练。
summary_zh.result: GIST在复杂几何上达到高精度，支持交互式设计空间探索。
summary_zh.validation: 通过公开基准和赛车数据集验证，与专家CFD结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity CFD is prohibitively expensive for extensive design space exploration in motorsport aerodynamics.
summary_en.method: A graph-based neural operator, GIST, is proposed and trained on a high-fidelity RANS dataset validated by aerodynamics experts.
summary_en.result: GIST achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on complex geometries, enabling interactive design-space exploration.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on public benchmarks and a proprietary race-car dataset, with expert validation of CFD results.

title: DeepRitzSplit Neural Operator for Phase-Field Models via Energy Splitting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可加速偏微分方程求解，但其应用于凝固相场模型而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it is validated on solidification phase-field problems only.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速相场模型的多尺度非线性模拟计算
summary_zh.method: 提出基于能量分裂和Deep Ritz的神经算子架构RDNO
summary_zh.result: 物理信息训练提升了分布外泛化能力，推理速度快于谱方法
summary_zh.validation: 对各向同性Allen-Cahn和各向异性枝晶生长进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate multi-scale and nonlinear simulations of phase-field models by developing a neural operator surrogate.
summary_en.method: A novel neural operator, RDNO, is trained using a Deep Ritz method with an energy-splitting variational formulation to enforce energy dissipation.
summary_en.result: The physics-informed approach achieves better generalization under out-of-distribution conditions and faster inference than traditional Fourier spectral methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on isotropic Allen-Cahn equation and anisotropic dendritic growth simulations.

title: Collaborative Contextual Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了协同上下文贝叶斯优化框架，可迁移到植入物设计优化中FEA仿真采样效率提升问题。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modelling, no biomechanics/implant design context, and validation on hot rolling rather than biomedical optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升上下文贝叶斯优化的效率，通过多客户端协作
summary_zh.method: 提出CCBO框架，支持在线协作与离线初始化，含隐私机制
summary_zh.result: 实现亚线性遗憾界限，在仿真与热轧应用中优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值仿真与真实热轧工业应用验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the sample efficiency of contextual Bayesian optimization in multi-client scenarios with heterogeneous tasks.
summary_en.method: A collaborative contextual Bayesian optimization framework that enables joint optimization across clients with controllable contexts and optional privacy preservation.
summary_en.result: The proposed CCBO achieves sublinear regret bounds and outperforms existing methods in both simulations and a real-world hot rolling application.
summary_en.validation: Validation through extensive simulations and a real-world hot rolling process optimization.

title: Neural Adjoint Method for Meta-optics: Accelerating Volumetric Inverse Design via Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用傅里叶神经算子加速电磁仿真中的伴随梯度计算，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No biomedical or implant context, no contact mechanics or stress shielding, no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速元光学结构的高维逆设计，减少全波仿真计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出神经伴随方法，用傅里叶神经算子预测三维伴随梯度场。
summary_zh.result: 设计时间从数小时降至数秒，在分光、聚焦和波导任务上验证。
summary_zh.validation: 基于FDTD仿真数据集，在三个光学任务上评估预测精度。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the high-dimensional inverse design of meta-optical structures by reducing the computational cost of iterative full-wave simulations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a neural adjoint method that uses a Fourier Neural Operator to predict 3D adjoint gradient fields from voxelized permittivity volumes.
summary_en.result: Design time is reduced from hours to seconds, validated on spectral sorting, achromatic focusing, and waveguide mode conversion tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a curated dataset of paired forward/adjoint FDTD simulations across three optical design tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决生物打印中参数与性能的非线性关系，避免试错成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于AI辅助模拟，集成仿真数据预测力学与几何稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the highly nonlinear relationships between bioprinting parameters, material properties, and cell function, reducing trial-and-error costs.
summary_en.method: An AI-assisted simulation approach integrating computer-generated data to predict mechanical strength, geometric stability, and cellular constraints.
summary_en.result: The method enables predictive assessment of the impact of printing parameters and cross-linking strategies on biomechanical and functional outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is limited to simulation-based analysis without experimental confirmation.

title: Uncertainty Quantification in PINNs for Turbulent Flows: Bayesian Inference and Repulsive Ensembles
relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化方法应用于PINNs，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on turbulent flows and does not address implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINNs缺乏不确定性量化，难以用于湍流逆问题。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯PINNs、MC Dropout和排斥集成进行不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 贝叶斯PINNs提供最一致的不确定性估计，排斥集成计算高效。
summary_zh.validation: 在Van der Pol振荡器和圆柱绕流数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Deterministic PINNs lack epistemic uncertainty quantification, which is critical for ill-posed inverse problems in turbulence modeling.
summary_en.method: Probabilistic PINNs are developed using Bayesian inference with Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, Monte Carlo dropout, and repulsive deep ensembles to quantify uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Bayesian PINNs yield the most consistent uncertainty estimates, while repulsive ensembles offer a computationally efficient alternative with competitive accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Methods are validated on the Van der Pol oscillator and turbulent flow past a circular cylinder at Re=3,900 and Re=10,000 using DNS and experimental data.

title: Time-zero stability of uncemented standard versus intermediate revision stems after extended trochanteric osteotomy (ETO): a biomechanical study.

first_author_affiliation: Department of Hip and Knee Surgery, Schulthess-Klinik, Zurich, Switzerland. jakob.hax@kws.ch.; Faculty of Medicine, University of Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland. jakob.hax@kws.ch.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接评估了髋关节假体（标准柄与翻修柄）在股骨截骨术后的初始稳定性，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨-假体界面的详细力学分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, does not report micromotion values with contact/friction modeling, and does not compare intact vs implanted femur.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较标准柄与翻修柄在股骨截骨术后无固定情况下的初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 使用合成股骨模型进行轴向和扭转循环加载及破坏测试。
summary_zh.result: 翻修柄轴向刚度及破坏载荷更高，扭转稳定性无显著差异。
summary_zh.validation: 机械测试验证，采用SYNBONE®股骨模型。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the time-zero primary stability of standard versus intermediate revision femoral stems in a worst-case scenario of unrepaired extended trochanteric osteotomy.
summary_en.method: Biomechanical testing on SYNBONE® femurs with axial and torsional cyclic loading followed by failure testing.
summary_en.result: The revision stem exhibited higher axial stiffness and failure load, while torsional stability was comparable between stem types.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing on synthetic bone models with standardized loading protocols.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Learnable Loss Balancing and Transfer Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应损失平衡和迁移学习PINN方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no multi-objective constrained optimization, no uncertainty quantification beyond loss weighting.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN中物理与数据损失权重手动调节问题
summary_zh.method: 引入可学习混合神经元自适应平衡损失，结合迁移学习
summary_zh.result: 仅用87个CFD数据点实现<8%预测误差
summary_zh.validation: 液金属微型散热器热传导模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome manual tuning of physics-data loss weights in PINNs under data scarcity.
summary_en.method: A learnable blending neuron adaptively balances physics and data losses based on uncertainties, combined with transfer learning.
summary_en.result: Achieves <8% error on liquid-metal heat sink prediction using only 87 CFD data points.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a heat transfer simulation case with limited CFD data.

title: PINNACLE: An Open-Source Computational Framework for Classical and Quantum PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该框架提供了PINN的基准测试和训练策略，可迁移到生物力学代理建模中。
why_not_core: No application to implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate modeling; benchmarks are on fluid dynamics and wave propagation, not solid mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 提供统一的PINN框架以系统评估训练策略和架构选择。
summary_zh.method: 开发模块化框架，集成多种训练增强和混合量子-经典架构。
summary_zh.result: 量化了不同策略对收敛、精度和计算成本的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 在1D守恒律、不可压缩流和电磁波基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a unified open-source framework for systematic evaluation of PINN training strategies and architectural choices.
summary_en.method: Developed a modular framework integrating Fourier features, loss balancing, curriculum training, and hybrid quantum-classical extensions.
summary_en.result: Quantified the impact of various strategies on convergence, accuracy, and computational cost, showing high sensitivity and cost relative to classical solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark problems including 1D hyperbolic conservation laws, incompressible flows, and electromagnetic wave propagation.

title: Neuroscience Inspired Graph Operators Towards Edge-Deployable Virtual Sensing for Irregular Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种面向不规则几何的节能神经算子，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的稀疏到稠密场重建。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现边缘部署下不规则几何的实时虚拟传感，降低能耗。
summary_zh.method: 提出可变脉冲图神经算子，融合谱-空间卷积与脉冲神经元及能量-误差平衡损失。
summary_zh.result: 在低脉冲率下达到约1%的重建误差，接近非脉冲基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上对比非脉冲基线，验证精度与能耗权衡。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time virtual sensing on irregular geometries under strict edge-device energy constraints.
summary_en.method: A Variable Spiking Graph Neural Operator (VS-GNO) integrating spectral-spatial convolutions, a variable spiking neuron, and an energy-error balance loss.
summary_en.result: VS-GNO achieves reconstruction errors of 0.71% and 1.04% with 15% and 24.5% average spiking, respectively, approaching the non-spiking baseline of 0.4%.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on irregular geometries comparing error and spiking rate against a non-spiking baseline.

title: Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimization via Adaptive \varepsilon-Constraints Decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至植入物多目标优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或有限元验证。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics context, no implant design application.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有多目标贝叶斯优化方法在Pareto前沿覆盖和约束处理上不足。
summary_zh.method: 提出STAGE-BO，通过自适应ε约束分解将问题转化为序列约束子问题。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准上实现了更均匀的Pareto覆盖和竞争性的超体积性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准多目标优化基准函数上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-objective Bayesian optimization methods suffer from poor Pareto front coverage and limited scalability with constraints.
summary_en.method: STAGE-BO sequentially targets geometric gaps in the approximate Pareto front by converting them into inequality constraints and solving via constrained expected improvement.
summary_en.result: The method achieves uniform Pareto coverage and competitive hypervolume performance on synthetic and real-world benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard multi-objective optimization benchmark functions.

title: Late Fusion Neural Operators for Extrapolation Across Parameter Space in Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种解耦状态与参数学习的神经算子架构，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的参数外推问题。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; only tested on canonical PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决神经算子在参数空间外推时因状态与参数纠缠导致的泛化差问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出Late Fusion架构，用神经算子学习状态动力学，用稀疏回归融合参数信息。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准PDE上，域内和域外RMSE分别降低72.9%和71.8%。
summary_zh.validation: 在advection、Burgers、反应扩散方程等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the poor generalization of neural operators under distribution shift caused by entangled state and parameter representations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Late Fusion Neural Operator that disentangles state dynamics learning via neural operators and parameter incorporation via sparse regression.
summary_en.result: Achieves 72.9% in-domain and 71.8% out-domain RMSE reduction on four benchmark PDEs compared to the second-best method.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including advection, Burgers, and 1D/2D reaction-diffusion equations.

title: Frenetic Cat-inspired Particle Optimization: a Markov state-switching hybrid swarm optimizer with application to cardiac digital twinning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合群智能优化器，可用于心脏数字孪生校准，其方法可迁移至生物打印中的工艺参数优化或数字孪生构建。

summary_zh.method: 提出FCPO混合群智能算法，结合马尔可夫状态切换和多种搜索算子。

summary_zh.validation: 通过CEC2022函数测试和心脏数字孪生校准任务验证。

summary_en.motivation: To design an effective optimizer under tight evaluation budgets for expensive black-box problems such as cardiac digital twinning.
summary_en.method: Proposes Frenetic Cat-inspired Particle Optimization (FCPO), a hybrid swarm method with a Markov state-switching controller that schedules exploration and refinement operators.
summary_en.result: FCPO achieves the lowest mean runtime on CEC2022 benchmarks and reaches target ECG fidelity within ~40 iterations in a ventricular activation digital twin calibration task.
summary_en.validation: Validated on five CEC2022 benchmark functions and a cardiac digital twin calibration task with physiological plausibility checks.

title: FLARE: A Data-Efficient Surrogate for Predicting Displacement Fields in Directed Energy Deposition

summary_en.motivation: Thermo-mechanical simulations in DED are computationally expensive, hindering design iteration and process optimization.

summary_en.result: The method achieves superior accuracy on DED displacement predictions for both in-distribution and extrapolation tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a numerical benchmark dataset generated from an open-source finite element DED simulation workflow.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of different gradient strategies on the compressive properties of lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Gradient lattice structures with varying strut diameter and cell size gradients were designed, fabricated via SLM, and tested under quasi-static compression combined with finite element simulation.

title: xFODE+: Explainable Type-2 Fuzzy Additive ODEs for Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种可解释的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的预测区间生成。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有模糊ODE模型缺乏可解释性，需要同时提供预测区间和可解释状态。
summary_zh.method: 提出可解释的2型模糊加性ODE模型，通过区间2型模糊逻辑系统约束隶属函数实现局部透明。
summary_zh.result: 在基准系统辨识数据集上，模型在预测区间质量和精度上与FODE相当，同时提供可解释性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Fuzzy ODE models lack interpretability while providing prediction intervals, motivating a model that balances accuracy, UQ, and transparency.
summary_en.method: The xFODE+ model uses Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Logic Systems with constrained membership functions to construct additive ODE states and prediction intervals, trained with a composite loss.
summary_en.result: On benchmark SysID datasets, xFODE+ achieves comparable prediction interval quality and accuracy to FODE while offering interpretability.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard system identification datasets.

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Pouch Cell Temperature Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了物理信息机器学习在热传导代理建模中的应用，其方法可迁移至植入物生物力学中的有限元代理建模。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate temperature estimation in pouch cells is computationally expensive via finite element simulations, motivating efficient surrogate models.

summary_en.result: The PIML model achieves 49.1% reduction in mean squared error and faster convergence compared to purely data-driven models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a dataset of varying cooling channel geometries and independent test cases.

title: Migration patterns of uncemented femoral stems in hip replacement: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical radiostereometric analysis cohort studies

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review and meta-analyze migration patterns of uncemented femoral stems using radiostereometric analysis studies.
summary_en.method: A meta-analysis of 73 RSA studies (120 cohorts, 2,970 stems) was performed to pool subsidence and retroversion data at multiple time points.

title: Mechanobiological design strategy for additively manufacturable tibial ankle implant for enhanced biomechanical and osseointegration performance: A finite element and machine learning approach.
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. Part H, Journal of engineering in medicine
first_author_affiliation: Biomechanics Research Laboratory, School of Mechanical & Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, India.; Laboratoire Jean Alexandre Dieudonné UMR CNRS 7351, Université Côte d'Azur, Nice, France.

corresponding_authors.name: Rajesh Ghosh
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Biomechanics Research Laboratory, School of Mechanical & Materials Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, India.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过有限元和机器学习方法优化多孔踝关节植入物设计以减少应力遮挡并促进骨整合，与用户关于多孔结构、应力遮挡和骨整合的研究方向直接相关。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on ankle implants rather than hip implants, and lacks LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (fatigue or static), and surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 踝关节假体无菌性松动与骨整合不足，需优化多孔结构设计。
summary_zh.method: 宏微观有限元结合人工神经网络预测骨长入，筛选菱形十二面体多孔结构。
summary_zh.result: PRDTI70假体在减少应力遮挡和最大化骨形成方面表现最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元数据集训练和验证神经网络模型。

summary_en.motivation: Aseptic loosening due to insufficient osseointegration drives the need to optimize porous architecture in tibial ankle implants.
summary_en.method: Macro-micro finite element analysis combined with artificial neural network models to predict bone ingrowth for four rhombic dodecahedron porous designs.
summary_en.result: The PRDTI70 implant achieved the best balance between reduced stress shielding and enhanced bone formation.
summary_en.validation: Neural network models were trained and validated on a finite element-derived dataset without experimental testing.

title: Influence of Immediate Versus Delayed Loading on Peri-Implant Bone Healing: A Comparative FEA Study of Titanium Threaded and Scaffold Dental Implants.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanics, Mathematics and Management, Polytechnic University of Bari, 70125 Bari, Italy.

corresponding_authors.name: Bartolomeo Trentadue
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanics, Mathematics and Management, Polytechnic University of Bari, 70125 Bari, Italy.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔种植体在即刻负载下的应力分布和骨愈合，与用户关注的LPBF多孔植入物应力遮挡和力学匹配方向相关，但未涉及LPBF制造和疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, or fatigue analysis; it is purely a finite element simulation without experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较即刻与延迟负载对牙种植体周围骨愈合的影响。
summary_zh.method: 建立三维有限元模型，模拟螺纹和多孔种植体在两种负载条件下的力学响应。
summary_zh.result: 多孔种植体降低皮质骨应力，增加愈伤组织刺激，促进骨成熟。
summary_zh.validation: 仅通过有限元仿真验证，无实验数据。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the biomechanical and mechanobiological effects of immediate versus delayed loading on peri-implant bone healing for threaded and porous dental implants.
summary_en.method: A three-dimensional poroelastic finite element model of a bone block with a peri-implant callus was developed in ABAQUS, simulating immediate and delayed loading via frictional and tied interfaces.
summary_en.result: The porous implant reduced cortical bone stress and increased callus stimulation, promoting higher fractions of mature bone under immediate loading.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely computational, with no experimental or clinical validation.

title: High‐Resolution and Real‐Time In Situ Generation of Cellular Spheroids by Laser‐Assisted Bioprinting for Guided Microvascularization

corresponding_authors.affiliation: INSERM BioTis – Tissue Bioengineering Laboratory Université de Bordeaux  Bordeaux France

corresponding_authors.name: Hugo Oliveira
corresponding_authors.affiliation: INSERM BioTis – Tissue Bioengineering Laboratory Université de Bordeaux  Bordeaux France

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及激光辅助生物打印，但未集成AI/ML方法，与AI生物打印方向相关性有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is purely a laser-assisted bioprinting technique without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有生物打印技术难以达到生理水平的细胞密度。
summary_zh.method: 提出微注射激光辅助生物打印（MI-LAB），在打印过程中动态生成细胞聚集体。
summary_zh.result: 实现了30微米特征尺寸和1亿细胞/mL的局部浓度，并引导微血管网络形成。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外构建预血管化组织，验证了血管生成和内皮标志物表达。

summary_en.motivation: Replicating native cellular density in bioprinted tissues remains a critical challenge due to low local concentrations in conventional techniques.
summary_en.method: Micro-Injection Laser-Assisted Bioprinting (MI-LAB) dynamically generates cellular aggregates during printing, achieving micrometer-scale deposition precision.
summary_en.result: MI-LAB produces features as small as 30 µm with local cell concentrations up to 100 million cells/mL, enabling guided vasculogenic sprouting in prevascularized constructs.
summary_en.validation: In vitro fabrication of prevascularized constructs using HUVEC aggregates in GelMA/ColMA matrix confirmed endothelial marker expression and microvascular network maturation.

title: A Mechanically Adaptive Titanium Scaffold With a Lattice-Modulated Piezocatalytic Coating for Infection Treatment and Bone Regeneration.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: College of Biomedical Engineering, Sichuan University, Chengdu, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛合金支架的力学适应性设计，但未聚焦于应力遮挡或疲劳性能，且缺乏LPBF制造细节。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication details, no fatigue testing, no stress shielding quantification, and no as-built surface morphology characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决植入物感染与骨再生协同难题
summary_zh.method: 制备负泊松比钛支架并涂覆掺锶铌酸钾钠压电涂层
summary_zh.result: 超声触发压电催化抗菌，同时促进骨整合与再生
summary_zh.validation: 兔股骨髁感染骨缺损模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the clinical challenge of implant-associated infections while supporting bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: A mechanically adaptive auxetic titanium scaffold was fabricated and coated with a strontium-doped potassium sodium niobate piezoelectric coating.
summary_en.result: Ultrasound-triggered piezocatalysis achieved antibacterial efficacy, while Sr enhanced osseointegration and bone regeneration.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rabbit femoral condyle infected bone defect model confirmed infection suppression and improved bone healing.

title: Auxiliary Finite-Difference Residual-Gradient Regularization for PINNs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种辅助有限差分残差梯度正则化方法，可提高PINN在热传导问题中的精度，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no FEA surrogate for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN在特定物理量（如边界通量）上的预测精度。
summary_zh.method: 在PINN损失中添加基于有限差分的残差梯度正则化项，不替代自动微分。
summary_zh.result: 在三维环形热传导基准中，外壁通量和边界条件误差显著降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Poisson和三维热传导数值基准验证，与基线PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: To improve PINN accuracy on application-specific quantities like boundary flux without replacing the automatic-differentiation-based PDE residual.
summary_en.method: A hybrid PINN with an auxiliary finite-difference residual-gradient regularization term that penalizes gradients of the sampled residual field.
summary_en.result: In a 3D annular heat conduction benchmark, the shell regularizer reduced outer-wall BC RMSE from 1.22e-2 to 9.29e-4 and wall-flux RMSE from 9.21e-3 to 9.63e-4.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Poisson and 3D heat conduction numerical benchmarks with seed-averaged comparisons.

title: Additive manufacturing and heat treatment of zero poisson’s ratio self-expanding nitinol stents
first_author_affiliation: Center for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing, School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, 270 Joondalup Drive , Joondalup,  WA, 6027, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Farhana Yasmin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Advanced Materials and Manufacturing, School of Engineering, Edith Cowan University, 270 Joondalup Drive , Joondalup,  WA, 6027, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造和力学测试，但针对的是血管支架而非骨科植入物，未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on self-expanding stents for peripheral arterial disease, not on orthopedic implants, stress shielding, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决LPBF打印NiTi支架相变温度过高、超弹性不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制造零泊松比NiTi支架，并开发系统后热处理方案
summary_zh.result: 优化热处理后Af温度降至35°C，首次循环恢复率93.6%，十次后97.9%
summary_zh.validation: 通过循环三点压缩测试和相变温度测量验证超弹性性能

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of achieving body-temperature superelasticity in additively manufactured Nitinol stents with complex geometries.
summary_en.method: Zero Poisson's ratio Nitinol stents were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion and subjected to systematic post-heat treatment (solution annealing and aging) to tune phase transformation temperatures.
summary_en.result: Optimized heat treatment reduced the austenite finish temperature to 35°C, yielding 93.6% recovery in the first cycle and 97.9% after ten cycles in cyclic compression tests.
summary_en.validation: Cyclic three-point compression testing and differential scanning calorimetry were used to evaluate superelastic recovery and phase transformation temperatures.

title: Multi-objective optimisation of 3D-printed multilayer TPMS osteochondral scaffolds for enhanced mechanical and biological performance
first_author_affiliation: Nanyang Technological University

corresponding_authors.name: Fengyuan Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: University of Bristol

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔支架的力学优化，但针对骨软骨修复而非髋关节植入物，且未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not address hip implant stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on osteochondral scaffolds with static compression and permeability.

summary_zh.motivation: 骨软骨缺损修复需要平衡高孔隙率和足够强度的矛盾需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用RSM代理模型和NSGA-II算法优化多层TPMS支架的几何参数。
summary_zh.result: 优化后支架的力学和流体性能与模型预测吻合，且具有良好的细胞相容性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过3D打印制造、力学测试、流体评估和体外生物学实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Osteochondral repair requires scaffolds that balance high porosity with sufficient compressive strength, which is challenging due to conflicting design requirements.
summary_en.method: A multi-objective optimisation framework using response surface surrogate models and NSGA-II was developed to design multilayer TPMS scaffolds with independently tuned cartilage and bone zones.
summary_en.result: Optimised scaffolds showed good agreement between predicted and measured compressive modulus, porosity, and pore size, and exhibited excellent cytocompatibility in vitro.
summary_en.validation: Validation included 3D printing, mechanical compression tests, fluid permeability measurements, and in vitro cell culture assays.

title: Learning Parameterized Nonlinear Elasticity on Curved Surfaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络的参数化非线性弹性求解器，可推广到曲面结构，其方法可迁移到生物力学植入物的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on curved manifolds like viral capsids.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统曲面弹性求解器需针对每个参数重新计算，效率低
summary_zh.method: 用物理信息神经网络学习参数化非线性弹性，直接嵌入控制方程和边界条件
summary_zh.result: 单模型可预测连续参数空间内的弹性平衡，泛化到未训练参数组合
summary_zh.validation: 在球面单向错基准问题上与精确解和数值解对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Traditional solvers for nonlinear elasticity on curved surfaces require reinitialization for each parameter choice, limiting scalability.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is trained to enforce governing equations and boundary conditions, learning a continuous family of elastic equilibria across geometric and material parameters.
summary_en.result: The trained model accurately reproduces exact and numerical solutions for a benchmark problem, including parameter combinations not seen during training.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a one-dimensional single disclination on a spheroidal surface with known exact and numerical solutions.

title: Black-Box Optimization From Small Offline Datasets via Meta Learning with Synthetic Tasks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的元学习框架可解决小样本离线优化问题，有望迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 小样本离线优化中代理模型难以捕捉优化偏差。
summary_zh.method: 提出OptBias元学习框架，用高斯过程生成合成任务预训练优化偏差。
summary_zh.result: 在多种连续和离散基准上优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准离线优化基准上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Offline black-box optimization suffers from data scarcity, making it difficult for surrogate models to capture optimization bias.
summary_en.method: OptBias meta-learns a reusable optimization bias by training on synthetic tasks generated from a Gaussian process, then fine-tunes on the target small dataset.
summary_en.result: OptBias consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on diverse continuous and discrete offline optimization benchmarks in small data regimes.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard offline optimization tasks.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Conceptual illustration of gradient estimation error vs. fraction of training data on the Shekel-4D synthetic task. The surrogate is trained on 8,000 samples and evaluated on 2,000 test points; bars are colored red→green for higher→lower error. The gradient estimation error increases significantly in the small training data regime relative to the full (100 %) data.

title: Black-Box Optimization From Small Offline Datasets via Meta Learning with Synthetic Tasks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对小样本离线优化的元学习框架，可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理模型构建，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization with constraints, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 小样本离线优化中代理模型难以捕捉优化偏差
summary_zh.method: 通过高斯过程生成合成任务进行元学习，微调代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在连续和离散基准上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准离线优化基准上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Offline black-box optimization suffers from data scarcity, making it difficult for surrogate models to capture optimization bias.
summary_en.method: Proposes a meta-learning framework that learns optimization bias from synthetic tasks generated by a Gaussian process and fine-tunes on target small data.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on diverse continuous and discrete offline optimization benchmarks in small data regimes.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard offline optimization benchmarks with numerical comparisons.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Conceptual illustration of gradient estimation error vs. fraction of training data on the Shekel-4D synthetic task. The surrogate is trained on 8,000 samples and evaluated on 2,000 test points; bars are colored red→green for higher→lower error. The gradient estimation error increases significantly in the small training data regime relative to the full (100 %) data.

title: Tunable 3D‐Printed Static Mixers for Gradient Bioprinting With High Cell Viability
first_author_affiliation: Department For Functional Materials in Medicine and Dentistry Institute of Functional Materials and Biofabrication University of Würzburg and Key Lab Polymers for Medicine of the Bavarian Polymer Institute (BPI)  Würzburg Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Tomasz Jüngst
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department For Functional Materials in Medicine and Dentistry Institute of Functional Materials and Biofabrication University of Würzburg and Key Lab Polymers for Medicine of the Bavarian Polymer Institute (BPI)  Würzburg Germany

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及梯度生物打印的混合器设计，但未集成AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on hardware design and mixing performance evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法难以制造具有梯度结构和细胞高活性的组织工程支架。
summary_zh.method: 设计DLP打印的静态混合器，结合挤出生物打印制造梯度结构。
summary_zh.result: 障碍物设计混合效果优于正弦和商用混合器，细胞活性显著提高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞实验和纳米压痕验证混合性能和梯度刚度。

summary_en.motivation: Fabricating tissue-like structures with gradual transitions in properties and cell types remains challenging due to lack of suitable methods.
summary_en.method: A novel approach combining extrusion-based bioprinting with DLP-printed static mixers of sinusoidal and obstacle geometries to create gradient constructs.
summary_en.result: Obstacle-based mixers achieved superior mixing and significantly enhanced cell viability compared to commercial counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Mixing performance was evaluated using dyed alginate solutions, and biocompatibility was assessed with U87 and NIH3T3 cells; gradient stiffness was confirmed by nanoindentation.

title: Signal-Aware Conditional Diffusion Surrogates for Transonic Wing Pressure Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于扩散模型的代理模型方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on aerodynamic pressure prediction for wings, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate for stress/strain, or uncertainty quantification for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有代理模型在预测强非线性压力场时平滑了尖锐特征，需要高保真方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出信号感知条件扩散模型，利用主成分表示和时步依赖损失权重预测机翼表面压力。
summary_zh.result: 相比确定性基线，降低了平均绝对误差，改进了激波和间断面的重建。
summary_zh.validation: 在NASA CRM机翼数据集上数值验证，并与确定性基线对比。

summary_en.motivation: Deterministic surrogate models smooth sharp nonlinear features in aerodynamic pressure fields, motivating a generative approach that preserves discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model is developed with a signal-aware training objective and principal component representation for unstructured surface data.
summary_en.result: The proposed method reduces mean absolute error and improves reconstruction of suction peaks, shock structures, and control surface discontinuities compared to deterministic baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on the NASA Common Research Model wing dataset with comparisons to deterministic baselines.

title: SCNO: Spiking Compositional Neural Operator -- Towards a Neuromorphic Foundation Model for Nuclear PDE Solving
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种模块化、可组合的脉冲神经算子，用于求解偏微分方程，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or any biomedical finite element analysis; it focuses on nuclear PDEs and general coupled PDE systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子模型庞大、能耗高且无法增量扩展，需要一种模块化、低能耗的替代方案。
summary_zh.method: 提出SCNO，由多个脉冲神经算子块组成库，通过轻量聚合器组合求解耦合PDE。
summary_zh.result: 在五个耦合PDE中四个取得最低误差，参数仅95K，优于传统DeepONet。
summary_zh.validation: 在八个PDE族（含五组耦合系统）上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators are monolithic, energy-intensive, and require retraining for new physics, motivating a modular and efficient alternative.
summary_en.method: SCNO maintains a library of spiking neural operator blocks for elementary differential operators and composes them via a lightweight aggregator with a correction network for cross-coupling.
summary_en.result: SCNO achieves the lowest relative L2 error on four out of five coupled PDEs with only 95K parameters, outperforming monolithic baselines by up to 65%.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on eight PDE families including five coupled systems and a nuclear neutron diffusion equation.

title: Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet for Coherent Nonlinear Wave Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No contact mechanics, no implant design, no biomedical context, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraints handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用物理描述符提高神经算子对相干非线性波动的建模精度
summary_zh.method: 提出多头残差门控DeepONet，通过并行条件路径进行残差调制
summary_zh.result: 在基准测试中误差更低，相位一致性和物理量保真度更优
summary_zh.validation: 在保守和耗散非线性波动数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve neural operator accuracy for coherent nonlinear wave dynamics by integrating physically meaningful descriptors via residual gating.
summary_en.method: Proposes Multi-Head Residual-Gated DeepONet with a parallel conditioning pathway modulating state prediction through low-rank multi-head residual gates.
summary_en.result: Achieves lower prediction error and better phase coherence and fidelity of dynamical quantities compared to feature-augmented baselines.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on numerical benchmarks of highly nonlinear conservative and dissipative trapped wave dynamics.

title: MorphoFlow: Sparse-Supervised Generative Shape Modeling with Adaptive Latent Relevance
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的稀疏监督生成形状建模方法可用于生物力学有限元分析中的几何参数化与不确定性量化，但未涉及力学仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on statistical shape modeling and generative shape synthesis, but does not address finite element simulation, surrogate modeling, or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有统计形状模型依赖密集标注和固定潜空间，缺乏灵活性和可扩展性。
summary_zh.method: 提出MorphoFlow框架，结合神经隐式表示、自解码器和自回归归一化流，学习稀疏监督下的概率形状模型。
summary_zh.result: 在腰椎和股骨数据集上实现高精度重建，并恢复与群体趋势一致的解剖变异模式。
summary_zh.validation: 在公开腰椎和股骨数据集上进行数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing statistical shape models rely on dense annotations and fixed latent representations, limiting scalability and flexibility in capturing complex anatomical variation.
summary_en.method: MorphoFlow integrates neural implicit representations with an autodecoder and autoregressive normalizing flows to learn compact probabilistic shape representations from sparse surface annotations.
summary_en.result: The model achieves accurate high-resolution reconstruction and recovers structured modes of anatomical variation consistent with population-level trends on lumbar vertebrae and femur datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on publicly available lumbar vertebrae and femur datasets using numerical benchmarks.

title: Loss-Driven Bayesian Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种损失驱动的贝叶斯主动学习框架，可针对特定损失函数优化数据采集，有望迁移到有限元代理模型的主动学习采样中，提高采样效率并处理多目标约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to finite element surrogate modeling, does not address biomechanical or implant design constraints, and lacks uncertainty quantification in the context of expensive simulation sampling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有主动学习方法难以灵活定制数据采集以适配不同下游任务和损失函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出损失驱动的贝叶斯主动学习框架，利用加权Bregman散度解析计算采集目标。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenges of reliable modal identification from output-only vibration data under measurement noise, sparse sensing, and structural variability.
