authors: Nishigandha Kadam1*, Rohan Raut2, Sanika Mote3
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
relevance_to_user: 该论文综述了AI在3D生物打印全流程中的应用，包括配方优化、实时控制和打印后预测，与用户研究方向高度相关，但缺乏具体实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper is a review without experimental validation or novel AI methodology implementation.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统3D生物打印面临细胞分布不均、血管化不足等问题，AI可提升智能化和精度。
summary_zh.method: 综述了CNN、GAN用于设计，强化学习用于实时参数调整，以及预测模型用于打印后组织成熟。
summary_zh.result: AI集成可实现亚微米级分辨率、闭环控制，并支持个性化组织制造。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为综述性文章。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional 3D bioprinting faces challenges such as heterogeneous cell distribution and insufficient vascularization, which AI can address by introducing intelligence and precision.
summary_en.method: This review covers the use of CNNs and GANs for patient-specific design, reinforcement learning for real-time parameter adjustment, and predictive models for post-printing tissue maturation.
summary_en.result: AI integration enables sub-micron resolution, closed-loop control, and personalized tissue fabrication.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a review article.

title: Towards Rapid Constitutive Model Discovery from Multi-Modal Data: Physics Augmented Finite Element Model Updating (paFEMU)
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合物理增强和稀疏回归的有限元模型更新方法，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建，但未直接涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, stress shielding, or uncertainty quantification in surrogate modeling for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速本构模型发现，利用多模态数据提高材料建模效率
summary_zh.method: 提出物理增强有限元模型更新方法，结合稀疏回归与迁移学习
summary_zh.result: 稀疏表示使模型易于集成到现有有限元流程，并支持低维更新
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值案例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate constitutive model discovery by leveraging multi-modal data and physics augmentation.
summary_en.method: Introduces physics augmented finite element model updating (paFEMU), a transfer learning approach combining sparse regression, adjoint optimization, and multi-modal data.
summary_en.result: The sparse representation enables easy integration into existing FE workflows and low-dimensional updating during transfer learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulation cases using synthetic multi-modal data.

key_terms.en: physics augmented finite element model updating
key_terms.zh: 物理增强有限元模型更新

title: Toward Generalizable Graph Learning for 3D Engineering AI: Explainable Workflows for CAE Mode Shape Classification and CFD Field Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个基于图神经网络的通用框架，用于CAE和CFD的替代建模，虽然应用于汽车工程，但其方法可直接迁移到生物力学和植入物设计的有限元代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on automotive CAE/CFD applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 缩短汽车工程开发周期，提高CAE/CFD分析效率
summary_zh.method: 将异构工程数据转换为物理感知图表示，用GNN进行分类和预测
summary_zh.result: 在振动模态分类和CFD流场预测上验证了框架的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 基于汽车车身和空气动力学仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate automotive engineering development by creating a reusable and interpretable AI framework for heterogeneous 3D engineering data.
summary_en.method: A graph learning framework that converts FE models, CAD, and CFD meshes into physics-aware graph representations and applies GNNs for classification and prediction tasks.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves accurate CAE mode shape classification under label scarcity and efficient CFD field prediction with symmetry-preserving downsampling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two automotive simulation cases: BiW vibration mode classification and aerodynamic body CFD prediction.

title: Hard-constrained Physics-informed Neural Networks for Interface Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束PINN方法可迁移至生物力学中的界面问题（如骨-植入物界面），但未涉及不确定性量化或多目标优化。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no multi-objective or constrained optimization, and no demonstration on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 软约束PINN在界面问题上精度不足，需硬约束方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出窗口法和缓冲法两种硬约束PINN公式。
summary_zh.result: 硬约束方法消除调参需求，缓冲法在二维问题中更鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 一维和二维椭圆界面基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Soft-constrained PINNs suffer from imperfect interface enforcement, motivating hard-constrained formulations.
summary_en.method: Two ansatz-based hard-constrained PINNs are introduced: a windowing approach using compactly supported subnetworks and a buffer approach with auxiliary correction functions.
summary_en.result: Hard constraints eliminate loss-weight tuning; the buffer method achieves robust accuracy in 2D while the windowing approach excels in simple 1D cases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 1D and 2D elliptic interface problems.

title: Hard-constrained Physics-informed Neural Networks for Interface Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束PINN方法可迁移至生物力学界面问题（如骨-植入物界面），但未涉及FEA替代建模或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 软约束PINN在界面问题上精度不足，需手动调参。
summary_zh.method: 提出窗口法和缓冲法两种硬约束PINN，将界面条件嵌入解表示。
summary_zh.result: 硬约束消除调参需求，窗口法精度达10^{-9}，缓冲法鲁棒性更好。
summary_zh.validation: 一维和二维椭圆界面基准测试对比软约束基线。

summary_en.motivation: Soft-constrained PINNs suffer from imperfect interface enforcement and require tedious loss-weight tuning for interface problems.
summary_en.method: Two ansatz-based hard-constrained PINN formulations (windowing and buffer) embed interface physics into the solution representation, decoupling enforcement from residual minimization.
summary_en.result: Hard constraints eliminate tuning; the windowing approach achieves up to 10^{-9} accuracy on simple cases, while the buffer method offers robustness across diverse configurations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 1D and 2D elliptic interface problems compared against soft-constrained baselines.

title: Bayesian Tendon Breakage Localization under Model Uncertainty Using Distributed Fiber Optic Sensors
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架和代理模型方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高效采样与不确定性传播。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring of concrete, not on implant biomechanics or FEA surrogate for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 在模型不确定性下实现预应力混凝土中筋断裂的可靠定位。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯推断、高斯过程代理和嵌入模型形式不确定性的有限元模型。
summary_zh.result: 框架实现了鲁棒的参数校准和不确定性感知的损伤检测。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据的有限元模拟和全尺度结构预测验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve reliable tendon breakage localization in pre-stressed concrete under model uncertainty using distributed fiber optic sensor data.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian framework integrating Gaussian process surrogates with finite element models, embedding model-form uncertainty into material parameters for joint inference.
summary_en.result: The framework enables robust parameter calibration, interpretable diagnostics, and uncertainty-informed damage detection.
summary_en.validation: Validation via finite element simulation of an experimental tendon-breakage test and transfer to a full-scale structural configuration.

title: A Multilevel Monte Carlo Virtual Element Method for Uncertainty Quantification of Elliptic Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层蒙特卡罗虚拟单元法可用于不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or multi-objective optimization; it focuses on elliptic PDEs with random coefficients and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低随机椭圆偏微分方程不确定性量化的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出多层蒙特卡罗虚拟单元法，利用网格聚合构建多层空间
summary_zh.result: 在给定精度下显著减少所需样本数，降低计算复杂度
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证理论收敛性和效率

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification for stochastic elliptic PDEs with random coefficients.
summary_en.method: A multilevel Monte Carlo virtual element method is developed, exploiting mesh agglomeration to construct a hierarchy of coarser spaces.
summary_en.result: The multilevel method substantially reduces the number of samples required on the finest level for a prescribed accuracy, yielding significant cost reductions.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments support the theoretical convergence and computational efficiency of the proposed method.

title: $φ-$DeepONet: A Discontinuity Capturing Neural Operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的不连续捕捉神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学中材料界面（如骨-植入物界面）的代理建模，但未涉及具体植入物设计或验证。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no experimental validation, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子无法处理输入输出中的不连续性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出φ-DeepONet，使用多分支网络处理输入不连续，通过one-hot域分解嵌入处理输出不连续
summary_zh.result: 在多个一维和二维基准问题上实现了准确稳定的不连续预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准问题验证，无实验或生物力学案例

summary_en.motivation: Classical neural operators fail to capture discontinuities in input or output functions, limiting their applicability to problems with material interfaces or shocks.
summary_en.method: φ-DeepONet employs multiple branch networks for discontinuous inputs and a one-hot domain decomposition embedding in the trunk network for discontinuous outputs, trained with physics- and interface-informed loss.
summary_en.result: The method yields accurate and stable predictions on 1D and 2D benchmark problems with strong interface-driven discontinuities.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks without experimental or biomechanical case studies.

title: The Theory and Practice of Highly Scalable Gaussian Process Regression with Nearest Neighbours
relevance_to_user: 该论文为大规模高斯过程回归提供了理论保证，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高效不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模高斯过程回归计算成本高，需要可扩展且理论完备的方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于最近邻的NNGP/GPnn回归理论框架，推导预测准则的极限性质。
summary_zh.result: 证明了均方误差、校准系数和负对数似然的几乎必然收敛，风险达到Stone极小化最优速率。
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论推导，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression suffers from cubic complexity, motivating scalable methods with rigorous theoretical foundations.
summary_en.method: A theoretical framework for NNGP/GPnn regression is developed, deriving almost sure pointwise limits for MSE, CAL, and NLL, and establishing L2-risk convergence rates.
summary_en.result: The method achieves Stone's minimax rate and shows asymptotic robustness to hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs only, no empirical validation.

title: Graph Neural ODE Digital Twins for Control-Oriented Reactor Thermal-Hydraulic Forecasting Under Partial Observability
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的GNN-ODE数字孪生方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但其应用领域为核反应堆热工水力，缺乏植入物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or contact mechanics; it focuses on reactor thermal-hydraulics with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现部分可观测条件下反应堆热工水力状态的实时预测。
summary_zh.method: 结合图神经网络与神经常微分方程构建数字孪生代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型在未观测节点预测中达到高精度，推理速度比模拟快105倍。
summary_zh.validation: 通过仿真瞬态和实验数据微调验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: Real-time supervisory control of advanced reactors requires accurate forecasting of thermal-hydraulic states under partial observability.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed message-passing graph neural network coupled with a neural ordinary differential equation (GNN-ODE) is proposed to model system dynamics with continuous-time latent evolution.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves an average MAE of 0.91 K at 60 s and 2.18 K at 300 s for uninstrumented nodes, with inference 105 times faster than real-time simulation.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes held-out simulation transients and sim-to-real transfer via fine-tuning on experimental facility data with only 30 training sequences.

title: From Perception to Autonomous Computational Modeling: A Multi-Agent Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个多智能体框架，可自动化有限元分析流程，但未涉及植入物或生物力学设计，其方法可迁移至代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, nor does it focus on implant/biomechanics design or multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 自动化从感知数据到工程报告的完整计算力学流程。
summary_zh.method: 基于LLM多智能体协作框架，通过质量门控和条件迭代执行几何提取、材料推断、网格划分、求解及不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 成功对L型钢支架照片进行全自动有限元分析，生成17万节点网格和代码合规评估。
summary_zh.validation: 通过单个L型支架案例展示，无手动修正，但需专业工程师审核。

summary_en.motivation: To automate the entire computational mechanics workflow from perceptual data to engineering report using coordinated LLM agents.
summary_en.method: A multi-agent framework with quality gates and conditional iteration performs geometry extraction, material inference, meshing, solver execution, and uncertainty quantification in a solver-agnostic manner.
summary_en.result: The framework autonomously generated a 171,504-node tetrahedral mesh, seven analyses, and a code-compliant assessment for a steel L-bracket from a photograph.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on a single L-bracket case study without manual correction, but requires professional engineer review.

title: Bayesian Optimization for Mixed-Variable Problems in the Natural Sciences
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合变量贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP, or implant/biomechanics design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 自然科学研究中混合变量昂贵黑箱优化问题缺乏高效方法
summary_zh.method: 推广概率重参数化方法处理非等距离散变量，实现梯度优化
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实验目标上验证了鲁棒性，适用于高度不连续离散空间
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和实验目标系统基准测试

summary_en.motivation: Efficient optimization of expensive black-box objectives over mixed search spaces remains challenging in the natural sciences.
summary_en.method: Generalized probabilistic reparameterization to handle non-equidistant discrete variables, enabling gradient-based optimization with Gaussian process surrogates.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated robustness on synthetic and experimental benchmarks, particularly effective for highly discontinuous discretized landscapes.
summary_en.validation: Systematic benchmarks on synthetic functions and experimental objectives.

title: Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的加权贝叶斯共形预测方法可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling, expensive simulation sampling, or biomechanical design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯共形预测要求独立同分布，无法处理分布偏移。
summary_zh.method: 提出加权贝叶斯共形预测，用加权狄利克雷先验替代均匀先验。
summary_zh.result: 理论证明有效样本量唯一匹配频率与贝叶斯方差，后验标准差随有效样本量衰减。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实空间数据集上验证覆盖率和不确定性信息。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Bayesian conformal prediction relies on the i.i.d. assumption, limiting its applicability under distribution shift.
summary_en.method: We propose Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction, which replaces the uniform Dirichlet prior with a weighted Dirichlet prior using Kish's effective sample size.
summary_en.result: Theoretical results show that the effective sample size uniquely matches frequentist and Bayesian variances, and the posterior standard deviation decays as O(1/√n_eff).
summary_en.validation: Experiments on synthetic and real-world spatial datasets demonstrate maintained coverage and richer uncertainty information.

title: Multiscale Physics-Informed Neural Network for Complex Fluid Flows with Long-Range Dependencies
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂流体流动中多尺度动力学和长程依赖的预测难题
summary_zh.method: 提出域分解移位物理信息神经网络（DDS-PINN），用局部网络加全局损失捕捉多尺度交互
summary_zh.result: 在层流和湍流后向台阶问题中，无需或仅需少量数据即可达到与CFD相当的精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过多尺度线性方程、Burgers方程、平板边界层及后向台阶流基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: Predicting multiscale fluid dynamics with long-range spatial dependencies remains challenging for scientific machine learning due to high data requirements and slow convergence.
summary_en.method: A Domain-Decomposed and Shifted Physics-Informed Neural Network (DDS-PINN) is proposed, employing localized networks with a unified global loss to capture both local precision and global dependencies.
summary_en.result: DDS-PINN achieves CFD-comparable results for laminar backward-facing step flow without data and converges to O(10^-4) for turbulent flow using only 500 random supervision points.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiscale linear ODE, Burgers' equation, flat-plate boundary layer, and backward-facing step benchmarks.

title: Decellularized extracellular matrix enhances hydrogel printability for bioprinting functional muscle constructs in a volumetric muscle loss model
first_author_affiliation: Australian Regenerative Medicine Institute, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia; ARC Training Centre for Cell and Tissue Engineering Technologies, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Shabnam Sabetkish
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Australian Regenerative Medicine Institute, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia; ARC Training Centre for Cell and Tissue Engineering Technologies, Monash University, Clayton, VIC, 3800, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于生物墨水和生物打印构建肌肉组织，但未涉及AI/ML在生物打印流程中的应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on bioink formulation and mechanical tension-assisted printing without computational modeling or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决体积性肌肉损失修复中缺乏功能性肌肉构建物的难题。
summary_zh.method: 将脱细胞外基质改性生物墨水与微柱张力辅助生物打印结合。
summary_zh.result: 共培养构建物在小鼠模型中促进血管化、对齐和功能性肌肉再生。
summary_zh.validation: 小鼠VML模型体内植入验证再生效果。

summary_en.motivation: Volumetric muscle loss (VML) lacks effective treatments due to limited muscle regeneration, motivating the development of biomimetic constructs that support cell viability, alignment, and vascularization.
summary_en.method: A methacryloyl-modified decellularized extracellular matrix (dECM-MA) bioink was integrated with gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) and printed using a micropost tension-assisted bioprinting strategy to provide passive mechanical tension.
summary_en.result: Co-cultured constructs containing human satellite cells and endothelial cells showed enhanced myotube maturation, contraction velocity, and in vivo functional recovery with higher myofiber density and organization.
summary_en.validation: In vitro characterization (rheology, cell viability, differentiation) and in vivo implantation in a mouse VML model with functional and histological analysis.

title: A machine learning framework for uncovering stochastic nonlinear dynamics from noisy data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合符号回归与高斯过程的混合框架，能够从噪声数据中恢复随机非线性动力学的符号形式并量化不确定性，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis (FEA) surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or multi-objective constrained optimization; it focuses on stochastic differential equation discovery from time-series data.

summary_zh.motivation: 从噪声数据中同时恢复系统动力学符号形式并量化参数不确定性
summary_zh.method: 结合深度符号回归与高斯过程最大似然估计的混合框架
summary_zh.result: 在数值基准和实验耦合振荡器系统中成功识别符号与随机成分
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（谐波、Duffing、van der Pol振荡器）及实验生物振荡器验证

summary_en.motivation: To recover symbolic governing equations and quantify parameter uncertainty from noisy data without prior assumptions on functional forms.
summary_en.method: A hybrid framework combining deep symbolic regression with Gaussian process-based maximum likelihood estimation to separately model deterministic dynamics and noise structure.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately identifies both symbolic and stochastic components on numerical benchmarks and an experimental system of coupled biological oscillators.
summary_en.validation: Validation on numerical benchmarks (harmonic, Duffing, van der Pol oscillators) and an experimental coupled oscillator system.

title: PINNs in PDE Constrained Optimal Control Problems: Direct vs Indirect Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN应用于PDE约束最优控制，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理优化，但未涉及具体生物医学问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on optimal control of semilinear PDEs with Allen-Cahn example.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索PINN在PDE约束最优控制中的直接与间接方法比较
summary_zh.method: 提出直接PINN和间接PINN两种公式，并应用于Allen-Cahn控制问题
summary_zh.result: 间接PINN更准确保持约束和最优性结构，产生更平滑的控制曲线
summary_zh.validation: 与离散-然后-优化伴随方法进行数值比较

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effectiveness of physics-informed neural networks as numerical solvers for PDE-constrained optimal control problems.
summary_en.method: Two PINN formulations are proposed: a direct approach minimizing the objective under state constraints, and an indirect approach based on the first-order optimality system, applied to an Allen-Cahn control problem.
summary_en.result: The indirect PINN better preserves the PDE constraint and optimality structure, yielding smoother control profiles and more accurate neural approximations than the direct PINN.
summary_en.validation: Numerical comparison with a discretize-then-optimize adjoint method on the Allen-Cahn problem.

key_terms.zh: 庞特里亚金最优性条件

title: Hybrid Fourier Neural Operator for Surrogate Modeling of Laser Processing with a Quantum-Circuit Mixer
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种混合量子-经典傅里叶神经算子，用于替代昂贵多物理场求解器，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on laser processing surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少三维多物理场代理模型中傅里叶神经算子的参数数量，提升实时部署能力。
summary_zh.method: 用共享变分量子电路混合器替代部分密集谱通道混合块，保持参数规模独立于傅里叶模式数。
summary_zh.result: 在激光加工代理模型中，参数减少15.6%，相分数误差降低26%，温度误差从2.89%降至2.56%。
summary_zh.validation: 在经典基线、量子通道预算扫描和含噪模拟器上验证了数值稳定性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the parameter count of Fourier Neural Operators for 3D multiphysics surrogate modeling while maintaining accuracy, enabling real-time deployment.
summary_en.method: A hybrid quantum-classical FNO (HQ-LP-FNO) replaces a fraction of dense spectral channel mixers with a compact, mode-shared variational quantum circuit whose parameter count is independent of the Fourier mode budget.
summary_en.result: On a 3D laser processing surrogate, HQ-LP-FNO reduces trainable parameters by 15.6%, lowers phase-fraction MAE by 26%, and improves temperature MAE from 2.89% to 2.56%.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes comparison to a classical baseline, a sweep over quantum-channel budgets, and noisy-simulator studies with ibm-torino backend noise.

title: Generative models for decision-making under distributional shift
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的生成模型框架可用于处理分布偏移下的不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的鲁棒优化与场景生成。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply generative models to FEA surrogate modeling or implant biomechanics; it focuses on decision-making under distributional shift from an operations research perspective without any structural mechanics or biomedical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决数据驱动决策中分布偏移导致性能下降的问题
summary_zh.method: 利用流模型和分数模型构建决策相关分布的统一框架
summary_zh.result: 提供了生成模型在鲁棒决策、后验采样和不确定性量化中的理论保证
summary_zh.validation: 理论分析，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address performance degradation in data-driven decision-making caused by distributional shift between nominal and deployment distributions.
summary_en.method: A unified framework based on pushforward maps, continuity equations, and Wasserstein geometry is presented, leveraging flow- and score-based generative models to construct decision-relevant distributions.
summary_en.result: Theoretical guarantees including forward-reverse convergence, first-order minimax analysis, and error-transfer bounds are provided for robust decision-making and posterior sampling.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis only; no experimental or simulation validation is performed.

title: FNO$^{\angle θ}$: Extended Fourier neural operator for learning state and optimal control of distributed parameter systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的扩展傅里叶神经算子（FNO）可学习PDE状态和最优控制，其方法可迁移到生物力学代理建模中，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle multi-objective or constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高傅里叶神经算子对PDE状态和最优控制的学习能力
summary_zh.method: 将FNO层中的频率变量从实数域扩展到复数域，基于Ehrenpreis-Palamodov基本原理
summary_zh.result: 在非线性Burgers方程上训练误差提升一个数量级，非周期边界预测更准确
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Burgers方程）

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the Fourier neural operator's capability in learning both state and optimal control of PDE-governed distributed parameter systems.
summary_en.method: Extend the frequency variable in the inverse Fourier transform from real to complex domain, inspired by the Ehrenpreis-Palamodov fundamental principle.
summary_en.result: Achieves order-of-magnitude improvement in training errors and more accurate non-periodic boundary predictions on the nonlinear Burgers' equation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on Burgers' equation.

title: Curvature-Aware Optimization for High-Accuracy Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的曲率感知优化器可加速PINN收敛，对生物力学代理模型的高效训练具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升PINN求解微分方程的收敛速度与精度
summary_zh.method: 实现自然梯度、自缩放BFGS等曲率感知优化器并应用于多种PDE/ODE
summary_zh.result: 优化器显著加速收敛，在Helmholtz、Burgers等方程上达到高精度
summary_zh.validation: 与高阶数值方法对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate convergence and improve accuracy of physics-informed neural networks for solving differential equations.
summary_en.method: Implemented curvature-aware optimizers including Natural Gradient, Self-Scaling BFGS, and Broyden, and applied them to PINNs for Helmholtz, Stokes, Burgers, Euler equations, and stiff ODEs.
summary_en.result: The proposed optimizers significantly accelerated training and achieved high accuracy on challenging PDE and ODE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Compared against high-order numerical methods for rigorous assessment.

title: Enhancing sample efficiency in reinforcement-learning-based flow control: replacing the critic with an adaptive reduced-order model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于自适应降阶模型的强化学习框架，通过替代评论家网络提高采样效率，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on active flow control, not on FEA surrogate modelling for implant or biomechanics design; it lacks biomedical context, constraint handling, and uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决无模型深度强化学习采样效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 用自适应降阶模型（线性系统+神经ODE）替代评论家网络，通过可微仿真优化控制器
summary_zh.result: 在边界层和方柱绕流控制中，以极少数据达到与DRL相当的性能
summary_zh.validation: 两个经典流控仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the poor sample efficiency of model-free deep reinforcement learning in active flow control.
summary_en.method: An adaptive reduced-order model combining a linear dynamical system and a neural ODE replaces the critic, enabling controller optimization via differentiable simulation.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves comparable or superior drag reduction with significantly fewer exploration data than standard DRL on two canonical flow problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on Blasius boundary layer and flow past a square cylinder simulations.

title: Nonlinear Model Updating of Aerospace Structures via Taylor-Series Reduced-Order Models
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过非线性模型降阶解决了昂贵仿真的采样效率问题，但应用于航空航天结构而非生物力学植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it is validated only on an aerospace wingbox panel.

summary_zh.motivation: 非线性模型更新仍具挑战
summary_zh.method: 结合泰勒级数展开的降阶模型与投影基适应方法
summary_zh.result: 捕获了幅度依赖的固有频率，提高了参数辨识精度
summary_zh.validation: 机翼盒段数值模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: Extending linear finite element model updating to nonlinear regimes remains an open challenge due to the complexity of nonlinear dynamics.
summary_en.method: A nonlinear model order reduction based on Taylor-series expansion of equations of motion is combined with a projection-basis adaptation scheme using the Cayley transform.
summary_en.result: The proposed method captures amplitude-dependent natural frequencies and improves the accuracy of recovered stiffness parameters compared to linear updating.
summary_en.validation: Numerical studies on a representative wingbox panel model demonstrate the effectiveness of the framework.

title: Lattice-Boltzmann-Driven Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Droplet Wettability on Rough Surfaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于格子玻尔兹曼的物理信息神经网络方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or structural FEA; it focuses on multiphase droplet dynamics on rough surfaces.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统PINN受限于宏观连续方程，难以处理复杂表面液滴动力学。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于格子玻尔兹曼的动力学PINN，在介观层次嵌入物理信息。
summary_zh.result: 实现高精度实时预测，误差降低50-75%，质量守恒误差小于1.5%。
summary_zh.validation: 与高分辨率格子玻尔兹曼仿真对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional PINNs are limited by macroscopic continuum equations and struggle with droplet dynamics on complex surfaces.
summary_en.method: A lattice-Boltzmann-driven kinetic PINN is proposed, embedding mesoscopic kinetic physics into a U-Net encoder-decoder neural network.
summary_en.result: The K-PINN achieves real-time prediction with over 10^4 evaluations per second, reducing error by 50-75% and ensuring mass conservation within 1.5%.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed against high-resolution lattice Boltzmann simulations, achieving L2 error ~0.021-0.026 and R^2 ~0.999.

title: Amalgamation of Physics-Informed Neural Network and LBM for the Prediction of Unsteady Fluid Flows in Fractal-Rough Microchannels
relevance_to_user: 该论文将PINN与LBM结合预测微通道非定常流动，方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但未涉及植入物或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and validation is on fluid dynamics benchmarks only.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低微通道粗糙壁面非定常流动仿真的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合稀疏LBM数据与Navier-Stokes约束的PINN模型
summary_zh.result: 仅需150-200倍少的数据点即可准确重建流场
summary_zh.validation: 不同雷诺数和粗糙度幅值下的数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of simulating unsteady fluid flows in microchannels with fractal-rough walls.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) is trained on sparse lattice Boltzmann data while enforcing Navier-Stokes constraints in the loss function.
summary_en.result: The PINN achieves accurate flow field reconstruction with 150-200 times fewer data points than full LBM simulations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation across Reynolds numbers 1-45 and roughness amplitudes 5-20 lattice units.

title: Abstract 7529: Reproducible 3D bioprinting of patient-derived tumors enables high-fidelity preclinical drug testing
first_author_affiliation: Carcinotech Ltd., Edinburgh, United Kingdom

corresponding_authors.name: H. Nikki March
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Carcinotech Ltd., Edinburgh, United Kingdom

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D生物打印构建患者来源肿瘤模型用于药物测试，但未涉及AI在生物打印流程中的集成。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage (pre/in/post), lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance from observation to autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统2D培养模型预测药物反应不准确，需要更真实的肿瘤模型。
summary_zh.method: 使用生物墨水打印患者来源的卵巢和乳腺癌细胞，构建3D肿瘤模型。
summary_zh.result: 打印结构变异系数低于10%，药物反应与临床结果相关。
summary_zh.validation: 通过活死染色、组织学、流式细胞术和药物反应实验验证模型保真度。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional 2D culture fails to recapitulate tumor microenvironment, motivating the need for more predictive preclinical models.
summary_en.method: Patient-derived ovarian and HER2+ breast tumors were dissociated, bioprinted with biomimetic hydrogels, and maintained in 3D culture.
summary_en.result: Bioprinted constructs achieved high reproducibility (CV<10%) and drug responses correlated with patient outcomes.
summary_en.validation: Validation included live/dead imaging, histology, flow cytometry, and drug-response assays with standard-of-care therapies.

title: A Numerical Method for Coupling Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks and FDM for Advanced Thermal-Hydraulic System Simulation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的参数化PINN与FDM耦合方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and applied to nuclear thermal-hydraulics rather than implant/biomechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决核安全分析中系统级代码重复模拟的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 提出参数化PINN与FDM耦合的P2F方法，用单一网络替代动量方程迭代求解
summary_zh.result: 在重力驱动排水场景中水位误差7.85e-5 m，速度误差3.21e-3 m/s
summary_zh.validation: 通过六罐重力排水算例验证，无需重训练或仿真数据

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of repeated simulations in nuclear safety analysis using system-level codes.
summary_en.method: A parameterized PINN coupled with FDM (P2F) is developed, where a single network replaces iterative momentum solves across all flow paths without retraining.
summary_en.result: The method achieves water level MAE of 7.85e-5 m and velocity MAE of 3.21e-3 m/s on a six-tank gravity-driven draining scenario.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a six-tank draining simulation with varying time steps and initial conditions, requiring no retraining or simulation data.

key_terms.zh: 参数化物理信息神经网络

title: Graph Neural Operator Towards Edge Deployability and Portability for Sparse-to-Dense, Real-Time Virtual Sensing on Irregular Grids
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的图神经算子用于稀疏到稠密的重建，可迁移至生物力学中基于稀疏传感器数据实时重建全场应力/应变场。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决资源受限环境下实时虚拟传感的稀疏到稠密重建问题
summary_zh.method: 提出图神经算子VIRSO和可变连接图构建算法V-KNN
summary_zh.result: 在核热工基准上实现低于1%的重建误差，且功耗低于10W
summary_zh.validation: 在三个核热工仿真基准上验证重建精度和边缘部署性能

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time virtual sensing of physical fields in resource-constrained environments where dense instrumentation is infeasible.
summary_en.method: Proposes VIRSO, a graph neural operator with a variable-connectivity algorithm (V-KNN) for sparse-to-dense reconstruction on irregular grids.
summary_en.result: Achieves mean relative L2 errors below 1% on nuclear thermal-hydraulic benchmarks while reducing energy-delay product by 20x compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three simulation benchmarks of increasing geometric and multiphysics complexity, with edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano.

title: General Explicit Network (GEN): A novel deep learning architecture for solving partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种新的点对函数PDE求解架构，可能迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no implant/biomechanics application, and no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN方法点对点拟合，忽略解的整体性质，鲁棒性差。
summary_zh.method: 提出通用显式网络GEN，实现点对函数PDE求解，利用先验知识构建基函数。
summary_zh.result: GEN方法获得高鲁棒性和强可扩展性的PDE解。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准问题上验证了方法的鲁棒性和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN methods perform pointwise fitting, neglecting global solution properties, leading to poor robustness and extensibility.
summary_en.method: A General Explicit Network (GEN) is proposed to achieve point-to-function PDE solving by incorporating prior knowledge through basis functions.
summary_en.result: The GEN approach yields PDE solutions with high robustness and strong extensibility.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark problems, demonstrating robustness and extensibility.

title: Flow Learners for PDEs: Toward a Physics-to-Physics Paradigm for Scientific Computing
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于传输的学习范式用于PDE求解，其不确定性量化和连续时间预测能力可迁移至生物力学代理建模。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no constraint handling demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PDE求解器在复杂场景下计算昂贵，且缺乏不确定性建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出流学习器，参数化传输向量场并通过积分生成轨迹，实现物理到物理的对齐。
summary_zh.result: 支持连续时间预测和原生不确定性量化，为PDE求解提供新范式。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为理论框架和研究路线图。

summary_en.motivation: Existing learned PDE solvers suffer from high cost and lack of uncertainty quantification, motivating a new paradigm that models transport over physically admissible futures.
summary_en.method: Flow learners parameterize transport vector fields and generate trajectories via integration, aligning with the continuous dynamics of PDE evolution.
summary_en.result: The framework enables continuous-time prediction and native uncertainty quantification, offering a stronger organizing principle for learned PDE solving.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper presents a conceptual framework and research agenda.

title: Feature Weighting Improves Pool-Based Sequential Active Learning for Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习特征加权方法可提升代理模型训练中样本选择的效率，适用于生物力学仿真的数据采样。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA-specific constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications; it focuses on generic regression active learning.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升主动学习在回归任务中的样本选择效率
summary_zh.method: 利用岭回归系数对特征加权，改进样本距离计算
summary_zh.result: 特征加权策略显著提升了多种主动学习方法的性能
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准数据集上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve sampling efficiency in active learning for regression by incorporating feature importance into distance computation.
summary_en.method: Proposes feature weighting using ridge regression coefficients from previously labeled samples to weight distances for sample selection in pool-based sequential active learning.
summary_en.result: The feature weighting enhancement consistently improves the performance of five existing active learning regression approaches in both single-task and multi-task settings.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: UQ-SHRED: uncertainty quantification of shallow recurrent decoder networks for sparse sensing via engression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的UQ-SHRED方法可用于稀疏传感中的不确定性量化，其分布学习框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it focuses on spatiotemporal field reconstruction from sparse sensors with UQ.

summary_zh.motivation: 在复杂系统中，稀疏传感重建需要有效的不确定性估计。
summary_zh.method: 通过engression框架学习预测分布，注入噪声并训练能量分数损失。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上生成校准良好的置信区间。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集（湍流、大气、神经科学、天体物理）上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Sparse sensing reconstruction in complex systems requires valid uncertainty quantification for high-fidelity modeling.
summary_en.method: UQ-SHRED learns the predictive distribution via engression, injecting stochastic noise into sensor inputs and training with an energy score loss.
summary_en.result: The method produces well-calibrated confidence intervals on diverse spatiotemporal datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic and real-world datasets including turbulent flow, atmospheric dynamics, neuroscience, and astrophysics.

title: The effect of 3D printing technology combined with Morse taper and platform switching design on microleakage performance of dental implants.
first_author_affiliation: School of Basic Medical Sciences, Mechanical Engineering College, Chengdu University, Chengdu, 610106, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Lijia Cheng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Basic Medical Sciences, Mechanical Engineering College, Chengdu University, Chengdu, 610106, China. chenglijia@cdu.edu.cn.

corresponding_authors.name: Liuxing He
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Basic Medical Sciences, Mechanical Engineering College, Chengdu University, Chengdu, 610106, China. heliuxingcq@163.com.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制造和机械测试，但主要关注牙科种植体的微渗漏和生物活性，而非应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, or fatigue testing; it focuses on microleakage and bioactivity of dental implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Morse锥度连接和平台转换设计对牙种植体微渗漏的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过有限元分析设计四种模型，SLM制造，并进行表面改性和表征。
summary_zh.result: HA涂层和平台转换设计显著减少细菌渗漏，提高生物活性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、XRD、EDS、细菌计数和细胞实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Morse taper connection and platform switching design on microleakage and bioactivity of dental implants.
summary_en.method: Four implant groups with varying platform switching and Morse taper angles were designed via FEA, fabricated by selective laser melting, and surface-modified with sandblasting, acid etching, and HA coating.
summary_en.result: The combination of Morse taper and platform switching reduced stress and bacterial leakage, while HA coating enhanced bioactivity and osteogenic capacity.
summary_en.validation: Validation included SEM, XRD, EDS, profilometry, bacterial colony counting, and in vitro cell assays.

title: Small crack initiation and propagation behavior of selective laser melting TC4 alloy under cyclic loading
venue: DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals)
first_author_affiliation: AECC Beijing Institute of Aeronautical Materials，Beijing 100095，China

corresponding_authors.name: Wu Liangliang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: AECC Beijing Institute of Aeronautical Materials，Beijing 100095，China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM TC4合金的疲劳裂纹行为，与用户关注的LPBF制造植入物疲劳性能相关，但未涉及多孔结构或应力遮挡。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses on crack behavior in solid SLM TC4 alloy.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM TC4合金在循环载荷下的小裂纹行为
summary_zh.method: 利用SEM原位疲劳试验和FIB制造初始缺陷，观察裂纹萌生与扩展
summary_zh.result: 小裂纹易在表面缺陷处萌生，寿命主要消耗在小裂纹扩展阶段，存在显著小裂纹效应
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM原位观察和与长裂纹数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the small crack initiation and propagation behavior of selective laser melted TC4 alloy under cyclic loading.
summary_en.method: In-situ SEM fatigue testing combined with FIB-machined artificial defects was used to observe crack behavior.
summary_en.result: Small cracks initiate preferentially at surface defects, fatigue life is dominated by small crack propagation, and a significant small crack effect is observed.
summary_en.validation: Validation via in-situ SEM observation and comparison with long crack growth data.

title: Preoperative Femoral Bone Texture Features on Radiographs Are Associated with Femoral Stem Subsidence Following Total Hip Arthroplasty
first_author_affiliation: Imaging Research Laboratories, Robarts Research Institute, Western University, London, Ontario, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Omar Abdelhalim
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Imaging Research Laboratories, Robarts Research Institute, Western University, London, Ontario, Canada

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过影像组学分析股骨骨纹理与假体下沉的关联，但未涉及应力遮挡或接触力学建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion via contact/friction modeling, or compare intact vs implanted femur biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索术前股骨骨纹理特征与全髋置换后假体下沉的关联

summary_en.motivation: Nonlinear PDEs lack spectral analysis tools analogous to linear systems, motivating a stable and interpretable learning framework for dynamics.

summary_en.result: On 2D Navier-Stokes turbulence, the method recovers known dissipation scaling and dispersion relations from data alone, and enables cross-viscosity model transfer.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of 2D turbulent flow, comparing learned spectral properties against known physical laws.

title: Conformal Prediction Assessment: A Framework for Conditional Coverage Evaluation and Selection
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的条件覆盖评估框架可用于代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on conformal prediction coverage evaluation, not on surrogate modeling for FEA, implant design, or biomechanics optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测方法在子群体上覆盖不足，缺乏条件有效性评估框架。
summary_zh.method: 将条件覆盖评估转化为监督学习任务，训练可靠性估计器预测实例级覆盖概率。
summary_zh.result: 提出条件有效性指数(CVI)和模型选择算法CC-Select，在合成和真实数据上表现优越。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实数据集上通过实验验证框架的诊断和选择能力。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage but may fail for subpopulations, motivating a framework to assess conditional coverage.
summary_en.method: The proposed CPA framework trains a reliability estimator to predict instance-level coverage probabilities, reframing evaluation as supervised learning.
summary_en.result: The Conditional Validity Index (CVI) decomposes reliability into safety and efficiency, and the CC-Select algorithm consistently identifies predictors with better conditional coverage.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the framework's effectiveness in diagnosing local failures and selecting models.

title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Sequence Encoder: Application to heating and early cooling of thermo-stamping process
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PINN-SE方法可处理多模态时序数据并预测系统响应，对生物力学代理模型中的参数化动态系统建模具有迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on a manufacturing process rather than biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 将PINN-SE方法从简单1D问题扩展到更真实的工业热冲压过程。
summary_zh.method: 结合序列编码器与PINN，利用多模态时序数据预测系统动态响应。
summary_zh.result: 多编码器融合可行，合成数据训练可提升对真实实验数据的泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 基于实验数据生成合成数据，并与真实实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To extend the PINN-SE method from simple 1D problems to a realistic industrial thermo-stamping process with multimodal data.
summary_en.method: Combines multiple sequence encoders with a physics-informed neural network to predict dynamical system responses from temporal 2D images and variable geometries.
summary_en.result: Multi-encoder fusion is feasible, and training on synthetic data generated from experimental data improves generalization to unseen real experimental data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing model predictions on real experimental data after training on synthetic data derived from experiments.

title: KMM-CP: Practical Conformal Prediction under Covariate Shift via Selective Kernel Mean Matching
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种处理协变量偏移下的不确定量化技术，可迁移至代理模型的UQ，但未涉及FEA代理建模或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant biomechanics, and its validation is on molecular property benchmarks rather than solid mechanics or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有共形预测在协变量偏移下覆盖保证失效，需稳定密度比估计
summary_zh.method: 提出KMM-CP框架，利用核均值匹配最小化RKHS矩差异，选择可靠重叠区域修正
summary_zh.result: 在分子性质预测上覆盖误差降低超50%
summary_zh.validation: 分子性质预测基准实验

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction loses coverage guarantees under covariate shift due to unstable density ratio estimation in low-overlap regimes.
summary_en.method: KMM-CP corrects covariate shift by minimizing RKHS moment discrepancy with explicit weight constraints, and selectively restricts correction to regions of reliable support overlap.
summary_en.result: Experiments on molecular property benchmarks with realistic shifts reduce coverage gap by over 50% compared to existing methods.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarking on molecular property prediction datasets with known distribution shifts.

title: GLU: Global-Local-Uncertainty Fusion for Scalable Spatiotemporal Reconstruction and Forecasting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的全局-局部-不确定性融合框架可用于稀疏测量下的状态重建和预测，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的多尺度物理场重建与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general spatiotemporal physical systems without constraint handling or design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 数字孪生中稀疏重建与动态预测通常分离处理，缺乏统一框架。
summary_zh.method: 提出GLU框架，通过全局-局部-不确定性融合构建结构化潜状态，统一重建与预测。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准上优于现有方法，在湍流燃烧数据上保持多物理场耦合结构。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准和湍流燃烧数据集上验证，与多种基线对比。

summary_en.motivation: Sparse reconstruction and dynamic forecasting in digital twins are typically treated as separate tasks, lacking a unified representation.
summary_en.method: GLU constructs a structured latent state combining global summary, local tokens, and uncertainty-driven importance field to unify reconstruction and forecasting.
summary_en.result: GLU outperforms reduced-order, convolutional, neural operator, and attention baselines on multiple benchmarks, preserving multi-scale structures and cross-field couplings.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks and a realistic turbulent combustion dataset with comparisons to state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Domain decomposition of large neural network surrogate models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种域分解方法用于训练神经网络代理模型，可提高局部非线性区域的近似精度，并处理界面约束，这对生物力学植入物设计中的多域代理建模具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and validates only on synthetic 2D/3D linear compression problems without real-world FEA surrogate tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 全局神经网络代理模型难以捕捉局部非线性，需大量参数。
summary_zh.method: 提出域分解方法，将输入空间划分为子域，每个子域由简单神经网络建模，并通过拉格朗日乘子法施加界面连续性约束。
summary_zh.result: 增广拉格朗日方法在保持精度的同时收敛更快，适合大规模问题。
summary_zh.validation: 在2D和3D线性压缩问题的有限元解上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Global neural network surrogate models struggle to capture local nonlinearities without excessive parameters.
summary_en.method: A domain decomposition method is proposed that partitions the input space into subdomains, each modeled by a simple neural network, with interface continuity enforced via Lagrange multiplier or augmented Lagrange multiplier methods.
summary_en.result: The augmented Lagrange method achieves faster convergence with slightly lower accuracy, making it scalable for large-scale problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic 2D and 3D linear compression problems solved by the finite element method.

title: Nonlinear Model Order Reduction on Quadratic Manifolds via Greedy Algorithms with Dimension-Dependent Regularization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于二次流形的降阶建模方法，虽然未直接应用于生物力学，但方法可迁移至植入物设计的代理模型。
why_not_core: This paper does not include UQ, biomedical context, or experimental validation for implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决参数化PDE中线性降维方法在慢衰减Kolmogorov n-width下效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出双贪婪算法联合优化正则化参数与物理参数，构建二次流形降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在线性输运、声波、对流扩散等方程上验证了方法的准确性、效率与稳定性
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个标准PDE数值算例验证算法性能

summary_en.motivation: To address the inefficiency of linear projection methods for parametric PDEs with slowly decaying Kolmogorov n-width, this work enhances quadratic manifold ROMs.
summary_en.method: A novel double-greedy algorithm is introduced to jointly select regularization parameters and physical parameters, balancing accuracy and stability of the quadratic mapping.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments on linear transport, acoustic wave, advection-diffusion, and Burgers' equations demonstrate accuracy, efficiency, and stability.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a set of standard parametric PDE benchmarks, showing improved performance over traditional linear ROMs.

title: DSO: Dual-Scale Neural Operators for Stable Long-term Fluid Dynamics Forecasting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了双尺度神经算子用于长期流体动力学预测，其方法框架可迁移至固体力学代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics forecasting and does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子长期预测存在局部模糊和全局漂移问题
summary_zh.method: 提出双尺度神经算子，分解为深度可分离卷积和MLP-Mixer分别处理局部和全局信息
summary_zh.result: 在湍流基准测试中降低预测误差88%以上
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证涡旋动力学和湍流基准

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators suffer from local detail blurring and global trend deviation in long-term fluid dynamics forecasting.
summary_en.method: The Dual-Scale Neural Operator (DSO) decouples local and global processing using depthwise separable convolutions and an MLP-Mixer.
summary_en.result: DSO reduces prediction error by over 88% on turbulent flow benchmarks compared to prior neural operators.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on vortex dynamics and extensive turbulent flow benchmarks.

title: A Distribution-to-Distribution Neural Probabilistic Forecasting Framework for Dynamical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分布到分布概率预测框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on probabilistic forecasting for chaotic dynamical systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有概率预测方法依赖集成采样，无法直接演化分布。
summary_zh.method: 提出分布到分布框架，用核均值嵌入编码输入分布，混合密度网络参数化输出分布。
summary_zh.result: 在Lorenz63系统上无需显式集成即可生成技能概率预测，部分优于完美模型基准。
summary_zh.validation: 在Lorenz63混沌系统上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Existing probabilistic forecasting methods rely on ensemble sampling and cannot directly evolve predictive distributions as dynamical objects.
summary_en.method: A distribution-to-distribution neural framework is proposed, using kernel mean embeddings to encode input distributions and mixture density networks to parameterize output predictive distributions.
summary_en.result: On the Lorenz63 system, the model produces skillful probabilistic forecasts without explicit ensemble simulation, outperforming a simplified perfect model benchmark in some cases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on the Lorenz63 chaotic dynamical system.

title: Weak and entropy physics-informed neural networks for conservation laws
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的弱形式与熵约束PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, surrogate modeling for expensive FEA, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on hyperbolic conservation laws with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在间断解处失效，需发展弱形式方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于散度定理的时空弱形式与熵不等式约束的WE-PINN。
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers、浅水波和欧拉方程上准确捕捉激波，并给出L1收敛率。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Burgers、浅水波、欧拉方程）。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs fail for discontinuous solutions due to strong-form residuals diverging near shocks, motivating a weak formulation.
summary_en.method: WE-PINNs enforce conservation via space-time flux integrals over control volumes and entropy admissibility in integral form, using a simple neural network without auxiliary networks or fixed meshes.
summary_en.result: Accurate shock resolution and robust performance on Burgers, shallow water, and Euler equations, with the first explicit L1 convergence rate for a mesh-free control-volume PINN.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on canonical hyperbolic conservation laws (Burgers, shallow water, Euler).

title: Trust Region Constrained Bayesian Optimization with Penalized Constraint Handling
relevance_to_user: 该方法将约束优化与贝叶斯优化结合，可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束昂贵优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomedical or implant design context, nor does it validate on FEA-based biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维黑箱约束优化中，昂贵评估和复杂可行域导致效率低下。
summary_zh.method: 提出结合惩罚函数、代理模型和信任区域的贝叶斯优化方法。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实问题上以更少评估找到高质量可行解，性能稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准基准函数和实际问题上进行数值对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional black-box constrained optimization suffers from expensive evaluations and complex feasible regions.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization method combining a penalty formulation, a surrogate model, and a trust region strategy is proposed.
summary_en.result: The method identifies high-quality feasible solutions with fewer evaluations and maintains stable performance across various benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic and real-world constrained optimization problems are used for validation.

title: SLAT-Phys: Fast Material Property Field Prediction from Structured 3D Latents
relevance_to_user: 该方法从单张RGB图像预测材料属性场，可迁移至生物打印中实时监测打印对象的力学性能，但未涉及生物打印流程或生物墨水。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation with bioprinted constructs, and does not address autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 从单张RGB图像快速预测3D物体的材料属性场，用于物理仿真和数字孪生。
summary_zh.method: 利用预训练3D生成模型的潜特征，训练轻量级神经网络解码器预测杨氏模量、密度和泊松比。
summary_zh.result: 在保持精度的同时，每对象仅需9.9秒，比先前方法快120倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在公开数据集上与基线方法对比数值精度和计算时间。

summary_en.motivation: To enable fast material property field estimation from a single RGB image for physics-based simulation and digital twins.
summary_en.method: Leverages spatially organized latent features from a pretrained 3D asset generation model and trains a lightweight neural decoder to predict Young's modulus, density, and Poisson's ratio.
summary_en.result: Achieves competitive accuracy with a 120x speedup over prior methods, requiring only 9.9 seconds per object.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark datasets comparing numerical accuracy and inference time against existing approaches.

title: Linear-Nonlinear Fusion Neural Operator for Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种轻量级、可解释的神经算子，可高效求解PDE，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant FEA problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子学习效率低，需显式解耦线性和非线性效应以提高效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出线性-非线性融合神经算子(LNF-NO)，通过乘法融合线性与非线性分量建模算子映射。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上，LNF-NO训练更快且精度相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在非线性Poisson-Boltzmann方程和多物理耦合系统等基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators suffer from low learning efficiency, motivating explicit decoupling of linear and nonlinear effects.
summary_en.method: A Linear-Nonlinear Fusion Neural Operator (LNF-NO) is proposed, modeling operator mappings via multiplicative fusion of linear and nonlinear components.
summary_en.result: LNF-NO achieves faster training and comparable or better accuracy across multiple PDE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on nonlinear Poisson-Boltzmann equations and multi-physics coupled systems benchmarks.

title: FFV-PINN: A Fast Physics-Informed Neural Network with Simplified Finite Volume Discretization and Residual Correction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的PINN框架，通过有限体积离散和残差校正加速收敛，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics benchmarks and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical FEA applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN忽略邻点信息且训练不稳定，需提升精度和收敛速度。
summary_zh.method: 提出FFV-PINN，结合简化有限体积离散和残差校正损失项。
summary_zh.result: 在多个高雷诺数/瑞利数流场问题中实现无数据求解，训练时间仅需数百秒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过二维/三维顶盖驱动流、后台阶流和自然对流等基准算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current PINNs suffer from neglecting neighboring point information and training instability, limiting their accuracy and convergence.
summary_en.method: A fast PINN framework (FFV-PINN) is proposed, integrating a simplified finite volume discretization for convection terms and a residual correction loss term.
summary_en.result: FFV-PINN achieves data-free solutions for challenging fluid problems at high Re and Ra, with training times of only hundreds of seconds.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on 2D/3D lid-driven cavity, backward-facing step, and natural convection benchmarks.

title: Residual Attention Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Robust Multiphysics Simulation of Steady-State Electrothermal Energy Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的残差注意力PINN框架可解决多物理场耦合仿真中的采样效率问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on electrothermal energy systems, not on implant biomechanics or structural FEA surrogate modeling, and lacks uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电热耦合多物理场仿真中传统PINN精度不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出残差注意力PINN，集成五场算子、残差传播与注意力通道调制
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准上相比MLP/LSTM-PINN取得最低误差，保持高结构保真度
summary_zh.validation: 通过四个电热耦合数值基准案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the accuracy limitations of conventional PINNs in simulating strongly coupled electrothermal multiphysics systems with nonlinearities and interface dynamics.
summary_en.method: A Residual Attention PINN (RA-PINN) is proposed, integrating a unified five-field operator formulation with residual-connected feature propagation and attention-guided channel modulation.
summary_en.result: RA-PINN achieves the lowest MSE, RMSE, and relative L2 errors across four benchmarks, outperforming Pure-MLP, LSTM-PINN, and pLSTM-PINN, especially in interface-dominated and variable-coefficient settings.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four numerical benchmarks covering constant-coefficient coupling, indirect pressure-gauge constraints, temperature-dependent transport, and oblique-interface consistency.

title: Mechanical properties of body-centered tetragonal lattice structures in 316L stainless steel fabricated by SLM
first_author_affiliation: Department of Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering, Meizhouwan Vocational Technology College, Putian, 351100, Fujian, China. slightlightnight@gmail.com

corresponding_authors.name: Zhimin Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Intelligent Manufacturing Engineering, Meizhouwan Vocational Technology College, Putian, 351100, Fujian, China. slightlightnight@gmail.com

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了316L不锈钢BCT点阵结构的力学性能，与用户关注的生物医用植入体点阵结构设计相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: No link to stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants; no fatigue testing; no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究BCT点阵结构参数对力学性能的影响，为优化设计提供依据。
summary_zh.method: 采用RSM结合数值模拟与SLM实验，分析杆径、杆长和倾角对屈服强度和弹性模量的影响。
summary_zh.result: 屈服强度和弹性模量随杆径和倾角增大而增大，随杆长增大而减小。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SLM制备试样并进行单轴压缩实验验证模拟结果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of structural parameters on the mechanical performance of BCT lattice structures for optimized design.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology combined with finite element simulations and SLM fabrication was used to analyze the effects of rod diameter, length, and inclination angle on yield strength and elastic modulus.
summary_en.result: Yield strength and elastic modulus increase with rod diameter and inclination angle but decrease with rod length.
summary_en.validation: Experimental uniaxial compression tests on SLM-fabricated specimens validated the numerical predictions.

title: Fatigue crack growth in cement mantle of taper-slip total hip arthroplasty systems: numerical simulation and mechanical testing
first_author_affiliation: Centre for Health Innovation, Kingston Health Sciences Centre, Kingston, ON, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Heidi‐Lynn Ploeg
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Centre for Health Innovation, Kingston Health Sciences Centre, Kingston, ON, Canada

relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于骨水泥套的疲劳裂纹扩展，而非股骨柄的应力遮挡或微动，与用户研究方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding or micromotion at the bone-implant interface; it focuses on cement mantle fatigue crack growth.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究骨水泥型髋关节假体骨水泥套的疲劳裂纹扩展机制
summary_zh.method: 采用扩展有限元法(XFEM)和Paris定律模拟裂纹扩展，并进行实验验证
summary_zh.result: 轴向载荷引起的环向应力是裂纹扩展的主要驱动力，低皮质壳刚度加速裂纹扩展
summary_zh.validation: 通过铝和聚合物皮质壳替代物的疲劳实验验证数值预测

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fatigue crack propagation behavior of the cement mantle in taper-slip total hip arthroplasty systems.
summary_en.method: A 2D plane-strain XFEM model with Paris law-based direct cyclic analysis was developed and validated with fatigue tests on bone-cement-implant constructs.
summary_en.result: Hoop stress from axial loading, not torsion, dominated crack growth; reduced cortical stiffness and larger initial defects accelerated failure.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue testing on surrogate cortical-shell constructs confirmed numerical predictions.

title: Electrophoretic deposition of hydroxyapatite coating on Ti6Al4V alloy: impact of chitosan on adhesion properties and microstructure
relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及LPBF制备Ti6Al4V合金及HAP/CS涂层，但未评估应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户研究方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on coating adhesion and microstructure, but does not evaluate stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue performance, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高Ti6Al4V植入体的生物相容性和长期性能
summary_zh.method: 采用LPBF制备多孔Ti6Al4V，并通过电泳沉积HAP/CS复合涂层
summary_zh.result: 30% CS/HAP涂层附着力最佳，临界载荷提高28.4%
summary_zh.validation: 通过XRD、SEM和划痕测试验证涂层性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve the biocompatibility and long-term performance of Ti6Al4V implants by applying a bioactive coating.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V substrates were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) and coated with hydroxyapatite-chitosan (HAP/CS) nanocomposite via electrophoretic deposition (EPD).
summary_en.result: The 30% CS/HAP coating achieved the best adhesion, with a critical load of 6.87 N, a 28.4% increase over pure HAP.
summary_en.validation: Coating properties were validated by XRD, SEM, and scratch testing.

title: Double Coupling Architecture and Training Method for Optimization Problems of Differential Algebraic Equations with Parameters

summary_en.result: The framework achieves strong prediction accuracy on 1D, 2D, and 3D PDE benchmarks, demonstrating scalability and cross-scenario generalization.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple standard PDE numerical benchmarks, comparing prediction accuracy and generalization capability.

summary_en.validation: The work is purely theoretical, with no numerical experiments or practical case studies.

title: Wasserstein-type Gaussian Process Regressions for Input Measurement Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理输入测量不确定性的高斯过程方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化。

summary_zh.method: 将带噪输入表示为概率测度，基于Wasserstein距离定义协方差核。

summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证方法的鲁棒性和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian process regression assumes noise-free covariates, leading to overconfident posteriors when inputs are measured with error.
summary_en.method: The authors represent each noisy input as a probability measure and define covariance via Wasserstein distances, instantiating a deterministic projected Wasserstein ARD kernel.
summary_en.result: The proposed PWA-GP handles input noise without latent variables or Monte Carlo projections, providing more transparent uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks demonstrating scalability and robustness.

summary_en.motivation: Earthquake hazard analysis requires large ensembles of scenario-specific ground-motion time histories with realistic spatiotemporal coherence, but physics-based simulations are computationally prohibitive.
summary_en.method: GMFlow combines a physics-inspired latent operator with flow matching to generate conditional spatiotemporal fields in a mesh-agnostic latent space, enabling rapid synthesis.

relevance_to_user: 该方法将变分不等式转化为优化问题并用PINN求解，可迁移至生物力学中的接触或约束问题，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no uncertainty quantification, and no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高椭圆变分不等式求解的精度和效率。
summary_zh.method: 用Deep Ritz方法将变分不等式转为优化问题，结合贝叶斯调参和残差自适应采样。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法能有效逼近解析解。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and efficiency of solving elliptic variational inequalities using neural networks.
summary_en.method: The Deep Ritz method transforms the variational inequality into an optimization problem, with Bayesian optimization for loss weights and a residual-based adaptive dataset update strategy.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate effective approximation of analytical solutions.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks without experimental or biomechanical context.

title: Deep Domain Decomposition Method for Solving the Variational Inequality Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的深度域分解方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling for optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解椭圆变分不等式问题，克服传统数值方法网格依赖。
summary_zh.method: 结合Ritz变分法与PINN的深度域分解方法，采用残差自适应数据集更新策略。
summary_zh.result: 均方误差达1e-7，迭代次数与网格尺寸无关。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证算法精度与收敛性。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve elliptic variational inequality problems while overcoming the grid dependence of traditional numerical methods.
summary_en.method: A deep domain decomposition method integrating Ritz variational formulation with PINN, employing a residual-adaptive dataset update strategy.
summary_en.result: Achieves mean square error of 1e-7 and iteration count independent of grid size under uniform overlap.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems demonstrating accuracy and convergence.

title: UniPINN: A Unified PINN Framework for Multi-task Learning of Diverse Navier-Stokes Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种统一的多任务PINN框架，可处理多种Navier-Stokes方程，其共享-专用架构和动态权重分配策略对解决生物力学设计中的多物理场代理建模问题具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN方法难以处理多流场景，存在负迁移和训练不稳定问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出UniPINN框架，包含共享-专用架构、跨流注意力机制和动态权重分配策略。
summary_zh.result: 在三种典型流动上实现了高精度预测，有效缓解了负迁移。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证，与单任务PINN对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN methods struggle with multi-flow scenarios due to negative transfer and unstable training dynamics.
summary_en.method: UniPINN integrates a shared-specialized architecture, cross-flow attention, and dynamic weight allocation for multi-task learning.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves superior prediction accuracy and balanced performance across three canonical flows while mitigating negative transfer.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of three canonical Navier-Stokes flows.

title: Neural Field Thermal Tomography: A Differentiable Physics Framework for Non-Destructive Evaluation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的硬约束神经场框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的逆问题求解，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modeling for expensive FEA sampling, constraint handling in optimization, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on inverse heat conduction with a hard-constrained neural field.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决逆热传导问题中软约束PINN梯度病态和内部场恢复困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出硬约束神经场框架NeFTY，将扩散率表示为连续坐标网络，通过可微隐式欧拉热求解器强制执行PDE。
summary_zh.result: 在合成3D基准和真实热成像数据上，NeFTY在无标签体积恢复中显著优于软约束PINN和体素基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成3D基准和真实热成像数据上验证，包括缺陷分割和深度估计。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the gradient pathology of soft-constrained PINNs in severely ill-posed inverse heat conduction problems, where interior fields are poorly recovered.
summary_en.method: NeFTY represents unknown diffusivity as a continuous coordinate-based neural network and enforces the PDE exactly via a differentiable implicit-Euler heat solver with harmonic-mean interface flux.
summary_en.result: NeFTY substantially outperforms soft-constrained PINN variants and voxel-grid baselines on label-free 3D volumetric recovery in synthetic benchmarks and real thermography data.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic 3D benchmarks and real thermography data, with defect segmentation and depth estimation metrics.

title: MCMC Informed Neural Emulators for Uncertainty Quantification in Dynamical Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将MCMC与神经网络结合的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no FEA validation, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决物理模型参数先验未知时，神经网络代理模型训练效率低且易采样非物理参数的问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过MCMC将模型参数分布作为网络训练输入，实现与物理模型等价的不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型在显著降低计算时间的同时，保持了与原始物理模型相同的不确定性量化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准和ODE系统上验证了分位数模拟器和自编码器网络的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To address the inefficiency and unphysical parameter sampling when training neural network surrogates without accurate prior distributions of model parameters.
summary_en.method: Decouple uncertainty quantification from network architecture by feeding the model-parameter distribution obtained via MCMC as an input to network training.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves the same uncertainty quantification as the physical model with substantially reduced computation time, demonstrated on quantile and ODE emulators.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and ODE systems, with a mathematical analysis linking performance loss to distribution mismatch.

title: Engineering Mechanically Tunable Elastin-Based Microgel Bioinks: From Microscale Stiffness Control to Macroscale Structural Bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: Henan Province Engineering Technology Research Center of MEMS Manufacturing and Applications, School of Mechanics and Safety Engineering

corresponding_authors.name: Jianwei Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Henan Province Engineering Technology Research Center of MEMS Manufacturing and Applications, School of Mechanics and Safety Engineering

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及生物打印中的微凝胶生物墨水，但未集成AI或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on material characterization and microgel size effects.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究微凝胶尺寸对生物墨水力学性能和可打印性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用微流控制备不同直径的GelMA-ElaMA微凝胶生物墨水，并进行压缩测试、AFM和FEA分析。
summary_zh.result: 大尺寸微凝胶刚度更高，小尺寸柔韧性更好；生物墨水可打印性优异，细胞存活率>90%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试、AFM纳米压痕和有限元分析验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how microgel size influences the mechanical properties and printability of elastin-based microgel bioinks.
summary_en.method: Microgel bioinks with tunable diameters (100-1000 μm) were fabricated via microfluidics and characterized by compression tests, AFM nanoindentation, and FEA.
summary_en.result: Larger microgels exhibited higher stiffness while smaller ones showed greater flexibility; bioinks demonstrated excellent printability and high cell viability.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through compression testing, AFM nanoindentation, and finite element analysis.
