title: A Tutorial Review of Bayesian Optimization with Gaussian Processes to Accelerate Stationary Point Searches
relevance_to_user: 该论文将贝叶斯优化与高斯过程回归应用于势能面上的驻点搜索，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on stationary point searches in potential energy surfaces, not on implant/biomechanics design, and does not address constraints or uncertainty quantification in multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速势能面上昂贵的电子结构评估中的驻点搜索。
summary_zh.method: 提出统一贝叶斯优化框架，使用高斯过程回归与导数观测，适用于最小化、单点鞍搜索和双端路径搜索。
summary_zh.result: 可减少约一个数量级的评估次数，同时保持理论精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过教学性Rust代码演示三种应用场景的相同贝叶斯优化循环。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate stationary point searches on potential energy surfaces, reducing the number of expensive electronic structure evaluations.
summary_en.method: A unified Bayesian optimization framework using Gaussian process regression with derivative observations, inverse-distance kernels, and active learning, applied to minimization, single-point saddle searches, and double-ended path searches.
summary_en.result: The surrogate reduces evaluations by roughly an order of magnitude while preserving accuracy, with extensions for production use.
summary_en.validation: Pedagogical Rust code demonstrates the same Bayesian optimization loop across three applications, bridging theory and practice.

title: Physics-informed neural operator for predictive parametric phase-field modelling
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical FEA context; it focuses on phase-field microstructural evolution.

summary_zh.motivation: 相场模拟计算成本高，神经算子缺乏物理约束导致泛化差。
summary_zh.method: 将相场控制方程残差嵌入损失函数，构建物理信息神经算子PF-PINO。
summary_zh.result: PF-PINO在精度、泛化能力和长期稳定性上显著优于传统FNO。
summary_zh.validation: 在电化学腐蚀、枝晶凝固和旋节线分解三个基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Phase-field simulations are computationally expensive for parametric studies, and standard neural operators lack physical constraints, limiting accuracy and generalization.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural operator (PF-PINO) is developed by embedding residuals of phase-field governing equations into the data-fidelity loss function.
summary_en.result: PF-PINO significantly outperforms conventional Fourier neural operator in accuracy, generalization, and long-term stability across multiple phase-field benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark phase-field problems including electrochemical corrosion, dendritic solidification, and spinodal decomposition.

title: Information Theoretic Bayesian Optimization over the Probability Simplex
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率单纯形上的贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及生物力学或有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant/biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO, and no handling of multi-objective or complex constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决概率单纯形上的昂贵黑箱函数优化问题
summary_zh.method: 基于信息几何构建Matérn核和几何优化器
summary_zh.result: 在基准函数和实际应用中优于欧几里得方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试和三个实际应用案例

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions defined on the probability simplex, a constrained non-Euclidean domain.
summary_en.method: Proposes α-GaBO, a family of Bayesian optimization algorithms using information geometry to construct Matérn kernels and geometric acquisition optimizers.
summary_en.result: Outperforms constrained Euclidean approaches on benchmark functions and real-world applications including mixture optimization and robotic control.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmarks and three real-world tasks (mixtures of components, classifiers, and robotic control).

title: Flow Field Reconstruction via Voronoi-Enhanced Physics-Informed Neural Networks with End-to-End Sensor Placement Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的传感器布局优化与PINN结合的方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中，用于提高稀疏测量下的场重建精度。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid flow reconstruction and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决稀疏传感器测量下流场重建精度和鲁棒性不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出Voronoi增强的PINN，端到端优化传感器布局并融合物理约束
summary_zh.result: 在多个流场算例中显著提升重建精度，对传感器失效具有鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 通过方腔流、血管流和环形旋转流三个仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve reconstruction accuracy and robustness of flow fields from sparse sensor measurements, especially under sensor failure.
summary_en.method: A Voronoi-enhanced physics-informed neural network (VSOPINN) that integrates differentiable soft Voronoi construction with centroidal Voronoi tessellation for end-to-end sensor placement optimization.
summary_en.result: VSOPINN achieves significantly higher reconstruction accuracy across multiple flow problems and remains robust under partial sensor failure.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three simulation cases: lid-driven cavity flow, vascular flow, and annular rotating flow.

title: Evidential Perfusion Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Residual Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文将证据深度学习与物理信息神经网络结合用于医学成像，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization; it focuses on CT perfusion deconvolution.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN方法缺乏不确定性量化，限制了可靠性评估。
summary_zh.method: 提出EPPINN框架，结合证据深度学习与物理信息建模，用Normal-Inverse-Gamma分布建模物理残差的不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 在数字体模、ISLES 2018和临床数据上，EPPINN比经典反卷积和PINN基线误差更低，不确定性估计更保守。
summary_zh.validation: 在数字体模、公开基准和临床队列上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN-based perfusion analysis lacks uncertainty quantification, limiting clinical reliability.
summary_en.method: EPPINN integrates evidential deep learning with physics-informed neural networks, placing a Normal-Inverse-Gamma distribution over the physics residual to quantify aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty without Bayesian sampling.
summary_en.result: EPPINN achieves lower normalized mean absolute error than classical deconvolution and PINN baselines, especially under sparse sampling and low SNR, while providing conservative uncertainty estimates with high empirical coverage.
summary_en.validation: Validated on digital phantom data, the ISLES 2018 benchmark, and a clinical cohort.

title: A neural operator for predicting vibration frequency response curves from limited data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no multi-objective or constrained optimization, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速工程部件振动测试中的频率响应预测。
summary_zh.method: 将神经算子与隐式数值格式结合，从有限数据学习状态空间动力学。
summary_zh.result: 仅用7%带宽数据即达到99.87%的频响曲线预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在单自由度线性系统上验证，未涉及实验或复杂结构。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate vibration testing in engineering design by replacing costly numerical simulations with a neural operator that learns dynamics from limited data.
summary_en.method: A neural operator integrated with an implicit numerical scheme learns the underlying state-space dynamics without physics-based regularization.
summary_en.result: The method achieves 99.87% accuracy in predicting the frequency response curve of a linear SDOF system using only 7% of the solution bandwidth.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a linear single-degree-of-freedom system as a proof-of-concept, without experimental or complex structural validation.

title: A Unified Hierarchical Multi-Task Multi-Fidelity Framework for Data-Efficient Surrogate Modeling in Manufacturing
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分层多任务多保真度高斯过程代理建模框架，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多源异构数据融合与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on manufacturing surface shape prediction, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA-based surrogate modeling for biomedical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有代理建模方法无法同时处理多任务信息共享和多保真度数据异质性。
summary_zh.method: 提出分层贝叶斯框架，将每个任务响应分解为全局趋势和跨任务联合学习的局部残差。
summary_zh.result: 在发动机表面形状预测中，相比单任务和多任务基线，精度提升19%和23%。
summary_zh.validation: 一维合成算例和真实发动机表面形状案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing surrogate models fail to simultaneously leverage inter-task similarity and fidelity-dependent data characteristics in manufacturing systems.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical Bayesian framework decomposes each task's response into a global trend and a residual component jointly learned across tasks, accommodating arbitrary numbers of tasks, design points, and fidelity levels.
summary_en.result: The proposed method improves prediction accuracy by up to 19% and 23% over state-of-the-art multi-task learning and independent stochastic kriging, respectively, on an engine surface shape prediction task.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a 1D synthetic example and a real-world engine surface shape case study.

title: Tau-BNO: Brain Neural Operator for Tau Transport Model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于生物物理模型的神经算子代理，其方法可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on tau protein transport in brain networks, not on FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics or structural mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂生物物理模型仿真耗时问题
summary_zh.method: 提出Tau-BNO神经算子，结合函数编码器和谱核近似各向异性传输
summary_zh.result: 代理模型预测精度高（R²≈0.98），速度提升显著
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与Transformer和Mamba对比

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational burden of simulating the Network Transport Model for tau protein spread in Alzheimer's disease.
summary_en.method: Tau-BNO combines a function operator encoding kinetic parameters with a spectral kernel to approximate anisotropic transport, serving as a surrogate for the PDE-based model.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves high predictive accuracy (R²≈0.98) and reduces simulation time from hours to seconds, outperforming sequence models.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks across diverse biophysical regimes and comparison with state-of-the-art sequence models.

title: Probabilistic calibration of crystal plasticity material models with synthetic global and local data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的两阶段代理模型校准与不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的材料参数标定。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on crystal plasticity for polycrystalline metals, not on implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or FEA surrogate for hip implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决晶体塑性模型参数唯一性差及校准计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出两阶段校准流程，结合代理模型与全场模拟，采用并行序贯蒙特卡洛进行贝叶斯推断
summary_zh.result: 两阶段方法在保证精度的同时显著提升计算效率，局部数据有效降低参数不确定性
summary_zh.validation: 使用Inconel 718合成数据验证，对比全局与局部数据校准效果

summary_en.motivation: To address parameter non-uniqueness and high computational cost in calibrating crystal plasticity models.
summary_en.method: A two-stage calibration procedure combining a surrogate model with full-field simulations and parallelized sequential Monte Carlo for Bayesian inference.
summary_en.result: The two-stage approach achieves computational efficiency while maintaining accuracy, and local data significantly reduces parameter uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validation using synthetic data for Inconel 718 microstructure, comparing calibrations with global and local data.

title: Optimizing Graded Porous Scaffolds for Bone Defects: Insights from In Vivo Mechanical Environments
first_author_affiliation: Departamento de Ingeniería Minera, Mecánica, Energética y de la Construcción, Escuela Técnica Superior de Ingeniería, Campus de «El Carmen», Universidad de Huelva, Avda. de las Fuerzas Armadas, s/n, 21007 Huelva, Spain

corresponding_authors.name: Juan Mora-Macías

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对骨缺损的梯度多孔支架设计，通过有限元模拟匹配体内力学环境，与用户关注的应力遮挡和刚度匹配高度相关。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏基于体内力学环境的梯度多孔支架设计共识
summary_zh.method: 基于CT有限元模型模拟骨痂应变场，设计梯度TPMS支架
summary_zh.result: 梯度多孔支架能复现骨痂应变场，微观参数与骨长入研究一致
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真验证应变场匹配性

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of consensus in designing graded-porosity scaffolds by mimicking the in vivo mechanical environment of bone callus.
summary_en.method: Finite element models based on CT scans were used to define the strain field of the callus, and graded TPMS scaffolds were designed to replicate this strain distribution.
summary_en.result: The graded-porosity scaffolds successfully replicated the callus strain field, with microstructural parameters consistent with bone ingrowth studies.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through finite element simulation comparing scaffold strain fields to callus simulations.

title: Optimization and Performance Analysis of Controllable Irregular Porous Bone Implant Structures.
first_author_affiliation: School of Civil Engineering and Architecture, Xi'an University of Technology, Xi'an 710048, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Yan Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Civil Engineering and Architecture, Xi'an University of Technology, Xi'an 710048, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出可控不规则多孔结构设计方法，降低弹性模量并缓解应力遮挡，符合骨植入物力学匹配需求。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 常规不规则多孔结构可控性差、随机性大，导致力学缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 采用泊松盘采样均匀化种子点分布，设计可控不规则多孔结构并用FEA和压缩实验验证。
summary_zh.result: 新设计应力分布更优，弹性模量降低，应力遮挡缓解。
summary_zh.validation: 3D打印试样压缩测试与FEA对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional irregular porous structures suffer from poor controllability and excessive randomness leading to mechanical defects.
summary_en.method: This study proposes a controllable irregular porous structure design using Poisson disk sampling to homogenize seed points, evaluated by FEA and compression tests on 3D-printed specimens.
summary_en.result: The designed structures exhibit improved stress distribution, reduced elastic modulus, and alleviated stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests on LPBF-fabricated specimens were compared with finite element simulations.

title: MUSA-PINN: Multi-scale Weak-form Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Fluid Flow in Complex Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多尺度弱形式PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling beyond PDE conservation.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在复杂拓扑几何中收敛困难，需改进全局信息传播。
summary_zh.method: 提出多尺度弱形式PINN，用分层球面控制体积的积分守恒律替代点残差。
summary_zh.result: 在TPMS流场中相对误差降低93%，质量守恒更好。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与SOTA对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from convergence issues in topologically complex domains due to locality bias of point-wise constraints.
summary_en.method: MUSA-PINN reformulates PDE constraints as integral conservation laws over hierarchical spherical control volumes with a three-scale subdomain strategy.
summary_en.result: The method reduces relative errors by up to 93% and improves mass conservation for steady incompressible flow in TPMS geometries.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on TPMS flow problems compared against state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对高维约束优化问题，可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化场景。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems, no FEA surrogate integration, no uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维约束贝叶斯优化面临维度灾难，现有方法处理复杂约束时易过早收缩。
summary_zh.method: 提出局部约束贝叶斯优化，利用约束惩罚代理的梯度交替进行局部下降和不确定性探索。
summary_zh.result: 在高达100维的基准测试中优于现有方法，并证明KKT残差收敛率与维度多项式相关。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准高维优化基准（如合成函数）上进行数值实验对比。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional constrained Bayesian optimization suffers from the curse of dimensionality, and existing trust-region methods prematurely shrink under tight constraints.
summary_en.method: LCBO alternates between rapid local descent and uncertainty-driven exploration by leveraging the differentiable landscape of constraint-penalized surrogates.
summary_en.result: LCBO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on high-dimensional benchmarks up to 100D, with a proven polynomial convergence rate in dimension for the KKT residual.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic high-dimensional constrained optimization problems (up to 100D) with comparison to multiple baselines.

title: Generative prediction of laser-induced rocket ignition with dynamic latent space representations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合卷积自编码器和神经常微分方程的代理模型方法，可大幅降低高维多物理场仿真的计算成本，其框架可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or structural FEA; it focuses on rocket ignition CFD surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 激光点火火箭发动机仿真耗时巨大，需快速探索设计空间。
summary_zh.method: 用卷积自编码器压缩高维流场，神经常微分方程学习时序动态。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型将预测成本降低数个数量级，支持参数空间高效探索。
summary_zh.validation: 基于激光点火湍流燃烧仿真案例验证预测精度与物理合理性。

summary_en.motivation: Scale-resolving simulations of laser-ignited rocket engines are computationally prohibitive, motivating a surrogate model for rapid design space exploration and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A convolutional autoencoder compresses high-dimensional flow fields into a low-dimensional latent space, where neural ODEs learn the temporal dynamics from initial conditions and operating inputs.
summary_en.result: The surrogate reduces prediction cost by several orders of magnitude while enabling spatiotemporal field predictions that are physically interpretable.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on a multi-physics turbulent combustion simulation of laser ignition, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency gains.

title: Prediction of Steady-State Flow through Porous Media Using Machine Learning Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用机器学习代理模型加速多孔介质流动预测，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion prediction, no patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统CFD计算成本高，需要快速代理模型用于拓扑优化。
summary_zh.method: 比较AE、U-Net和FNO三种架构，结合物理信息损失函数预测稳态多孔介质流动。
summary_zh.result: FNO性能最优，MSE低至0.0017，加速比达1000倍。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与CFD结果对比MSE。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional CFD is computationally prohibitive for large-scale topology optimization, motivating data-driven surrogate models for rapid flow prediction.
summary_en.method: Three neural architectures (autoencoder, U-Net, Fourier Neural Operator) are trained with physics-informed loss to predict steady-state flow governed by Navier-Stokes-Brinkman equations.
summary_en.result: FNO achieves the lowest MSE of 0.0017 and up to 1000x speedup over CFD, with mesh-invariant property beneficial for topology optimization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark against CFD simulations on porous media flow cases.

title: Certified and accurate computation of function space norms of deep neural networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种对神经网络函数空间范数进行认证计算的方法，可用于PINN残差误差控制，但未涉及FEA替代建模或生物力学设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on certified error computation for neural network outputs in function space norms, but does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络求解PDE需要可靠的函数空间范数误差控制，但点评估不足以提供紧的确定性界。
summary_zh.method: 结合区间算术包围盒与自适应标记/细化及求积聚合，计算神经网络积分量的认证上下界。
summary_zh.result: 实现了Lp、W1,p、W2,p范数的认证计算，并用于PINN内部残差误差控制。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证了方法的准确性和实际行为。

summary_en.motivation: Reliable error control in function space norms is needed for neural network PDE solvers, but point evaluations alone cannot provide tight deterministic bounds.
summary_en.method: A framework combining interval arithmetic enclosures on axis-aligned boxes with adaptive marking/refinement and quadrature-based aggregation to compute certified lower and upper bounds for integral quantities of neural networks.
summary_en.result: Certified computation of Lp, W1,p, and W2,p norms is achieved, with practical application to PINN interior residual error control.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments demonstrate the accuracy and practical behavior of the proposed methods.

title: CREDO: Epistemic-Aware Conformalized Credal Envelopes for Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的CREDO方法结合了可信集和共形预测，能够量化认知不确定性，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的预测区间校准。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanics; it only validates on benchmark regressions.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准共形预测在模型外推区域可能过于自信，缺乏认知不确定性表示。
summary_zh.method: 提出CREDO方法，先构建可信包络，再应用分裂共形校准，保证边际覆盖。
summary_zh.result: 在基准回归上保持目标覆盖率，同时提高稀疏自适应性。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个基准回归数据集上验证覆盖率和区间效率。

summary_en.motivation: Standard conformal prediction intervals can appear overconfident in extrapolation regions because they do not explicitly represent epistemic uncertainty.
summary_en.method: CREDO first builds an interpretable credal envelope that widens under weak local evidence, then applies split conformal calibration to guarantee marginal coverage.
summary_en.result: The method maintains target coverage while improving sparsity adaptivity at competitive efficiency on benchmark regressions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on multiple benchmark regression datasets, evaluating coverage and interval width.

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for Industrial Processes: Time-Discrete VPINNs for heat conduction
relevance_to_user: 该论文将VPINN应用于工业热传导问题，方法可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and validation is only on an industrial heat conduction problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高工业热传导过程仿真的计算效率
summary_zh.method: 提出时间离散变分物理信息神经网络（VPINN）
summary_zh.result: 成功模拟咖啡提取物冻结过程的热动力学
summary_zh.validation: 与实验数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency of simulating industrial heat conduction processes with temperature-dependent properties.
summary_en.method: A Variational Physics-Informed Neural Network (VPINN) with classical time discretization and a composed loss function minimizing the residual's dual norm at each time step.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately captures thermal dynamics of coffee extract freezing in an industrial cylinder.
summary_en.validation: Validation against experimental data from the industrial freezing process.

summary_en.result: Accurate reconstruction of spatiotemporal activation patterns under measurement noise and reduced spatial resolution.
summary_en.validation: Simulation case studies on simplified left ventricular geometries with synthetic deformation data.

title: Hierarchical Inference and Closure Learning via Adaptive Surrogates for ODEs and PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了结合层次化贝叶斯推断和自适应代理模型的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题。

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on ODE/PDE systems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators struggle to capture heterogeneous features and complex dependencies in PDE systems, limiting large-scale pre-training.

summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on diverse PDE benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the approach.

summary_zh.method: 提出SGNO，在傅里叶空间使用指数时间差分更新，约束生成器实部非正，并加入门控强制项和频谱截断。
summary_zh.result: 在APEBench上，SGNO在长程误差和稳定滚动长度上优于现有基线。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators suffer from instability in autoregressive rollouts due to error accumulation and high-frequency feedback.
summary_en.method: SGNO employs an exponential time differencing update in Fourier space with a constrained nonpositive generator, a gated forcing term, and spectral truncation to ensure stable long-horizon predictions.
summary_en.result: SGNO achieves lower long-horizon error and longer stable rollout lengths than strong baselines on APEBench across multiple PDE families.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 1D, 2D, and 3D PDE problems with ablation studies confirm the contributions of each component.

title: SGNO: Spectral Generator Neural Operators for Stable Long Horizon PDE Rollouts
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的频谱生成神经算子（SGNO）针对长时间PDE滚动预测中的频谱误差累积问题，其结构化自回归方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模中的瞬态或频域问题。

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate spectral amplitude distortion, phase misalignment, and nonlinear mode-interaction errors that accumulate during long autoregressive PDE rollouts.
summary_en.method: SGNO organizes each learned one-step map as a structured spectral evolution update with a real-valued nonpositive diagonal generator and a complex-valued spectral mixing correction pathway.
summary_en.result: SGNO reduces GMean100 by a median of 74.8% across ten APEBench tasks, with strongest gains on dispersive and transport-dominated PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on ten mechanism-matched periodic linear and semilinear evolution PDE tasks from the APEBench suite.

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the slow convergence of global optimization and the local optima trap of local search in nanophotonic inverse design.
summary_en.method: BONNI integrates Bayesian optimization with interior point optimization, leveraging gradient information to guide sampling.

title: MGD: Moment Guided Diffusion for Maximum Entropy Generation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的矩引导扩散方法可用于高效采样最大熵分布，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的约束优化与采样效率问题。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the exponential slowdown of MCMC sampling for maximum entropy distributions in high dimensions.
summary_en.method: Moment Guided Diffusion (MGD) solves a stochastic differential equation that guides moments toward prescribed values within finite time.
summary_en.result: MGD converges to the maximum entropy distribution in the large-volatility limit and provides a tractable entropy estimator.
summary_en.validation: Validation on financial time series, turbulent flows, and cosmological fields using wavelet scattering moments.

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINNs suffer from gradient stiffness and ill-conditioning when solving multi-scale PDEs due to geometric misalignment between fixed input coordinates and solution structures.

summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical experiments on standard PDE problems demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed mapping strategies.

title: Geometric Neural Operators via Lie Group-Constrained Latent Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于李群约束的几何神经算子，可提升长期预测稳定性，对生物力学代理模型中的约束处理有借鉴意义。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子在多步迭代和长期预测中不稳定，违反几何守恒律。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于低秩李代数参数化的流形约束模块，对潜在表示进行群作用更新。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from slow convergence and spectral bias, limiting their application to large-scale wave field reconstruction.
summary_en.method: This work proposes PE-PINN, which integrates an envelope transformation layer into the neural network architecture to embed physical priors beyond loss functions.
summary_en.result: PE-PINN achieves over 10x speedup in convergence compared to standard PINNs and orders of magnitude reduction in memory usage versus FEM.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on 2D/3D electromagnetic wave reconstruction demonstrate accuracy and efficiency gains.

title: Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过统计杠杆加权实现自适应共形预测，可迁移至有限元代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。

summary_en.motivation: Standard conformal prediction produces constant-width intervals that overcover in low-variance regions and undercover in high-variance regions.
summary_en.method: Leverage-Weighted Conformal Prediction (LWCP) weights nonconformity scores by a function of statistical leverage, deriving adaptivity from the design matrix geometry without auxiliary model training.
summary_en.result: LWCP preserves finite-sample marginal validity, achieves asymptotically optimal conditional coverage with negligible width cost, and eliminates the conditional coverage gap of vanilla CP.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic and real datasets, demonstrating substantial reductions in conditional coverage disparity.

summary_en.method: Continuous bath embedded bioprinting (CBEB) dynamically generates locally confined microbaths via cyclic deposition of a shell-bath-bioink trilayer, enabling ultrashort nozzles.

title: PRISM: A 3D Probabilistic Neural Representation for Interpretable Shape Modeling

title: A physics-informed data-driven framework for modeling hyperelastic materials with progressive damage and failure
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息数据驱动框架可用于生物力学中软组织的损伤建模，但未直接涉及植入物或有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, stress shielding, or surrogate modeling for finite element analysis; it focuses on constitutive modeling of hyperelastic materials with damage.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决超弹性软材料损伤建模中物理一致性与数据驱动灵活性的结合问题。
summary_zh.method: 两阶段框架：GPR学习完整弹性响应，再学习损伤演化，通过罚函数约束热力学可容性。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据和脑组织实验数据上验证了高精度和泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试与实验数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a constitutive modeling framework that combines physical consistency with data-driven flexibility for hyperelastic materials undergoing progressive damage and failure.
summary_en.method: A two-stage framework using Gaussian Process Regression to separately learn the intact hyperelastic response and damage evolution, with penalty-based optimization enforcing thermodynamic admissibility.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves high accuracy on synthetic benchmarks and generalizes to unseen deformation modes, and successfully infers damage evolution from experimental brain tissue data.
summary_en.validation: Validation on synthetic datasets against analytical models and competing methods, plus application to experimental brain tissue data.

title: Supervised Metric Regularization Through Alternating Optimization for Multi-Regime Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的拓扑感知PINN方法通过度量正则化处理多机制动力学系统，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模中的约束优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, lacks experimental validation, and focuses on dynamical systems rather than solid mechanics or structural optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在参数化动力系统存在尖锐机制转换时出现谱偏差或模式崩溃。
summary_zh.method: 提出拓扑感知PINN，通过监督度量正则化结构化潜空间，并采用交替优化调度。
summary_zh.result: 在Duffing振子上物理残差降低49%，梯度方差降低2.18倍，参数减少5倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在Duffing振子数值基准上验证，与多输出Sobolev误差和超网络基线对比。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from spectral bias or mode collapse when modeling parameterized dynamical systems with sharp regime transitions.
summary_en.method: A Topology-Aware PINN (TAPINN) is proposed that structures the latent space via supervised metric regularization and uses alternating optimization to manage gradient conflicts.
summary_en.result: On the Duffing oscillator, TAPINN achieves 49% lower physics residual, 2.18x lower gradient variance, and 5x fewer parameters compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on the Duffing oscillator with comparisons to multi-output Sobolev error and hypernetwork baselines.

title: Patient-Specific Lattice Implants for Segmental Femoral and Tibial Reconstruction (Part 1): Defect Patterns, Fixation Strategies and Reconstruction Options-A Review.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Tallinn University of Technology, 19086 Tallinn, Estonia.

corresponding_authors.name: Irina Hussainova
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Tallinn University of Technology, 19086 Tallinn, Estonia.

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了股骨节段性缺损的晶格植入物，但未聚焦于髋关节假体柄的应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: This is a review of segmental defect reconstruction, not hip implant stress shielding or micromotion quantification; it lacks patient-specific femoral stem FEA with contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述CT引导的增材制造多孔植入物在股骨和胫骨大段骨缺损重建中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾27项研究，分析缺损分类、固定策略及力学环境。
summary_zh.result: 缺损形态和局部生物学是主要决定因素，晶格结构和相对密度影响刚度与微动。
summary_zh.validation: 70%研究采用仿真或力学测试，33%有体内数据，验证缺口明显。

summary_en.motivation: This review examines CT-based additively manufactured porous implants for reconstructing large segmental femoral and tibial defects.
summary_en.method: A systematic review of 27 studies analyzing defect classification, fixation strategies, and mechanical environment.
summary_en.result: Defect morphology and local biology are primary determinants; lattice architecture and relative density control stiffness and micromotion.
summary_en.validation: 70% of studies used simulation or mechanical testing, 33% included in vivo data, highlighting a validation gap.

title: Drug Release Modeling using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用物理信息神经网络结合实验数据预测药物释放，其框架可转移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanics, implant design, or constraint handling; it focuses on drug release in pharmaceutical systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统药物释放模型在复杂几何中的精度限制，利用PINN融合物理与数据。
summary_zh.method: 将菲克第二定律嵌入PINN损失函数，结合LHS采样和实验数据训练网络。
summary_zh.result: PINN在仅使用短时间数据时，均方根误差低于0.05，比经典模型误差降低40%。
summary_zh.validation: 使用公开药物释放实验数据，对比经典模型并评估噪声和有限数据下的表现。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limited accuracy of classical drug release models in complex geometries by integrating physical laws with experimental data.
summary_en.method: Fick's second law is embedded as a loss term in PINN with 10,000 Latin-hypercube collocation points, trained on short-term experimental data.
summary_en.result: The PINN achieves RMSE below 0.05 using only 6% of the release time for planar films and reduces mean error by up to 40% compared to classical models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on published experimental datasets for planar, wrinkled, and crumpled films under noisy and limited-data conditions.

key_terms.zh: 贝叶斯物理信息神经网络

title: Adaptive Physics Transformer with Fused Global-Local Attention for Subsurface Energy Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应物理变压器（APT）是一种几何、网格和物理无关的神经算子，可解决昂贵数值模拟的效率问题，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决地下能源系统全物理数值模拟计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出融合图编码器和全局注意力机制的几何无关神经算子APT
summary_zh.result: APT在规则和不规则网格上均优于现有架构，并具备超分辨率能力
summary_zh.validation: 在多个地下模拟任务上对比基准模型验证性能

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of full-physics numerical simulations in subsurface energy systems caused by geological heterogeneity and multi-scale coupling.
summary_en.method: Proposes the Adaptive Physics Transformer (APT), a geometry-agnostic neural operator that fuses a graph-based encoder for local features with global attention for long-range dependencies.
summary_en.result: APT outperforms state-of-the-art architectures on subsurface tasks across regular and irregular grids, and demonstrates robust super-resolution and cross-dataset learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of subsurface flow and transport simulations, including adaptive mesh refinement data.

title: Weighted Wasserstein Barycenter of Gaussian Processes for exotic Bayesian Optimization tasks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于Wasserstein重心的高斯过程融合方法，可用于贝叶斯优化中的多保真度、联邦等任务，其思想可迁移至代理模型构建和优化采样，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on Bayesian optimization algorithmic unification.

summary_zh.motivation: 统一多种异类贝叶斯优化任务，如联邦、批量、多保真度优化。
summary_zh.method: 利用加权Wasserstein重心融合高斯过程后验，不同任务仅需调整权重。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准任务上验证了框架的有效性，并比现有方法计算更高效。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，对比标准BO采集函数。

summary_en.motivation: To unify diverse exotic Bayesian optimization tasks (collaborative, batch, multi-fidelity) under a single framework using the weighted Wasserstein barycenter of Gaussian processes.
summary_en.method: The posterior distributions of Gaussian processes are aggregated via a weighted Wasserstein barycenter, with different tasks realized by adjusting the weighting scheme.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework matches or outperforms standard acquisition functions on benchmark tasks while offering computational efficiency gains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic and standard optimization problems, comparing against conventional BO methods.

title: Selective laser melting of stainless steel for biomedical implants: A critical review of processing, microstructure, and performance
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology
relevance_to_user: 该综述覆盖了不锈钢SLM工艺、微观结构和性能，但未涉及多孔结构设计或应力遮挡问题。
why_not_core: This paper is a general review of SLM stainless steel for implants, but does not specifically address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述不锈钢SLM在生物医用植入物中的工艺、组织和性能。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾SLM参数、微观结构演变和力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 总结了工艺-结构-性能关系及当前挑战。
summary_zh.validation: 文献综述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This review critically summarizes the processing, microstructure, and performance of selective laser melted stainless steel for biomedical implants.
summary_en.method: A systematic review of SLM parameters, microstructural evolution, and mechanical properties is presented.
summary_en.result: The process-structure-property relationships and current challenges are identified.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature review.

title: Model Design and Path Optimization of Perfusable Chips in Extrusion-Based Bioprinting: Linking Hydrogel Rheology with Structural Features.
first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Robotics and System, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150080, China.; School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150001, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Chunya Wu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Robotics and System, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150080, China.; School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150001, China.; Key Laboratory of Micro-systems and Micro-structures Manufacturing, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin, Heilongjiang 150080, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了挤出式生物打印中水凝胶流变性与结构特征的关系，但未涉及AI/ML方法，与AI生物打印方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on empirical rheology-path optimization without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索水凝胶流变性、模型结构与打印路径之间的相互作用
summary_zh.method: 系统评估低/高粘度水凝胶的打印性，并针对含悬垂结构的可灌注芯片优化路径
summary_zh.result: 成功打印10×10 mm²悬垂结构，芯片最大爆破压力1.2 kPa
summary_zh.validation: 通过打印阵列和3D网格验证打印性，并测试芯片的流动和密封性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the interplay among hydrogel rheology, structural design, and printing path planning in extrusion-based bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Printability of low- and high-viscosity hydrogels was evaluated via pattern arrays and 3D grids; path optimization was performed for a perfusable chip with overhanging features based on rheological properties.
summary_en.result: A 10×10 mm² overhanging structure was successfully fabricated, and perfusable chips achieved a maximum burst pressure of 1.2 kPa.
summary_en.validation: Printability was validated through fabrication of pattern arrays and 3D grid constructs; chip performance was tested via flow and burst pressure measurements.

title: Foundation Inference Models for Ordinary Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种预训练的基础推理模型，可快速从噪声轨迹推断ODE向量场，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建，但未涉及有限元分析或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on ODE inference from trajectories.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有ODE推断方法需要复杂训练或领域先验，缺乏通用预训练模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出FIM-ODE，基于神经算子预训练，从噪声轨迹直接预测向量场。
summary_zh.result: 零样本性能优于ODEFormer，微调后超越现代神经和GP基线。
summary_zh.validation: 在低阶多项式ODE先验分布上预训练，并在多种ODE基准上测试。

summary_en.motivation: Current ODE inference methods require complex training pipelines or system-specific priors, motivating a pretrained foundation model for amortized inference.
summary_en.method: FIM-ODE uses a neural operator to predict vector fields directly from noisy trajectories in a single forward pass, pretrained on a prior distribution over low-degree polynomial ODEs.
summary_en.result: The model achieves strong zero-shot performance, matching or exceeding ODEFormer, and finetuning yields fast adaptation outperforming modern neural and GP baselines.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on various ODE systems demonstrate zero-shot and finetuning performance compared to symbolic regression, GP, and Neural ODE baselines.

title: Inhomogeneous Priors for Bayesian Inverse Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非平稳先验方法可用于生物力学逆问题中的不确定性量化，但未直接涉及有限元代理模型或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on Bayesian inverse problems with inhomogeneous priors in imaging contexts.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯逆问题中空间不均匀性导致的先验假设局限
summary_zh.method: 通过白噪声卷积构造非平稳Whittle-Matern随机场先验
summary_zh.result: 在去噪和层析成像中显著提升重建质量与不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 一维去噪和二维有限角度X射线层析成像数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitation of globally homogeneous Gaussian priors in capturing spatially inhomogeneous structures in Bayesian inverse problems.
summary_en.method: A new class of inhomogeneous priors is introduced via convolution with white noise, yielding nonstationary Whittle-Matern random fields with rigorous mathematical construction and efficient sampling through pseudo-differential equations.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments in 1D denoising and 2D limited-angle X-ray tomography show significant improvements in reconstruction quality and uncertainty quantification, especially in data-limited scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on 1D denoising and 2D limited-angle X-ray tomography problems.

key_terms.zh: 有限角度X射线层析成像

title: Adaptive Acquisition Selection for Bayesian Optimization with Large Language Models
relevance_to_user: 该方法将LLM用于贝叶斯优化中的采集函数选择，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中采集函数的选择非平稳且依赖问题，现有方法忽略丰富状态信息。
summary_zh.method: 提出LMABO框架，利用预训练大语言模型作为零样本在线策略，根据结构化状态选择采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 在50个基准问题上，LMABO显著优于静态、自适应组合及其他基于LLM的基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准问题上进行性能对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: The optimal acquisition function in Bayesian optimization is non-stationary and problem-dependent, yet existing adaptive portfolio methods ignore rich state information such as remaining budget or surrogate model characteristics.
summary_en.method: LMABO casts a pre-trained large language model as a zero-shot online strategist that selects the most suitable acquisition function from a diverse portfolio based on a structured state representation at each iteration.
summary_en.result: Across 50 benchmark problems, LMABO demonstrates significant performance improvements over strong static, adaptive portfolio, and other LLM-based baselines.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark problems, comparing against multiple baselines.

title: Surrogate Modeling for Neutron Transport: A Neural Operator Approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经算子替代昂贵的数值求解器，方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on neutron transport with no biomedical context, no constraint handling, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速中子传输计算，实现实时数字孪生。
summary_zh.method: 分别用DeepONet和FNO学习从中子源到角通量的映射。
summary_zh.result: 两种代理模型在精度上接近传统求解器，速度提升超过1000倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种散射比和源配置下与SN求解器对比。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate expensive neutron transport simulations for real-time digital twin and design optimization applications.
summary_en.method: DeepONet and Fourier Neural Operator are trained to map anisotropic neutron sources to angular fluxes in 1D slab geometry.
summary_en.result: Both surrogates achieve high accuracy (deviations ~100 pcm) with runtime less than 0.1% of conventional SN solver on fine grids.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on unseen source configurations and integrated into k-eigenvalue solver, compared against reference SN solutions.

title: Nonparametric Bayesian Optimization for General Rewards
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的非参数贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or biomechanical implant design; it focuses on general reward optimization with no-regret guarantees.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决一般奖励设置下贝叶斯优化的遗憾界问题
summary_zh.method: 提出无限高斯过程作为替代模型，结合汤普森采样进行探索与利用
summary_zh.result: 在非平稳、重尾等复杂奖励设置中取得最优性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证算法性能

summary_en.motivation: To achieve no-regret Bayesian optimization under general reward model uncertainty with only Lipschitz continuity.
summary_en.method: Proposes an infinite Gaussian process surrogate model combined with Thompson sampling and a novel regret analysis framework based on total variation distance.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates state-of-the-art performance on non-stationary, heavy-tailed, and ill-conditioned reward settings.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks comparing against classical GP-based BO methods.

title: Flow-Based Conformal Predictive Distributions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于流的共形预测分布方法，可高效生成高维预测集并量化不确定性，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化任务。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on conformal prediction for general high-dimensional outputs.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维输出空间中共形预测集难以表示和采样的问题
summary_zh.method: 利用可微非一致性分数诱导确定性流，沿流采样共形边界并混合置信水平得到预测分布
summary_zh.result: 在PDE反问题、降水降尺度等任务上验证了方法的计算效率和近似误差分解
summary_zh.validation: 通过PDE反问题、气候模型偏差校正等数值案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient sampling and representation of conformal prediction sets in high-dimensional output spaces for downstream tasks.
summary_en.method: A deterministic flow is induced by a differentiable nonconformity score, whose trajectories converge to the conformal prediction set boundary; mixing across confidence levels yields conformal predictive distributions.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves computationally efficient, training-free sampling of conformal boundaries, with an approximation bound decomposing error into score distortion, base measure quality, and flow distortion.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on PDE inverse problems, precipitation downscaling, climate model debiasing, and hurricane trajectory forecasting.

title: Mechanistic Investigation of Microdroplet Formation in High-Viscosity Shear-Thinning Hydrogel Bioinks.
first_author_affiliation: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Peng Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mechatronics Engineering, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150001, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高粘度剪切变稀水凝胶生物墨水的微滴形成机理，但未涉及AI集成，其物理建模方法可迁移至AI辅助生物打印中的过程建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on mechanistic CFD and experimental validation without machine learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 高粘度剪切变稀水凝胶难以通过喷墨打印稳定喷射，需稀释或改配方。
summary_zh.method: 提出瞬态剪切喷射法，结合高频电磁阀和CFD建模优化驱动参数。
summary_zh.result: 实现了2.5%海藻酸钠的稳定液滴生成，液滴尺寸可通过行程长度调节。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验验证液滴生成稳定性，并与CFD模拟结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: High-viscosity shear-thinning hydrogel bioinks are difficult to jet stably in drop-on-demand inkjet bioprinting without dilution or reformulation.
summary_en.method: A transient shear-enabled jetting method using a high-frequency electromagnetic microvalve is developed, coupled with a rheology-informed CFD and FEM modeling framework to link actuation parameters to droplet formation.
summary_en.result: Stable droplet generation of 2.5% sodium alginate is achieved with tunable droplet size via stroke length and driving conditions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation of droplet stability and size control is performed, corroborated by CFD simulations.

title: BONSAI: Bayesian Optimization with Natural Simplicity and Interpretability
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的默认感知贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标约束优化问题，但未涉及有限元代理模型或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling in multi-objective optimization, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化常将弱相关参数推向边界，增加验证负担。
summary_zh.method: 提出BONSAI策略，通过修剪低影响偏差并控制采集值损失实现默认感知优化。
summary_zh.result: 在保持优化性能的同时大幅减少非默认参数数量，计算开销仅为标准BO的1.5倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个真实世界基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization often pushes weakly relevant parameters to the boundary, complicating the vetting of recommendations.
summary_en.method: BONSAI introduces a default-aware acquisition policy that prunes low-impact deviations while explicitly controlling the loss in acquisition value.
summary_en.result: BONSAI substantially reduces the number of non-default parameters while maintaining competitive optimization performance, with only 1.5x the candidate-generation cost of standard BO.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on multiple real-world benchmark problems demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: Are Deep Learning Based Hybrid PDE Solvers Reliable? Why Training Paradigms and Update Strategies Matter
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究深度学习混合PDE求解器的可靠性，其物理感知加速方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的训练与迭代优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to biomedical implant design or biomechanics FEA, nor does it address multi-objective constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度学习混合PDE求解器可能停滞在虚假不动点，可靠性存疑。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理感知的Anderson加速（PA-AA），最小化物理残差而非不动点更新。
summary_zh.result: PA-AA在更少迭代次数内恢复可靠收敛，解决AI求解器争议。
summary_zh.validation: 在DeepONet和Fourier神经求解器上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Deep learning-based hybrid PDE solvers may stagnate at false fixed points, raising reliability concerns in scientific computing.
summary_en.method: Physics-aware Anderson acceleration (PA-AA) is introduced to minimize the physical residual instead of the fixed-point update.
summary_en.result: PA-AA restores reliable convergence in substantially fewer iterations, addressing controversies around AI-based PDE solvers.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on DeepONet-based HINTS and FFT-based Fourier neural solver validate the method.

key_terms.zh: 深度学习混合迭代方法

title: SpectraKAN: Conditioning Spectral Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种输入条件化的谱神经算子，可提升PDE求解效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计验证。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate tasks, no implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有谱算子使用静态傅里叶核，无法适应多尺度和各向异性动力学。
summary_zh.method: 通过全局表示调制多尺度傅里叶主干，实现输入条件化的谱卷积。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE基准上RMSE降低高达49%，尤其擅长时空预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证，无实验或生物力学案例。

summary_en.motivation: Existing spectral neural operators apply static Fourier kernels uniformly, limiting their ability to capture multi-scale and anisotropic dynamics.
summary_en.method: SpectraKAN conditions the spectral operator on the input by extracting a compact global representation and modulating a multi-scale Fourier trunk via cross-attention.
summary_en.result: The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on diverse PDE benchmarks, reducing RMSE by up to 49% over strong baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical PDE benchmarks without experimental or biomechanical case studies.

title: Pragmatic Curiosity: A Unified Framework for Hybrid Learning and Optimization via Active Inference
relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移至生物力学FEA替代建模中的高效采样与不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA-based surrogate modeling, implant design, or biomechanical constraints, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵黑箱评估中学习与优化耦合问题
summary_zh.method: 提出Pragmatic Curiosity框架，通过主动推断平衡信息增益与遗憾
summary_zh.result: 在多个场景中降低决策风险并提高关键区域覆盖
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟案例验证框架有效性

summary_en.motivation: To address the need for a unified approach that couples learning and optimization in expensive black-box evaluations.
summary_en.method: Proposes Pragmatic Curiosity, an active inference framework that trades off information gain about task-relevant latents against expected regret.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates reduced downstream decision risk and improved coverage of critical outcome regions across three regimes.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulation case studies in plume monitoring, active search, and composite Bayesian optimization.

title: Iterative Data-Consistent Inversion with Multiple Push-forward Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种处理多约束不确定性问题的方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的多目标优化与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on measure-theoretic inversion with multiple push-forward constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多观测数据下参数分布需同时满足多个推前约束的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 提出迭代数据一致性反演框架，通过最小化累积f-散度收敛到多约束解。
summary_zh.result: 理论证明最优性，数值算例验证高维PDE参数空间的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高维PDE数值算例验证方法收敛性与鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: To estimate a parameter probability measure that simultaneously satisfies multiple push-forward constraints from distinct observational data sets.
summary_en.method: An iterative data-consistent inversion scheme that minimizes cumulative f-divergence across all constraints, proven to converge to the maximal entropy solution.
summary_en.result: The method achieves robust convergence in high-dimensional PDE-constrained parameter spaces without approximating joint observed measures.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on high-dimensional PDE problems demonstrate the method's convergence and practical utility.

title: High-precision path planning for multi-material 3D bioprinting of complex structures.
first_author_affiliation: State Key Laboratory of High-Performance Precision Manufacturing, School of Mechanical Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China.

corresponding_authors.name: Danyang Zhao
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of High-Performance Precision Manufacturing, School of Mechanical Engineering, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China.; Department of Cardiology, Central Hospital of Dalian University of Technology, Dalian 116024, People's Republic of China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了多材料3D生物打印的路径规划策略，虽未直接集成AI，但其优化方法可迁移至AI驱动的打印路径规划。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; it uses a deterministic optimization strategy without learning or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 多喷头协同打印存在喷嘴干涉和几何保真度问题，需优化路径规划。
summary_zh.method: 提出层内重分区与自适应模式切换的路径规划策略MN-CAPP。
summary_zh.result: 打印效率提升约33%，小尺度支架孔扩散度改善33.8%，异质模型尺寸偏差≤4%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Y型血管模型和兔肝胆模型打印验证精度与效率。

summary_en.motivation: Multi-nozzle collaborative bioprinting faces challenges of nozzle interference and inconsistent geometric fidelity for asymmetric heterogeneous structures.
summary_en.method: A multi-nozzle collaborative and alternating printing path (MN-CAPP) strategy is proposed, integrating intra-layer repartitioning and adaptive mode switching based on ink rheology.
summary_en.result: MN-CAPP improves printing efficiency by over 32% compared to single-nozzle printing, enhances pore diffusion by 33.8% in small scaffolds, and achieves dimensional deviation ≤4% in a rabbit hepatobiliary model.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed by fabricating Y-shaped vascular models and a heterogeneous rabbit hepatobiliary model, with quantitative measurements of efficiency, pore diffusion, and dimensional accuracy.

title: A Fast and Generalizable Fourier Neural Operator-Based Surrogate for Melt-Pool Prediction in Laser Processing
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于傅里叶神经算子的代理模型，用于激光加工中的熔池预测，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical context; it focuses on laser welding melt-pool prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真激光焊接仿真计算成本高，限制了大规模工艺探索和实时应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出LP-FNO，在移动激光框架下进行时间平均，将瞬态问题转化为准稳态，学习过程参数到温度场和熔池边界的映射。
summary_zh.result: 温度预测误差约1%，熔池分割IoU超过0.9，推理速度比传统有限体积法快十万倍。
summary_zh.validation: 基于FLOW-3D WELD多物理场仿真数据，在粗网格训练后评估细网格预测能力。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity simulations of laser welding are computationally expensive, limiting large-scale process exploration and real-time applications.
summary_en.method: We propose LP-FNO, a Fourier Neural Operator surrogate that reformulates the transient problem in a moving laser frame with temporal averaging to achieve quasi-steady state, learning the mapping from process parameters to 3D temperature fields and melt-pool boundaries.
summary_en.result: The model achieves temperature prediction errors around 1% and melt-pool segmentation IoU over 0.9, with inference speeds up to 100,000 times faster than traditional finite volume solvers.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using multiphysics simulation data from FLOW-3D WELD, with evaluation on coarse-to-fine grid transferability.

title: Multi Objective Design Optimization of Non Pneumatic Passenger Car Tires Using Finite Element Modeling, Machine Learning, and Particle swarm Optimization and Bayesian Optimization Algorithms
relevance_to_user: 该论文将机器学习代理模型与多目标优化结合用于轮胎设计，其方法可迁移至植入物或生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, bone-implant interface mechanics, or any biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 非充气轮胎的辐条结构在刚度、耐久性和振动方面存在挑战，需要高效优化方法。
summary_zh.method: 采用参数化生成设计、机器学习代理模型（KRR、XGBoost）及PSO和贝叶斯优化进行多目标优化。
summary_zh.result: 实现了53%的刚度可调性、50%的耐久性提升和43%的振动降低。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真验证优化设计的性能改进。

summary_en.motivation: Non-pneumatic tires with discontinuous spoke structures face challenges in stiffness tuning, durability, and high-speed vibration, necessitating an efficient optimization framework.
summary_en.method: An integrated framework combining generative design, machine learning surrogates (KRR for stiffness, XGBoost for durability and vibration), and multi-objective optimization (PSO and Bayesian optimization) was developed.
summary_en.result: The optimized spoke designs achieved 53% stiffness tunability, up to 50% durability improvement, and 43% vibration reduction compared to the baseline.
summary_en.validation: Performance improvements were validated through finite element simulations of the optimized designs.

title: Joint Parameter and State-Space Bayesian Optimization: Using Process Expertise to Accelerate Manufacturing Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合过程专家知识和结构化概率模型的贝叶斯优化框架，可加速多阶段制造过程的优化，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for structural mechanics; it focuses on manufacturing process optimization with state-space observations.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化忽略中间观测和过程结构，难以优化高维多阶段制造系统。
summary_zh.method: 提出POGPN-JPSS框架，结合部分可观测高斯过程网络与联合参数状态空间建模，利用专家知识提取低维潜在特征。
summary_zh.result: 在生物乙醇生产仿真中，该方法比现有方法快两倍达到性能阈值，且可靠性更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高维多阶段生物乙醇生产仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization ignores intermediate observations and process structure, limiting its performance in high-dimensional multi-stage manufacturing systems.
summary_en.method: We propose POGPN-JPSS, a framework that combines Partially Observable Gaussian Process Networks with Joint Parameter and State-Space modeling to leverage expert knowledge for extracting low-dimensional latent features from high-dimensional state-space data.
summary_en.result: On a challenging bioethanol production simulation, POGPN-JPSS achieves the desired performance threshold twice as fast and with greater reliability compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on a high-dimensional multi-stage simulation of bioethanol production.

title: Joint Parameter and State-Space Bayesian Optimization: Using Process Expertise to Accelerate Manufacturing Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合过程专家知识和结构化概率模型的贝叶斯优化方法，可加速高维多阶段制造过程的优化，其方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification for structural mechanics; it focuses on manufacturing process optimization with intermediate observations.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准贝叶斯优化忽略多阶段制造过程的中间观测和结构，导致高维优化效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出POGPN-JPSS框架，结合部分可观测高斯过程网络与联合参数状态空间建模，利用专家知识提取低维潜在特征。
summary_zh.result: 在生物乙醇生产仿真中，该方法比现有方法快两倍达到性能阈值，且可靠性更高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高维多阶段生物乙醇生产仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization ignores intermediate observations and process structure in multi-stage manufacturing, limiting its efficiency in high-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: The proposed POGPN-JPSS framework integrates Partially Observable Gaussian Process Networks with Joint Parameter and State-Space modeling, leveraging expert knowledge to extract low-dimensional latent features from high-dimensional state-space data.
summary_en.result: On a high-dimensional bioethanol production simulation, POGPN-JPSS achieves the desired performance threshold twice as fast and with greater reliability compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a challenging, high-dimensional simulation of a multi-stage bioethanol production process.

title: Effect of extramedullary fixation under different biomechanical modes on osseointegration of short-stem intramedullary implants: an experimental study.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Xijing Hospital, Air Force Medical University of PLA, Xi'an, People's Republic of China.; Department of Orthopedics, 902nd Hospital, Joint Support Force of PLA, Bengbu, People's Republic of China.

corresponding_authors.name: Jing Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Xijing Hospital, Air Force Medical University of PLA, Xi'an, People's Republic of China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过动物实验研究了低弹性模量髓外固定对短柄髓内植入物骨整合的增强作用，与用户关注的LPBF多孔植入物应力屏蔽和骨整合方向有方法学关联，但未涉及LPBF制造或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, porous structure design, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同弹性模量髓外固定对短柄髓内植入物骨整合的影响
summary_zh.method: 兔模型植入3D打印短柄髓内植入物，比较低弹性模量和高弹性模量髓外固定组
summary_zh.result: 低弹性模量组在骨痂形成和骨整合指标上显著优于高弹性模量组
summary_zh.validation: 通过X光、CT和组织学分析验证骨整合效果

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate how extramedullary fixation with low versus high elastic modulus affects osseointegration of short-stem intramedullary implants in a rabbit model.
summary_en.method: Twenty-four rabbits received 3D-printed custom short-stem intramedullary implants with either low or high elastic modulus extramedullary fixation components, and were followed for 6 and 12 weeks.
summary_en.result: The low elastic modulus group showed significantly greater callus formation, bone ingrowth, and osseointegration compared to the high elastic modulus group at 12 weeks.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through weekly X-rays, CT quantification of callus, and histological analysis of bone-implant contact and new bone area.

title: An Efficient Bayesian Framework for Inverse Problems via Optimization and Inversion: Surrogate Modeling, Parameter Inference, and Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化与反演框架可迁移至植入物力学设计中的代理建模与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; only tested on analytical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解计算昂贵的逆问题并量化不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 贝叶斯优化自适应构建高斯过程代理模型，结合贝叶斯反演推断参数后验。
summary_zh.result: 在多个解析基准上验证了代理精度与反演鲁棒性，计算成本显著降低。
summary_zh.validation: 一维和二维解析函数测试（混合高斯-周期、Lévy等）。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve inverse problems with expensive high-fidelity models while providing rigorous uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Bayesian optimization adaptively constructs Gaussian process surrogates, which are then used in Bayesian inversion to infer parameter posteriors.
summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates accurate surrogate modeling and robust parameter inference on multiple analytical benchmarks with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on one- and two-dimensional analytical functions including Mixed Gaussian-Periodic, Lévy, Griewank, Forrester, and Rosenbrock.

title: Variational Sparse Paired Autoencoders (vsPAIR) for Inverse Problems and Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种可解释的不确定性量化框架，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的逆问题求解。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA surrogate or biomechanics design; experiments limited to image inpainting and CT.

summary_zh.motivation: 逆问题需要快速推理与不确定性估计，现有方法难以兼顾。
summary_zh.method: 提出变分稀疏配对自编码器，通过标准VAE与稀疏VAE配对及潜在映射实现。
summary_zh.result: 在盲修复和CT重建中展示了可解释的结构化不确定性估计。
summary_zh.validation: 在图像修复和CT数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Inverse problems require both fast inference and uncertainty quantification, which existing methods struggle to provide simultaneously.
summary_en.method: A variational sparse paired autoencoder (vsPAIR) is proposed, pairing a standard VAE for observations with a sparse VAE for quantities of interest via a learned latent mapping.
summary_en.result: The method yields interpretable and structured uncertainty estimates on blind inpainting and computed tomography tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for image inpainting and computed tomography reconstruction.

title: Single step nanosecond laser structuring for cost effective functional titanium surfaces with topography driven preosteoblast adhesion.
first_author_affiliation: Danylo Halytsky Lviv National Medical University, Pekarska Str. 69, Lviv, 79010, Ukraine.

corresponding_authors.name: Joanna Kisała
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Exact and Technical Sciences, University of Rzeszow, Pigonia 1 Str., Rzeszow, 35-310, Poland. jkisala@ur.edu.pl.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及钛表面激光处理对成骨前体细胞粘附的影响，但与应力遮挡、LPBF制造或疲劳测试无直接关联。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索低成本纳秒激光处理钛表面促进骨整合的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 使用两种能量密度的纳秒激光处理钛表面，并进行表面表征和细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 激光处理表面粗糙疏水，无细胞毒性，支持前成骨细胞粘附和增殖。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS、XRD、接触角等表征及小鼠前成骨细胞系体外实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether single-step nanosecond laser processing can create micro/nanostructured titanium surfaces that promote preosteoblast adhesion and osseointegration at lower cost than femtosecond methods.
summary_en.method: Titanium substrates were treated with nanosecond laser at two pulse energies, and surfaces were characterized by SEM, EDS, XRD, Raman, ToF-SIMS, contact angle, and topography; biological response was assessed using mouse preosteoblast cell line.
summary_en.result: Both laser regimes produced rough, hydrophobic surfaces with moderate oxidation; surfaces were non-cytotoxic and supported preosteoblast proliferation and adhesion.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays (cytotoxicity, proliferation, adhesion) combined with extensive surface characterization.

title: Score-based diffusion models for diffuse optical tomography with uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文将扩散模型用于光学断层成像的不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的后验采样与不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element analysis, surrogate modeling for structural mechanics, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on diffuse optical tomography.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决扩散光学断层成像中高度病态逆问题的后验采样与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用无条件表示条件分数函数框架，并引入混合分数正则化防止过拟合。
summary_zh.result: 数据驱动先验生成的后验样本方差低且接近真实值，优于经典模型方法。
summary_zh.validation: 使用仿真和实验测量数据验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve posterior sampling and uncertainty quantification for severely ill-posed inverse problems in diffuse optical tomography.
summary_en.method: The unconditional representation for conditional score function framework is employed, with a novel mixed score regularization to prevent overfitting.
summary_en.result: Data-driven priors yield posterior samples with low variance centered around ground truth, outperforming classical model-based estimation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using both simulated and experimental measurement data.

title: Predicting porosity in laser powder bed fusion of metals (PBF-LB/M) using scanning data and machine learning

why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks mechanical testing (fatigue or static), and does not report surface roughness or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用扫描数据和机器学习在线预测LPBF金属件孔隙率
summary_zh.method: 嵌入高速扫描采集装置提取热点特征，结合LSBoost模型预测孔隙

summary_en.motivation: To enable in situ porosity prediction in laser powder bed fusion by linking scan behavior to defect formation.
summary_en.method: A high-speed scan acquisition device records layer-wise exposure paths, from which hotspot features are derived and used to train machine learning models (e.g., LSBoost) for porosity prediction.
summary_en.result: LSBoost achieves MAE ≈ 7.29 for total pore count per layer, with better accuracy for pores >0.100 mm, though outliers are underestimated.
summary_en.validation: Ground-truth porosity from XCT of a qualification artifact containing multiple geometries including lattice structures.

title: NeuroPareto: Calibrated Acquisition for Costly Many-Goal Search in Vast Parameter Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合贝叶斯分类器与深度高斯过程的昂贵多目标优化方法，可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型辅助优化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant design problems; no contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维搜索空间中昂贵多目标优化面临计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 集成排序过滤、不确定性解耦和历史条件采集的神经帕累托架构
summary_zh.result: 在标准测试集和能源任务上优于基线方法
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试与地下能源提取案例验证

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently searching for optimal trade-offs in high-dimensional spaces under limited evaluations remains a critical challenge in multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.method: NeuroPareto integrates rank-centric filtering, uncertainty disentanglement via deep Gaussian processes, and a history-conditioned acquisition network to guide expensive evaluations.
summary_en.result: The method consistently outperforms classifier-enhanced and surrogate-assisted baselines in Pareto proximity and hypervolume on DTLZ, ZDT, and a subsurface energy extraction task.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks (DTLZ, ZDT) and a subsurface energy extraction simulation case.

title: BayeSQP: Bayesian Optimization through Sequential Quadratic Programming
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合序列二次规划与贝叶斯优化的方法，可迁移用于生物力学设计中的约束优化问题，但未涉及FEA或植入物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogates, biomechanics, or implant design, and lacks validation on biomedical sampling efficiency problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决黑箱优化中约束处理与不确定性量化的难题
summary_zh.method: 结合二阶高斯过程代理与序列二次规划，构建含不确定性的子问题
summary_zh.result: 在高维优化任务上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准数值基准测试集的性能对比

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of handling constraints and uncertainty in black-box optimization.
summary_en.method: Merges sequential quadratic programming with Bayesian optimization using second-order Gaussian process surrogates for objective and constraints, formulating a stochastic subproblem as a second-order cone program.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on high-dimensional optimization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on standard numerical benchmark functions comparing against baseline Bayesian optimization and constrained optimization methods.

title: A Probabilistic Framework for Solving High-Frequency Helmholtz Equations via Diffusion Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的概率框架可用于解决高频波动问题，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至植入物生物力学设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on Helmholtz equations and wave propagation, not on solid mechanics or implant design, and does not include any biomedical or biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 确定性神经算子难以逼近高频波动问题，存在谱偏差和输入敏感性。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于分数条件扩散算子的概率框架，用于求解高频亥姆霍兹方程。
summary_zh.result: 概率神经算子在L2、H1和能量范数上误差最低，并能捕获不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验与多种数据驱动方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Deterministic neural operators struggle with high-frequency wave phenomena due to spectral bias and strong input sensitivity.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic framework using score-based conditional diffusion operators is developed to solve high-frequency Helmholtz equations.
summary_en.result: The probabilistic neural operator achieves the lowest errors in L2, H1, and energy norms and captures input-to-solution uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments across a wide frequency range benchmarked against popular data-driven and ML approaches.

title: Shaping hydrogel bioinks into 3D, multiscale, perfusable models using multimodal printing.
venue: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于多模态生物打印平台，未涉及AI集成，但与生物打印工艺相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance toward autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服软水凝胶生物墨水在制造多尺度复杂结构时的局限性。
summary_zh.method: 结合数字光投影与双光子消融的多模态打印平台。
summary_zh.result: 成功制造厘米级含微米级可灌注拓扑结构的生物墨水构建体。
summary_zh.validation: 通过制造微流控芯片和肺泡-毛细血管界面模型进行实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the inherent trade-offs in fabricating multiscale, multi-material, and topologically complex 3D structures using soft hydrogel bioinks.
summary_en.method: A multimodal printing platform combining additive digital light projection (DLP) and subtractive two-photon ablation (TPA) with multi-material exchange.
summary_en.result: Centimeter-scale bioink constructs with embedded microscale perfusable topologies were fabricated, including microfluidic chips and alveoli-capillary mimics.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through fabrication of perfusable microfluidic devices and endothelialized microchannels.

title: Physics-Informed Chebyshev Polynomial Neural Operator for Parametric Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于切比雪夫多项式的物理信息神经算子，可用于参数化偏微分方程的高效求解，其方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant mechanics, stress shielding, or any biomedical application; it focuses on general PDE surrogates with no validation on biomechanical FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服MLP在物理信息神经算子中的谱偏差和训练不稳定性
summary_zh.method: 用切比雪夫谱基替代单隐层网络，构建近最优函数空间的神经算子
summary_zh.result: 在基准参数化PDE上精度更高、收敛更快、超参数鲁棒性更强
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准和跨音速翼型流动算例上验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome spectral bias and training instability caused by MLP architectures in physics-informed neural operators.
summary_en.method: A mesh-free neural operator framework that replaces MLP with a numerically stable Chebyshev spectral basis and incorporates a parameter-dependent modulation mechanism.
summary_en.result: CPNO achieves superior accuracy, faster convergence, and enhanced robustness on benchmark parametric PDEs and transonic airfoil flow.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard parametric PDE benchmarks and a transonic airfoil flow problem.

title: PINN-Based Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with RAR-D Adaptive Sampling for Solving Elliptic Interface Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于KAN的PINN架构和自适应采样方法虽然针对椭圆界面问题，但可以迁移到生物力学中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained multi-objective optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific design validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有基于MLP的PINN求解椭圆界面问题时需要大网络和长训练时间。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于KAN的PINN架构，采用双KAN结构并集成RAR-D自适应采样策略。
summary_zh.result: 相比标准PINN，该方法以更小的网络规模和更快的收敛速度实现了更高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在椭圆界面问题的数值实验中验证了均匀误差分布和准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard MLP-based PINNs require large networks and extensive training for complex interface problems.
summary_en.method: A novel PINN architecture using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) with a dual KAN structure and RAR-D adaptive sampling is proposed.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves superior accuracy and faster convergence with significantly smaller network sizes compared to standard PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on elliptic interface problems demonstrate uniformly distributed errors and high accuracy.

title: Observation-dependent Bayesian active learning via input-warped Gaussian processes

why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准高斯过程后验方差对观测值不敏感，限制了主动学习效率。
summary_zh.method: 通过可学习的单调输入扭曲注入观测依赖反馈，并采用自监督目标训练。
summary_zh.result: 在非平稳主动学习基准上显著提升采样效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个主动学习基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Gaussian process posterior variance is insensitive to observed outputs, limiting active learning efficiency.
summary_en.method: Inject observation-dependent feedback via a learned monotonic input warping, trained with a self-supervised objective.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly improves sample efficiency on non-stationary active learning benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple active learning benchmark datasets.

title: Effect of powder reuse on forming characteristics and mechanical properties of SLM formed Ti-6Al-4V
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming, 650500, PR China

corresponding_authors.affiliation: National-Local joint Engineering Laboratory for Technology of Advanced Metallic Solidifcation Forming and Equipment, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Kunming University of Science and Technology, Kunming, 650093, PR China
