summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of powder reuse on the forming characteristics and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Experimental comparison of microstructure and mechanical properties of specimens fabricated with different powder reuse cycles.
summary_en.result: Powder reuse significantly affects density, surface quality, and tensile properties of the SLM-formed parts.
summary_en.validation: Validation through tensile testing and microstructural characterization.

title: Comparison of Trefftz-Based PINNs and Standard PINNs Focusing on Structure Preservation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的Trefftz-PINN方法在结构保持方面优于标准PINN，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on structure preservation in magnetic field and CFD problems without implant/biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN在低MSE下可能破坏全局物理结构，需改进。
summary_zh.method: 对比标准PINN与Trefftz-PINN在磁场和CFD问题中的结构保持能力。
summary_zh.result: Trefftz-PINN能保持全局拓扑结构，而标准PINN可能失效。
summary_zh.validation: 使用精确解采样数据，在相同MSE水平下比较磁场线和流线可视化。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs may fail to preserve global physical structures even with low MSE, motivating a structure-preserving alternative.
summary_en.method: A comparative study between standard PINNs and Trefftz-PINNs is conducted on magnetic field and CFD problems using identical training data from exact solutions.
summary_en.result: Trefftz-PINNs successfully preserve global topology of field lines, whereas standard PINNs exhibit structural collapse under matched MSE levels.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by visualizing magnetic field lines and CFD streamlines at matched MSE levels, comparing against exact solutions.

title: Co-Design of Rover Wheels and Control using Bayesian Optimization and Rover-Terrain Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文将贝叶斯优化用于轮式机器人设计与控制的联合优化，其多目标优化和仿真加速方法可迁移至植入物设计中的FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on rover-terrain simulation and control co-design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真地形仿真计算昂贵，限制了全车联合优化
summary_zh.method: 使用贝叶斯优化联合优化车轮几何与转向控制参数
summary_zh.result: 联合优化优于顺序优化，仿真时间从数月降至数天
summary_zh.validation: 初步硬件实验验证了仿真优化结果的趋势一致性

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity deformable terrain simulations are computationally expensive, limiting their use in full-vehicle co-optimization of mechanical design and control.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework co-designs rover wheel geometry and steering PID gains using efficient continuum-representation terrain simulations.
summary_en.result: Simultaneous co-optimization outperforms sequential design, reducing simulation time from months to days while achieving balanced performance.
summary_en.validation: Preliminary hardware experiments confirm that simulation-optimized wheel designs preserve relative performance trends on a physical rover.

title: An Open-Source Automated Pipeline for Quantitative Morphological Analysis of 3D-Bioprinted Cancer Cell Spheroids.

summary_en.motivation: To establish a reproducible and high-throughput pipeline for generating and quantitatively analyzing 3D cancer spheroids via bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Spheroid-laden GelMA droplets are bioprinted using a CELLINK BioX printer, followed by automated morphological analysis using a custom CellProfiler and ImageJ pipeline.
summary_en.result: The pipeline enables robust, high-throughput formation and quantitative characterization of 3D spheroids for cancer research.

title: Multimodal Scientific Learning Beyond Diffusions and Flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合密度网络（MDN）方法可用于生物力学设计中的多模态不确定性量化，但未涉及有限元代理建模或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on general multimodal uncertainty quantification in scientific regression tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 科学机器学习需要处理多模态条件不确定性，现有扩散/流模型数据需求高且计算昂贵。
summary_zh.method: 提出混合密度网络（MDN）作为显式参数密度估计器，用于多模态不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: Scientific machine learning requires models that capture multimodal conditional uncertainty, but current diffusion and flow-based methods are data-hungry and computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: This work proposes Mixture Density Networks (MDNs) as explicit parametric density estimators for multimodal uncertainty quantification, imposing an inductive bias tailored to low-dimensional physics.
summary_en.result: MDNs achieve superior generalization, interpretability, and sample efficiency across inverse, multistable, and chaotic regression tasks, especially in data-scarce regimes.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks including inverse problems, multistable systems, and chaotic dynamics.

title: Decoupled Diffusion Sampling for Inverse Problems on Function Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种解耦扩散采样方法用于逆问题求解，其数据高效和物理感知特性可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的约束优化与不确定性量化。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome data inefficiency and over-smoothing in joint diffusion models for inverse PDE problems.

summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance under sparse observations, with 11% lower l2 error and 54% lower spectral error on average; maintains 40% l2 advantage when training data is limited to 1%.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for inverse PDE problems with sparse observation settings.

why_not_core: This paper focuses on compressible Navier-Stokes equations and turbulent flows, not on implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or biomedical design optimization.

summary_en.motivation: To address the accumulation of auto-regressive error and violation of physical conservation in neural operator models for long-term PDE simulation.
summary_en.method: A model-agnostic conserved quantity correction technique that enforces physical conservation criteria during inference.

summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on compressible Navier-Stokes equations with multiple neural operator architectures.

title: E-QRGMM: Efficient Generative Metamodeling for Covariate-Dependent Uncertainty Quantification

why_not_core: This paper is a review that does not embed AI into a specific bioprinting workflow stage, lacks experimental validation of AI models, and does not advance from observation to autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述导电生物材料与3D/4D打印在再生医学中的智能整合。
summary_zh.method: 提出“生物材料-打印-功能”三元框架，系统分析材料、打印技术和应用。
summary_zh.result: 识别多材料4D打印为克服导电-降解权衡的关键，并展望AI驱动设计。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to systematically synthesize advances in bioinspired conductive biomaterials and 3D/4D bioprinting for intelligent electroactive tissue regeneration.
summary_en.method: A 'bioinspired material–printing–function' triad framework is proposed to analyze tunable conductive materials, advanced printing technologies, and functional applications in neural, cardiac, and musculoskeletal tissues.
summary_en.result: Multi-material 4D bioprinting is identified as a transformative approach to address conductivity–degradation trade-offs and enable dynamic, shape-adaptive scaffolds.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is performed; the paper is a literature review.

title: Multi-Objective Hierarchical Optimization with Large Language Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种利用大语言模型作为代理模型和候选采样器的分层多目标优化方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant mechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification, and is validated only on synthetic and general real-world benchmarks without biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 大语言模型在多目标优化中表现不佳，需结构化搜索策略提升效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出分层搜索算法，自适应划分输入空间并利用LLM作为代理模型和采样器。
summary_zh.result: 算法在Hausdorff距离下收敛到真实Pareto集，性能优于全局LLM优化器。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成和真实基准问题上与进化算法和贝叶斯优化对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Large language models lack structured strategies for multi-objective optimization, motivating a hierarchical approach to improve sampling efficiency.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical search algorithm partitions the input space into hyperrectangular regions and uses an LLM as a surrogate model and candidate sampler within high-potential subspaces.
summary_en.result: The proposed method converges to the true Pareto set in Hausdorff distance and outperforms global LLM-based optimizers on benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks compare performance against evolutionary and Bayesian optimization algorithms.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Illustration of MOHOLLM’s optimization pipeline.

title: Diffusion Large Language Models for Black-Box Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文将扩散大语言模型用于黑箱优化，其方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样优化。
why_not_core: No FEA or biomechanics context; no constraint handling; no uncertainty quantification beyond GP surrogate.

summary_zh.motivation: 离线黑箱优化中数据有限，传统方法忽略预训练大模型的上下文学习能力。
summary_zh.method: 提出扩散大语言模型dLLM，结合上下文去噪模块和掩码扩散树搜索进行设计优化。
summary_zh.result: 在design-bench的少样本设置下达到最先进性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准黑箱优化基准数据集上评估。

summary_en.motivation: Offline black-box optimization suffers from limited data, and prior methods overlook the in-context learning capability of pre-trained LLMs.
summary_en.method: We propose dLLM, a diffusion LLM with an in-context denoising module and masked diffusion tree search that balances exploration and exploitation via expected improvement.
summary_en.result: dLLM achieves state-of-the-art results on design-bench in few-shot settings.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard black-box optimization benchmarks (design-bench).

visual.caption: Figure 1: In-context denoising.

title: Multi-level Monte Carlo Dropout for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多级蒙特卡洛丢弃不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中的高效不确定性估计。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to any FEA surrogate or implant/biomechanics design problem; validation is only on PINN benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高蒙特卡洛丢弃法不确定性量化的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 构建基于丢弃掩码复用的多级蒙特卡洛框架，实现均值和方差的无偏估计。
summary_zh.result: 在固定预算下显著降低采样方差，PINN基准验证了效率提升。
summary_zh.validation: 在正向和逆向PINN-Uzawa基准上进行数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the computational efficiency of uncertainty quantification using Monte Carlo dropout.
summary_en.method: A multilevel Monte Carlo framework is constructed by reusing dropout masks across fidelities, yielding unbiased telescoping estimators for predictive means and variances.
summary_en.result: The proposed method reduces sampling variance at a fixed evaluation budget, with efficiency gains demonstrated on PINN benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on forward and inverse PINN-Uzawa benchmarks confirm the predicted variance rates and efficiency gains.

title: Fabrication, characterization, and compressive properties of SLM-fabricated 316L triply periodic minimal surface structures
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part C Journal of Mechanical Engineering Science
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Engineering, Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS), Kota Samarahan, Malaysia

corresponding_authors.name: Abdullah Yassin
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering, Universiti Malaysia Sarawak (UNIMAS), Kota Samarahan, Malaysia

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造的316L TPMS多孔结构的压缩性能，与用户关注的生物医用植入体多孔结构力学性能相关，但材料为316L不锈钢而非钛合金，且未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching for biomedical implants, uses 316L stainless steel instead of Ti-6Al-4V, and lacks fatigue testing, surface roughness characterization, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造的316L TPMS多孔结构的制造特性和压缩性能
summary_zh.method: 设计均匀和梯度Gyroid及IWP多孔结构，通过SLM制造，结合SEM、Micro-CT和有限元分析
summary_zh.result: 均匀多孔结构的弹性模量和屈服强度随孔隙率增加而降低，梯度设计提高了抗压强度和能量吸收
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验与有限元模拟对比验证了力学响应的一致性

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fabrication characteristics and compressive properties of 316L stainless steel TPMS porous structures produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Uniform and gradient Gyroid and IWP porous structures with varying porosities and unit cell sizes were designed, fabricated via SLM, and characterized using SEM, Micro-CT, and finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: Elastic modulus and yield strength of uniform porous structures decreased with increasing porosity, while gradient designs significantly enhanced compressive strength and energy absorption.
summary_en.validation: Experimental results were validated by finite element simulations showing strong agreement with observed stress-strain responses.

title: Architecture-Optimization Co-Design for Physics-Informed Neural Networks Via Attentive Representations and Conflict-Resolved Gradients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的架构-优化协同设计方法可提升PINN求解PDE的精度和收敛速度，对构建FEA替代模型具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constrained optimization or multi-objective design scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN因表示能力有限和梯度冲突导致求解精度低。
summary_zh.method: 提出层注意力机制和冲突解决梯度更新，协同优化网络架构与训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准PDE上实现更快收敛和更低误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在Burgers、Helmholtz等经典PDE基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINNs suffer from limited representational capacity and optimization difficulties due to conflicting gradients, hindering their accuracy and convergence.
summary_en.method: This work proposes a layer-wise dynamic attention mechanism for enhanced representation and a conflict-resolved gradient update strategy to mitigate gradient interference, integrating both into a unified architecture-optimization co-design framework.
summary_en.result: The proposed ACR-PINN achieves faster convergence and significantly lower relative L2 and L∞ errors on benchmark PDEs including Burgers, Helmholtz, Klein-Gordon, and lid-driven cavity flow.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of canonical PDEs, comparing against standard PINNs.

title: PTL-PINNs: Perturbation-Guided Transfer Learning with Physics- Informed Neural Networks for Nonlinear Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合微扰理论与迁移学习的PINN方法，可加速非线性微分方程求解，其思想可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on solving nonlinear ODEs/PDEs with perturbation theory.

summary_zh.motivation: PINN求解非线性方程泛化差且训练慢，需高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出微扰引导迁移学习框架，用闭式解近似线性化系统。
summary_zh.result: 精度与Runge-Kutta相当，速度提升一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在非线性振子、Lotka-Volterra等基准问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the poor generalization and long training times of PINNs for nonlinear differential equations.
summary_en.method: A perturbation-guided transfer learning framework that solves an approximate linear perturbative system with closed-form expressions.
summary_en.result: Achieves accuracy comparable to Runge-Kutta methods with up to an order of magnitude speedup.
summary_en.validation: Validated on nonlinear oscillators, Lotka-Volterra, KPP-Fisher, and wave equation benchmarks.

visual.caption: Figure 1: Multi-Headed-PINN architecture used for one-shot transfer learning. A shared neural backbone learns a latent representation H ​ ( x , t ) \textbf{H}(x,t) across k k training equations, while linear output heads represented by matrices W (head weights) map this representation to solution components for each equation. At inference time, new linear problems are solved by computing closed-form output weights without gradient-based optimization.

title: Operator learning on domain boundary through combining fundamental solution-based artificial data and boundary integral techniques
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过边界数据学习算子，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，减少全域采样成本。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical or implant mechanics problems; only tested on 2D Laplace, Poisson, and Helmholtz equations.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少算子学习对全域数据的依赖，仅用边界数据训练。
summary_zh.method: 结合基本解生成人工边界数据，学习边界到边界映射，再用边界积分恢复内部解。
summary_zh.result: 在二维拉普拉斯、泊松和亥姆霍兹方程上达到与现有算子学习相当或更优的精度，训练时间显著减少。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准算子学习基准任务上验证，与现有方法对比精度和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the reliance on full-domain data for operator learning by leveraging only boundary data.
summary_en.method: A boundary neural operator (MAD-BNO) is trained on synthetic Dirichlet-Neumann data pairs generated from fundamental solutions, and interior solutions are recovered via boundary integral formulations.
summary_en.result: The method achieves comparable or better accuracy than existing neural operators on 2D Laplace, Poisson, and Helmholtz benchmarks while significantly reducing training time.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard numerical benchmarks for operator learning, comparing accuracy and training efficiency against existing methods.

visual.caption: Figure 2 : Training loss curve for the Laplace equation (Eq. 6 ) with Dirichlet boundary conditions. The vertical axis is shown on a logarithmic scale to emphasize the convergence rate of the model. The plotted loss values represent the average loss within every 100 epochs to better illustrate the training progress.

title: Gradient-based Active Learning with Gaussian Processes for Global Sensitivity Analysis
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于梯度的主动学习方法可用于提高代理模型在全局敏感性分析中的采样效率，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle constrained optimization or uncertainty quantification for design objectives.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少全局敏感性分析中昂贵数值模拟的计算负担
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程梯度的后验分布构建采集函数，主动选择信息量最大的输入点
summary_zh.result: 在标准基准函数和实际环境模型上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准函数和农药传输环境模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of global sensitivity analysis by efficiently selecting informative simulation runs.
summary_en.method: Develops acquisition functions that leverage the joint posterior distribution of Gaussian process gradients to target regions most informative for sensitivity indices.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art methods on standard benchmarks and a real environmental pesticide transport model.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark functions and a real-world environmental model of pesticide transfers.

key_terms.zh: 基于导数的敏感性度量

title: Diagnosing Failure Modes of Neural Operators Across Diverse PDE Families
relevance_to_user: 该论文系统评估了神经算子在不同PDE族下的鲁棒性，其方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的泛化性测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, lacks biomedical context, and does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经PDE求解器评估缺乏对分布偏移下鲁棒性的系统测试。
summary_zh.method: 提出标准化压力测试框架，在五种PDE族上测试三种架构的泛化能力。
summary_zh.result: 发现分布内精度不能预测鲁棒性，失效模式与架构和PDE族相关。
summary_zh.validation: 基于750个训练模型和多种诊断指标进行数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current evaluation of neural PDE solvers lacks systematic robustness testing under deployment-relevant distribution shifts.
summary_en.method: A standardized stress-testing framework is introduced, evaluating three neural operator architectures across five PDE families with controlled shifts in coefficients, boundary conditions, and discretization.
summary_en.result: In-distribution accuracy does not reliably predict robustness, and failure patterns depend jointly on architecture and PDE family.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on 750 trained models using baseline-normalized degradation factors, spectral analysis, and rollout diagnostics.

title: An efficient solver based on low-rank approximation and Neumann matrix series for unsteady diffusion-type partial differential equations with random coefficients
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的低秩近似与Neumann级数求解器可显著加速含随机系数的扩散型PDE求解，其方法有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型中，以提高不确定性量化效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks contact mechanics or structural optimization, and does not demonstrate validation on biomedical FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 含随机系数扩散型PDE的大规模线性系统求解效率低
summary_zh.method: 提出广义低秩矩阵近似结合Neumann级数展开，将高维求逆转为低维矩阵乘法
summary_zh.result: 显著降低计算成本与存储需求，同时保持高数值精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过非稳态随机扩散方程及其最优控制问题的数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently solving large-scale linear systems arising from spatial and temporal discretizations of unsteady diffusion-type PDEs with random coefficients remains a computational challenge.
summary_en.method: A generalized low-rank matrix approximation is proposed to represent stochastic stiffness matrices, and their inverses are approximated via Neumann matrix series expansion, converting high-dimensional inversion into sequences of low-dimensional matrix multiplications.
summary_en.result: The solver significantly reduces computational cost and storage while maintaining high numerical accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on unsteady stochastic diffusion equations and associated distributed optimal control problems demonstrate feasibility and effectiveness.

title: Online identification of nonlinear time-varying systems with uncertain information
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的在线符号学习与不确定性量化框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型的在线更新与解释性建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法难以同时满足数字孪生对高精度、可解释性和在线自适应能力的要求。
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯回归符号学习框架，将在线符号发现建模为概率状态空间模型，并推导带遗忘因子的递归算法。
summary_zh.result: 在案例中实现了可解释的概率预测和在线学习，并保证了后验分布的适定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值案例验证框架的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Existing methods struggle to simultaneously achieve high predictive accuracy, interpretability, and online adaptation for digital twins.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian Regression-based Symbolic Learning framework is proposed, formulating online symbolic discovery as a probabilistic state-space model with a recursive algorithm incorporating a forgetting factor.
summary_en.result: The framework achieves interpretable probabilistic predictions and online learning, with rigorous convergence guarantees under persistent excitation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical case studies validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

title: Bayesian Model Selection for Complex Flows of Yield Stress Fluids
relevance_to_user: 该论文的贝叶斯不确定性量化框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型的校准与模型选择，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics application, and no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决复杂流动中屈服应力流体本构模型校准与选择的不确定性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出贝叶斯不确定性量化框架，整合模型精度与实验观测的不确定性
summary_zh.result: 贝叶斯模型选择提供鲁棒概率预测，并揭示流变测量参数在复杂流动中的局限性
summary_zh.validation: 通过Carbopol 980的流变测量和挤压流动实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address uncertainties in calibrating and selecting constitutive models for yield stress fluids under complex flow conditions.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian uncertainty quantification framework is proposed that explicitly accounts for uncertainties in both model accuracy and experimental observations.
summary_en.result: Bayesian model selection yields robust probabilistic predictions and reveals that rheological parameters may not be representative in complex flows.
summary_en.validation: Validated using rheological measurements and squeeze flow experiments on Carbopol 980.

title: Verifying Physics-Informed Neural Network Fidelity using Classical Fisher Information from Differentiable Dynamical System
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出用Fisher信息量验证PINN对动力系统保真度的方法，可迁移至FEA替代模型的保真度评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constrained optimization; it focuses on dynamical system fidelity verification.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN验证方法仅关注轨迹预测，缺乏对系统动力学完整保真度的量化。
summary_zh.method: 利用可微动力系统的Fisher信息量，比较PINN与解析模型的几何和稳定性特性。
summary_zh.result: Fisher信息量匹配可定量衡量PINN对系统动力学的保真度。
summary_zh.validation: 以汽车动力学模型为例，计算并比较Fisher信息量。

summary_en.motivation: Current PINN validation methods focus on trajectory prediction but fail to quantify the comprehensive fidelity of learned dynamics.
summary_en.method: A novel framework uses Fisher information for differentiable dynamical systems to compare the geometric and stability properties of PINN-learned dynamics with the analytical model.
summary_en.result: Matching Fisher information landscapes provides a quantitative measure of PINN fidelity beyond state prediction.
summary_en.validation: The methodology is demonstrated on a car dynamical model by computing and comparing Fisher information from Jacobians.

visual.caption: Fig. 1: MSE per Epoch for the best 5 architectures for Case 1

title: Two continuous extensions of the Neural Approximated Virtual Element Method
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出连续神经基函数用于虚拟单元法，可提升FEA代理模型的精度和连续性，对生物力学设计中的约束优化有潜在价值。
why_not_core: No application to implant/biomechanics design, no uncertainty quantification, and no handling of constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经虚拟单元法的全局连续性和计算效率
summary_zh.method: 提出B-NAVEM和P-NAVEM两种连续神经基函数构造方法
summary_zh.result: 在训练和测试阶段评估了计算成本、内存和精度
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验对比两种方法的性能

summary_en.motivation: To enhance global continuity and computational efficiency of neural-based virtual element methods for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Two continuous neural basis function constructions are proposed: B-NAVEM using PINNs for local Laplace problems, and P-NAVEM enforcing polynomial reproducibility via a tailored loss.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments compare computational cost, memory usage, and accuracy during training and testing phases.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks without application to biomechanics or implant design.

title: Correlations in LPBF-fabricated Ti6Al4V: Influence of laser power and scanning speed on microstructure and mechanical performance
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF工艺参数对Ti6Al4V微观结构和力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the AM biomedical direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 系统研究激光功率和扫描速度对LPBF Ti6Al4V致密化、微观结构和力学性能的耦合影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用九组工艺参数组合制备样品，通过密度、XRD、残余应力及拉伸测试表征。
summary_zh.result: 最优能量密度窗口（45-90 J/mm³）获得近全致密（>99.4%）和优异强塑性组合（UTS~1.02-1.08 GPa，延伸率~6-12.7%）。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量相对密度、残余应力和力学性能验证工艺-结构-性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically investigate the coupled effects of laser power and scanning speed on densification, microstructure, and mechanical properties of LPBF-fabricated Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: Nine parameter combinations of laser power (180-320 W) and scan speed (500-1500 mm/s) were used; samples were characterized by density, XRD, residual stress, and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: An optimal volumetric energy density window of 45-90 J/mm³ yielded near-full density (>99.4%) with a favorable combination of strength (UTS ~1.02-1.08 GPa) and ductility (elongation ~6-12.7%).
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of relative density, residual stress, and mechanical properties validated the process-structure-property relationships.

title: VBO-MI: A Fully Gradient-Based Bayesian Optimization Framework Using Variational Mutual Information Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于变分互信息估计的全梯度贝叶斯优化框架，可显著降低计算成本，适用于昂贵黑箱函数优化，对代理模型辅助的植入物设计优化具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for biomechanical design, or implant-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统贝叶斯优化中后验采样和采集函数优化计算昂贵，亟需高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出VBO-MI框架，利用变分互信息估计和actor-critic架构实现端到端梯度流，消除内循环优化瓶颈。
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准任务上达到相同或更优优化性能，计算量降低两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数、PDE优化、Lunar Lander等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional Bayesian optimization suffers from expensive posterior sampling and acquisition function optimization, motivating a more efficient gradient-based framework.
summary_en.method: VBO-MI employs an actor-critic architecture with variational mutual information estimation to enable end-to-end gradient flow, eliminating the inner-loop acquisition optimization bottleneck.
summary_en.result: The method achieves up to 100x reduction in FLOPs while maintaining or improving optimization performance across diverse benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on high-dimensional synthetic functions, PDE optimization, Lunar Lander control, and categorical Pest Control tasks.

title: Soft Partition-based KAPI-ELM for Multi-Scale PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种快速求解多尺度PDE的确定性方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no implant or biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有物理信息机器学习方法难以高效求解多尺度、高频振荡PDE。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于软分区的核自适应物理信息极限学习机，通过平滑分区长度控制核宽度，单次线性求解。
summary_zh.result: 在八个基准上达到或超过PINN精度，计算成本极低。
summary_zh.validation: 在振荡ODE、高频泊松方程、不规则区域等数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing physics-informed machine learning methods struggle with multiscale and highly oscillatory PDEs due to spectral bias and high computational cost.
summary_en.method: A soft partition-based kernel-adaptive physics-informed extreme learning machine is introduced, where smooth partition lengths jointly control collocation centers and Gaussian kernel widths, enabling a single linear solve.
summary_en.result: The method matches or exceeds state-of-the-art PINN accuracy on eight multiscale benchmarks while requiring only a single linear solve.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including oscillatory ODEs, high-frequency Poisson equations, and irregular domains.

title: Effects of manufacturing defects and microstructure on the tensile and low cycle fatigue behavior of selective laser melting IN718 TPMS structures
first_author_affiliation: Research Institute of Aerospace Technology, Central South University, Changsha, 410083, China

corresponding_authors.name: Jia Qi Huang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Research Institute of Aerospace Technology, Central South University, Changsha, 410083, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制造的TPMS结构的拉伸和低周疲劳行为，与用户关注的增材制造生物医学植入物的力学性能相关，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, does not report surface roughness or osseointegration, and focuses on IN718 (a nickel superalloy) rather than biomedical implant materials like Ti6Al4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究制造缺陷和微观结构对SLM TPMS结构疲劳性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制造的IN718 TPMS结构进行拉伸和低周疲劳实验，结合微观表征
summary_zh.result: 制造缺陷显著降低疲劳寿命，微观结构影响裂纹萌生和扩展
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验力学测试和微观分析验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how manufacturing defects and microstructure affect the tensile and low-cycle fatigue behavior of selective laser melted TPMS structures.
summary_en.method: Tensile and low-cycle fatigue tests were conducted on SLM-fabricated IN718 TPMS structures, combined with microstructural characterization.
summary_en.result: Manufacturing defects significantly reduced fatigue life, and microstructure influenced crack initiation and propagation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through experimental mechanical testing and microstructural analysis.

title: Design and performance study of novel medical composite lattice structures with low Poisson's ratio and high energy absorption characteristics
first_author_affiliation: College of mechanical and electronic engineering, Shandong University of Science and Technology, Qingdao, Shandong, 266590, China

corresponding_authors.name: Lina Liang

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了用于骨植入物的混合晶格结构，涉及弹性模量匹配和能量吸收，但未直接评估应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: No fatigue testing, no stress shielding quantification, no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计具有低泊松比和高能量吸收的医用晶格结构，用于骨植入物。
summary_zh.method: 提出Gyroid-蜂窝和Diamond-蜂窝混合晶格，通过SLM制造并测试准静态压缩性能。
summary_zh.result: 混合结构弹性模量与天然材料相似，比能量吸收提升76%以上，泊松比极低。
summary_zh.validation: 准静态压缩实验验证力学响应和能量吸收特性。

summary_en.motivation: To design novel hybrid lattice structures with low Poisson's ratio and high energy absorption for potential bone implant applications.
summary_en.method: Two hybrid lattice structures (Gyroid-reentrant honeycomb and Diamond-reentrant honeycomb) were fabricated via selective laser melting and tested under quasi-static compression.
summary_en.result: The hybrid structures exhibited elastic moduli matching natural materials, over 76% increase in specific energy absorption, and extremely low Poisson's ratio with improved deformation controllability.
summary_en.validation: Quasi-static compression experiments validated mechanical response and energy absorption characteristics.

title: Parametric Probabilistic Manifold Decomposition for Nonlinear Model Reduction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种参数化概率流形分解方法，可构建连续高保真参数代理模型，适用于设计优化和不确定性量化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or any biomedical application; it focuses on fluid dynamics surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有概率流形分解仅适用于时间动态，无法处理参数变化，限制了其在优化和不确定性量化中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出参数化概率流形分解，将概率流形嵌入与参数感知潜在学习结合，构建连续参数代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在圆柱绕流和后向台阶流算例中，PPMD在参数外推精度上优于传统POD+GPR方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过收敛性理论分析和两个经典流体数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: The existing Probabilistic Manifold Decomposition is limited to temporal dynamics and cannot handle parametric variability, hindering its use in design optimization and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Parametric Probabilistic Manifold Decomposition integrates probabilistic-manifold embeddings with parameter-aware latent learning to construct continuous, high-fidelity parametric surrogates.
summary_en.result: On flow past a cylinder and backward-facing step flow, PPMD achieves superior accuracy and generalization beyond the training parameter range compared to POD with Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through a comprehensive convergence analysis and numerical experiments on two classic fluid flow configurations.

title: In silico study of a bilayer titanium dental implant with a porous titanium and hydroxyapatite composite outer layer for enhanced osseointegration.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究牙科植入物的双层多孔设计，与用户关注的髋关节植入物应力遮挡方向有方法上的相似性，但应用领域不同。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on dental implants, not femoral stems; it does not include LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, or fatigue analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发双层多孔牙科植入物以增强骨整合和稳定性
summary_zh.method: 使用SolidWorks建模，ANSYS进行有限元分析，系统改变孔隙率、HA含量和外层厚度
summary_zh.result: 双层多孔设计相比传统植入物应力降低69-94%，2mm壳层设计最优
summary_zh.validation: 仅有限元模拟，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To design a bilayered dental implant with a porous composite outer layer to improve osseointegration and mechanical stability.
summary_en.method: Finite element analysis was performed on 3D models with varying porosity (10-90%), HA content (10-50%), and shell thickness (1-2 mm) under 250 N axial load.
summary_en.result: Bilayered porous implants reduced von Mises stress by 69-94% compared to conventional implants, with the 2 mm shell design showing optimal microstrain and load transfer.
summary_en.validation: The study is purely computational; no experimental validation was conducted.

title: Dual-Level Models for Physics-Informed Multi-Step Time Series Forecasting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的双层物理信息时间序列预测方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的多步预测与不确定性量化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on general dynamical system forecasting without implant-specific constraints, FEA surrogate validation, or biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决纯数据驱动时间序列预测泛化差的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出双层策略：LSTM混合概率状态模型预测输入，PINN生成多步输出
summary_zh.result: 混合输入预测模型在似然和MSE上优于传统方法，PINN驱动预测泛化更强
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值测试案例上对比MSE和对数似然

summary_en.motivation: To address poor generalization of purely data-driven models in multi-step forecasting of dynamical systems under incomplete physical knowledge.
summary_en.method: A dual-level framework combining LSTM-integrated probabilistic state transition models for input forecasting with PINNs for physics-informed output prediction.
summary_en.result: The hybrid input forecasting models achieve higher log-likelihood and lower MSE than conventional STMs, and the PINN-driven predictions outperform purely data-driven counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark experiments on multiple test cases comparing MSE and log-likelihood metrics.

title: DataScribe: An AI-Native, Policy-Aligned Web Platform for Multi-Objective Materials Design and Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该平台集成了不确定性感知代理建模和多目标贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on materials discovery (electrochemical, high-entropy alloys) rather than biomedical implant design or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速材料发现需要集成学习与优化的数字平台。
summary_zh.method: 构建AI原生云平台，融合知识图谱、不确定性感知代理模型和多目标多保真度贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 在电化学材料和高熵合金案例中验证了端到端数据融合与实时优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个材料科学案例研究验证平台功能。

summary_en.motivation: Accelerating materials discovery requires digital platforms that embed learning and optimization into research workflows beyond data repositories.
summary_en.method: DataScribe integrates ontology-backed data ingestion, uncertainty-aware surrogate modeling, and multi-objective multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization within a cloud-based platform.
summary_en.result: Case studies in electrochemical materials and high-entropy alloys demonstrate end-to-end data fusion and real-time multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.validation: The platform is validated through two materials science case studies showing closed-loop propose-measure-learn workflows.

title: CompNO: A Novel Foundation Model approach for solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的组合式神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomedical FEA problems, no constraint handling for implant design, and no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低偏微分方程数值求解的计算成本，避免大规模预训练。
summary_zh.method: 组合式神经算子，先学习基础微分算子库，再组装成任务特定求解器。
summary_zh.result: 在一维PDE基准上优于现有模型，精确满足边界条件。
summary_zh.validation: 在PDEBench的一维对流、扩散、对流扩散和Burgers方程上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of solving parametric PDEs without relying on large-scale pretraining of monolithic models.
summary_en.method: A compositional neural operator framework that learns a library of Foundation Blocks for fundamental differential operators and assembles them into task-specific solvers with lightweight Adaptation Blocks.
summary_en.result: The proposed CompNO achieves lower relative L2 error than strong baselines on linear parametric systems and maintains exact boundary satisfaction.
summary_en.validation: Validated on one-dimensional convection, diffusion, convection-diffusion, and Burgers' equations from the PDEBench suite.

title: The Ill-Posed Foundations of Physics-Informed Neural Networks and Their Finite-Difference Variants
relevance_to_user: 该论文从理论上分析了PINN的适定性问题，对FEA替代建模中神经网络的稳定性有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper provides theoretical analysis of PINN ill-posedness but does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示AD-PINN和FD-PINN优化问题的适定性缺陷。
summary_zh.method: 通过数学证明和数值实验对比两种PINN变体的理论性质。
summary_zh.result: 证明两种PINN均存在无限多极小值，但FD-PINN与有限差分解紧密耦合。
summary_zh.validation: 在正向和逆向PDE问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To clarify the analytical properties of AD-PINNs and FD-PINNs, which are widely used but poorly understood theoretically.
summary_en.method: A unified mathematical framework proves ill-posedness under mild assumptions and establishes structural properties linking FD-PINNs to finite-difference solutions.
summary_en.result: Both AD- and FD-PINN optimization problems are ill-posed with infinitely many minimizers, yet FD-PINNs remain stable and coincide with discrete PDE solutions on the grid.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on forward and inverse PDE problems, including noisy data, confirm the theoretical findings.

title: Robust Bayesian Optimization via Tempered Posteriors
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通过温度调整后验分布来缓解贝叶斯优化中代理模型过度自信的方法，可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and does not include uncertainty quantification beyond GP tempering.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中代理模型因局部采样过度自信，需缓解不确定性低估问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过温度参数α调整似然权重，提出在线选择α的前序方法。
summary_zh.result: 温度调整后验可严格改善最坏情况下的累积遗憾界，且实际性能稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准测试上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization often suffers from overconfident surrogates due to localized sampling, necessitating robust uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A tempered posterior update downweights the likelihood by a power α, with a prequential procedure to adapt α online based on prediction errors.
summary_en.result: Tempering yields strictly sharper worst-case regret bounds and stabilizes BO surrogates in practice.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on numerical benchmarks demonstrates improved robustness over standard BO.

title: Bgolearn: a Unified Bayesian Optimization Framework for Accelerating Materials Discovery
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化框架可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on materials discovery and does not address implant-specific biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速材料发现中昂贵实验的采样效率。
summary_zh.method: 开发统一贝叶斯优化框架Bgolearn，支持多目标、多代理模型及不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 相比随机搜索等方法，所需实验减少40-60%，且解质量相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三周期极小曲面、高熵合金等基准案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate materials discovery by reducing the number of expensive experiments through efficient Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Developed Bgolearn, a unified Python framework integrating single- and multi-objective Bayesian optimization with multiple acquisition functions, surrogate models, and bootstrap-based uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Bgolearn reduces required experiments by 40-60% compared to random search, grid search, and genetic algorithms while maintaining comparable or superior solution quality.
summary_en.validation: Validated on benchmark problems including triply periodic minimal surface structures, high-entropy alloys, and medium-Mn steels.

title: An efficient hyper reduced-order model for segregated solvers for geometrical parametrization problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的超降阶模型方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no biomechanics context, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低几何参数化问题中全阶求解的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 采用离散-投影策略，结合DEIM超降阶技术，仅计算稀疏网格单元
summary_zh.result: 超降阶模型与全阶解高度吻合，计算时间大幅减少
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性对流、非线性Burgers和不可压Navier-Stokes三个基准问题验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of full-order solvers for geometrically parametrized problems.
summary_en.method: A discretize-then-project hyper-reduced order model using DEIM to select sparse sampling points, applied to segregated finite-volume solvers.
summary_en.result: The hyper-reduced models achieve high accuracy compared to full-order solutions with significant computational speedup.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three benchmark problems: linear transport, nonlinear Burgers, and incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.

title: StablePDENet: Enhancing Stability of Operator Learning for Solving Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的对抗训练增强算子学习稳定性的方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化与鲁棒性提升。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant/biomechanics design, lacks constraint handling, and does not demonstrate transfer to biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 神经网络求解微分方程时对输入扰动缺乏稳定性，影响实际应用可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 提出自监督对抗训练框架，通过最小-最大优化增强算子学习稳定性。
summary_zh.result: 在标准输入和对抗扰动输入下均保持高精度，验证了稳定性训练的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上测试，对比标准训练方法展示稳定性提升。

summary_en.motivation: Neural operators for differential equations lack stability under input perturbations, hindering their deployment in real-world applications.
summary_en.method: A self-supervised adversarial training framework is proposed, formulating operator learning as a min-max optimization to enforce robustness against worst-case perturbations.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy on both clean and adversarially perturbed inputs, demonstrating the importance of stability-aware training.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems are used to compare against baseline operator learning methods.

title: Physics-informed Gaussian Process Regression in Solving Eigenvalue Problem of Linear Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息高斯过程回归应用于特征值问题，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的模态分析或稳定性问题，但未涉及植入物设计或优化约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification for point predictions, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决物理信息高斯过程回归在特征值问题中因零源项导致的平凡预测均值问题。
summary_zh.method: 利用传递函数型指标从后验协方差中识别特征值/特征函数。
summary_zh.result: 后验协方差仅在λ为特征值时非平凡，后验样本位于特征空间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线性和非线性特征值问题的数值示例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the trivial predictive mean and degenerate marginal likelihood in physics-informed Gaussian process regression for eigenvalue problems with null source terms.
summary_en.method: Construct a transfer-function-type indicator from the physics-informed Gaussian process posterior to identify eigenvalues and eigenfunctions.
summary_en.result: The posterior covariance is non-trivial only when λ corresponds to an eigenvalue, and posterior samples lie in the eigenspace.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on several numerical examples including linear and nonlinear eigenvalue problems.

title: Physics-constrained Gaussian Processes for Predicting Shockwave Hugoniot Curves
relevance_to_user: 该论文的物理约束高斯过程方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no FEA surrogate, no constraint handling in design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少冲击波模拟成本，利用少量数据预测Hugoniot曲线
summary_zh.method: 结合Rankine-Hugoniot跳跃条件的物理约束高斯过程回归
summary_zh.result: 以碳化硅为例，准确重建Hugoniot曲线并量化不确定性
summary_zh.validation: 与分子动力学模拟结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of shockwave simulations by predicting Hugoniot curves from limited data.
summary_en.method: A physics-constrained Gaussian Process regression framework incorporating Rankine-Hugoniot jump conditions into the covariance function.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately reproduces the Hugoniot curve for silicon carbide while providing uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validated against molecular dynamics simulations of silicon carbide under shock loading.

title: Sequential Bayesian Optimal Experimental Design in Infinite Dimensions via Policy Gradient Reinforcement Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文将强化学习用于贝叶斯最优实验设计，其代理模型和降维方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: No implant biomechanics, no contact mechanics, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, and no multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PDE控制反问题中序贯贝叶斯最优实验设计的计算瓶颈
summary_zh.method: 将SBOED建模为马尔可夫决策过程，用策略梯度强化学习学习设计策略，结合双降维和注意力神经算子代理
summary_zh.result: 在污染物源追踪中实现约100倍加速，策略可解释且优于随机放置
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（污染物源追踪多传感器放置）

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational challenges of sequential Bayesian optimal experimental design for PDE-governed inverse problems with infinite-dimensional random fields.
summary_en.method: Formulates SBOED as a finite-horizon MDP and learns an amortized design policy via policy-gradient RL, using dual dimension reduction and a derivative-informed latent attention neural operator surrogate.
summary_en.result: Achieves approximately 100x speedup over high-fidelity FEM in contaminant source tracking, with interpretable policies that discover an upstream tracking strategy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark on sequential multi-sensor placement for contaminant source tracking.

title: Sensoformer: Robust Sim-to-Real Inference on Variable-Geometry Sensor Sets via Physics-Structured Randomization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理结构化域随机化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型，以处理稀疏传感器数据并增强鲁棒性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, and does not include uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决稀疏、变几何传感器阵列的模拟到真实推理问题
summary_zh.method: 提出Sensoformer，结合物理结构化域随机化与集合注意力机制
summary_zh.result: 在地震源反演中优于MPNN和DeepONet，注意力机制自动发现最优传感器布局
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据预训练，并在真实地震目录上评估

summary_en.motivation: To enable robust inference of high-dimensional physical states from sparse, variable-geometry sensor arrays under sim-to-real distribution shifts.
summary_en.method: Sensoformer integrates set-attention with Physics-Structured Domain Randomization (PSDR) that randomizes underlying physical dynamics to learn domain-invariant operators.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art precision on real-world seismic source inversion, outperforming MPNNs and DeepONet, with attention autonomously discovering optimal sensor placement.
summary_en.validation: Pre-trained on 100,000 synthetic samples and evaluated on a complex real-world seismic catalog.

title: Hard Constraint Projection in a Physics Informed Neural Network
relevance_to_user: 该论文将硬约束嵌入PINN以求解非线性PDE，其方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模中的约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics (Navier-Stokes) and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 将硬约束嵌入PINN以精确满足非线性PDE的离散形式。
summary_zh.method: 扩展硬约束投影层至强非线性Navier-Stokes方程，通过微分流函数恢复速度场。
summary_zh.result: 硬约束投影层确保预测解精确满足离散控制方程。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证方法在2D不可压缩Navier-Stokes方程上的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To enforce exact satisfaction of discretized governing equations in PINNs for strongly nonlinear PDEs.
summary_en.method: Extends the hard constraint projection layer to the 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations, recovering velocity from stream function differentiation.
summary_en.result: The hard constraint projection layer ensures predicted velocity and pressure lie on a hyperplane of exact solutions to the discretized equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks for 2D incompressible Navier-Stokes flow.

title: 3D organotypic skin models recapitulate autoantibody-driven pemphigus pathomechanisms and targeted therapeutic response.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, University of Nebraska-Lincoln, Lincoln, NE 68588, USA.

corresponding_authors.name: Fanben Meng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, University of Nebraska-Lincoln, Lincoln, NE 68588, USA.; Nebraska Center for Integrated Biomolecular Communication, University of Nebraska-Lincoln, Lincoln, NE 68588, USA.

relevance_to_user: 该论文使用3D生物打印构建皮肤模型，但未将AI集成到打印工作流中，仅在后处理分析中应用机器学习。
why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into any bioprinting workflow stage (pre/in/post) for process control or optimization; AI is only used for post-hoc image analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建能模拟自身免疫性疾病的3D皮肤模型以研究机制和筛选药物。
summary_zh.method: 结合3D生物打印和细胞自组织构建多层皮肤结构，并利用机器学习分析图像。
summary_zh.result: 模型再现了天疱疮的病理特征，并定量评估了靶向治疗药物的效果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外实验验证了皮肤屏障功能和抗体诱导的病理变化。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a physiologically relevant 3D skin model that recapitulates autoimmune disease progression for mechanistic studies and drug screening.
summary_en.method: A dynamic biofabrication strategy combining 3D bioprinting and cell self-organization to create multilayered skin constructs, with machine learning-assisted image texture analysis for quantitative evaluation.
summary_en.result: The organotypic model replicated pemphigus vulgaris pathomechanisms and enabled quantitative assessment of targeted therapeutic inhibitors.
summary_en.validation: In vitro validation using cell-cell junction integrity measurements and machine learning-based image analysis confirmed disease phenotype recapitulation.

title: The Kernel Manifold: A Geometric Approach to Gaussian Process Model Selection
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于几何的核搜索方法，可迁移至代理模型中的高斯过程优化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on kernel selection for Gaussian processes in general, not on surrogate modeling for finite element analysis or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程核选择困难且计算昂贵，需高效方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用核间几何距离构建流形，结合贝叶斯优化搜索核空间。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据、时间序列和增材制造案例中优于基线方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和实际数据集验证预测精度与不确定性校准。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process regression performance heavily depends on kernel choice, which is computationally expensive and challenging.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian optimization framework using kernel-of-kernels geometry and MDS embedding to create a continuous manifold for kernel search.
summary_en.result: Achieved superior predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration on synthetic benchmarks, time-series, and additive manufacturing data.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks and real-world datasets including an additive manufacturing case study.

title: Step‐Ladder Bioprinting to Align Collagen Fibers for Anisotropic Tissue Fabrication

relevance_to_user: 该论文开发了一种步梯式生物打印方法，通过控制流动实现胶原纤维定向排列，但未涉及任何AI/ML技术。
why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses solely on a mechanical nozzle design for fiber alignment.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有方法难以在复杂几何中实现可控的胶原纤维定向排列。
summary_zh.method: 设计变宽通道的步梯式打印喷头，结合拉伸流与3D生物打印。
summary_zh.result: 打印结构纤维各向异性增强，细胞沿纤维定向排列，角膜和软骨构建体性能良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过纤维角度分布、细胞取向及组织力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional bioprinting methods fail to achieve consistent and tunable collagen fiber alignment within complex geometries.
summary_en.method: A step-ladder printing nozzle with variable-width channels was designed to combine extensional flows with extrusion bioprinting.
summary_en.result: The printed constructs exhibited improved collagen anisotropy, guided cell alignment, and demonstrated functional properties in corneal and cartilage models.
summary_en.validation: Validation included fiber angle distribution analysis, cell orientation imaging, and mechanical testing of printed tissues.

title: Variability in elastic and corrosion properties with laser scan speed in selective-laser-melted 316L SS
first_author_affiliation: Department of Physics, University of Louisiana at Lafayette, Lafayette, Louisiana 70504, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Gabriela Petculescu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Physics, University of Louisiana at Lafayette, Lafayette, Louisiana 70504, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM工艺参数对316L不锈钢弹性模量和腐蚀性能的影响，虽然未涉及多孔结构或生物医学植入物，但其弹性各向异性调控方法可迁移至生物医用植入物的刚度匹配设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, and uses 316L SS (not biomedical Ti alloys) without implant-specific mechanical or biological validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索SLM工艺参数对316L不锈钢弹性与腐蚀性能的调控能力
summary_zh.method: 改变激光扫描速度（800-1200 mm/s），利用共振超声光谱和电化学测试表征性能
summary_zh.result: 高扫描速度实现弹性各向同性但耐腐蚀性下降，低扫描速度则相反
summary_zh.validation: 通过EBSD分析晶界密度与取向分布验证微观结构-性能关联

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how selective laser melting parameters can tailor the elastic and corrosion properties of 316L stainless steel for application-specific performance.
summary_en.method: Laser scan speed was varied from 800 to 1200 mm/s, and elastic moduli were measured via resonant ultrasound spectroscopy while corrosion behavior was assessed by cyclic potentiodynamic polarization.
summary_en.result: Higher scan speed (1200 mm/s) yielded near-isotropic elasticity but lower corrosion resistance, whereas lower speed (800 mm/s) produced anisotropic elasticity with superior pitting resistance.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis using EBSD correlated grain boundary density and misorientation with the observed property variations.

title: Prediction of surface roughness and porosity in SLM-fabricated SS316L components using an artificial neural network approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用ANN预测SLM制造件的表面粗糙度和孔隙率，与AM生物医学方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, lacks LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing, and does not cover fatigue or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发快速准确预测SLM制造件表面粗糙度和孔隙率的方法
summary_zh.method: 使用ANN模型处理SEM图像提取特征并预测Ra和孔隙率
summary_zh.result: 预测值与实际值平均误差分别为2.45%和3.07%
summary_zh.validation: 通过训练和测试数据集的MAE和MSE评估模型性能

summary_en.motivation: To develop a fast and accurate method for predicting surface roughness and porosity in SLM-fabricated components to improve part functionality and longevity.
summary_en.method: An artificial neural network model was used to extract patterns from SEM images and predict surface roughness (Ra) and porosity.
summary_en.result: The ANN model achieved average errors of 2.45% and 3.07% for Ra and porosity predictions, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Model performance was validated using mean absolute error and mean square error on training and testing datasets.

title: Neural Operators for Biomedical Spherical Heterogeneity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的球形格林函数神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未直接处理植入物设计或应力遮挡问题。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant mechanics, no contact mechanics or stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有球形深度学习方法难以平衡几何归纳偏置与真实异质性建模。
summary_zh.method: 提出可设计的格林函数框架，融合等变、不变和各向异性三种算子解。
summary_zh.result: 在多个球形基准和生物医学任务上表现优越。
summary_zh.validation: 在球形MNIST、浅水方程、扩散MRI等基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing spherical deep learning methods struggle to balance strong geometric inductive biases with modeling real-world heterogeneity.
summary_en.method: A designable Green's function framework is introduced, fusing equivariant, invariant, and anisotropic operator solutions.
summary_en.result: The proposed GSNO achieves superior performance on spherical benchmarks and biomedical tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on spherical MNIST, shallow water equation, diffusion MRI fiber prediction, and other benchmarks.

why_not_core: This paper does not embed AI into a bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses on bioreactor monitoring without AI-based decision-making or experimental validation of AI models.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现组织培养过程中实时、非破坏性的成熟度监测。
summary_zh.method: 整合MRI、CFD和光学成像等多模态监测手段。
summary_zh.result: 首次量化组织培养中的几何保真度（87.6%），并揭示内部重塑。
summary_zh.validation: 通过MRI测速和CFD模拟验证流体分布。

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time, non-destructive monitoring of tissue maturation during cultivation.
summary_en.method: Integrated multi-modal monitoring combining 7T MRI, CFD simulation, and optical imaging.
summary_en.result: Quantified geometric fidelity to CAD model (87.6%) and revealed internal tissue remodeling for the first time.
summary_en.validation: Validated flow patterns via MRI velocimetry and CFD simulation.

title: Discontinuous Galerkin finite element operator network for solving non-smooth PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的无数据算子学习框架可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统算子学习在非光滑PDE中需要大量数据且难以处理间断的问题
summary_zh.method: 结合间断伽辽金法与神经网络，最小化弱形式残差实现无数据训练
summary_zh.result: 在一维和二维问题中准确恢复间断，泛化能力强且收敛可靠
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证收敛性和间断恢复能力

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the data hunger and poor handling of discontinuities in traditional operator learning for parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: A data-free operator learning framework that minimizes the residual of a DG-based weak formulation using a neural network to predict element-wise solution coefficients.
summary_en.result: Accurate recovery of discontinuities, strong generalization across parameter space, and reliable convergence rates on 1D and 2D problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE problems with discontinuous coefficients and non-smooth solutions.

title: Ribbon-shaped microgels as bioinks for 3D bioprinting of anisotropic tissue structures

why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it focuses solely on material development and biological characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有球形微凝胶生物墨水只能打印各向同性组织，无法模拟天然组织的各向异性结构。
summary_zh.method: 开发了刚度可调的带状微凝胶（μRB）作为生物墨水，通过挤出打印实现细胞定向排列。
summary_zh.result: μRB生物墨水保持良好打印性，挤出时定向排列，并促进间充质干细胞成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞培养和共聚焦显微镜验证细胞排列与成骨分化。

summary_en.motivation: Current spherical microgel bioinks produce isotropic tissues, failing to recapitulate the anisotropy of native tissues.
summary_en.method: Ribbon-shaped microgels (μRBs) with tunable stiffness were developed as bioinks for extrusion-based bioprinting, enabling cell alignment during printing.
summary_en.result: μRB bioinks maintained printability, aligned during extrusion, and promoted mesenchymal stromal cell osteogenesis with increasing stiffness.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture with confocal imaging confirmed cell alignment and osteogenic differentiation.

title: Physics-Informed Gaussian Process Regression for the Constitutive Modeling of Concrete: A Data-Driven Improvement to Phenomenological Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息高斯过程回归用于混凝土本构建模，其方法可迁移至生物力学中植入物或骨骼的材料模型替代。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks FEA surrogate for structural mechanics, and has no uncertainty quantification for implant performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 混凝土经验本构模型缺乏灵活性和不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 用物理约束高斯过程回归替代经验失效面，保留弹塑性结构。
summary_zh.result: 物理约束GPR在插值和外推时均优于无约束版本，预测区间更紧。
summary_zh.validation: 三轴压缩实验数据训练，不同围压水平测试泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: Empirical concrete constitutive models lack flexibility and uncertainty quantification, motivating a data-driven improvement.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Gaussian process regression replaces the empirical failure surface while preserving the modular elastoplastic structure of the KCC model.
summary_en.result: The constrained GPR achieves better accuracy and tighter confidence intervals under extrapolation compared to unconstrained GPR.
summary_en.validation: Trained on triaxial compression data and evaluated at unseen confinement levels to assess generalization.

title: Fast Conformal Prediction using Conditional Interquantile Intervals

why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling or biomechanical design, and lacks validation on engineering simulation datasets.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有分布共形预测方法计算效率低或对偏态分布处理不佳。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于条件分位区间的共形回归方法CIR和CIR+，利用黑箱模型估计分布并构建紧凑预测区间。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实数据集上，方法在预测精度和计算效率之间取得最优平衡。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个合成和真实数据集上与现有方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing distributional conformal prediction methods suffer from high computational cost or poor handling of skewed distributions.
summary_en.method: We propose Conformal Interquantile Regression (CIR) and its enhanced version CIR+, which leverage black-box models to estimate outcome distributions via interquantile ranges and construct compact prediction intervals.
summary_en.result: Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show that our methods achieve an optimal balance between predictive accuracy and computational efficiency.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on multiple synthetic and real-world datasets against existing conformal prediction approaches.

title: Spatio-temporal modeling and forecasting with Fourier neural operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的FNO方法可用于替代昂贵有限元模拟，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计约束。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics application, no constraint handling, only PDE surrogate without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统时空统计模型难以捕捉复杂动态过程，需高效替代模型。
summary_zh.method: 利用傅里叶神经算子学习偏微分方程解算子，构建动态时空统计模型。
summary_zh.result: 在非线性PDE模拟和真实海温、降水数据上，FNO预测准确且具备有效不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过已知解的非线性PDE模拟和两个真实数据集验证。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional spatio-temporal statistical models struggle with complex dynamic phenomena, motivating a more flexible and efficient surrogate.
summary_en.method: Fourier neural operators are employed to learn the solution operator of unknown PDEs, enabling efficient spatio-temporal forecasting.
summary_en.result: FNO-based dynamic spatio-temporal models achieve accurate forecasts with valid uncertainty quantification on both simulated and real-world datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via simulations from a nonlinear PDE with known solution and two real-world datasets (sea surface temperature and precipitation).

title: Latent Space Element Method

summary_zh.motivation: 解决代理求解器从小域训练到大域扩展的难题。

summary_en.motivation: To develop surrogate solvers that can be trained on small domains and scaled to larger ones without intrusive access to PDE operators.

summary_en.result: LSEM maintains predictive accuracy on 1D Burgers and Korteweg-de Vries equations while scaling to spatial domains larger than those in training.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of 1D nonlinear PDEs, demonstrating scalability and accuracy.

title: Efficient temporal prediction of compressible flows in irregular domains using Fourier neural operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文将傅里叶神经算子应用于不规则域中的可压缩流动时间预测，其方法可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。

title: Expanding the Chaos: Neural Operator for Stochastic (Partial) Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于Wiener混沌展开的神经算子方法，可高效求解随机微分方程，其不确定性量化能力可迁移至植入物力学代理模型中的随机性处理。

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解随机微分方程，替代传统蒙特卡洛方法。

summary_en.motivation: To develop efficient deep learning solvers for stochastic differential equations that can replace costly Monte Carlo simulations.
summary_en.method: Project driving noise onto orthonormal Wick-Hermite features via Wiener chaos expansion and parameterize the resulting chaos coefficients with neural operators.

summary_en.validation: Validated on standard SPDE benchmarks, diffusion one-step image sampling, topological graph interpolation, financial extrapolation, parameter estimation, and manifold SDE flood forecasting.

summary_en.motivation: Reliable temperature forecasting in Enhanced Geothermal Systems is hindered by the high computational cost of THM simulations and the lack of physics consistency in traditional decline curves and ML surrogates.

summary_en.motivation: To accurately model small crack growth in SLM Ti-6Al-4V for fatigue life prediction.
summary_en.method: An optimization-based approach using Nelder-Mead and SLSQP algorithms to calibrate a modified S-N curve model.
summary_en.result: The proposed model achieves high predictive capability (R²=99.28%), comparable to the traditional Basquin equation.
summary_en.validation: Validation against experimental fatigue data demonstrates the model's accuracy.
